mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/lo so drug pa lcags mo bya'i lo la rgyal po 'bras chang gsol nas gzims pa la sbas stag rna can dang cog ro lha lod gnyis kyis rgyal po ltag pa bskor nas bkrongs so/ /'di'i yan chad bod kyi lo rgyus thog skyid pa'i gdung rabs phyed dang bcu gsum dang shin tu skyid pa'i gdung rabs phyed dang lnga zer ro//de nas glang dar ma 'u dum btsan gyis rgyal srid du dbang bskur nas lo shas song bar dam chos bsnubs/ dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs las lo paṇa phal cher yul gzhan du bros/ ma byon pa rnams bkum/ rab byung phal cher 'dul ba'i sde snod las gsungs pa'i rtags dang bral zhing mi nyan pa rnams rngon pa byed du bcug gsung rab phal cher lha sa'i brag la sbas shing 'ga' zhig chu dang mer sbyangs/ rgyal po dgyes su re nas btsun pa chang 'thung ba yi gzugs brnyan bris zhes pa gsal ba dang chos khrims dang rgyal khrims thams cad nyams par byas pa'i rkyen gyis slob dpon thon mi'i gsung gi brda sprod bstan bcos gzhan rnams kyang nub/ bod kyi rigs gzhung la'ang gnod 'tshe chen po byung yod/ slob dpon thon mis mdzad pa'i bstan bcos brgyad yod pa las sum rtags gnyis tsam ma gtogs sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang chabs cig bsnubs/ gtsug lag khang mang po bshigs/ dpe cha rnams me la bsregs pa dang / chu la bskyur ba dang sa 'og tu gnon pa bcas byas phyir chos srid rig gnas de je sdug je sdug gis nyams smad du song / de nas mi ring bar glang dar ma lha lung dpal gyi rdo rjes bkrongs ba nas bzung mi lo sum brgya lhag tsam ring bod spyi la dbang ba'i rgyal po ma byung bar bod sil bur 'thor/ dbus gtsang khams kyi sa yi thig le 'dir nad 58

sangs rgyas chos lugs dar ba des bod kyi rig gnas la phan gnod ci byung gleng ba/yams dang / mu ge/ dmag 'khrug bcas gcig rjes gnyis mthud du byung nas rgya che'i bod 'bangs rnams brnag dka'i sdug bsngal gyi me mtsho'i nang du lhung nas spyi tshogs hril po kha 'thor ya bral gyi gnas su gyur/phyis su smad mdo khams kyi phyogs nas bstan pa phyi dar gyi me kha gsos pa dang stod mnga' ris phyogs nas gu ge rgyal po lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis rgya gar nas a ti shas gtsos paṇ+ḍi ta mang po bod du spyan drangs te bstan pa phyi dar gyi 'go brtsams/ bod kyi mkhas grub du ma rgya gar yul du byon nas tshad ldan bla ma mang po spyi bor bsten te gsung rab rgya mtsho chen po'i pha rol du son cing gzhan 'dring mi 'jog pa'i skad gnyis smra ba chags te/ bod du sngags kyi bstan pa dar bar byas pa dang rgya bod gtsug lag ji snyed thogs med du gzigs pa'i blo gros kyi rtsal yongs su rdzogs te bod gangs can gyi ljongs su rig pa'i gnas chen lnga dar rgyas su btang nas 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi srol rgyun bstan pa snga dar dus las lhag pa byung /dus rabs bar ma 'di'i ring bod kyi zhing 'dir grub mtha' tha dad pa du ma dar zhing / nang don rig pa dang / sgra rig pa 'di gnyis gtsor byas pa'i rig gzhung gtsug lag gnyis shin tu dar che ba'i dus rabs shig yin no//bstan pa snga dar dang phyi dar dus kyi zhib phra'i lo rgyus dpe rgyun gzhan nas shes thub/ 'dir rnam pa 'ga' zhig la dbye na gong smros sangs rgyas chos lugs dar ba de bod kyi rig gnas la phan gnod ci byung min gyi bgo skal yin pas 'di dag 'chad par spro/59

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/dang po/ dpar 'debs bya bas gangs can rigs gzhung dar rgyas su btang /rgyal ba'i gsung rab dang bstan bcos mang po zhig legs sbyar gyi skad nas bod yig tu bsgyur ba dang bod kyi lo paṇa rnams kyis kyang rang mi rigs kyi skad yig gi thog nas gsar rtsom gnang ba rnams lag bri kho nar ma lus par phyi rabs bstan 'gro'i phan bde kho nar dmigs te de dag legs bsgrigs dpar bskrun gyi sgo 'phar yangs par phye ba'i mgo brtsams/de'ang bod rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyi dus la lo tsā ba ska ba dpal brtsegs sogs kyis pho brang ldan dkar na bzhugs pa'i bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur rnams phyogs bsgrigs gnang ste (dkar chag ldan dkar ma 〉 zhes pa brtsams gnang ba ni kha ba'i ljongs 'dir bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur phyogs bsgrigs byas pa'i lo rgyus thog ma yin/ de rjes char rjes smyug rtsa rgyas pa bzhin byung mod kyang dus rabs bco lnga'i 'go stod bar du bka' 'gyur bris ma sha stag las dpar ma med/rab byung bdun pa'i sa byi (spyi lo 1408)lor ming rgyal rabs kyi gong ma yung lis rje tsong kha pa rgya nag tu gdan drangs pa'i sku tshab tu byams chen chos rje shākya ye shes gtong gnang mdzad de pe cin du yun ring bzhugs/yung li lo dgu pa (spyi lo 1411)lor gong ma yung lis nan cing du bod yig gi bka' 'gyur dpar gzhi thog mar brkos te rgyal mkhar rtser dpar btab 60

sangs rgyas chos lugs dar ba des bod kyi rig gnas la phan gnod ci byung gleng ba/pa ni bod yig gi bka' 'gyur dpar du brkos pa thengs dang po yin/de rjes li thang mtshal dpar zer ba dang co ne bka' 'gyur sogs byung ba dang lhag par du rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i lcags khyi (spyi lo 1730)lor srid skyong chen po pho lha ba bsod nams stobs rgyal gyis sbyin bdag gnang ste mtshal pa'i bka' 'gyur la gzhi bzung nas shel dkar mi 'gyur rdo rje rdzong gi 'dab rol par khang bden bzhi'i chos 'khor du bka' 'gyur cha tshang dpar du brkos nas snar thang dgon par bzhag pa ni cha tshang shos su mngon/ der snar thang bka' 'gyur zer/gzhan yang bod yig gi bstan 'gyur cha tshang bsgrigs pa ni gong gsal snar thang bka' 'gyur dang chabs cig phyogs bsgrigs byas pa yin la bod rab byung drug pa'i shing khyi (spyi lo 133grulor zha lu'i sku zhang kun dga' don grub kyis sbyin bdag gnang ba dang bu ston rin po ches zhus dag gnang ba'i bstan 'gyur cha tshang zhig bzhengs pa zha lu'i gser khang gtsug lag khang du bzhugs/ der bu ston rin po ches (bka' 'gyur gyi dkar chag yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po'i phreng ba 〉zhes pa'i dkar chag mdzad/ bu ston rin po che'i gsung 'bum /pa1pa'i nang 'khod yod/ de'i rjes su bstan 'gyur cha tshang ba'i dpe rgyun mang che ba snar thang dang zha lu'i bstan 'gyur la ma dpe byas nas bzhengs srol chags/bka' bstan 'gyur gnyis cha tshang ba'i dpe yod gshis/ phyis su rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me sbrul (spyi lo 1737)lor sde dge rgyal po bstan pa tshe ring gis bstan 'gyur cha tshang par brkos te bzhag par sde dge bstan 'gyur 61

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/zer ba dang / yang rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i lcags bya (spyi lo 1741)lor bstan 'gyur cha tshang zhig dpar brkos gnang ste snar thang du bzhag par snar thang bstan 'gyur zer/ 〈dpal snar thang chos sde'i lo rgyus 〉zhes bya ba'i nang du 'khod par gzhigs na rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i me stag (spyi lo 1746)lor pho lha'i sras wang 'gyur med rnam rgyal gyis mdzad brgya dpag bsam 'khri shing gi thang ka'i par grangs 31dang rje tsong kha pa brgyad cu'i thang par ngo grangs 15brkos pa sogs 'gro phan gyi bya ba mang dag byas/ de rjes bod chol kha gsum gyi yul 'dir bka' bstan 'gyur sogs kyi dpar khang ji snyed cig snga rjes su btsugs/dpar skrun gyi bya ba gsar gtod rgya bskyed du btang ba des tha snyad rig pa'i gnas dang nang don rig pa'i gnas sogs shes bya'i gnas mtha' dag gra rgyas phun tshogs pa yar ngo'i zla ba'i dpal la 'gran ltar 'gro bar bsub med lo rgyus don snying ldan pa'i shugs rkyen thebs pa ste/ krung hwa mi rigs kyi gsar gtod bzhi las thang rgyal rabs kyi snga dus su krung go'i par brkos bya ba gsar gtod byas pa des mes po'i rgyal khab kyi snyan grags dang lo rgyus gong du 'phel bar phan 'bras nges can thon pa dang gnyis su ma mchis so/de rjes kyi dus rabs ring po'i nang dpar bskrun byas pa'i dpe rgyun khag nang skyes rabs dang / rgya bod chos 'byung / gzhung chen bka' pod lnga sogs sde snod gsum du 'dus pa rnams kyi brjod don gtsor byas nas skye 'gro rnams la 'jig rten 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs brjod nas nges 'byung gi bsam pa bskyed pa dang / 'di phyi'i legs tshogs kyi 'byung rtsa skyabs gsum gnas 62

sangs rgyas chos lugs dar ba des bod kyi rig gnas la phan gnod ci byung gleng ba/la bcol te thar lam la 'jug dgos pa'i brjod bya mang dag cig mchis/des mi rigs gzhan gyi rig gnas kyi snying bcud blangs nas rang mi rigs kyi rig gnas 'phel rgyas 'thus tshang du btang ba dang gcig mi rnams snying rje dang gzhan phan gyi thugs bskyed shed shugs che ru btang ba dang gnyis/gangs ljongs kyi skye 'gro rnams sangs rgyas kyi chos la blo kha phyogs te dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro bya rgyur sems khong nas bag chags shugs chen thebs pa dang gsum/ mkhas mchog dge 'dun chos 'phel gyi 'bel gtam las rnying pa thams cad lhar 'dzin/ gsar pa thams cad 'dre ru 'dzin zhes pa de ni da lta'i bar du rang re'i srol zhes pa ltar gsar skyes dngos po dang tshan rig lag rtsalartsogasar gtod bya rgyur shugs rkyen ngan pa thebs pa dang bzhi bcas phyogs 'di dag mthong dgos kyi/ de las ldog ste g.yag zha ldong gis rtswa bzas pa bzhin phyogs gcig mthong ste phyogs gzhan zhig ma mthong ba ni ma mthar yang rtsod sgrub dngos gtso smra ba zhig min/bod kyi rig pa'i gnas khag la chos lugs kyis 'bags med pa shin tu dkon te skabs de'i dmigs bsal gyi spyi tshogs lam lugs dang / dpal 'byor rmang gzhi/ steng gi bkod pa'i khyab khongs la gzhigs nas sangs rgyas chos lugs de thog mar dar ba dang bar du gnas pa la brten nas lam lugs der zhabs 'degs zhu ba dang de'i khyad 'phags yon tan brjod pa dag dpar skrun byas pa mang / dper na/ deng gi spyi tshogs ring lugs lam lugs kyi gzhung thig 'di dang mthun pa'i rtsom sna tshogs dpar skrun bya rgyu dang mtshungs shing / 'di gnyis ngo bo'i thog khyad par che tsam las rnam pa'i thog 63

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/gnyis su gyes pa'i cha mi mngon snyam/ gong smros dag gis sdom tshig bstan par bka' bstan 'gyur dpar brkos par bskrun bya bas bod kyi rigs gzhung sngon thon can du gtong rgyur phan 'bras nges can thob pa de bsnyon med dang /sangs rgyas chos lugs dang bod kyi rig gnas de nya chu lta bu'i 'brel ba yod pa ra sprad pa yin/ de'i thad rgyal po glang dar mas bstan pa ma bsnubs gong bod du bstan bcos brgyad yod par grags pa dang bstan pa phyi dar gyi dus gang dang gang lhag yod min lo rgyus kyis nga tshor blo sgo de bas gsal ba zhig 'byed nus snyam mo//gnyis pa/ skad gsar bcad kyis bod skad yig gcig gyur dang 'gyur dag par btang /skad gsar bcad ces pa ni yi ge'i 'bri klog mi bde ba dang mkhas pa so so'i rang 'dod ltar bris pa'i brda rnying gi 'bri lugs dper na myig dmar stsogs zhes pa lta bu mig dmar sogs zhes par zor yang du btang ba dang legs sbyar skad bod skad du bsgyur rgyur gcig gyur gtan la phab par zer/spyir bod yig 'dir skad gsar bcad chen po thengs gsum byung ste/ de'ang skad gsar bcad dang po ni dus rabs bdun pa'i dkyil du lo tsā ba thon mi sam bho ṭas gtsos mkhas pa rnams kyis gtan la phab pa'i dag cha la'o/ /de nas mnga' bdag khri ral pa can gyis srid dbang ma bzung ba'i bar dang lo tsā ba ska cog zhang gsum ma byon gyi lo brgya dang brgyad cu'i bar gyi yi ge'i dag 64

sangs rgyas chos lugs dar ba des bod kyi rig gnas la phan gnod ci byung gleng ba/byed la bod kyi lo rgyus thog skad gsar bcad dang po zer/dus rabs dgu pa'i 'gor mnga' bdag khri ral pa can gyi ring la lo tsā ba ska cog zhang gsum gyis dag bcos byas te gtan la phab nas lo chen rin chen bzang po ma byon bar la lo rgyus thog skad gsar bcad bar ma zer/mnga' bdag khri ral pa'i skabs kyi skad gsar bcad ni rgya che la zhib phra che shos shig yin/ rgyal po 'dis bkas bcad gsum mdzad de 'dul ba gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba'i sde las gzhan pa'i sde pa dag gi sde snod mi bsgyur bar bkas bcad/ gsang sngags ma rgyud rnams ma bsgyur cig ces pa bkas bcad/ skad gsar bcad kyi bkas bcad pa ste gsum mo/ /'dir skad gsar bcad byas tshul dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs las nyi 'og gi mkhan po dzi na mi tra/ su ren tā bo rnyi/ dzha na shī la sogs pa paṇ+ḍi ta du ma dang lo tsā ba ska cog sogs gdan 'dzoms par byas te sngar yab mes kyi ring la mdo sngags kyi chos phal cher bsgyur zin na'ang yul dbus 'gyur/ o rgyan/bal yul/ rgya nag sogs skad du ma la brten nas 'gyur ba'i bod skad la bsgyur ma btub pa 'ga' zhig so so'i rang skad du bzhag pas go dka' zhing brda rnying dang sdeb sbyor 'ga' zhig la brten nas 'gyur mi bde ba dang klog dka' zhing legs sbyar gyi skad dang mi mthun pa rnams dbus 'gyur gyi rgya dpe saṃskrata'i lugs gzhir byas pa rnams dang sgo bstun zhes gsal/ de'i dus lo paṇa rnams 'tshogs nas gtan la phab pa'i lugs bzhin bsgyur dgos pa las so so nas 'chos shing ming gsar du 'dogs su ma bcug par/ nges par du chos kyi gzhung dang sgra'i lugs las ji skad 'byung ba ltar bsgyur dpe sna tshogs 65

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/kyi tha snyad gcig gyur skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab nas bsgyur ba thams cad dag par byas shing / don rtogs bde ba'i ched don 'gyur gtso bor byas/ de mtshungs bstan pa snga dar gyi skabs su sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab rnams bod skad du phab pa la sde snod gsum so sor ngos 'dzin sla ba'i ched du chos kyi rgyal po rnams kyis bkas bcad de lo chen gsum gyi dus su 'dul ba'i sde snod kyi dbur thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo zhes dang mdo sde'i sde snod kyi dbur sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dam dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo zhes dang / mngon pa'i sde snod kyi dbur 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa gtan la phab par mdzad/ thengs de'i skad gsar bcad kyis dag byed dang /bod yig gi rnam dbye tshig phrad/ tha snyad/ gsung rab sogs kyi bsgyur lugs la lo rgyus rang bzhin ldan pa'i shugs rkyen thebs yod/ skad gsar bcad bar ma de ji ltar byas tshul/ bstan 'gyur gras su zhugs pa'i sgra sbyor bam gnyis dang bye brag rtogs byed kyi bstan bcos la gsal bas 'dir zhib mor dpyad pa'i ngal ba spangs/skad gsar bcad tha ma ni lo chen rin chen bzang po dang rngog lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab gnyis kyi man chad dus rabs bcu pa'i mjug tu byung ba nas dus rabs bco lnga pa'i 'gor zha lu lo tsā ba chos skyong bzang po byung ba'i bar la lo bzhi brgya dang bdun cu lhag tsam song / de'i ring la 〈chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston 〉lo paṇa 'byung ba la gzhigs na lo tsā ba brgya dang drug cu re bdun tsam byung zhing / bod yig gi dag cha rim pas bcos pa la lo rgyus 66

sangs rgyas chos lugs dar ba des bod kyi rig gnas la phan gnod ci byung gleng ba/thog skad gsar bcad tha ma zer/de skabs kyi skad gsar bcad ji ltar byas tshul ni dus rabs bco lnga par skyogs ston smon grub lo tsā bas mdzad pa'i (bod kyi skad las gsar rnying brda'i khyad par ston pa legs bshad li shi'i gur khang 〉 zhes par zhib par gsal bas spyan dkyus kyi gzigs rgya yangs pa'i mkhas pa rnams kyis dpyad gzhir 'tshal/lo rgyus thog skad gsar bcad gsum byas pa des mi rigs gzhan gyi skad yig dang bod kyi skad yig shan ma phye bar brda rnying lta bur rang sor bzhag pa dang / legs sbyar gyi skad zur chag pa/ bod skad nyid ma dag pas brda rnying du 'khrul ba/ dam chos bsgyur tha dad pa sogs ma dag rgyun 'byams mang po zhig dag bcos dang legs bsgrigs gtan la phab par brten phyis su dag cha dang / 'gyur yig rnam dbye tshig phrad sogs gcig gyur yong bar phan nus nges can zhig thon pa lo rgyus yig tshang man shel lta bu'i ngos nas gsal/ rgyu mtshan de'i phyir thog mar mdo rgyud bstan bcos rnams lo paṇa tshos bod skad du bsgyur skabs ming tshig sogs tha dad pa rnams rgyal po'i bkas bcad nas legs bcos byas pa dang / de dang mnyam du bod kyi rig gnas ni sangs rgyas chos lugs dang 'dres nas bsdad yod stabs/ skabs de dang khor yug de lam lugs de dang de'i dngos yod gnas tshul gyi cha rkyen 'og sangs rgyas chos kyi dar rgud dang bod kyi rig gnas zhes pa'i dar rgud de gnyis snod bcud kyi 'brel ba lta bu zhig yin pa las chos lugs dor ba'i rig gnas zhes pa rkyang pa zhig phal cher med par kho bos mngon no//67

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/gsum pa/ a lce lha mo'i 'khrab rgyun dar bas gangs can lha mo'i zlos gar gyi sgyu rtsal 'phel rgyas su btang ba/bod kyi lha mo'i zlos gar gyi skor 'dir brjod gzhi gtsor ma mchis kyang de'i nang don dang 'phel rim kyi lhu tshigs gzhan zhig gi thog nas gtso don 'dir mtshon byed kyi nus pa thon nges par snyam nas sug 'bri cung zad bya bar spro/bod kyi lha mo'i zlos gar zhes pa ni grub thob lcags zam pa brtson 'grus bzang po zhes pas bu mo spun bdun sgrig 'dzugs gnang ste bod rigs kyi dmangs khrod glu gar gyi rmang gzhi'i thog dus rabs bcu bzhi pa'i nang a lce lha mo'i zlos gar gsar gtod mdzad de lha yul dri za'i bu mo bdun bod yul 'dzin ma'i khyon 'dir 'phos pa bzhin gar 'khrab pa'i 'go brtsams pas na 'dra ba rgyu mtshan du byas nas lha mo zhes pa'i tha snyad btags/tshad mtho'i sgyu rtsal gyi rnam pa la brten nas lo rgyus dang / lha sgrung ston pa'i mdzad rjes/ gnyen gcugs mdza' mthun byung ba'i skor bcas mtshon pa'i bod du yongs grags 'khrab gzhung brgyad tsam byung / de las sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi mdzad brgya dpag bsam 'khri shing yal 'dab brgya rtsa brgyad kyi bdag nyid las yal 'dab re bzhi pa 〈'khor ba la zhen cing 'ching bar byed pa'i zhen pa la yid 'byung ba'i sbyin pa chos skor 〉 nang du zur phyung 68

sangs rgyas chos lugs dar ba des bod kyi rig gnas la phan gnod ci byung gleng ba/ba'i chos rgyal nor bu bzang po'i rtogs brjod gzhir byas nas lha mo'i zlos gar 'khrab gzhung du bcos sgrig byas pa ni phar phyin drug las sbyin pa'i pha rol du phyin pa'i brjod bya gtso bor byas pa zhig yin pas/ da lta'i bar du nyams med par bod rigs ltad mo ba tshos shin tu lta bar dgyes pa'i zlos gar zhig tu gyur nas 'khrab mus lags/yang bod dang rgya gar bal yul sogs bar gnyen sgrig gi lo rgyus mtshon par byed pa'i lha mo'i zlos gar gyi 'khrab gzhung (rgya bza' bal bza' 〉 zhes pa dang / de bzhin gtsang myang stod rgyal rtse'i khul du dngos su byung ba'i lo rgyus kyi ltad mo'i zlos gar gyi 'khrab gzhung (snang sa 'od 'bum 〉 zhes pa dang bod yul mon rta dbang khul du byung ba'i gtam rgyud zlos gar 〈mkha' 'gro ma 'gro ba bzang mo 〉 la sogs ni bod du byung ba'i zlos gar 'khrab gzhung yin zhing / rgya gar gna' bo'i gtam rgyud las byung ba'i lha mo'i zlos gar gyi 'khrab gzhung ni gzugs kyi nyi ma/ dri med kun ldan/ rgyal po sprin gyi bzhon pa/ gcung don yod don grub sogs yin/ de dag gis mtshon bya'i don dang gtam rgyud nang gi mi sna'i zhi drag sdang khro'i dgos mkhor gzhigs te gar gyi nyams dgu tshang ba'i thog nas ltad mo bar gzugs brnyan gson nyams kyis mtshon par byas par ltad mo ba'i spro ba bsrings ba dang / bod mi rigs kyi zlos gar gyi sgyu rtsal ni gzhan 'dring 'jog mi dgos par gnang thub pa'i lo rgyus kyi don snying ldan pa 'di'ang shing rta'i srol 'byed mkhan po rnams kyi drin du sems/'o na 'khrab gzhung 'di dag la lha sgrung dang / chos kyi bag chags yod 69

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/dam med zer na/ los kyang yod/ rgyu mtshan ni/ skabs de'i spyi tshogs kyi gnas babs dang khor yug gi cha rkyen/ mi rnams kyi blo kha phyogs yul bcas sangs rgyas chos dang 'dres nas gnas yod pa dang dam chos de mi rnams kyi sems khongs la bye ma'i nang chu blugs pa ltar sim pas so/ /des na 'dis bod kyi rig gnas sgyu rtsal la phan gnod ci byung zhe na thog mar bod kyi rig rtsal skyed tshal yangs por rnam par bkra ba'i lha mo'i zlos gar gyi me tog bzhad pas/ bod mi rigs kyi rig gnas dang sgyu rtsal 'tsho ba phun tshogs su btang ba gzhir byas/ skabs de dang de'i dus kyi las skal gyi dbang gis gnyen sgrig gi gtam rgyud yin na'ang 'dra lo rgyus kyi zlos gar yin na'ang 'dra tshang mar phyin drug spyod pa'i bzha' rlan gyis ma gsher ba ma mchis te/ gna' rabs dang deng rabs rgyal khab phyi nang du su'i rig rtsal yin yang de ni lam lugs de'i srid dang 'byor la zhabs 'degs zhu ba'i lag char gyur pa bzhin bod kyi lha mo'i zlos gar de yang dngos po spyi'i gnas lugs las tha dad ma mchis/ gson nyams ldan pa'i mi sna'i gzugs brnyan dang / thun mong min pa'i mi rigs rang gi sgyu rtsal rang gshis ldan pa de dag gis bod kyi rig gnas khyab khongs la sman pa'i lo rgyus rang bzhin ldan phyir deng gi dus 'dir 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed dgos pa ni gnad dam pa'o//70

sangs rgyas chos lugs dar ba des bod kyi rig gnas la phan gnod ci byung gleng ba/bzhi pa/ zab don mdzes rtsal gyis mtshon par byas pa'i skor/spyi lo dus rabs bco lnga pa'i dus 'gor bod kyi sangs rgyas chos lugs de dar rgyas ches cher phyin te sa skya dang / dge lugs/ rnying ma gsum gtsor byas pa'i grub mtha' tha dad pa snga rjes su mang bar thon/ de nas dgon sde'i dpal 'byor gyi ma lag dang dge 'dun pa'i 'tsho rten gyi 'byung khungs la rim pas 'gyur ldog byung ste spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu gcig dang bcu gnyis pa'i rjes la mchod gzhis dang / zhing bran/ nags tshal/ 'brog thang / chos byed mi sna'i 'tsho rten la dpal 'byor gyi sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen nges can yod pa'i dbang gis chos byed mi sna je mang du 'phel ba dang chabs cig bla ma'i yang srid lam lugs kyi 'go brtsams/ dpal 'byor dang lo rgyus 'phel rim gyi phan yod cha rkyen de dag gis dgon sde gsar bskrun dang rgya bskyed/ sku gsung thugs rten bzhengs pa'i 'phrin las gra rgyas su phyin te bod kyi 'dzin ma'i khyon 'dir gdan sa ji snyed bskrun/ dgon sde de tsho ni sa dpyad shin tu legs pa'i steng mi rigs gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos kyi bkod pas bzhengs yod/ dper na 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir grags pa'i ba dan lhab lhub g.yo ba'i gru 'dzin gnyis pa dang / bkra shis lhun gyi grub pa'i gling / nor gling / se 'bras dge gsum sogs kyi bzo skrun lag rtsal ni bod rigs mi dmangs kyi sgyu rtsal dang blo gros kyi snying bcud yin pas krung hwa 71

mig dmar tshe ringahogi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi gna' shul rig gnas dngos rdzas kyi 'gangs che'i rigs su nges/ de dag gi ldebs su bod rigs lha bzo pa rnams kyis bris pa'i ldebs ris ni lta bas chog mi shes pa dang dpyad pas dpog dka' ba yod/ 'dir kho bos brjod bya'i snying po dang 'brel yod mtshon byed tsam zhus na/1zirtsa che'i lo rgyus mtshon pa'i ldebs ris ni/ mu 'brel ri mo gcig gi thog nas lo rgyus mi sna'i 'gangs che'i mdzad rjes bstan pa ni thun mong min pa'i sgyu rtsal zhig yin te/ de dag gi nang nas khyad du 'phags pa ni rgya bza' bod du phebs skabs bod mis bsu ba byas pa'i rnam pa dang de rjes jo khang bzhengs tshul mtshon pa'i gtsug lag khang gi ldebs ris de yin/ de'i steng spyi lo 641lor rgya bza' kong jo bod du phebs te klung shod la 'byor skabs khrom srang du chibs rags bsgrigs pa dang / gzab mchor rab tu spras te glu gar la ci dgar rol ba dang rtsal rtsed sna tshogs rtsed pa sogs bod 'bangs kyis sems rtsa 'khol ba'i ngang dga' bsu zhus pa'i rnam pa mtshon gyi yod pa red/de bzhin chu 'brug(spyi lo 1652)lor gong ma shun rtsis gdan drangs pa ltar rgyal dbang sku phreng lnga pa rgyal sa pe cin du phebs 'byor gyis mchod yon zhal 'dzoms gnang te/ gong ma chen pos gser yig dang gser gyi tham ga skad rigs bzhi'i yi ge shan sbyar ba'i 'bru don7‘nub phyogs kyi phul byung zhi ba sangs rgyas rgya chen khyon la sangs rgyas bstan pa'i mnga' bdag thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje 'chang tā la'i bla ma'i tham ga ’zhes 'khod pa'i 'ja' sa dang bcas pa bstsal ba mtshon pa'i ldebs ris ni pho brang nor bu gling khar bzhugs 72

sangs rgyas chos lugs dar ba des bod kyi rig gnas la phan gnod ci byung gleng ba/pa de yin/ de dag ni sgyu rtsal dang / skabs de'i lo rgyus mtshon pa'i ldebs ris yin pa las chos don gyi dri g.ya' bgos pa'i rigs e yin snyam/2risangs rgyas chos kyi brjod don mtshon pa ni/ sku brnyan so so'i zhi drag gi ngo bor brten nas bod rigs lha bri bas dpe gzhung gzhir bzung ste sgyu rtsal gyi steng nas brjod bya'i nang don dang snang stong sgyu ma'i 'phrul mtshon pa'i ldebs ris dgon sde khag nang mtha' yas pa zhig mchis/ 'dir mtshon byed tsam zhus na/ gtsang bkras lhun dgon du gnas pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mdzad brgya mtshon pa'i ldebs ris des/ mu 'brel ri mo'i thog nas ston pas dang por byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed bar du bdud bzhi bcom nas sangs rgyas pa rtsa ba byas te phar phyin drug la slob tshul gyi rnam thar dang / mthar sems can gyi don mdzad rnam pa sogs yod pa ni zhib tshags la tshad mtho'i sgyu rtsal gyi rang bzhin ldan pa yin te/ mkhyen ldan rnams kyi gzigs na nang don dang rnam pa gcig tu 'brel ba'i bod mi rigs kyi khyad chos dang sgyu rtsal mtshon pa'i mdzes rtsal zhig go/gzhan yang ser skya rnams spro skyid gling gtong byed pa'i rnam pa mtshon byed dang / dkyil 'khor/ bod kyi mdzangs blon bdun mtshon pa'i ri mo dang /sman dpyad mkhas can/ grub thob pa sogs mtshon pa'i ldebs ris mang po zhig mchis pas/ bod rigs sa gnas kyi dgon sde khag gi ldebs ris yongs rdzogs ni chos la zhabs 'degs dang chos kho na dril bsgrags rgyun 'dzin byed yas kyi dngos po zhig min zhing / de ni mi rigs rang gi dmigs bsal khyad yon ldan pa'i sgyu rtsal zhig dang / bod kyi rig gnas rgyun 'dzin dang 'phel 73

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/rgyas gtong bar gzhan dang bsdur ya med pa zhig yin pa bltos bcas kyi lta ba 'dzin mkhan lus can pa tshos mthong mod snyam/lnga pa/ gangs can mkhas grub skar tshogs lta bu byon pa'i gnas/bod zhi bas bcings 'grol ma btang gong bod kyi zhing khams 'dir rig pa'i gnas la sbyang ba'i gnas ni phal cher dgon sde khag dang / rtse slob grwa/sman rtsis khang tsam las med/ 'byor ldan khyim bdag so sos dge rgan gdan 'dren zhus nas sger btsugs kyi slob grwa yod rung grangs 'bor shin tu nyung /gzhung chen bka' pod lnga dang tha snyad rig pa'i gnas la 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum bgyis te mkhas pa'i go 'phang thob pa mang che ba ni dgon sde khag nas thon pa sha stag red/ de dag ngo ma yin min ni nye ba'i lo rgyus la gzigs na shes thub/ dpe mtshon tsam mtshams 'byor zhus na rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag la mkhyen pa mthar son pa rje yab sras gsum dang / gung thang dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me/ kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa/ rgyal dbang sku phreng lnga pa sogs rgyal dbang rim byon dngul chu darma bha dra/ sa paṇa kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ bu ston rin po che/ mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang / zha lu lo tsā ba sogs lo paṇa nam mkha'i skar tshogs ltar byon pa'i gnas ni chos sde chen po khag yin/ mkhas grub de dag gi gzhal med thugs rje'i byin rlabs rnam thar dang / chos 'byung / brda gzhung / mgur glu/74

sangs rgyas chos lugs dar ba des bod kyi rig gnas la phan gnod ci byung gleng ba/legs bshad kyi bstan bcos/ brtsams sgrung / bsgyur rtsom/ tshad ma rig pa sogs rig pa'i gnas bcu phrag gcig gi nang don du phyes pa'i 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo 'phar yangs par phye ste/ skal bzang skye bo'i mig lam du longs su spyod rgyu byung ba ni sngon byon mkhas dbang rnams kyi drin yin no/ /rgyu mtshan de'i phyir/ de yang gnad la 'phigs pos brjod na skabs de'i dgon sde ni rig gnas slob sa'i slob grwa chen mo yin la chos byed pa'i nang bstan gyi slob grwa'ang yin pa'i gcig bsdus rang bzhin gyi slob grwa zhig yin/ thal cha che tsam gyis brjod na bod kyi snga rabs kyi grags can mkhas pa phal che ba dgon sde khag nas byung ba yin la/ bod kyi rig gnas 'phel 'byung gi gnas gzhi'ang dgon sde khag yin/ gong smos phal che ba zhes pas skya bo'i khrod du gnas pa'i mkhas pa 'ga' shas ming med du btang ba min pas sbugs 'thum ma mdzod cig 'o na skabs de'i spyi tshogs dang lo rgyus 'phel rim gyi gnas tshul 'og kla klo'i gnas nas grol te shes rig ldan pa'i mi rigs shig yin par ngos 'dzin rung yang tshan rig dar rgyas che ba'i deng gi dus 'dis bltas na lo rgyus gong du 'phel ba dang rig gnas dar rgyas che ru gtong bar bkag rgya nges can byas yod/ skabs der dgon sde dang sku drag nyung shas kyi mi rigs hril po'i rig gnas sger sdem byas te bod 'bangs mang che bar rig gnas slob pa'i go skabs dang bral ba yin/ phyogs gzhan zhig nas rig gnas slob gso'i sgrig gzhi dang slob gso'i gzhi rgya ris med kyis shes bya sbyang rgyur tshod 'dzin nges can thebs te bod kyi yul 'dir yig rmongs pa shin tu mang ba'i ngan 'bras tshabs chen yin pa 'di'ang mthong thub pa byed dgos 75

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/snyam/sangs rgyas chos lugs ni bod kyi spyi tshogs dang/ dpal 'byor/ lo rgyus 'phel rim nges can zhig gi 'og tu dar ba dang / des bod kyi rig gnas la phan gnod ci byung min thad la'ang lo rgyus dngos gtso smra ba dang /gcig nas gnyis su gyes pa'i lta stangs spyad nas gdeng 'jog nges can yo 'khyor med pa zhig byed dgos pa las phyogs gcig gis phyogs gzhan zhig bkab na mi 'grig snyam/ gnad don 'di'i thad kho bo'i rmongs brtul gyi bsam par sangs rgyas chos lugs dar ba des skabs de'i bod kyi spyi tshogs lam lugs dang mi rnams kyi 'du shes 'dzin stangs/ dpal 'byor rmang gzhi bcas dang bstun nas lo rgyus kyi cha rkyen nges can 'og rig gnas 'phel rgyas 'gro bar phan thogs nges can byung ba gzhi ra byed pa dang chabs cig des rig gnas kyi 'tsho ba mi gtsang ba dang / slob gso khyab chung ba/ ris med slob gso myong bar gnod pa nges can byung ba khas len dgos/ de'ang chos gang rung rten 'brel gyi rtsa ba yin gshis/ sangs rgyas chos lugs bod la dar ba des bod kyi rig gnas la phan gnod ci byung min gyi gnad don 'di'i thad la'ang tshangs thig dmigs bsal gang yang ma mchis so snyam/76

bod yig gi rtsom gzhung skor gleng ba/gleng gzhi/kha cig gis bod yig la rtsom 'bri'i rigs pa'i gzhung lugs shig gtan nas med pas de'i thad kyi 'khrid rgyun kyang med par bzhed pa dang / 'ga' shas kyis rgya yig gi rtsom 'bri'i gzhung lugs de tshur bod yig la thad bsgyur dang don bsgyur sor bzhag gang 'thus kyis bsgyur nas bod yig rtsom 'bri'i gzhung lugs ma lag dang bcas pa cha tshang zhig chags na ci dga' snyam pa'i 'dun pa bskyed/ la las bod yig byung nas da bar lo chig stong sum brgya lhag tsam phyin yod mod/ rtsom 'bri'i gzhung lugs ces pa ched du 'khrid srol med rung gang ltar sum rtags dag gsum dang snyan ngag rob tsam shes na rtsom 'bri bar thogs pa med par bstan bcos po ti long ba brtsams pa mang bar mngon par dgongs pa phyogs/ kha shas kyis rgya yig la rtsom 'bri'i gzhung lugs 'di lta bu zhig yod pa bzhin bod yig la'ang rang gi khyad chos dang mthun pa'i rtsom 'bri'i gzhung lugs shig nges can yod par nges na'ang bsil bur gyur nas phyogs bsdus kyi gzhung lugs 'di dang 'di yin zhes pa'i rnam gzhag cig chags med par dgongs nas lam mdo 'gro ldog ma shes par nyi mas zla ba dang zla bas lo bskyal nas 'das pa'i lo rgyus kyi rnam gzhag shig me long gi ngos su gzugs brnyan bzhin kho bo'i snang ngor 'char/ 77

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/'dir da lta dpyad nas ma 'ongs par blo kha phyogs pa dang / rnying zhen ring du dor nas gsar 'dzugs kyi rig pa spel ba'i rdzogs ldan skal bzang gi 'dus tshogs thog brjod gzhi 'di'i gleng 'go btsugs nas 'brel yod sde khag dang mkhas mchog rnam pas dpyad gsum gnang ste/ yang snying brjod gzhi 'di slad mar rkang pa tshugs 'pher min thad dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang ste rgya mtshor rdo dbyugs su mi 'gro ba'i 'dun pa dang sbrags/ skal mnyam rnams kyis de bas ma lag dang bcas phun sum tshogs pa'i rtsom 'bri'i gzhung lugs shig 'dzugs rgyur snon dbri'i legs bshad 'dren pa'i sngun bsu'i 'khar rnga brdung ba tsam las 'pher sha dod pa'i sngon med legs bshad min/rus sgrom tsam gyi gzhung lugs dngos min rus sgrom 'dis go 'pher ba'i re ba 'dug snyam pa'i dus tsa na rus 'ching dang bcas snod lnga don drug kha bskang na/da gzod rtsom 'bri'i gzhung lugs ma lag dang bcas pa zhig chags par gdon mi za'o//gsham du rang mi rigs la 'gro rgyugs 'pher thag chod pa dang / gzhan dang bsdur na mi dman pa'i rtsom 'bri'i gzhung lugs rnams shin tu bsdus pa'i tshig gis dran bskyed kyi tshul du brjod par spro ba 'phel/dang po/ snyan gzhung /lo tsā ba shong ston gyis 〈snyan ngag me long ma 〉 thog mar cha yongs su rdzogs pa bod yig tu bsgyur ba de nas bzung snyan ngag gi rtsom gzhung bod la thog mar dar ba red/ des na rtsom rigs yongs su rdzogs pa la mi mkho ba 78

bod yig gi rtsom gzhung skor gleng ba/med pa snyan ngag ni rje rin po ches sa steng rin po che rnam gsum gyi ya gyal du drangs nas bsngags brjod mdzad pa ltar lags/ da lta slob grwa che 'bring nang gzhung de 'khrid mus yin pas gzhung de'i nang don lus rgyan skyon sel gsum la 'du ba dang / lus la'ang tshig sbyor gyi thog nas tshigs bcad/ tshig lhug bcad lhug spel gsum du dbye ba dang rgyan la'ang don rgyan sgra rgyan gab tshig gi rgyan dang / skyon sel bcas su nges nas bshad 'khrid kyi gzhung chags yod pa de ni rtsom 'bri'i gzhung lugs zhib phra dang ldan pa zhig yod pas ma mthar yang don rgyan so lnga dang skyon sel sogs slob dgos pa'i gnad 'duga'ags na re/ (snyan gzhung me long ma 〉legs sbyar gyi skad nas bod skad du bsgyur nas 'khrid rgyun chags pa de bzhin da lta rgya yig gi (snyan ngag gi mdo 〉 dang de min ji bzhin brjod pa'i rtsom zhes pa dang / 'byin sgrub kyi rtsom zhes pa sogs kyang snyan gzhung de dang 'dra bar bsgyur nas bed spyod byas te bod yig gi rtsom rig phun tshogs dar rgyas su 'ong bar thugs dgongs kyi yod/'on kyang deng skabs der dad zhen phyogs pa'i skye bo ni shin tu nyung bar mngon/ de'i gnad 'gag thug sa ni sgyur rtsal la rag las par bsams/dper na sku zhabs lu'u shun gyi phyag rtsom (don chung gcig 〉 ces pa lta bu bod yig tu bsgyur dus de la rtsa che'i rin thang de tsam mi mngon pa lta bu dang /snyan ngag gi bstan bcos chen po 〈dpag bsam 'khri shing 〉 brgya rtsa brgyad kyi bdag nyid dang (sprin gyi pho nya 〉lta bu bsgyur rtsom yin rung / mi rigs 79

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/gzhan gyi skad yig gi shan ma zhugs par bod kyi mkhas pa zhig gis rang gi skad yig gi thog nas brtsams gnang bar ngo ma mngon pa ni lo tsā ba'i bsgyur rtsal la rag las par bsams/ der brten gzhung lugs gsar pa 'dzugs rgyur blo kha phyogs dgos la/ rang mi rigs kyi gzhung lugs mi nyams par cha tshang 'dzugs dgos pa ni bod yig gi rigs gzhung de blo kha gsum la phyogs/ pa'i sngon 'gro yin no//gnyis pa/ legs bshad/legs bshad rtsom lugs ni 'tsho ba dngos kyi zab don rnams shin tu go sla ba'i tshig sbyor gyis mtshon par byed pa'i rtsom lugs shig yin pas/ de'i rtsom stangs thad gtsor dpe dang dpe can zung du 'brel nas rtsom pa ni legs bshad rtsom lugs kyi ches mngon gsal dod pa'i khyad chos shig yin/ de'ang bod kyi yul du thog mar sa paṇa gyis gsar rtsom gnang ba dang / de nas char rjes spang sha rdol ba ltar thon pa'i nang tshan dus rabs bcu drug pa'i nang tsam la paṇa chen bsod nams grags pas mdzad pa'i (dge ldan legs bshad pad+ma dkar po'i chun po 〉 zhes pa dang / dus rabs bco brgyad pa tsam la gung thang bstan pa'i sgron mes mdzad pa'i (chu shing bstan bcos/〉 'ju mi pham rnam rgyal rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i 〈rgyal po lugs kyi bstan bcos sa gzhi skyong ba'i rgyan 〉 zhes pa sogs blang dor gyi gnas mi nor ba ston pa'i bstan bcos sha stag yin/ nang don khag la dbye na mkhas blun rnam 'byed skor dang /'phral yun gnyis kyi bde bar 'jug ldog byed pa'i khyad par/ rgyal khams 80

bod yig gi rtsom gzhung skor gleng ba/bde 'phung gi khyad par/ drin can la drin lan 'jal tshul gyi khyad par/dam tshig gtsang min gyi khyad par/ sbyang bya'i gnas rgya mtsho la brtson 'grus skya bas 'jug tshul gyi khyad par/ don la brtag ste 'jug ldog bya tshul gyi khyad par sogs brjod don de dag sho lo ka re re dpe dang dpe can zung du 'brel pa'i snyan ngag skabs kyi zla bo dngos po'i dpe'i thog nas rtsom pa po'i rnam dpyod blo gros kyi rtsal las byung ba'i legs bshad seng ge'i nga ros lugs dang lugs min dang / mkhas blun ma 'dzol ba'i rig pa'i rnam dpyod kyi sgo yangs 'byed nus pa'i rtsom rig cig yin pa de'ang rtsom stangs thad phal che ba tsheg bar bdun ma yin pas rjod byed kyi tshig nyung la brjod don rtogs sla ba dang gcig chu dang shing gi bstan bcos dang me'i bstan bcos lta bu don de sbyar gzhi dpe gcig la sbyar ba dang gnyis/ sho lo ka de'i tshig rkang phyed snga ma don dang phyed phyi ma dpe byas nas dpe don khal sde mgo spel byas pa dang gsum/ tshig rgyan dang mngon brjod brda rnying sogs nyung zhing bab chags go bde'i tshig gis 'tsho ba dngos gson rjen du mtshon pa'i nus pa ldan pa dang bzhi/ dpe de'ang lo rgyus mi sna dang rig byed kyi gtam rgyud/ srog chags kyi gtam rgyud sogs dang sbyar bas dpe'i 'dren khungs rgya che la gting zab pa bcas dang lnga/ lus ni tshigs bcad kho na yin pa las lhug pa dang spel ma gang rung min pa dang drug bcas re zhig khyad chos drug dang ldan pa'i rtsom lugs shig tu mngon gyi 'dug pas/ de'i thad kyi mtshan gzhi dpe brjod sngon byon mkhas dbang chos rje sa paṇa gyis gtsos brtsams gnang ba mang dag yod pas de dag nas drangs pa'i don med/ ngal dub dang du ma blangs pas de'i 81

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/thad kyi las skal srid gzhung gis ched bskos gnang ba'i sde khag dang mi sger gyis blang dor zhib 'jug phyogs bsdus kyi rtsom gzhung gi bye brag cig tu rkang pa btsugs na de'i byin rlabs 'gran zla bral ba 'ong bar gdon mi za ba rmongs blor 'char ro//gsum pa/ yig bskur rnam gzhagayul mchog dman bar gsum la dpags te che brjod dang / 'bebs sor che chung / yig lteb bya tshul gtsor byas pa'i 'phrin yig spel tshul gyi rnam gzhag ni nga tshos gsar rtsom bya mi dgos par sngon byon mkhas pa rnams kyis brtsams gnang ba rnams yod pas/ de ni bod yig la yod pa'i gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i dmigs bsal gyi rtsom lugs shig yin/ rgya yig gi rtsom gzhung nang du 'phrin yig ni spyir btang gi rgyun spyod yig rigs shig tu brtsis nas dang dod ha las mi byed pa dang ched du 'khrid pa'ang shin tu nyung / bod yig gi 'phrin yig spel thabs de rtsom gzhung gi nang don zhig tu bzhag nas 'khrid na de la yod pa'i khyad chos 'don spel byed thub pa dang / slad mar yang rtsom gzhung zhig chags nas rtsom rtsal 'pher bar phan pa che/ 'phrin yig gi rnam gzhag la spyir cha rkyen yang rgyal srid rin po che'i grangs su nges par gsungs pa las gsum pa tshig gi brjod tshul don tshang bdun te/ 1 che brjod/2 gus 'dud 'tshams zhu/ 3 yul gyi khams 'dri/ 4 rang gi khams gnas zhu ba/ 5 skabs don dngos/ 6 slad char dge smon/7 mjug bsdu'i mtshams skyes zla tshes dang bcas pa'o//82

bod yig gi rtsom gzhung skor gleng ba/bye brag tu yul gyi khyad par la ltos pa'i bab phreng che chung dang / zhe tshig dang che brjod bkod tshul/ yig gzugs gang zhig 'bri dgos min/ lteb lugs/ hung thag gi bcings tshul/ rtags thel gyi bkod sa sogs bskur yul de la bstun nas 'bri dgos pa bcas yod pa 'dir zur tsam 'don pa tsam las de'i gzhung rtsom gyi skabs min pas de lta bu nges par du rtsom gzhung gi rigs su bzhag na shin tu 'thad par bsams/ gang yin zhe na/ gna' snga mo nas rnam gzhag de yod na yang / de las gong 'phel dar rgyas/gsar rtsom phun sum tshogs su re zhig gtong ma thub rung / de rgyun 'dzin bya dgos pa ni dngos 'brel bod kyi rig gzhung nyams pa sor chud dang ma nyams gong 'phel bya dgos zhes pa'i don dam pa de'i steng du nyag phran 'phangs pa yin 'khel/ lhag par du snyan ngag gi gzhung sbyangs tshar rjes dngos spyod bu yul gyi phyogs bsdus rang bzhin gyi rtsom rig cig tu grub yod pas/ da lta bklag deb khag nang thar thor du bkod yod pa tsam las ched du rtsom gzhung zhig la brtsis nas de'i gzhung lugs yan lag dang bcas pa'i mtshan gzhi dper brjod khag cha tshang bkod pa zhig nam mkha'i me tog lta bu zhig tu gyur pas/ de kha bskang 'thus tshang du gtong dgos pa'i gal che'i rang bzhin 'dug ces mgrin pa'i rdza rnga gsar pos brdung ba 'dis bod yig gi rtsom rig bya gzhag dus rabs 'di'i nang tshad mtho shos kyi dus rabs shig tu slebs pa'i dge smon pa las ma 'das so//83

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/bzhi pa/ rtogs brjod/lo rgyus thog rtogs brjod rtsom rig gis bod kyi rtsom rig gi gar stegs steng du go gnas nges can zhig zin yod de/ dper na/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' sogs kyi sku tshe snga ma'i yon tan brjod pa'i skyes rabs dang tshe 'di'i yon tan brjod pa'i rnam thar dang chabs cig tshe sngon ma'i lo rgyus kyang yod pa de dag la rnam thar dang rtogs brjod kyang zer/ gzhon nu drug gi rtogs brjod lta bu rtsom pa pos rtsom gzhi dngos su byung yod med la mi bltos par bsam don gzhan zhig la bsams nas brtsams pa'i lo rgyus lta bu ste rigs gsum las/ 'di'i rigs la deng sang rig rtsom zhes logs su 'jog srol chags yod/ mdor na rtogs brjod rtsom rig gis bod yig gi rtsom rig 'phel rgyas 'gro rgyur sman pa'i legs skyes phul yod pa nga tsho'i mig lam du gsal ler 'char rgyu yod pa de dag gi rtsa ba'i rtsom lugs dang brjod don 'di ltar dgos pa ste/gcig rtogs brjod rtsom rig ni lo rgyus rig pa dang rtsom rig zung du 'brel ba'i dmigs bsal gyi sgyu rtsal gyi rnam pa zhig red/ dper na 〈bka' blon rtogs brjod 〉 lta bu mdo mkhar zhabs drung tshe ring dbang rgyal gyi mi tshe hril po'i byung ba brjod pa dang de dang de'i dus kyi spyi tshogs kyi rnam pa dang /khor yug ji ma ji bzhin du bris pa'i lo rgyus shig yin la rtsom gyi nyams gyur thad mi sna'i gzugs brnyan dang bya ba'i 'gul bskyod/ bsam pa'i 'khyer so 84

bod yig gi rtsom gzhung skor gleng ba/sogs shin tu snyan 'jebs dod pa'i rtsom rig gi tha snyad kyis mtshon par byas yod/ rtogs brjod rtsom rig ni lo rgyus yin la rtsom rig sgyu rtsal yang yin/de la lo rgyus yin pa'i dbang gis lo rgyus kyi rgyu cha khungs btsun pa dang rtsom rig yin pa'i dbang gis rtsom gyi nyams 'gyur dang mi sna'i gzugs brnyan gson nyams ldan pa 'bri rgyur yid gzab byed kyi yod/ nga tshos rigs pa'i gzhung lugs kyi thog nas rtogs brjod kyi gal che'i rang bzhin dang nus pa/rin thang bcas gsal rtogs byas na rtogs brjod rtsom rig de yar rgyas gong 'phel gtong rgyur rtsa che'i don snying ldan yod pa rang blos ngang gis rtogs nus so//gnyis/ rtogs brjod rtsom rig gi dmigs yul gtso bo ni skye bo zhig gi mi tshe hril po'i nang spyi tshogs kyi byed sgo rnam gzhag dang mi sna'i gzugs brnyan/phyag rjes gsung rtsom dang / slob ma/ mkhar/ rgyu dngos gang rung so so'i las gnas la dpag pa'i sgo nas mngon rjen du gsal bar bya dgos pas de'i nang mi sna'i gshis rgyud sogs mgo mjug gzhi gcig tu mthun pa bya dgos/gong smros bzhin rtogs brjod rtsom rig la rtsa che'i lo rgyus kyi nus pa thon pa'i 'gan 'khri yod pa ma zad/ rtsom rig las dbang 'gan 'khri yang 'khyer dgos/ rtsom rig yin pa'i dbang gis mi sna'i gzugs brnyan rtsom 'bri dang 'char 'god bya rgyu la'ang kha bral mi rung ba zhig yin/ rtogs brjod rtsom rig gi srog rtsa ni gson nyams ldan la mi rnams kyi yid dbang 'gug thub pa'i mi sna'i gzugs brnyan rtsom 'bri bya rgyu de yin/ 'on kyang bod kyi rtogs brjod mang po'i nang mi sna'i gzugs brnyan rtsom 'bri bya rgyu'i thad skyes ma thag 85

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/nas skyes bu dam pa yin na mi tshe hril por skyes bu dam pa dang / skyes ma thag nas skyes bu tha mal pa yin na tshe gang por ma rabs tha shal kho na yin pa'i 'ching rgya dang / dngos slob kyis rang gi bla ma la che brjod dang / tshad las brgal ba'i 'ud bstod bya rgyu'i thad don dngos dang ring du bral ba'i 'ud shob thal drags pas zhan cha'ang yod pa shes pa bya dgos/ der brten mi sna'i gzugs brnyan ches gzi brjid dang dpa' nyams ldan pa/ skyes bu dam pa gang 'dra zhig bar bzo min gyi gnad don ni rtogs brjod rtsom rig rgyal pham gyi srog rtsa yin pas de'i thad la nus pa che tsam kyang bton dgos par bsams/gsum/ rtogs brjod rtsom rig rtsom 'bri bya rgyur lo rgyus kyi gnas tshul dngos mtshon par byed dgos la rgyal khab kyi khe phan la bstun rgyu dang mi rigs kyi la rgya 'dzin rgyur do snang bya dgos/ de'ang don dngos dang / dmigs bsal gyi gnas tshul/ sgyu rtsal/ rgyal khab kyi khe phan bcas rgyu rkyen de dag yug gcig tu 'dres pa bya dgos/ lo rgyus thog bod kyi gna' bo'i rtogs brjod khag kyang skabs de'i spyi tshogs la zhabs 'degs zhu ched kyi lag cha lta bur gyur yod pas/ sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi snying don dang spyi tshogs de'i lam lugs mtshon par byas yod/ der brten rtogs brjod rtsom 'bri bya dgos na nges par du rgyal gces ring lugs kyi snying stobs de tshangs pa'i thig shing lta bur 'dzin dgos pa ste/ mes rgyal dang mi rigs kyi las dbang dang zung gcig tu 'brel ba'i shes yon can zhig gi ngos nas brjod na'ang lta ba de las ma gol ba byed dgos/ rtogs brjod rtsom rig la nges par du lo rgyus rig pa'i lta spyod bzang po zhig dgos shing lo rgyus kyi don dngos gtso bor byas 86

bod yig gi rtsom gzhung skor gleng ba/nas/ lo rgyus kyi gnyug ma'i rnam pa de lo rgyus kyis mtshon pa bya rgyu las rtsom pa po'i rang snang gis 'gyur gyur pab btang na lo rgyus kyi rin thang shor ba yin pas/ rtsa che'i lo rgyus kyi dpyad gzhi'i yig rigs nyar tshags dpyad zhib kyis blang dor gnas la mi rmongs pa'i blo mig rno po zhig dgos pa dang /dpyad gzhi'i yig rigs yin min dbye ba ma 'byed par dgos med yig rdzob rang sor spos nas spungs zog brgyab na phan pa'i rgyu gtan nas med pa de zhar la rtogs dgos/mdor na/ rtogs brjod rtsom rig ni bod kyi rtsom rig ldum ra'i nang gi khyad du 'phags pa'i rtsom rig gi me tog mtshar sdug ldan pa zhig yin pas/der mthong chen bya dgos pa ni bod yig gi rtsom rig rgyun 'dzin dang 'phel rgyas gtong rgyur thad kar 'brel ba gal chen yod pa'i don rtsa zhig yin pa dngos stobs kyis grub bo//87

bstan bcos kyi mtshan 'dogs tshul la dpyad pa/dang po/ mtshan 'dogs pa'i dgos pa/lang gar gshegs pa'i mdo las/ ming du gdags par ma mdzad na//'jig rten thams cad mongs par 'gyur/ /de bas smongs pa bsal ba'i phyir/ /mgon pos ming du btags par mardzod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ming klad du smos pas/ rgya mtsho las khab 'tshol ba lta bu min par btsal sla ba dang / rtsa reg las nad rkyen ngos zin pa ltar ming las gzhung don rtogs pa/ dmag rtags las dgra zun 'byed pa ltar/ rig tshan gang gtogs rtogs pa/sman rkyal la kha byang bkal ba ltar 'chol ba med pa bcas dgos pa bzhi ldan shes par bya'o// gnyis pa/ mtshan gyi 'dogs lugs bshad pa/gcig yul gyi sgo nas btags pa/〈dge tshul gyi bslab bya gnam rtse ldeng ma/〉 sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa'i (sa skya legs bshad/〉 paṇa chen bsod grags kyis mdzad pa'i 〈dge ldan legs bshad/〉 lta bu'o/ /88gnyis/ gang zag gi sgo nas btags pa/

lke bstan bcos kyi mtshan 'dogs tshul la dpyad pa/(dbyangs can sgra mdo/〉 (bu ston chos 'byung /〉 pra ti'i sum rtags lta bu'o//gsum/ 'bras bu'i sgo nas btags pa/rdo sbis dge bshes shes rab rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i 〈chos srid grub mtha' sna tshogs kyi gtam thos pa don ldan bklags pas don grub/〉yongs 'dzin ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i (skyabs 'gro'i khrid yig dngos grub kun 'byung 〉lta bu'o//bzhi/ dpe yi sgo nas btags pa/brag dkar blo bzang dpal ldan bstan 'dzin snyan grags kyis mdzad pa'i (mdzod kyi 'grel pa legs bshad gser gyi lde mig〉 (gangs ljongs mkhas dbang rim byon gyi rtsom yig gser gyi sbram bu 〉lta bu'o//lnga/ gzhung tshad kyi sgo nas btags pa/1 sho lo ka'i tshad/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i (rigs pa drug cu pa/〉 thon mis mdzad pa'i (sum cu pa 〉lta bu'o//2 bam grangs/ bod kyi sgra bsgyur rig pa'i bstan bcos (sgra sbyor bam gnyis 〉lta bu//3 don tshan gyi grangs/ rgyal sras thogs med kyis mdzad pa'i (blo sbyong don bdun ma 〉lta bu'o//4 le'u dang sa bcad/ slob dpon dpa' bo'i (skyes rabs so bzhi 〉lta bu'o//drug zhu ba po'i sgo nas btags pa/89

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/rje tsong kha pas mdzad pa'i (bshes gnyen sba ba la gdams pa 〉rdo sbis dge bshes shes rab rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i (chos kyi blo gros la gdams pa zab don rab gsal 〉lta bu'o//bdun/ gang la brten pa'i khungs kyi sgo nas btags pa/dngul chu chos bzang gis mdzad pa'i 〈si tu'i zhal lung 〉dang / lnga pa chen mos mdzad pa'i (lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung /〉 tshe tan zhabs drung gis mdzad pa'i (thon mi'i zhal lung 〉lta bu'o//brgyad/ byed las kyi sgo nas btags pa/bu ston rin po ches mdzad pa'i (rtsis kyis bstan bcos mkhas pa dga' skyed/〉 dbyangs can rol ba'i 'o mtshos mdzad pa'i 〈dag yig mkhas pa dga' skyed〉lta bu'o// dgu/ gtam rgyud dang sbyar nas btags pa/tshe tan zhabs drung gis mdzad pa'i (phyi dus kyi 'khor lo'i tshes zhag lnga bsdus sgra gcan gza' lnga nyin zhag dang bcas pa'i mgyogs rtsis mi'u thung sgyu ma'i gom 'gros 〉zhes pa lta bu'o//bcu/ pha rol zil gyis gnon pa'i tshig gis btags pa/rje shes rab rgya mtsho'i (smra ba ngan pa rnam par 'thag pa'i mi rigs rdo rje'i thog mda'/〉 sde pa rin spungs po'i (snyan 'grel mi 'jigs seng ge'i nga rog〉lta bu'o/ /bcu gcig thun mong min pa'i 'dogs srol/tshal pa kun dga' rdo rje'i 〈deb ther dmar po 〉 'gos lo tsā ba gzhon nu dpal gyi 〈deb ther sngon po 〉lta bu'o//90
bcu gnyis/ snyan ngag gi tshig rgyan dang sbyar ba/'jam dpal sprin phyi rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i 〈sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas kyi 'grel pa zla 'od snye ma 〉lta bu'o//

bod kyi rtsom rig yongs 'du'i tshal las srol rgyun rtogs brjod rtsom gyi rnam gzhag la dpyad pa/dang po/ rtogs brjod ces pa'i go don/dam pa rnams kyi rtogs brjod ces pa ni gang zag phal pa gzhan las khyad par du 'phags shing ngo mtshar ba'i mkhas pa'i yon tan 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum dang / btsun ma'i yon tan sdom gsum bcas pa'i mtshams las mi 'da' ba/ bzang ba'i yon tan mkhas grub kyi lag rjes bstan 'gro kun la sman pa'i 'phrin las rlabs po che mi tshe hril por ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul la sogs pa ngag gi phreng bar spel ba la rtogs brjod dam rnam thar zer ba yin no//rtogs brjod ces pa'i sgra bshad ni rtogs pa ste gang zag gang de'i rgyud la bslab gsum sogs nyams rtogs kyi yon tan rgya cher 'phel ba'i mdzad 'phrin rnams rtsom pa pos ngag gi phreng ba'i lam nas brjod pas na de ltar brjod de ji skad du/'jigs med rig pa'i blo gros kyis/ 'khor ba'i 'dam las sor gang ma 'phags phyir/ /rnam thar bya ba'i ming 'dogs byed mi 'os/ /nyams rtogs yo~X 2tan ri bong rwa mtshungs phyir/ /rtogs brjod bya ba'i ming yang ji ltar

bod kyi rtsom rig las srol rgyun rtogs brjod rtsom gyi rnam gzhag la dpyad pa/rigs/ /zhes pa lta bu dang gzhan yang rnam thar zhes pa'i don ni bdag nyid chen po zhig gi gtan bde thar pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang dam pa bde blag tu brnyes tshul rnams gtso bor bzung nas brjod pa zhig yin/ 'di'i sgra bshad ni 'jam mgon tsong kha pa'i rnam thar(thub bstan mdzes pa'i rgyan gcig ngo mtshar nor bu'i phreng ba〉zhes pa las/ brjod bya dang rjod byed kyi rnam pa de la brten nas mthong thos kyi gdul bya rnams thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa thob pa'i rgyur 'gyur ba zhig dgos pa'i phyir gsungs pa ltar ro//'o na/ rtogs brjod dang rnam thar la khyad par ci yod ce na/ spyir rnam thar ni 'jig rten 'khor ba ring du spang ba'i bla ma dang bdag nyid chen po rnams kyi mi tshe hril po'i mdzad 'phrin gtsor brjod pa dper na rje btsun mi la ras pa'i rnam thar lta bu dang / rtogs brjod ni spyi 'jig rten khyim pa'i byung ba brjod pa la rtogs brjod ces pa'i ming 'dogs srol med mod kyang /phyis skya bo dam pa zhig gi mi tshe hril po'i mdzad 'phrin gtsor byas nas lo rgyus bkod pa la rtogs brjod ces pa'i ming btags pa'ang yod de/ dper na/dpal mi'i dbang po'i rtogs brjod lta bu'o/ /de dag ni ser skya'i gnas kyi cha nas dbye ba 'byed pa dang / gzhan yang de gnyis la khyab che chung gi khyad par yod de/ /rtogs brjod yin na rnam thar yin pas khyab la/ rnam thar yin na rtogs brjod yin pas mi khyab/ de bzhin sgra 'jug tu yod rung sgra bshad yod pas mi khyab ste/ dper na/ mar pa lo tsā ba'i rnam thar zhes pa dang / rtag tu ngu'i rtogs brjod lta bu'o//93

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/gnyis pa/ rtogs brjod rtsom gyi rnam dbye'i skor/rtogs brjod rtsom gyi rtsom gzhi'i sgo nas dbye na sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshe rabs du ma'i mdzad 'phrin brjod pa'i skyes rabs dper na skyes rabs so bzhi lta bu dang / gang zag gcig gi mi tshe hril po'i mdzad spyod dang / spyi tshogs kyi gnas bab/ bsam pa'i 'jug ldog sogs rten de'i yon tan gyi byung ba brjod pa'i rtogs brjod dper na/ 〈dpa' mi'i dbang po'i rtogs brjod 〉 lta bu dang / mi sna dang gnas tshul sogs kyi rtsom gzhi de dngos su byung yod med gang la'ang ma ltos par rtsom pa pos bsam don gzhan zhig la bsams nas sgro btags te brjod pa'i rtogs brjod dper na/gzhon nu drug gi rtogs brjod lta bu'o/ /'dir smros pa'i rtogs brjod kyi rtsom zhes pa ni gnyis pa de yin te de la dbye na rang rnam dang / gzhan rnam/gsang rnam zhes gsum yod pa des bod kyi rtsom rig gi lo rgyus 'phel rim gyi gar stegs thog lo rgyus rig pa dang rtsom rig zung du 'brel ba'i grangs 'bor che la/ spus tshad legs pa'i dmigs bsal gyi sgyu rtsal go 'phang zin yod pas/ 'dir de'i rtsom tshul gyi skor thog ma'i dung sgra lta bu zhig thos pa'i kha mig chung ba'i blo dman bdag gis spel bar bsrings/94

bod kyi rtsom rig las srol rgyun rtogs brjod rtsom gyi rnam gzhag la dpyad pa/gsum pa/ rtogs brjod rtsom gyi lus kyi skor/rtogs brjod rtsom gyi lus ni rtsom lugs gzhan dang rigs 'dra bar 'di la'ang tshigs su bcad pa dang / lhug pa/ spel ma bcas rnam pa gsum gyi rnam gzhag 'jog rung ba ste/ de'ang dang po tshigs bcad kyi rnam thar ni tshigs rkang ring thung dang / rgyan gyi rnam grangs gang zhig spyad min la ma ltos par skyes bu de'i mi tshe hril po'i byung ba tshigs su bcad pa'i lam nas drangs pa zhig go/ dper na paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i 〈sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i rtogs brjod dri za'i glu dbyangs 〉lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa tshig lhug gi rtogs brjod nipha‘rkang med tshig rgyun lhug pa'i mtshan nyid ’’ces gsungs pa ltar/ tshigs su bcad pa min pa'i tshig gi rgyun gyis skyes bu gang de'i mi tshe hril po'i gnas tshul rnams bkod pa la zer/ dper na 'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po'i rnam thar (thub bstan mdzes pa'i rgyan gcig ngo mtshar nor bu'i phreng ba 〉zhes pa lta bu/ gsum pa bcad lhug spel ma'i rtogs brjod ni rtsom gyi gzhi ma tshig lhug yin pa la/ bar skabs su tshigs su bcad pa yang yod pa'i rtogs brjod la zer ba yin te/ dper na mdo mkhar zhabs drung tshe ring dbang rgyal gyis brtsams pa'i (dpal mi'i dbang po'i rtogs brjod 〉lta bu'o//95

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/bzhi pa/ rtogs brjod rtsom 'bri la tshang dgos pa'i cha rkyen/gcig sku bltams pa'i skor/ 'di la gtso bo sngar gyi rtsom lugs ltar na yul dus/ yab yum/ rigs rus phun sum tshogs pa gang zhig gis sras su mtshan ltas bzang po gang dang bcas pas bltams pa'i tshul cha tshang 'bri dgos pa'o//gnyis/ na tshod kyi byu gu gin tu phra ba'i dus kyi spyod tshul skor/ 'dir gtso bo skyes pa nas bzung byis pa'i dus kyi lus ngag yid gsum dang /bsam pa'i 'khyer so/ gshis ka rig stobs/ dad zhen/ 'tshar longs byung tshul bcas dam pa'i yon tan rmad du byung ba bdag gir bzhes tshul bcas rags 'bri bya dgos/gsum/ dal 'byor rten bzang la yon tan 'phel ba'i skor/ nar son nas dang po ka kha'i 'bri klog nas 'go brtsams te/ gnas gang zhig tu mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma gang zhig la bsten nas gzhung gang zhig la gsan sbyong mdzad pa'i skor dang / rang la thos bsam sgom pa'i sgrub pa gang zhig thob pa'i skor rgyas par 'bri dgos/ rgyu mtshan ni bla ma'i gdams ngag la ma brten pa dang / rang gi gus rtag brtson 'grus kyis rig gzhung ma sbyang bar mkhas pa chags pa rgya bod yul du med pa dang mkhas pa min na rtogs brjod kyang der mi 'ongs pas so//bzhi/ 'chad nyan spel te gzhan don byas pa'i skor/ 'di'i skabs su 96

bod kyi rtsom rig las srol rgyun rtogs brjod rtsom gyi rnam gzhag la dpyad pa/lang tsho'i yal 'dab rnam par rgyas shing gsan sbyong gi 'bras bzang smin pa'i dus su slebs pas/ dbus gtsang mdo khams rgyud kyi chos grwa che khag tu zhabs bcags te mdzad pa'i gtsor gyur pa 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum dang /mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi sgo nas gzhan don mdzad tshul rgyas par 'bri dgos pa ni gnad dam pa'o//lnga/ phyag rjes kyi skor/ skyes bu gang des mi tshe hril por dka' spyad kyis 'gro don mdzad pa las mkhas pa zhig gi ngos nas brjod na bka' rtsom gang dang gang mdzad tshul dang / de'i rin thang dang / slob ma'i tshogs ji ltar byon tshul/ chos sde'am slob grwa gang zhig tu ring lugs kyi srol gang zhig btod nas 'gro don rlabs chen mdzad gnang ba'i skor 'bri dgos pa'o//drug mdzad pa mtha' ma'i skor/ sku tshe mtha' mar phyag las gang zhig gnang ba dang / bka' lung gang gnang ba/ bsnyun gzhi gang zhig bzhes nas sman dpyad legs par byas rung skyes mthar 'chi ba dang / 'dus mthar bral ba'i 'jig rten chos nyid ltar bod rab byung (spyi lo'i )gang gi zla tshes gang la dgongs pa rdzogs pa dang / dgongs rdzogs chos sprin sgrub pa'i skor bcas drug gis mkhas grub dam pa zhig gi rtogs brjod cha tshang 'bri thub pa'o//'o na rgyal po'am sne mo ba zhig gi rtogs brjod cig 'bri dgos na/ gong smros kyi gsum pa'i skabs su gang zhig yul dus gang tu gang zhig gi bka' lung bstsal ba ltar chos srid kyi byed por bskos nas rgyal srid gser gyi khri la zhabs sen pad+mo mngon par bkod pa'i skor dang / bzhi pa'i skabs su/ rgyal srid skyong ring gi chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ rig gnas sogs mnga' thang 97

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/dar rgyas dang / spyi tshogs dang / phyi 'brel gyi byed sgo'i rnam gzhag rgyal khams yongs kyi bde sdug ched gzhan phan 'phrin las bskyangs pa'i tshul dang /lnga pa'i skabs su rgyal srid skyong ba'i ring la bzhag pa'i gsar gtod kyi mdzad rjes khrims srol dang / srid jus/ dpal 'byor/ sku mkhar bzhengs pa dang / srol bzang gang zhig btod pa bcas rlabs che'i mdzad rjes rnams snon 'bri dgos pa phud de byings rigs bsgre byas na 'thus par bsams so//dang po mtshan gzhi dper brjod ni dper na/ rje tsong kha pa'i rnam thar mdor bsdus tshigs bcad bcu bdun pa lta bu ste/'jam dbyangs ngur smrig zlos gar cong kha pa'i/ /phra zhib rigs lam rdo rje gzegs ma'i mtshon/ /gangs can log smra'i gshed du gdengs pa'i gtam/ /'dzam gling blo ldan skye bo'i ngag na mardzes/ /rab byung drug pa'i me mo bya yi lor/ /sangs rgyas byung chub mang po'i lung bstan bzhin/ /dpal chen klu 'bum dge dang sras su 'brel/ /rtsong kha'i yul du bltams pa'i rnam thar yin/ /lte ba'i mtshal thigs sa la 'phos ba las/ /tsan dan ljon pa lon 'dab 'bum phrag can/ /seng ge'i nga ro'i sku yis brgyan pa 'khrungs/ /snga rabs gzhan la med pa'i rnam thar yin/ /dgung lo gsum par grub dbang karma pas/ /dge bsnyen bsgrubs shing bdun par chos kyi rje/ /don grub rin chen drung nas rab rtu byung /98

bod kyi rtsom rig las srol rgyun rtogs brjod rtsom gyi rnam gzhag la dpyad pa/rgyal ba'i bstan la zhugs pa'i rnam thar yin/ /bcu bdun pa la dus gsum gzigs pa yis /bla ma'i bka' dang rang gi dad stobs kyis/ /dbus gtsang chos kyi ljongs su gom kha bskur/ /nyi zla shar nas 'char ba'i rnam thar man/ /rgya gar paṇa grub lta bu'i mkhas mang gis/ /mdo sngags tha snyad gtsug lag kun la sbyangs/ /rab 'byams shes bya nam mkha'i pha mthar son/ /dang po thos pa btsal ba'i rnam thar yin/ /gdul bya'i khams dang 'tshams par 'jug pa yis/ /rgyal ba'i bka' las yi ge 'bya gcig kyang / /lus pa med par thar pa'i thabs su dgongs/ /bar du gdams par shar ba'i rnam thar yin/ /mkha' khyab skye rgu skyob ba'i brtse ba dang / /zab rgyas lam gyi rim pa'i dmigs lam la/ /mnyam brjes nyin mtshan kun tu g.yel ba med/ /tha mar nyams su blangs pa'i rnam thar jin/ /bka' dang bstan brtsos bye ba'i gnad la sna/ /sor thar byang sems gsang sngags tshul khrims gtsang / /byams dang snying rje phyin drug brtsa bzhi'i gter/ /phul byung mkhas btsun bzang po'i rnam thar yin/ /don dam dbu ma chen po'i de nyid gzigs/ /nyes pa lnga spong 'du byed brgyad dang 'grogs/ /'dod gdung mtha' gnyis skyon bralah+phud+ma'i ljon/ /99

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/zla med lta sgom spyod pa'i rnam thar yin/ /gzhung chen bcu phrag mang po blo na 'grel/ /phas rgos glang smyon klad pa'i bum pa 'gems/ /phra zhib gsung ngag srid zhi'i khong na brjid/ /ngo mtshar 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i rnam thar yin/ /rdzing phyi'i mi pham rten dang brten pa gsos/ /gnyal gyi lung rar sngon med chos 'khor bskor/ /cho 'phrul smon lam stag rtse'i sgrub mchod spel/ /bsngags 'os mdzad chen rnam bzhi'i rnam thar yin/ /snang yang stong pa'i rten 'byung zab mo dang / /gnyug rlung lha skur shar ba'i sgyu lus la/ /legs bshad blog gi sgron me cher sbar ba/ /gnad kyi smongs mun sel ba'i rnam thar yin/ /nga gsum sa mo glang la dga' ldan btab/ /re gsum phag la byams pa'i mdun sar gshegs/ /rjes 'jug dgon dang slob mas sa steng khyab/ /srid na 'gran zla bral ba'i rnam thar yin/ /de las 'ongs pa'i bsod nams 'o ma'i klung / /zla ba bdud rtsi'i mdzod la 'khu 'dra bas/ /dbyig gi blo gros ma 'di nad mtshon dang / /mu ge'i bskal bas kun nas dben gyur cig /de ltar chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa'i/ /rnam thar mdor bsdus tshig bcad bcu bdun pa/ /shis ngan bkwang rin zi li tā bla ma/ /100

bod kyi rtsom rig las srol rgyun rtogs brjod rtsom gyi rnam gzhag la dpyad pa/gon dru chin gyi ring nas bskul ba'i ngor/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa'i byin gyi cha shas tsam/ /snying gi ze'u 'byar rol ba'i mthu nyid las/ /mdo rgyud gzhung mang smra ba'i rdzobs pa can/shes rab rgya mtshos 'phral mar bris te phul/ /zhes pa lta bu'o//gnyis pa chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i rtogs brjod ni dper na/ bod kyi rgyal rabs so gsum pa chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po ni yab gnam ri srong btsan dang / yum tshe spung bza' gnyis kyi sras su me mo glang gi (spyi lo 617)lor sku bltams/ dgung lo bcu gsum bzhes pa'i sa glang gi (spyi lo 629)lor rgyal po'i khri la 'khod/ gru 'dzin ri la pho brang po ta la bzhengs/mdzad pa gtso bo shing pho rta la bal bza' khri btsun khab tu bzhes nas rten skal byams pa chos 'khor ma dang / jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje/ rang byon sgrol ma bcas rten gsum spyan drangs/ rgya nag thang gi rgyal pos khong la rlu ma du'u we zhes pa'i mag pa'i cho lo dang / mtsho nub mi'i rgyal po shis he khyun dbang zhes pa'i cho lo bskur/ de nas spyi lo dus rabs bdun pa'i dus dkyil du ra sa 'phrul snang gtsug lag khang dang / ra mo che zhes pa'i gtsug lag khang rnam gnyis bzhengs/ thon mi a nu'i bu sasto ṭa g.yog bcu drug dang bcas pa rgya gar du brdzangs/ bram ze li byin ka ra dang / lha rig pa'i seng ge slob dpon du bsten nas bod du yi ge'i bstan bcos brgyad brtsams te yon tan kun gyi gzhi ma yi ge'i srol gtod/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thog mar bod yig tu bsgyur/ bka' yi khrims yig chen po rnam drug gtan la phab pa dang / rus 101

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/rgyud tsho pa khag bco brgyad tsam yod pa tshang ma gcig gyur mdzad pa dang /srid 'dzin lam lugs thad/ blon chen gsum gyis phyi'i srid 'dzin las don sgrub pa dang / nang blon gsum gyis nang gi las don sgrub pa/ bka' blon gsum gyis rgyal po'i bka' la yo bsrang dang / legs bcos byed pa bcas blon po che dgus phyi nang gi las don thams cad thag gcod pa'i lam lugs btsugs/ lha chos dge ba bcu dang / mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug gi srol mngon par bzhengs nas bod kyi rgyal srid legs par bskyangs/ rang mi rigs kyi sngar yod rig gzhung gong 'phel gtong ba'i rmang gzhi'i thog mi chen bu rnams rgya nag tu yon tan slob tu btang ste/ sman dang / rtsis dang /sgyu rtsal/ dpal 'byor la sogs pa'i srol rgyun bod du drangs/ bal yul nas lha bzo pa dang / ri mo mkhas pa/ rdo bzo pa sogs mang po bkug nas de dag gi lag rtsal bod khams su dar bar byas te/ rgya bod mi rigs bar dang / bal bod mi rigs bar gyi mthun sgril la byas rjes rlabs po che mdzad/dgung lo gya gnyis pa spyi lo 698lor sku gshegs pa'o/ /zhes pa lta bu ni shin tu bsdus pa'i sgo nas rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i mdzad rjes gtso bo rnams 'bur thon gyis bris pa'i rtogs brjod yin pa'o//lnga pa/ rtogs brjod rtsom gyi khyad chos/rtogs brjod kyi rtsom ni rtsom rig gzhan dang mi 'dra bar spyir sgro btags spang nas skyes bu zhig gi mi tshe hril po'i las don dang / slob sbyong / 'tsho ba sogs kyi mdzad pa rnams lo rgyus dang rtsom rig yug gcig tu 'brel ba'i cha 102

bod kyi rtsom rig las srol rgyun rtogs brjod rtsom gyi rnam gzhag la dpyad pa/nas yi ger bkod pa zhig 'o na de la yang snying khyad chos ji ltar ldan dgos she na gsham gsal 'di lta ste/gcig rtsom pa po/ rtogs brjod rtsom pa'i rtsom pa po la spyir rigs gnyis yod de rtsom pa po rang nyid kyi gnas tshul ji lta ba bzhin rang gis bkod pa'i rang rnam zhes pa dper na (bka' blon rtogs brjod 〉lta bu dang /yang na rtsom pa pos cha rgyus ha cang che ba'i mi sna zhig gi gnas tshul bkod pa'i gzhan rnam zhes pa dper na mdo mkhar ba tshe ring rnam rgyal gyis mdzad pa'i 〈dpal mi'i dbang po'i rnam thar 〉lta bu'o//gnyis/ rtsom gyi go rim sgrig stangs/ spyir rtogs brjod rtsom 'bri'i go rim la rtsom gzhan dang 'dra bar klad kyi don dang / gzhung dngos kyi don/mjug bsdu zhing dge bsngo ba'i don gsum tshang dgos pa gzhir byas/ gzhung don dngos kyi skabs su go rim sgrig stangs thad chos gzhan dang 'dra bar skye rga na 'chi'i go rim mam/ thog mar byung ba dang / bar du gnas pa/ mthar 'jig pa'i khyad chos gzhir byas pa'i rtsom gyi go rim sgrig stangs thad rigs mi 'dra ba 'ga' yod pa ste/1༄rtogs brjod kyi brtsam gzhi de'i lo zla'i dus tshod kyi go rim bzhin bris pa/ dper na/ rab byung ga ge mo'i lo zla tshes la 'khrungs pa dang /de nas na tshod kyi 'phel rim dang bya ba'i 'phel rim la brten nas rab byung dang bcas pa'i sgo nas bris pa ni rtogs brjod kyi rtsom rig mang che bar khyab pa'i go rim sgrig stangs shig yin/2riskabs gsum la dbye nas brjod pa'i rtogs brjod yod pa ste/ sku 103

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/gzhon nu'i dus kyi rnam thar dang / sku tshe stod kyi rnam thar/ sku tshe smad kyi rnam thar zhes bris pa/ dper na/ dbra ston skal bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i (shar rdza bkra shis rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar 〉 lta bu/brjod gzhi mi sna de dang po rigs rus phun sum tshogs par skye tshul dang /bar du rten de la yon tan ji ltar brnyes tshul/ tha mar bstan 'gro'i bya ba mdzad tshul bcas sa bcad gsum du dbye nas bris pa'ang yod do//3rirtogs brjod kyi brtsam gzhi la dgung lo'i rim pa bzhin bris srol yod pa dper na/ rje btsun bla ma tsong kha pa chen po'i rnam thar 〈dad pa'i 'jug ngogs 〉 lta bu'o//gsum/ tshig smyor/ rtogs brjod kyi rtsom ni byung ba brjod pa gtso byas pa'i rtsom rig dang zung du 'brel ba'i rtsom gyi rigs shig yin pas brjod gzhi de'i mi sna gtso bo dang / 'brel yod kyi mi sna/ spyi tshogs bcas kyi lo rgyus dngos la sgro skur spang dgos rung / rjod byed tshig gi snyan cha dod pa'i phyir tshig sbyor thad snyan ngag gi rang bzhin rgyan gtso byas nas/ dpe rgyan dang /gzugs rgyan/ 'gog rgyan/ don gzhan bkod pa'i rgyan/ phul byung gi rgyan/ rab btags/ nyams ldan/ rab spel sogs snyan ngag gi rgyan gyis brgyan te brjod gzhi gtso bo de don dngos las khyad du 'phags par bstan yod pa ni sgyu rtsal gyi rnam pa zhig yin pas 'gal ba med/ rtogs brjod kyi rtsom ni phyogs bsdus rang bzhin ldan pa'i rtsom rig cig yin pas na/ de la lus srog rgyan gyi rnam gzhag kyang rgya cher ldan pa zhig yin dgos/bzhi/ brjod bya/ rtogs brjod rtsom gyi brjod bya gtso bo ni skye bo zhig 104

bod kyi rtsom rig las srol rgyun rtogs brjod rtsom gyi rnam gzhag la dpyad pa/gis mi tshe hril po'i nang du spyi tshogs kyi byed sgo rnam gzhag khag la the zhugs dang / skabs de'i spyi tshogs dang khor yug gi mi sna rnams kyi gshis rgyud dang lta spyod/ chos lugs kyi dad phyogs/ rang la yon tan brnyes tshul/ rang gis spyi tshogs sam yang na khyim tshang sogs sgro la phul ba'i legs skyes sogs btags 'khyog bshad med par bkod dgos pa ni spyir rtogs brjod kyi ngo bos thag bcad pa bzhin brjod bya'i snying po de 'bur thon mtshon pa bya dgos/drug pa/ rtogs brjod rtsom 'bri byed skabs do snang bya dgos pa'i gnad don 'ga'/gcig rtogs brjod rtsom kyi srog rtsa ni dngos don mtshon rgyu de yin/kra'u tsung lisapha‘bden pa bden drang ’’bya dgos ces gsungs pa ltar rtogs brjod 'bri skabs nges par du skye rab dam pa zhig gi 'khrungs 'das sogs kyi dus tshod la 'khrul ba med par lo rgyus thog de nyid dngos su byung ba yod pa dang / mi sna de dang de'i gnas tshul/ don rkyen/ bsam blo/ gtam spyod/ mdzad rjes sogs rang 'dod ltar sgro btags dang zhwa dpe lham 'gebs gtan nas byed mi rung / mdor bsdus nas brjod na/ mi sna dang dngos po/ gtam spyod sogs bya ba'i 'phel rim 'di bzhin dngos don yin dgos pa ni rtogs brjod rtsom 'bri'i rtsa ba'i re 'dun dang / de'i ngo bos thag bcad pa'i lo rgyus gtsor ston pa'i rtsa ba'i srog rtsa yin pa'o//gnyis/ lo rgyus kyi mi snar gdeng 'jog gnad 'dzigs bya dgos/rtogs brjod rtsom 'bri bya skabs nges par du lo rgyus dngos gtso smra ba dang /105

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/bden pa bden drang gi tshan rig gi lta ba bzung nas skabs de'i lo rgyus kyi cha rkyen 'og byung ba'i lo rgyus mi sna'i lag len dngos kyi bya spyod dang / bsam pa'i 'phel rim bzhin mi tshe hril po'i byas nyes dang rgyal pham/ nyams myong dang bslab bya sogs ji ma ji bzhin du bkod nas lo rgyus dang / don dngos la khyon yongs nas dbye zhib byas te gdeng 'jog gnad 'phigs bya dgos/de ltar 'ong ba bya dgos na gsham gsal gyi 'brel ba khag nges par du thag gcod yang dag bya dgos pa ste/1rimi sger dang mi dmangs bar gyi 'brel ba/ phul du byung ba'i mi sna zhig gis spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas dang mi'i rigs bar gyi bde thabs kyi ched du mdzad rjes gal chen bzhag pa dang / nus pa nges can zhig thon yod na yang /de ni mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi 'gran med nus pa dang kha bral du mi rung ba zhig yin/ der brten sngar gyi bod yig rtogs brjod nang du lo rgyus mi snar gdeng 'jog byed skabs mi de skyes ma thag pa nas skyes bu dam pa zhig yin pa dang mi tshe hril por skyes bu dam pa yin pa'i 'ching rgya yod pa de dag spang dgos/ rgyu mtshan ni dngos yod spyi tshogs steng gi mi zhig yin pa las gna' rabs lha sgrung nang gi mi sna zhig min pas red/2zimi sger dang dus rabs bar gyi 'brel ba/ khyad du 'phags pa'i skyes bu dam pa su zhig yin rung dus rabs nges can gyi gnas tshul 'og byung ba zhig yin pas dus rabs de'i tshad bkag gi rang bzhin med pa ci la srid/des na rtogs brjod 'bri skabs 'bri bya'i mi sna de skabs de'i dus rabs kyi cha rkyen 'og byung ba'i don dngos la dpyad zhib byas nas 'bri dgos pa las 106

bod kyi rtsom rig las srol rgyun rtogs brjod rtsom gyi rnam gzhag la dpyad pa/'das pa'i re ba thal drags pa bton mi rung /3chimi gastsag gi mi tshe hril po'i byas nyes kyi 'brel ba/ mi zhig gi mi tshe hril po'i las don nang du byas rjes yod la nyes pa'ang yong srid pas/ de dag bden pa bden drang dang / gcig nas gnyis su gyes pa'i lta bas gdeng 'jog bya dgos/ gal srid nongs pa'i cha yod na de dag nyams myong dang /bslab bya'i ngos nas 'bri dgos pa dang zhan cha de dag rags 'bri las zhib par bris na mi 'thad/ yin na yang legs nyes gang yin rung gsal por 'bri dgos pa las/ byas rjes kyis nyes pa'i cha bkab pa bya mi rung /4ribyas rjes dang de'i che ba brjod pa'i bar gyi 'azel ba/ rmad du byung ba'i gtso 'dzin dang / slob dpon/ rtsom pa po/ rgyal po/ dpa' bo/tshan rig mkhas can su zhig yin na yang / des gzhan phan kho na thugs bskyed kyis mi'i rigs la bla na med pa'i mdzad rjes bzhag yod rung / de dag che brjod byed skabs rang 'dod ltar bya rgyu med la srid gzhung dang / skye bo kun gyis khas len pa'i don dngos dang mthun pa'i che brjod bya dgos pa ste dper na/ paṇa chen rin po che'i che brjod du/ rang rgyal gyi rlabs chen gyi rgyal gces ring lugs pa dang / snyan grags che ba'i rgyal don gnang sgo mkhas can/ krung go gung khran tang gi lhag bsam zol med kyi grogs po/krung go bod brgyud nang bstan chos lugs kyi phul byung gtso 'dzin/ skabs bdun pa'i rgyal yongs mi dmangs 'thus tshogs rgyun las u yon lhan khang gi u yon krang sku gzhon pa/ krung go nang bstan mthun tshogs kyi mtshan 'dzin tshogs gtso/ paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa blo bzang 'phrin las lhun grub chos kyi 107

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ zhes pa lta bu'o//gsum/ lo rgyus dngos mtshon dgos pa de'ang rgyal khab kyi khe dbang dang bskun dgos/ rtogs brjod rtsom 'bri bya rgyur lo rgyus kyi gnas tshul dngos mtshon pa byed dgos la rgyal khab kyi khe phan la bstun rgyu dang / mi rigs kyi la rgya 'dzin rgyur do snang bya dgos/ de'ang don dngos dang dmigs bsal gyi gnas tshul/ sgyu rtsal/ rgyal khab kyi khe phan bcas rgyu rkyen de dag yug gcig tu 'dres pa bya dgos/ lo rgyus thog bod kyi gna' bo'i rtogs brjod khag kyang spyi tshogs la zhabs 'degs zhu ched kyi lag cha lta bur gyur yod pas skabs de'i sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi snying don dang / spyi tshogs lam lugs mtshon par byas yod/ der brten rtogs brjod rtsom 'bri bya dgos na nges par du rgyal gces kyi snying stobs de tshangs pa'i thigs shing lta bur 'dzin dgos/mes rgyal dang mi rigs kyi las dbang dang yug gcig tu 'brel ba'i shes yon can zhig la mtshon na sgos su lta ba de las ma gol ba byed dgos/ rtogs brjod rtsom rig la nges par du lo rgyus rig pa'i lta spyod bzang po zhig tshang dgos shing / lo rgyus kyi don dngos gtso bor byas nas lo rgyus kyi gnyug ma'i rnam pa ci yin pa de lo rgyus kyis mtshon par bya rgyu las/ rtsom pa pos rang snang gi 'gyur ba btang na lo rgyus kyi rin thang shor ba yin phyir rtsa che'i lo rgyus kyi dpyad gzhi'i yig rigs la nyar tshags dang dpyad zhib kyis blang dor gnas la mi rmongs pa'i blo mig rno po zhig dgos pa dang / dpyad gzhi'i yig rigs yin min dbye ba ma 'byed par dgos med yig rigs gang yod phung gsog brgyab pa lta bu la phan pa'i rgyu gtan nas med pa de'ang zhar la rtogs 108

bod kyi rtsom rig las srol rgyun rtogs brjod rtsom gyi rnam gzhag la dpyad pa/par bya dgos/bzhi/ rtogs brjod rtsom 'bri'i yig cha'i khungs dag dgos/ rtogs brjod rtsom yag po zhig 'bri dgos na nges par du rgyun du yig cha khungs dag 'tshol bsdu bya dgos/ de ni rtogs brjod yag po zhig 'bri ba'i rmang gzhi yin/lo rgyus kyi yig cha khungs lung dag pa zhig med tshe/ rtogs brjod ces pa'i rtsom 'bri thabs med pas lo rgyus kyi yig cha khungs dag ni rtogs brjod rtsom 'bri'i ches rtsa bar gyur pa'i sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen yin/ rgyu mtshan de'i phyir yig cha de dag thabs lam gang 'dra zhig brgyud de 'tshol bsdu bya dgos ces she na/ gtso bo gsham gsal don tshan gsum la yid gzab bya dgos pa ste/1ringag thog las byung ba'i rtsom 'bri'i rgyu cha/ ngag thog gi yig cha'i yong khungs ni gtso bo rtogs brjod 'bri yul de'i spun mched dang / nye du/ las grogs/ slob ma sogs lo rgyus kyi dpang rtags mi snar bca' 'dri dang /bzhugs mol byas pa la brten nas 'ongs pa zhig yin/ de ni dpe deb dang yig tshags las shes dka' ba'i lo rgyus kyi rgyu cha zhig yin pas nga tshos lo rgyus gyi rgyu cha gson po de bsdu tshags bya rgyur gzab nan bya dgos/2༄yig thog las byung ba'i rtsom 'bri'i rgyu cha/ yig thog gi dpyad gzhi'i yig rigs kyi 'byung khungs gtso bo ni lo rgyus kyi yig tshags khang dang dpe mdzod khang yin/ lo rgyus kyi dpyad gzhi'i yig rigs 'tshol bar tshig mdzod chen mo'i rigs dang / lo tshigs/ dkar chag bla ma'i gsan yigazin tho sogs la rgyun par 'tshol zhib byas pa las dpyad yig khungs dag byung ba der las phyod che la klog pa po rnams yid rangs skye thub pa'i lo rgyus kyi rin 109

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/thang che ba'i khyad chos ldan yod pa'o//3༄dngos rdzas ngo ma las byung ba'i rtsom 'bri'i rgyu cha/ dngos rdzas ngo ma'i rgyu cha'i yong khungs gtso bo ni gshin rdzas dang / rjes shul/ 'das po'i 'dra ris sogs dngos rigs sna tshogs yin pas de dag rtogs brjod kyi rtsom 'bri skabs bar bcug ri mor bzhag na de bas nus pa rgya cher thon pa dang /rtogs brjod de'i rin thang che ru 'gro nges pas der yid gzab byed dgos/gong smras de dag sgrub na mang ba bzhi dgos pa ste/ gnad don gang ru nga zhig la thug na'ang bsam gzhigs mang tsam bya dgos pa dang gcig rtogs brjod 'bri yul de dang 'brel ba yod rigs kyi mi snar bca' 'dri mang tsam bya dgos pa dang gnyis/ rtogs brjod 'bri yul de'i 'khrungs yul dang /las ka'i gnas yul/ dpe mdzod khang sogs la mang tsam 'gro dgos pa dang gsum/ rang gis dpyad gzhi'i yig cha 'tshol ba'i brgyud rim yongs rdzogs nang mthong thos byung rigs rnams lag pa 'gul nas mang tsam zin thor 'god dgos pa dang bzhi bcas yin/mjug bsdu'i gtam/ rtogs brjod rtsom 'bri'i rigs lam mkha' dbyings ngos su rnam dpyod bye'u chung gshog rlabs nyag phra'i 'phur lding nyams kyis gcod 'dod byas pa'i ngang tshul du zad/ de lta yin na'ang bod yig rtsom gzhung rnam gzhag la gang tsam phan pa'i rgyu las ma mchis bsams te thog ma'i zin bris rags rim zhig bkod pa 'dir 'gal 'dzol dang / log bshad kyi rigs 'ongs nges bas/ bod mkhas pa rnams kyis skyon sel dge sgrub kyi dgongs 'char bdud rtsa'i rgyun bzhin lhun stsol thugs rje che'o//110

gab tshig dang lde'u dang khed bcas kyi dris lan/dge rgan nyi ma gcung lags kyis lo dgu'i 'gan babs slob gso'i dma' 'bring bod yig slob deb gnyis pa'i nang gi gab tshig ces pa dang lde'u khed bcas pa la khyad par gang yod/ der gnad la 'khel ba'i lan 'debs mkhan dkon gshis/ de ga nas lan zhig 'debs par 'tshal zhes phyag 'phrin gnang 'byor byung bas/ kho bos don 'dir dpyad 'bras da lam dris lan gyi tshul du 'bul lam song bas dgyes gzigs kyis zhib dpyod gnang bar 'tshal/de yang gab tshig ces pa'i go don ni snyan ngag me long las/rtsed mo'i mdun sar bzhad gad dang / /de shes tshogs su gsang smra dang / /pha rol kun tu mongs byed la/ /gab tshig dag ni nyer mkho ldan/zhes skye bo mang po 'du ba'i dbus su ku re ched bzhad gad slong ba dang /tshogs dbus gsang ba bya dgos pa'i don/ tshig sbyor gzhan gyi gab nas brjod de pha rol pa rmongs par byed pa'i nyams mtshar gyi snyan ngag rgyan la gab tshig zer ba 'di nye bar mkho ba'i don bstan/yang lde'u zhes pa ni sngar bod kyi rgyal rabs dgu pa pu de gung rgyal gyi dus nas (ro langs gser sgrub kyi sgrung 〉 dang lde'u sogs dar so chen po byung ste bod rgyal srong btsan sgam po yan chod du bod kyi rgyal srid bon sgrung lde'u gsum 111

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/gyis bskyangs zhes grags pa'i lde'u ni gab tshig gam khed kyi brda rnying yin/de'ang khams sprul bstan 'dzin chos kyi nyi mas/ gab tshig ces bya ba sngon gyi lo tsā ba chen po ska cog rnams kyis sku ska'am lde'u zhes bsgyur ba ni gangs can 'dir dam pa'i chos ma dar ba'i gong rol du rgyal srid sgrung lde'u bon gsum gyis bskyangs zer ba'i lde'u de yin te/ da lta ldeb rgyags pa'am bskul bar grags pa de yin zhes bstan/ mkhas dbang tshe tan zhabs drung gis lde'u'i ngag tshig brjod byar byas pa'i snyan ngag gi gab tshig 'di 'dra ba ni slob dpon daṇ+ḍi'i thugs la yang dgongs thabs med pa'i bod rang gi rig rtsal las thon pa'i snyan ngag gi rnam 'gyur gsar pa zhig yin pa kun gyis mkhyen par mdzod cig ces gsungs pa las/ lde'u zhes pa ni gab tshig dang 'dra bar bstan to//de'ang de dag gi mtshon byed dpe tsam brjod na dang po gab tshig gi dper brjod ni/ dpyis pa dge bshes blo gros rgya mtshos/thogs thug reg pa bral ba'i bar snang du/ /srin gyi bu dgu 'dren pa'i gzhal med khang / /yongs sprul dbus nas 'khor bral gtso bo'i lha/ /rig rig mig gis phyogs bcu'i slob mar blta/ /zhes pa lta bu 'bu sdom gyi gab tshig yin pa dang / gnyis pa lde'u'i dper brjod ni srong btsan sgam pos lha sa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs skabs gdung ma'i sdebs su sgrung dang lde'u bshad pa'i ri mo mang po 'bri yod par bshad pa'i nang nas lde'u'i mtshan gzhi ni/ nag po kha gdangs gdangs mig tshums/ dmar po spu med bcug cing phyung / ci yin zhes pa'i lan du mgar ba zhig gis lcags dmar po 112

gab tshig dang lde'u dang khes bcas kyi dris lan/skam pas bzung ste thab kyi nang nas 'don pa zhig ri mo bris pa yod tshul dang /gsum pa khed kyi mtshan gzhi ni/ mi brgya la ske rags gcig yod pa gang yin zhes pa dang / thang dkar dkar/ lug nag nag lug rdzi glu ba ci khed/ ces dris tshe rim bzhin phyags ma dang / dpe cha 'don mkhan zhig yin pa lta bu'o//de dag gsum gyi khyad par ni/ mi mang 'du sar gsang dgos pa'i brjod bya'i nang don rnams tshig sbyor gzhan gyi gab nas brjod de nyams mtshar ba dang ldan pa'i tshig sbyor zhig la gab tshig zer ba dang / sngon bon sgrung lde'u gsum zhes pa'i ya gyal lde'u ni gab tshig ces pa'i brda rnying tsam du zad pa dang / khed ni dmangs khrod du yongs grags che ba'i tha snyad tsam las gab tshig ces pa dang cha 'dra ba'i nyams mtshar dang ldan pa'i tshig sbyor zhig yin/ des na de gsum tshig sbyor thad snyan ngag gi rgyan gyi nyams ston tshul dang phal skad srong po'i lam nas drangs min dang tha snyad kyi ming 'dogs tshul gyi khyad par tsam las don gcig ming gi rnam grangs su grub ste/ dper na/brda rnying du nem nur dang ming gi mngon brjod du phyag mo nyug yongs grags phal skad du the tshom zhes pa dang 'dra bar snang ste/ mkhas dbang dung dkar rin po ches gab tshig gi rgyan brjod pa'i skabs su'ang /gzhan lang snga rabs lde'u dang / /yul 'gar khed ces grags pa ni/ /gangs ljongs rig rtsal las 'ongs pa'i/ /ngo mtshar gab tshig rnam grangs mang / /zhes gsungs pa 'di rang lugs gtad so 'pher ba'i rgyab rten du grub/113

ka bshad rtsom lugs kyi skor/dang po/ ka bshad ces pa'i go don skor/ka bshad ces pa ni yi ge a li dang kā li gnyis las kā li gtsor byas pa'i tshigs bcad gang de'i rkang pa'i thog rnyetha' bar gsum du rim bzhin bkod pa'am yang na gsal byed kyi go rim ldog nas gang brjod par 'dod pa'i ngag sbyor kun gsal bar bshad pas na ka bshad ces brjod/ ka bshad rtsom lugs ni bod mi rigs kyi thun-i mong ma yin pa'i mi rnams kyis ngag thog dang yig thog ci rigs nas rtsom thub pa'i gzhan gyi skad yig las khyad du 'phags pa'i yon tan ldan pa'i rtsom rig cig yin/gnyis pa/ ka bshad rtsom gyi tshig smyor gyi rnam pa/ka bshad rtsom la tshig sbyor gyi thog nas dbye na snyan tshig 'khyog po'i lam nas drangs pa'i ka bshad dang / dmangs khrod du dar khyab che ba'i ngag rtsom gyi ka bshad/ 'bol rtsom gyi ka bshad/ mgur glu'i ka bshad sogs yod pa las 'dir de dag gi mtshan gzhi dpe brjod tsam rim bzhin brjod pa las/gcig ni dper na sman ri ba blo bzang rnam rgyal gyi nyams 'char rgad po'i dris lan las/ 11༵ li'i ngos su nyer ma'i phreng brtsegs rlung gis bris pa'i mardzes sku bzhin//
