sum cu pa'i dri ba dris lam mu thi la'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/bdun/ sngon 'jug ces pa'i don gang yin/brgyad/ sngon yang gnyis la mu bzhi 'jog tshul gang 'dra yin/dgu/ ming gzhi rkyang pa'i yi ge gang dang gang yod/bcu/ sngon med pa wa la a/ 'a ra ha yi ge drug ra la gnyis kyang rkyang pa'i dbang zhes pa'i go don gang yin nam/bcu gcig ming gzhi zhes pa'i don gang yin/bcu gnyis/ spyir gsal byed sum cu yin na ming gzhi yin pas khyab bam mi khyab/ ming gzhi yin na sngon rjes yang gsum yin pas e khyab/bcu gsum/ bod yig gi nga ro'i rtsa ba gang dang gang yin/ nga ro de dag gis pho mo ma ning gi sgra'i sna ji ltar 'dren/bcu bzhi/ gsal byed sum cur sgra'i skye gnas dang / byed pa/ rtsol ba/ rgyu sogs 'dren tshul gang 'dra yod/ re re bzhin ngos 'dzin dgos/bco lnga/ med kyang rung ba'i yi ge gang yin pa dang rung ba zer dgos don ci/dris lan/gcig nga ro'i rnam pa can gyi cha nas bzhag pa'i yi ge de dbyangs yig gi mtshan nyid/ de'ang dbyangs kyi gnas dang byed pa'i rnam 'gyur mi gsal zhing / rang nyid gsal byed rnams dang phrad par brten nas ming tshig gi brjod pa'i sgra gdangs gsal bar byed nus pa la zer ba yin no//gnyis/ dbyangs bzhir bzhed pa ni gtso che ba pra ti rin chen don grub 187

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/dang / zha lu lo tsā ba/ si tu bstan pa'i nyin byed yin/ a yig dbyangs su bzhed mkhan ni sa paṇa gyi mkhas pa'i rna rgyan las bod kyi dbang du mdzad de dbyangs rnams ni lnga'o/ /gsal byed rnams ni nyi shu rtsa dgu'o zhes pa dang /dpal sgang lo tsā ba'i dag yig ngag sgron las/ dbyangs lnga ya ra la wa'i smad 'dogs zhes pa dang / dngul chu bla thog gnyis pa dbyangs can grub pa'i rdo rje'i dka' gsal me long du/ mo yig dbyangs dang mi ldan na/ pho yig gsal byed brjod mi nus/ de phyir dbyangs lngar bzhed pa bde zhes pa dang / bstan dar lha rams pas/ a la dbyangs 'jug med pas na gsal byed yin gyi a ma gtogs/ lhag ma nyi shu rtsa dgu ni/ a yig dbyangs kyis brjod pa'i phyir/ a yang dbyangs su 'du bar 'dod/ ces gsungs/thon mi'i yig phud du'ang dbyangs la gcig pur nges pa'i snyan rtsom yod pa 'di lta ste/zhal ras gsal ba rang mdangs gang ba bzang /gdam ngag zab lam ma chad tha dad rang / /las ngan bag chags thams cad bsal mdzad pa/ /'phags pa ma pham yang dag dam pa lags/ / zhes pa ltar ro//gsum/ rang grogs dbyangs dang sbyar na rang gi brjod don gsal bar byed pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'i yi ge de gsal byed kyi mtshan nyid/ de'ang ming tshig gi gzhi rtsa'i brda don gsal bar byed pa'i nus pa gtso bor 'don pa'i cha nas de skad ces brjod/bzhi/ tshad ma rig pa'i gzhung du/ brda'i dbang gis go bar bya ba de 188

sum cu pa'i dri ba dris lam mu thi la'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/brjod bya'i mtshan nyid yin/ rjod byed kyi sgra la ngo bo'i phyogs nas dbye na/ming tshig yi ge gsum/ de'ang don gyi ngo bo tsam ston pa'i sgra de ming tshig yi ge gsum du phyes pa'i ming gi mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni gdung 'degs kyi don byed nus pa la ka ba zhes brjod pa'i sgra lta bu'o/ /don byed kyi ngo bo dang khyad par sbyar nas ston pa'i sgra de ming tshig yi ge gsum du phyes pa'i tshig gi mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni ka ba sbom po lta bu'o/ /ming tshig gnyis kyi rtsom gzhir gyur pa'i skad kyi gdangs de yi ge'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan gzhi ni ka ba zhes brjod pa'i sgra'i rtsom gzhir gyur pa'i ka'i gdangs dang na ro'i gdangs dang ba'i gdangs lta bu/ de la dbye na dbyangs yig dang / gsal byed kyi yi ge gnyis so//lnga/ rang gi 'jug yul du gyur pa'i ming gzhi'i yi ge rnams kyi rjes su 'jug pa'i yi ge de rjes 'jug gi don red/ 'dir nges par ston dgos pa ni mkhas mchog si tu'i zhal lung du/ de'ang yi ge thams cad kyi rjes su 'di dag 'jug pa'i phyir rjes 'jug ces bya zhing yi ge'i grangs bcu nyid du nges pa yin zhes gsungs pa dang / yig bshad mkhas pa'i kha rgyan du spyir rjes 'jug bcu po gsal byed sum cu thams cad kyi rjes su 'jug pa la dgag pa med mod/ 'on kyang de dag gis mtha' rten byas na ming 'grub mi 'grub kyi khyad par ni/ dper na/ ba yig dang ma yig gi rjes su rjes 'jug ba ma sbyar ba bab mam lta bu'i ming bod skad la mi dgos pa de ltar sbyor mi rung ba'i tshul shes par bya dgos zhes gsungs pa'ang zhar la rtogs par bya ba'i gnad yin no//189

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/drug da dang sa gnyis rjes 'jug yin par ma zad/ yang 'jug kyang yin zhes pa'i don red/ sgra bshad ni/ rjes 'jug gi rjes su yang bskyar 'jug pas na yang 'jug ces zer ba red/da drag dang sa drag gnyis las da drag ni sngon gyi lo tsā ba chen po dag gis bsdus nas/ deng sang de tsam 'bri srol med pa chags/ 'on kyang don la thob thang yod pa shes dgos te da drag bsdus pa ltar du da drag gi mthar yod pa'i tshig phrag rnams rang 'dod kyis bcos su mi rung / dper na/ltad mo bstan to/ bka' bstsal to/ shin tu/ 'khor lo bskor to lta bur/ltad mo bstan no dang shin du lta bu ni mi 'grig go/sa drag ni dngos 'bri'i srol gyi gzhis chags pa yin te/ 'on tang bar skabs cig la sa drag gi rnam gzhag mi bzhed pa byung myong / sde dge bla ma nor bu bstan 'dzin gyis (ming gzhan sa phud bla ma )mdzad pa'i yi ge'i dag sdeb ces par sa'i yang 'jug gtan nas mi 'dod pa'i rang lugs kun dang mi mthun pa zhig bzos pa red/ de la 'ju mi pham gyis/ gzigs shig gzigs shig lugs 'di gnyis la gzigs/ gzig cig gzig cig lug 'di gnyis la gzig ces yang 'jug sa mi dgos pa zhes par brgal lan tsha thag chod cig btab pa'o//bdun/ rang gi 'jug yul du gyur pa'i ming gzhi'i yi ge rnams kyi sngon du 'jug pa'i yi ge der sngon 'jug yi ge'i mtshan nyid/brgyad/ sngon 'jug yin la yang 'jug min pa'i mu (ga ba ma 'a)yang 'jug yin la sngon 'jug min pa'i mu (sa/) gnyis ka yin pa'i mu (da/)190

sum cu pa'i dri ba dris lam mu thi la'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/de gnyis ka min pa'i mu (nga na ra sogs/)dgu/ ka kha ca cha ja nya ta tha pa pha tsa tsha dza wa zha za ya sha ha a nyi shu po ni/sngon rjes gang la'ang mi 'jug pas ming rkyang pa'ang ming gzhi kho na zhes brjod/bcu/ ming gzhi rkyang pa'i skabs su b.ral dang galag lta bu mi 'jug pa ma gtogs/ brtsegs 'dogs skabs 'jug pa yod ces pa'i don dper na brtson dang bltas lta bur 'jug pa bstan (ra dang la/)bcu gcig ming gi ched du sngon rjes gnyis kyi 'jug yul du gyur pa'i gzhi yin pas ming gzhi zhes brjod/bcu gnyis/ ming gzhi yin pas khyab yang / sngon rjes yang gsum yin pas mi khyab/ ming gzhi'i yi ge ni ming gzhi rkyang ba'i yi ge nyi shu'i khar rjes 'jug bcu bsnan par zer/ ming gzhi rkyang pa'i yi ge las ming gzhi'i yi ge khyab che ba ni/ rjes 'jug bcu dang / ming gzhi rkyang pa'i yi ge nyi shu tshang mar go ba'i phyir/ ming gzhi rkyang pa'i yi ge la ming gzhi kho na'i yi ge'ang zer ba zhar la rtogs dgos pa yin no//bcu gsum/ dbyangs kyi nga ro'i rtsa ba gsum ni ha a 'a yin/ a yig ltar sgra drag pa 'don pa ka ca sogs pho yig rnams yin pa dang / ha yig bzhin du bar ma'i sgras 'don pa/ kha cha ma sogs ma ning gi yi ge rnams yin/'a yig bzhin du sgra zhan pas 'don pa ga ja sogs mo yig yin no//bcu bzhi/ yi ge'i skye gnas brgyad yod de/ dog pa'i gnas mgrin pa dang / sna/ spyi bo gsum dang / yangs pa'i gnas khog pa/ rkan/ lce/so/ mchu bcas so/ /yi ge'i rgyu bzhi ni gzhi'i rgyu/ 'byin par byed pa'i 191

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/rgyu/ skyod par byed pa'i rgyu/ skul bar byed pa'i rgyu bcas so/ /byed pa drug gi nang du phrad pa dang / cung zad phrad pa/ btsum pa/ phye ba/ dog pa/ yangs pa bcas so/ /rtsol ba gsum ni rnam rtog dang skul slong /rlung bcas so//bco lnga/ wa yig ni ba phyed wa ru 'bod pa yin zhes pa ltar/ phal cher ba dang sbyor mtshungs shing / der ma zad ming gzhi la'ang wa skyes wa kha lta bu nyung zad cig las med pa'i phyir gsal byed sum cu las wa yig 'di la med kyang chog pa'i yi ge zhes brjod do// dzi192

rgyugs shog rtsom 'bri'i rnam gzhag la thog mar dpyad pa/rgyugs shog ni mi'i rigs kyi slob grwa dbu brnyes pa dang dus mnyam du byung zhing rgyugs shog rtsom 'bri ni slob grwa khag gi dge rgan gyis rgyun par spyod pa'i yig rigs shig yin pa dang / khyad par du nye ba'i char 'bring rim slob grwa dang slob grwa chen mo'i slob ma bsdu skabs sogs la spyod pa'i gal che'i rtsom 'bri'i shes bya zhig tu gyur nas tang dang / srid gzhung / khyim bdag bcas spyi tshogs hril pos do 'khur shin tu chen po byed kyi yod pas/ 'dir rgyugs shog rtsom 'bri'i go don dang rnam gzhag skor la thog mar dpyad pa'i tshul gyis 'chad pa la dpyod ldan rnams kyis dpyad par 'tshal/dang po/ rgyugs zhes pa'i go don/rgyugs zhes pa ni rig pa'i gnas ci 'dra zhig sbyong ba po'i khong tu sbyangs goms ji ltar byung tshul tshad 'jal rtogs zhib bya ba'i thabs lam 'ba' zhig la brjod pa yin/ rang re bod la mtshon na rig gzhung bgro gleng gi ngag rgyugs dang / dpe cha blo 'dzin gyi tshig rgyugs/ brjod bya'i don rjod byed tshig gi phreng ba'i lam nas spel ba'i rtsom rgyugs/ yig gzugs kyi rgyugs zhes pa'i srol kha gna' snga mo nas dar zhing / khyad par du bod zhi bas bcings 193

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/'grol btang ba nas bzung slob grwa che 'bring chung gsum gyi slob ma bsdu ba'i rgyugs dang / slob yun so so'i nang gi sbyangs 'bras tshad 'jal gyi rgyugs/zhib 'jug slob ma bsdu ba'i rgyugs/ spyi tshogs thog nas las bzo pa bsdu ba'i rgyugs sogs rnam pa mang dag dar ro//gnyis pa/ rgyugs kyi rnam dbye/rgyugs la rnam pa'i thog nas dbye na dus mtshams rang bzhin dang /khongs gtogs rang bzhin/ dpyad zhib rang bzhin/ tshad 'jal rang bzhin sogs kyi rgyugs yod ste/1 dus mtshams rang bzhin gyi rgyugs/ zhes pa ni dus tshod tshad gzhir byas nas len pa'i slob dkyil rgyugs dang slob mjug gi rgyugs/ slob lo'i rgyugs/ slob thon rgyugs bcas lta bu mig sngar slob grwa che 'bring chung gsum nang lag bstar bya mus yin pa de dag tshang ma dus mtshams so so'i nang sbyong dgos nges kyi shes bya khag slob mas khong du chud min dang / dge rgan gyis 'khrid bya khag legs sgrub thub min lta ba'i slob grwa'i slob gso slob khrid kyi gal che'i lhu tshigs shig red/ des rang gis rang la tshad 'jal dang / rang gis rang la skul 'ded/ skyon spangs dge sgrub bcas byas nas sbyangs 'bras sngar bas bzang po 'thob rgyur skul 'ded kyi nus pa shugs chen thon gyi yod/2 khongs gtogs rang bzhin gyi rgyugs/ zhes pa ni dper na rgyal spyi'i rang bzhin gyi rgyugs te rgyal spyi'i rtsis rig 'gran bsdur gyi rgyugs dang /rgyal khab rang bzhin gyi rgyugs te rgyal yongs kyi mtho rim slob grwa'i slob ma bsdu 194

rgyugs shog rtsom 'bri'i rnam gzhag la thog mar dpyad pa/ba'i rgyugs lta bu/ sa khul rang bzhin gyi rgyugs te dper na/ 1995lo'i ljongs yongs kyi nang sa'i bod ljongs 'dzin grwa'i dma' rim slob 'bring gi slob ma bsdu ba'i gcig gyur rgyugs lta bu/ las khungs rang bzhin gyi rgyugs te bzo grwa'am slob grwa'i nang gtong ba'i rgyugs dper na lha sa ar 'dam bzo grwa'i mtho rim lag rtsal gyi go ming len pa'i rgyugs lta bu'o//3 dpyad zhib rang bzhin gyi rgyugs/ zhes pa ni dngos gzhi'i gcig gyur gyi rgyugs la ma zhugs gong shes tshad lta zhib bya lugs shig la zer te/ de'ang slob khrid skabs kyi dri ba dris lan dang / sbyang gzhi bkol ba'i dpyad zhib/slob khrid kyi 'char gzhi ltar sbyangs pa'i shes bya rnams khong du chud min lta ba'i phyogs bsdoms rang bzhin gyi dpyad zhib/ tshad ldan gyi slob thon slob ma zhig yin min lta ba'i tshod lta'i rgyugs sogs yod de/ de dag ni slob grwa khag gi nang khyab gdal che'o//4 tshad 'jal rang bzhin gyi rgyugs/ zhes pa ni deng skabs rgyal yongs su 'bring rim ched las slob ma dang / mtho rim slob ma/ zhib 'jug slob ma/ las rig lag rtsal slob ma sogs bsdu skabs gcig gyur thog rgyugs len byed pa'i lam lugs la zer/ de ni slob gso'i srid 'dzin las khungs kyis rgyugs sprod kyi nang don dang / rig tshan/ tshad gzhi sogs gcig gyur gyi gtan la phab pa'i slob grwa'i slob gso slob khrid kyi las don la tshad 'jal rang bzhin ldan pa'i gzhi rgya che ba'i rgyugs shig yin/ de ni slob grwa dang / dge rgan/ slob ma/ khyim bdag sogs kyi skyid sdug dang khe dbang la thad kar 'brel ba che khar rgyugs kyi sgrig 'dzugs dang / rtsa 'dzin/ bskyar sbyong gi 195

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/khyab khongs/ rgyugs shog rgyugs ra'i sgrig khrims/ rgyugs shog bzo bcos sogs kyi lhu tshigs la do dam shin tu chen po byed dgos pa'i don chen zhig tu gyur yod do// gsum pa/ rgyugs shog gi 'dri gzhi 'don lugs/gcig rgyugs 'don pa por tshang dgos pa'i yon tan/rgyugs shog gi nang don gnad 'phigs dang tshad ldan lugs mthun zhig yong thub min gyi 'gag rtsa ni rgyugs 'don mkhan la rag las pas/ des na rgyugs 'don mkhan la ma mthar yang gsham gsal yon tan dag nges par du tshang dgos pa ste/1 yul la bstun par mkhas dgos pa/ rgyugs shog legs nyes kyi gal che'i grub cha zhig ni rgyugs 'don mkhan gyis rgyugs gtong mkhan gyi shes tshad la khyon yongs nas bstun thub min de yin/ de'ang slob grwa'i rim pa dang /lo na'i khyad chos/ rgyugs kyi ngo bo bcas brtag par mkhas dgos te/ de ltar byed dgos don ni be'u la glang lto dang glang la be'u lto lta bu'i dka' sla'i mtha' gnyis su mi lhung ba'i slad du yin pas/ yul la dpyad de rgyugs 'don gyi dka' sla gtan la phab na slob ma'i chu tshad ngo ma rgyugs 'phen thub pa'i khyad yon ldan no/ /2༄rig tshan der byang tshad mtho po dgos pa/ rig tshan gang 'dra zhig gi rgyugs 'don dgos na/ rgyugs 'don mkhan rang nyid rig tshan de'i dge rgan nam slob gzhi rtsom sgrig pa/ yang na ched las rgyugs 'don pa'am rig 196

rgyugs shog rtsom 'bri'i rnam gzhag la thog mar dpyad pa/gcig mkhas can yin pa gzhir byas bslab gzhi de'i rtsa 'dzin dang nang don cha tshang sbar mthil du blangs pa lta bu'i byang tshad dang rgyus mnga' yod dgos/de ltar byung na som nyi'i 'dri gzhi dang / ya mtshan gyi 'dri gzhi/ ches dka' sla'i 'dri gzhi/ tha na bslab gzhi las ring du 'das pa'i 'dri gzhi sogs mi thon par rgyugs gtong ba'i dmigs yul dngos sgrub thub/3 tshan mtho'i 'gan 'khri dang bsam smyor gtsang ma dgos pa/ tshad dang ldan pa'i rgyugs 'don pa zhig yin phyin gsham gsal gyi cha rkyen khag 'dzoms dgos pa ste/ rgyal khab dang / slob grwa/ khyim bdag slob ma bcas la lhag bsam rnam dag gis 'gan khur ba'i bsam sbyor dgos pa dang gcigabasam pa'i 'khyer so bzang la sgam brling ldan pa/ rtog dpyod kyi rig pa rno ba dang rang gis rang gcun la mkhas dgos pa dang gnyis/ rgyugs dang 'brel yod kyi gsang rgya sdom par btsun pa dang gsum/ nye mi ring du dor te nyi zla'i 'od bgrod ltar ris med bya dgos pa dang bzhi bcas tshang dgos/gnyis/ rgyugs 'don gyi rtsa don/1 slob khrid kyi rtsa 'dzin ltar 'don dgos pa'i rtsa don/ rgyugs len rgyu ni slob gnyer pa'i sbyangs 'bras dang slob khrid kyi phan 'bras la dpyad bsdur byed pa'i thabs lam dam pa zhig yin pa dang / rim pa khag gi slob grwa'i rig tshan dang ched las gso skyong gi dmigs tshad/ bslab gzhi sogs tha dad yin pa des rgyugs kyi zhib phra'i nang don yang tha dad 'ongs bar gor mi chaga'on kyang rgyugs 'don skabs tshang mas slob khrid kyi dmigs tshad dang / rtsa 197

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/'dzin gyis tshangs thig bya dgos pa las dge rgan gyis rang 'dod ltar rgyugs kyi nang don dang tshad gzhi/ re ba mtho ru'am yang na dma' ru gtong mi chog par nges par du rig tshan de'i spyi'i slob khrid kyi dmigs tshad dang las 'gan/re ba sogs tshang ma rtsa 'dzin gzhir bzung nas rgyugs 'don byed dgos pa ni ches rtsa bar gyur pa'i rtsa don yin/2 tshan rig gi rang bzhin ldan dgos pa'i rtsa don/ rgyugs la tshan rig gi rang bzhin ldan dgos zhes pa ni/ rgyugs gtong ba'i dmigs yul dngos ni spyi tshogs gang de'i chab srid dang dpal 'byor/ tshan rig rig gnas 'phel rgyas 'gro ba'i dgos mkho dang 'tsham pa'i shes ldan mi sna gso skyong bya rgyu de kho na yin pas/ rgyugs kyi nang don dang dmigs tshad gal te spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi don dngos dang kha bral na shes ldan mi sna gso skyong dang /gdam gses/ bed spyod bcas bya rgyu nyams zhan du phyin te spyi tshogs hril po'am mi rigs hril po'i byang tshad la gnod che bas nges par du spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi chos nyid dang mthun dgos pa dang gcig rgyugs gtong mkhan gyi khrod du lo na che chung dang / spyi tshogs kyi sde tshan/ khyim tshang /khor yug blo gros sogs tha dad pa'i dbang gis mi'i sems khams kyang cung mi 'dra bar yod gshis/ rgyugs 'don skabs rgyugs len yul gyi sems khams kyi chos nyid dang bstun gang thub bya dgos pa dang gnyis/ rgyugs len pa'i dmigs yul dang / nang don/ rnam pa bcas las ma 'gal bar rgyugs kyi rtsa ba'i chos nyid dang mthun dgos pa dang gsum mo//3 tshig nyung gnad 'dzigs kyi rang bzhin ldan dgos pa'i rtsa don/ 'di 198

rgyugs shog rtsom 'bri'i rnam gzhag la thog mar dpyad pa/ni rgyugs kyi 'dri gzhi'i khrod dgos med tshig ro ring du spangs nas rjod byed kyi tshig rnams nyung la brjod don gnad 'phigs kha gsal go bde yin dgos pa ste/ 'dri gzhir brda rnying la sogs pas ma bcings par rgyugs gtong mkhan gyis 'dri gzhir rang blos brtag nas lan ji ltar 'debs dgos pa gsal po rtogs thub pa dgos pa dang gcig rtsod gzhir gyur pa'i rigs 'dri gzhir mi byed par rigs pas dpyad bzod kyi rigs 'don dgos pa dang gnyis/'dri gzhi'i nang don som nyi'i dra bar tshud 'gro ba'i rigs spong dgos pa dang gsum/ 'dri gzhi khungs btsan po dgos pa dang bzhi bcas rtsa don de rnams tshang na rgyugs 'don mkhan dang rgyugs gtong mkhan bar gyi log rtogs sel thub pa'i dge mtshan ldan no//4 khron yongs nas tshad 'jal ba'i rang bzhin ldan dgos pa'i rtsa don/rgyugs len ni rgyugs gtong mkhan de'i rmang gzhi'i shes bya dang rigs lam/dpyad stobs sogs phyogs gang ci'i thad kyi shes yon de slob khrid rtsa 'dzin nang bton pa'i tshad gzhi dang mthun min dpyad zhib tshad 'jal bya rgyu de yin/des na rgyugs la'ang nges par du gtso gnad 'bur thon dang khyon yongs la dpyad zhib dang tshad 'jal byed thub pa dang gcig dran shes dang go stobs sogs phyogs gang ci'i thad kyi nus rtsal la dpyad zhib dang tshad 'jal byed thub pa dang gnyis/ slob ma rnams slob chung nas 'go brtsams te gtso bo slob khang nang du dpe cha'i nang gi shes bya thos bsam bya rgyu shas che zhing /lag len dngos kyi shes rgya cung chung bas rgyugs kyi 'dri gzhir rigs pa'i gzhung lugs dang lag len dngos kyi 'brel ba thag gcod yang dag bya dgos 199

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/pa dang gsum bcas rgyugs shog gi 'dri gzhi 'don pa'i spyi'i rtsa don tshul du brjod pa dag re zhig de tsam gyis rdzogs par byas/gsum/ 'dri gzhi'i nang don rigs dbye byed pa/bod kyi sngar srol rgyugs len bya thabs la tshig rgyugs dang / don rgyugs/rtsom rgyugs/ yig rgyugs bcas rigs che ba bzhi la dbye yod pa/ deng gi char yang chu sna mi gcig brgya dang brgyad 'du sa rgya mtsho chen po zhes pa'i dpe ltar rig pas dpyad na 'di la ma 'dus pa yang ma mchis snyam/1 tshig rgyugs/ tshig rgyugs zhes pa ni rig tshan de'i rtsa tshig dang /sdom tshig mtshan nyid rnam grangs dang nges srol sogs blor 'dzin dgos pa'i rigs dag nges thub min lta ba'i rgyugs kyi thabs dam pa zhig ste ming gzhan la blo tshig dang blo rgyugs yang zer/ rgyugs dngos 'don skabs de'i nang don nges par du mtshon dgos pa ste dper na bod yig la mtshon na sum rtags kyi rtsa tshig dang / snyan ngag gi sdom tshig lta bu'o //2 don rgyugs/ don rgyugs zhes pa ni gzhung don la go ba len tshad de rig pas dpyad zhib byas te nang don thag gcod byed pa'i rig stobs kyi chu tshad mtho dman lta ba'i rgyugs kyi thabs dam pa zhig ste/ sngar srol ltar na bod kyi dgon sde khag tu slob dpon gyis 'dri gzhi gsal 'don gyis rigs pa'i bgro gleng dang / nang don nges med kyi bgro gleng byas te lan gnad la 'khel min rtsod rgyugs len srol yod cing / deng gi char yang slob gnyer ba'i rtsa ba'i nus rtsal dngos tshad 'jal phyir don rgyugs kyi nang don ches mang 200

rgyugs shog rtsom 'bri'i rnam gzhag la thog mar dpyad pa/ba dgos pa ste dper na bod yig la mtshon na snyan ngag sum rtags kyi dper brjod nang gses ngos 'dzin bya rgyu dang / rtsom gyi gong 'og la dpyad de 'os mtshams kyi phrad dang rnam dbye 'jug rgyu/ tshig don rgyas 'grel bya rgyu/rigs bsgre bya rgyu/ dris lan gnad la 'phigs min rnam 'byed nor bcos sogs bsam gzhigs bya rgyu'i 'dri gzhi mtshon dgos pa lta bu'o//3 rtsom rgyugs/ rtsom rgyugs zhes pa ni ji ltar byas te sbyangs zin pa'i ches rmang gzhir gyur pa'i shes bya rnams bed spyad de spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba dngos mtshon pa'i rtsom 'bri'i chu tshad ji tsam la slebs pa lta ba'i thabs lam zhig yin/sngar srol ltar na gzhung gang sbyangs zin pa'i mtshams su der rtsom rgyugs re len srol yod cing / deng gi char rgyugs shog steng rtsom gyi kha byang gtan phab kyis rtsom rgyugs len pa shas che zhing de la'ang rtsom gyi nang don dang / yig 'bru'i grangs/ yi ge'i dag cha sogs kyi re ba gsal 'don byas pa'i rtsom rgyugs dang / gzhan yang myong 'bri dang / rgyas 'bri/ bsdus 'bri bya ba'i rtsom rgyugs kyi 'dri gzhi 'don srol dar mus lags so//4 yig rgyugs/ yig rgyugs zhes pa ni lo rim mtho dman la gzhigs te yig gzugs kyi tshad gzhi lon min lta ba'i rgyugs shig ste sngar srol ltar na yig gzugs slob pa'i go rim re re bzhin du rgyugs len pa dang / slob grwa thon mtshams su yig gzugs che chung rigs mi 'dra ba tshang ma rgyugs len srol yod cing / da lta'i rgyugs sprod lam lugs rtsa 'dzin nang 'khod pa'i dmigs re dang / rgyugs len gnyis tha dad du phyin pa'i 'gal 'dzol tshabs chen byung ba des deng gi slob gnyer pa rnams kyi yig gzugs zhan pa dang / yig 201

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/gzugs la dang dod gtan nas mi byed pa'i phugs 'bras ngan pa 'di thon pas slad mar mes po'i phyag rgyun mi nyams pa'i phyir nges par du rgyugs kyi 'dri gzhi'i nang yig rgyugs kyi nang don mtshon rgyur dgos gal che'o//bzhi/ 'dri gzhi'i rnam pa/'dri gzhi'i rnam pa zhes pa ni dri ba dngos 'don skabs thabs 'phrul rnam pa sna tshogs spyad de rgyugs gtong ba po'i shes tshad 'jal bar byed pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi rnam pa zhig ste de la rags tsam dbye na/1 dri ba dris lan gyi rnam pa/ rnam pa de ni rtsa ba'i tha snyad dang / rtsa ba'i rig gzhung / gzhi rtsa'i lo rgyus sogs kyi shes bya'i tshad dpyad zhib bya rgyur spyod sgo che khar 'dri gzhi 'don las sla shos kyi khyad yon ldan yod/ de na 'dri gzhi gcig las 'da' mi rung ba dang gcig 'dri gzhi'i nang dris lan dang 'brel yod kyi tshig sna'i rigs spong dgos pa dang gnyis/ bslab gzhi dang dpyad gzhi'i yig rigs nang 'khod pa'i 'dri ba rang sor 'god rgyu spong dgos pa dang gsum mo//2 stong cha kha skong gi rnam pa/ stong cha kha skong gi 'dri ba zhes pa ni nang don cha ma tshang ba rnams gong 'og gi brjod don la dpyad de 'os shing 'tshams pa'i ming tshig dang phrad/ rnam dbye dang grangs la sogs pa'i nang don bcug ste 'jug pa bde zhing go rim ma 'khrug par brjod don cha tshang zhig ston thub pa bya rgyu de'o/ /dper na bod kyi yi ge la dbye na —yod ces pa dang /mngon brjod la dbye ba —yod ces pa lta bu'o// —202

rgyugs shog rtsom 'bri'i rnam gzhag la thog mar dpyad pa/3 gdam nga'i rnam pa/ gdam nga'i rnam pa'i 'dri gzhi zhes pa ni 'dri gzhi gcig la dris lan gsum nas lnga re yod pa las yang dag pa'i dris lan gcig las med pa de 'dems dgos pa la zer/ de ni mtshon rtags kyis dris lan mtshon par byas pas rgyugs gtong mkhan dang bzo mkhan gnyis kar stabs bde ba'i khyad yon yod mod/ 'on kyang rgyugs gtong ba po'i rtsom 'bri'i nus pa dang / bsam gzhigs kyi nus pa/ don dngos kyi shes bya'i tshad mang drags na skyon las dge nyung bar sems/4 'grig min rnam 'byed kyi rnam pa/ 'grig min rnam 'byed kyi rnam pa'i 'dri gzhi zhes pa ni brjod bya'i tshul de yang dag yin min rang blos brdar sha bcad de 'grig na 'grig rtags dang / nor na nor rtags rgyag dgos pa'i rigs shig la zer/ 'di dang gdam nga'i 'dri gzhi mi 'dra ba'i gnad don ni 'di la 'grig min gyi lan gnyis las gdam nga med pa dang / cig shos la gsum yan yod pa de'o//5 mtshams smyor gyi rnam pa/ mtshams sbyor gyi rnam pa'i 'dri gzhi zhes pa ni go rim 'khrug pa'i brjod don rnams 'os 'tshams kyis mda' rtse'i gzugs ris kyis mtshams sbyor byed pa'i rigs shig la zer ba/ dper na gsham gsal rtsom pa po dang brtsams chos 'os 'tshams kyis mtshams sbyor bya dgos pa ste/ rā ma ṇa'i rtogs brjod/ sba gsal snang / dbyangs can dgyes glu/blo bzang grags pa/ mi dbang rtogs brjod/ tshe ring dbang rgyal/ byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngu'i rtogs brjod/ zhang zhung chos dbang grags pa/deb ther dkar po/ dge 'dun chos 'phel/ sba bzhed/ rje tsong kha pa lta 203

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/bu'o//6 rtsom 'bri'i rnam pa/ rtsom 'bri'i rnam pa zhes pa ni phyogs bsdus rang bzhin ldan pa'i rgyugs kyi rnam pa zhig ste/ de las bsam pa'i 'khyer so dang /thos rgya/ 'tsho ba'i nyams myong / sum rtags dag gsum tshig sbyor sogs kyi shes tshad mtshon gyi yod/ rtsom 'bri'i 'dri gzhi 'don skabs slob gzhi'i nang 'khod kyi rtsom lugs mi 'dra ba'i rtsom gyi rnam pa la dpyad de spyir rgyugs sprod mkhan phal mo ches so so'i khyad yon la gzhigs te rtsom 'bri'i nus pa dang /bye brag tu rtsom 'bri'i nus pa cher ldan pa rnams la dpa' bor dpa' rtsal 'don yul bshams pa bzhin rtsom 'bri'i nus pa drag zhan dbye lam ring du chod thub pa dgos pa'o//7 nor bcos kyi rnam pa/ nor bcos kyi rnam pa zhes pa ni bod yig la mtshon na sum rtags dag gsum gyi dgongs pa dang mi mthun pa rnams bcos dgos pa dang gcig rtsom thung zhig bris te de'i brjod tshul 'jig rten na ma grags pa dang / de min rigs lam dang ma mthun pa rnams bcos dgos pa dang gnyis/ rnam pa 'di ni rgyugs 'don skabs rgyun par spyod pa'i rnam pa zhig go/8 blta klog gi rnam pa/ 'dri gzhi'i rnam pa 'di ni rgyugs sprod mkhan la rtsom thung zhig blta klog bya rgyu mkho 'don byas te de rjes so so'i go stobs la dpags te dris lan gdab rgyu'i rnam pa zhig ste de la'ang gdams ga'i dris lan dang / dris lan thad 'debs kyi rnam pa gnyis yod/ gong smros dag ni rgyugs kyi 'dri gzhi dngos la 'jug skabs rgyugs 'don pa por tshang dgos 204

rgyugs shog rtsom 'bri'i rnam gzhag la thog mar dpyad pa/pa'i yon tan dang / gzab brtan bya dgos pa'i skor la zur bltas leb mthong gi tshul du kho bo'i blo rgya thos rgya khab mig lta bu las mthong ba'i chos so//bzhi pa/ rgyugs shog 'char 'god/rgyugs shog gang 'dra zhig yin rung spyir 'go brjod dang 'dri gzhi dngos bcas grub cha che ba gnyis las grub pa ste/gcig 'go brjod/1 gsang thig nang du (1)rgyugs gtong mkhan gyi slob grwa'am tshan pa (2)ming (3)ang rtags 'bri dgos/2 'go brjod dngos nang du nges par du don tshan drug tshang dgos pa ste/(1)rgyugs gtong ba'i dus tshod/ (2)tshan pa'i khyab khongs/ (3)rim pa ste slob grwa che 'bring chung gsum/ (4)ngo bo ste slob thon nam lo rim 'phar ba sogs/ (5)rig tshan te bod rgya rtsis sogs/ (6)skar thob 'god sa'i re'u mig bcas so//gnyis/ 'dri gzhi dngos/rgyugs kyi rim pa dang rig tshan/ ngo bo/ re 'dun sogs rnam pa sna tshogs la brten nas 'dri gzhi'i grangs 'bor yang mi 'dra ba sna tshogs yong srid rung / spyir na 'dri gzhi che ba 1—6dang yang na 1—7bar dang /nang gses 'dri gzhi chung ba 'ga' las grub/ 'dri gzhi che ba re'i mtshams su thob grangs dang bcos mkhan gyi mtshan bkod sa'i re'u mig chung ba zhig 205
bcos mkhan

rgyugs shog rtsom 'bri'i rnam gzhag la thog mar dpyad pa/gang ra sprod par bya ba'i rang gi —dang rang gi —de la zer zhing / sgrub byed zer ba ni rang gi —dang —yang dag pa yin pa ra sprod byed pa'i rgyu mtshan de la zer/ sgrub rim zhes pa ni —kyis —bsgrub par bya ba'i brgyud rim la'o//2 bya byed tha dad pa ni bya ba gang zhig byed kyang gedang —gnyis tha dad du yod pa zhig dgos/ bya byed tha dad pa ni bya ba gang byed rung de sgrub pa'i rgyu zhig med pa mi srid rung bya ba de sgrub bzhin pa'i skabs —dngos su mi sna ba'am/ yang na —dang gnyis tha dad du mi snang ba zhig go/3 rnam dbye drug pa 'brel sgra zhes pa ni ming don —don la 'jug cing /rnam dbye gsum pa byed sgra ste —ston pa'i don can la 'jug go/4 spyir 'phrin yig re rer yang don tshan —tshang dgos so//5 dpe deb klog pa'i chu tshad mtho ru gtong phyir rgyun du dpe deb klog pa'i gtso gnad tho yig 'bri stangs sbyong brdar byed dgos pa ste/ dpe deb gcig bklags rjes de'i da 'jog stangs gsal po rtogs pa byas thog da so so'i gtso don bton nas tho yig tu 'god dgos pa dang / da dung de —phyogs bsdoms kyang byed dgos/gnyis/ gsham gyi stong cha'i nang du sum cu pa'i byed 'azel gyi phrad 'jug dgos/ skar 51 nyam chung skye bo der byams snying rje ( )sems ( )zas gos gya nom pa sbyin/2 khang chung ( )khung bu rnams ras ( )bkag207
bcos mkhan

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/khong drug yul nas thon te phyi rol gyi 'jig rten la ltad mor song / spun zla drug pos rang rang gi yon tan la brten nas zas gos gnas mal la sems khral med par dga' dga' spro spros rgyal khams rig pas bskor te/ sngar mthong ma myong ba'i ltad mo mang po mthong / mig rgya bskyed pas blo rgya lhag par cher song / nyin zhig kho tshos gros byas tepha‘da bar nga tsho lhan cig song nas ltad mo mang po mthong / da nga tsho so sor gyes nas mi re lung pa re la 'gro/lo gsum 'khor nas sa 'dir 'dus te rang gi mthong thos shes gsum kha khog pas ma gsang / blo sgyu mas ma bskum par bshad ’’zer nas mi drug pos bla shing re btsugs/ ‘‘lo gsum 'gor nas der 'dus tshe su'i bla shing skam pa dang / su ma 'ongs na tshang mas de 'tshol dgosami’zhes kha chad byas nas phan tshun gus gus 'dud 'dud bcas so sor gyes so//gong gsal rtsom yig dum bu der bltas te gsham gyi 'dri bar lan 'debs dgos/1 bu drug po rang rang gi pha'i rjes su 'brangs nas lag rtsal la byang pa thon tshul dpe gang la bzhag 'dug gam/ skar 22 bu drug pos gros byas te 'jig rten rgyal khams rig pas bskor dgos don ci yin/ skar 13 na gzhon drug por thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos gsum yod pa re re byas nas bris dang / skar 3212
bcos mkhan

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/drug pa/ rtsom yig 'bri rgyu/ skar 35rtsom gyi kha byang /1 ngas gus bkur che shos byed pa'i mi zhig 2 phran dang gshibs yun ring ba'i slob grogs shig214

nub rgyud thon 'byed chen mo'i khrod rang ljongs su shes ldan mi sna'i 'byung khungs ji ltar gsar spel bya ba'i 'char sgo 'ga' gleng ba/dang po/ nub rgyud thon 'byed chen mo'i sa khul ngos 'dzin pa'i skor/bsgyur bcos sgo dbye byas pa nas bzung rang rgyal gyi dpal 'byor de skas rim bzhin 'phel rgyas gtang rgyu'i phugs jus spel te/ dpal 'byor gyi rmang gzhi dang / 'phel rgyas kyi cha rkyen/ srid jus kyi dmigs bsal bcas kyi khyad 'phags ldan pa'i rang rgyal gyi pe cin dang / nan cin/ hrang ha'e/kong tung / ha'e nan/ cang su'u sogs gtsor byas pa'i shar rgyud zhing chen dang grong khyer bcu gnyis/ hran zhi (①a+yo)dang nang sog ci lin/ an hu'e/ cang zhi/ hu'u nan sogs gtsor byas pa'i dbus rgyud zhing chen dang rang skyong sa khul dgu/ khrung ching dang / zi khron/ ku'e kra'u/ bod ljongs/ hra'an zhi (lko.o)kan su'u/ mtsho sngon/ nying zha/ shin cang /yun nan bcas nub rgyud zhing chen dang / grong khyer/ rang skyong ljongs bcur 'bod pa'i shar rgyud dang / nub rgyud/ dbus rgyud bcas gnas bab chen mo gsum chags/215

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/nub rgyud kyi khul 'di ni sa rgya che la/ thon khungs phun sum tshogs pa/grangs nyung mi rigs phal mo che 'di'i rgyud la gna' snga mo nas gzhis chags 'tsho sdod bya kyi yod de ( krung go'i bod kyi shes rig〉 las nub rgyud kyi zhing chen dang / grong khyer/ rang skyong ljongs bcu tshud pa'i nub rgyud sa khul du sa rgya spyi le gru bzhi ma 540tsam yod pa des rgyal yongs kyi skam sa'i rgya khyon gyi brgya cha'i 56dang / mi 'bor dung phyur 2 85yod pa des rgyal yongs kyi brgya cha'i 23zin zhes gsungs①par gzhigs na rang rgyal gyi nub rgyud 'di sa rgya che la gter rdzas dang / chu bed/ rdo snum/ rdo sol/ rlung shugs/nyi ma'i tsha nus/ chu tshan sogs thon khungs rgyal yongs kyi go 'phangs mtho shos zin yod de (shes bya ni stobs shugs yin 〉 zhes pa las/ da lta rtsad chod zin pa'i gter rdzas kyi rigs 200lhag tsam yod pa'i nang nas nub rgyud khul du rigs 140tsam zin la rang rgyal gyi rtswa thang chen mo lnga las gsum nub rgyud du yod pa dang / nub rgyud sa khul dang sbrel ba'i mtha' bskor gyi rgyal khab dang sa khul bcu drug yod ces gsungs/② des na nub rgyud la gzhan su yis kyang 'gran par dka' ba'i rang byung thon khungs dang / phyi snod kyi rang byung zhing khams kyi khyad 'phags rang bzhin gyi cha rkyen mnga' ba'o//gnyis pa/ nub rgyud thon 'byed chen mo'i gal che'i don snying gi skor/rang rgyal gyi dpal 'byor de bya 'phur ba ltar 'phel rgyas chen po byung ste/216

nub rgyud thon 'byed khrod rang ljongs su shes ldan mi sna gsar spel ji ltar bya ba'i skor/bgrang bya nyis brgya'i sngon du bzo las dpal 'byor gyis zhing las dpal 'byor gyi tshab byas te spyi tshogs yar 'phel la sman pa'i legs skyes bstsal/deng gi char shes rab dpal 'byor gyis bzo las dpal 'byor gyi tshab byed pa'i dus rabs gsar par blo kha gtad/ de ni mi'i rigs kyi spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi gsar brje chen po gnyis par grags/ blo mthun cang tse min gyis srog shing byas pa'i tang krung dbyang gis nub rgyud sa khul gyi 'das dang /da lta/ ma 'ongs bcas kyi chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ rig gnas sogs kyi rnam par dpyad de/ khong yangs dkyel che dang / gzigs rgyang ring pos mgyogs myur ngang nub rgyud thon 'byed bya dgos pa'i dung sgra phyogs bcur bsgrags/ de ni dus rabs nyer gcig par blo kha phyogs shing mi rigs mthun sgril zab tu gtong ba dang / spyi tshogs brtan lhing rgyun 'khyongs thub pa/ mtha' srung sra brtan/ shar rgyud dang nub rgyud bar gyi he bag je chung du btang nas mthar thun mong mnyam phyug chags par byed pa'i dgongs gzhi'i phugs jus chen mo zhig ste/ nub rgyud sa khul ni dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas cung nyag phra ba'i sa khul sha stag yin pas rgyal khab kyis nub rgyud thon 'byed gyi thabs lam la brten nas de'i rgyud kyi 'byung khams dang / mnga' 'bangs kyi 'tsho ba legs bcos kyis 'phel rgyas che ba'i shar rgyud dang mnyam du phyug po'i lam bur bskyod rgyu'i 'thab jus dang gcig nub rgyud kyi mtha' 'khor ni phyi'i rgyab khab dang / sa khul bcu drug tsam gyi sa mtshams dang sbrel nas gnas yod pas/ tshong zog phyir 'tshong nang 'dren dang / mtha' mtshams sra brtan dang 'dzugs skrun bya rgyur gal che'i don snying ldan pa dang gnyis/217

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/rang rgyal shar rgyud kyi dpal 'byor dar rgyas je cher phyin rung thon khungs nyams zhan du 'gro ba'i rnam pa zhig thon dang thon mus lags pas/ nub rgyud ni sa rgya che la/ rang byung thon khungs phun sum tshogs pa'i mi mngon pa'i khrom ra'i nus shugs chen mo zhig yod pas/ gal te nub rgyud thon 'byed myur bar byas na/ gzhi nas shar rgyud dang nub rgyud sa khul gnyis mnyam du 'phel rgyas kyis rgyal khab kyi deng rabs can mngon gyur bya rgyur don snying gting zab ldan pa dang gsum/ deng gi dus 'dir shes bya'i rba klong 'phyur bzhin/ cha 'phrin dang / glog rdul rtsis rgyag 'khor lo'i dus rabs gsar rkyang zhig tu slebs tsa na/ nub rgyud du shes ldan mi sna dang / lag rtsal gsar pa/ do dam lam lugs gsar pa/ rig pa gsar pa nang 'dren gyis de'i rgyud kyi dpal 'byor dar rgyas dang / spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas/ rang byung sa khams bdag srung / yul mi'i byang tshad mtho ru gtang rgyu'i phugs jus chen po dang bzhi/ nub rgyud thon 'byed bya rgyu ni rang re'i krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab kyi lhu lag yongs su rdzogs pa dar rgyas bkra shis phun tshogs kyi dgongs gzhi chen po yin la blo mthun teng zha'o phing gis gtan la phab pa'i rang rgyal spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi deng rabs can 'dzugs skrun byed rgyu de cha yongs su tshang ba'i sgo nas 'phel rgyas gtang rgyu'i lo brgya'i 'thab jus dang /rang rgyal gyi deng rabs can gyi 'dzugs skrun gyi gom stabs rim pa gsum pa'i dmigs tshad mngon 'gyur bya bar don snying zab mo ldan pa dang lnga'o//218

nub rgyud thon 'byed khrod rang ljongs su shes ldan mi sna gsar spel ji ltar bya ba'i skor/gsum pa/ nub rgyud thon 'byed chen mo'i khrod kyi rang ljongs kyi shes ldan mi sna'i 'byung khungs gsar spel gyi skor/bod rigs ni bod rang skyong ljongs gtsor byas pa'i mi rigs shig yin pas sa khams dang / skye khams kyi khor yug gis dpal 'byor thad zhing phyugs las kyi gnyer skyong gtso bor byed kyi yod pa red/ thengs 'di'i nub rgyud thon 'byed chen po'i skabs su krung dbyang gis rmang gzhi'i sgrig bkod 'dzugs skrun bya rgyu dang gcig 'byung khams khor yug srung skyong byas nas 'dzugs skrun bya rgyu dang gnyis/ thon las kyi grub cha legs su gtang rgyu dang gsum/ lag rtsal dang slob gso 'phel rgyas gtang rgyu dang bzhi bcas gtso gnad du bzhag nas gsar spel bya dgos rgyu'i blang bya bton gnang mdzad pas/ rang re bod 'di'i dmigs bsal gyi gnas tshul dang / yul bab la brten nas ji ltar byas te nub phyogs gsar spel chen po'i rdzogs ldan bskal bzang dam 'dzin gyis de'i rlung rlabs khrod rang gi rkang pa brtan par btsugs nas dus rabs kyi rjes su bsnyegs te bod 'di 'phur bskyod chen po'i nang 'gran rtsod bya dgos na/ nges par du shes ldan mi sna'i thon khungs gsar spel bya rgyu de mdzad brgya'i thog mar 'jog dgos/ deng gi char 'dzam gling dpal 'byor gyi 'gran rtsod dang / rgyal khab dang rgyal khab bar gyi stobs 'byor mnga' thang gi 'gran rtsod/ sa khul dang sa khul bar gyi 'gran 219

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/rtsod de don dam pa'i gnad 'gag ni shes ldan mi sna'i 'gran rtsod yin te/nye ba'i lo shas nang du rang rgyal gyi zhing chen dang / rang skyong ljongs/ grong khyer 'ga'i nang shes ldan mi snar 'gran rtsod bya ba'i mtho rlabs shig 'phyur dang 'phyur mus lags te/ dper na rgyal sa pe cin dang / hrang ha'e/bod ljongs kyi lha sa grong khyer sogs shes ldan mi sna mang zhing mi tshags shin tu dam pa'i grong khyer du'ang shes ldan mi sna yid 'gugs bya ba'i dmigs bsal gyi srid jus gtan la phab pa dang / zhang kang gis nye char nang sa dang 'dzam gling sa gnas gzhan nas tshan rig lag rtsal mkhas can nyis stong nang 'dren bya rgyu'i khyab bsgrags byas/ rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi nub rgyud thon 'byed chen po'i 'go khrid tshogs chung gis thabs shes yod rgu rtsal sprugs kyis da yod kyi shes ldan mi sna bed spyod legs par byas zhing / bya thabs bzang po legs par spyad de rgyal khab phyi nang nas shes ldan mi sna nang 'dren dang / las rigs mi 'dra ba'i shes ldan mi sna gso skyong byed par shugs chen bya dgos zhes blang bya bton pa ltar/ kho bos 'dir nub rgyud thon 'byed chen po'i nang bod ljongs khul du shes ldan mi sna'i thon khungs gsar spel ji ltar bya rgyu'i thad thog ma'i 'char sgo 'ga' gleng bar spro ba bsrings/gcig bod la mkho gal che ba'i shes ldan mi sna'i skor/bod ljongs sa khul gyi ngal rtsol pa'i byang tshad dang / shes ldan mi sna'i 'bor tshad de rang rgyal shar rgyud dang bsdur na ches nyag phra ba yin pa 'dis rang re'i kha ba can gyi zhing khams 'di'i 'phel rgyas la 'ching rgya dam por 220

nub rgyud thon 'byed khrod rang ljongs su shes ldan mi sna gsar spel ji ltar bya ba'i skor/bcings yod/ des na thog mar 'das pa'i dus dang / da lta'i dngos yod gnas tshul/ ma 'ongs 'phel phyogs chen po la dpyad na/ bod kyi las rigs khag gi nang du ches mkho gal che ba'i shes ldan mi sna gsham gsal 'di ltar dgos pa ste/1 cha 'phrin do dam gyi shes ldan mi sna/deng skabs mi'i rigs kyi cha 'phrin dar ba'i spyi tshogs su 'phags te glog rdul rtsis rgyag 'khor lo'i glog lam dra ba la brten nas rgyal khab phyi nang gi gsar 'gyur dang / brda 'phrin brgyud sprod dang do dam bya ba'i lag rtsal gyi gsar brje chen po zhig tu slebs yod pas/ bod du rig pa gsar pa 'di khyab gdal bya rgyu de ni 'das pa'i dus kyi yig rmongs sel ba dang / deng gi dus kyi lo dgu'i 'gan babs slob gso'i lam lugs ltar brtsis te glog rdul rtsis rgyag 'khor lo'i rig pa la rmongs pa'i skye bo yig rmongs pa gsar pa dag gi rmongs mun nges par du bsal dgos/ des na rig pa de'i skor gyi cha 'phrin do dam gyi shes ldan mi sna ni bod du ches mkho gal che ba'i mi snar bdag gis mthong /2 rig gnas slob gso'i shes ldan mi sna/ljongs yongs la ched las lag rtsal pa 35246yod pa'i nang zhib 'jug slob ma 73yod pa des brgya cha'i 2 07zin pa dang / slob grwa chen mo'i dngos gzhi'i tshan khag gi slob ma 4619yod pa des brgya cha'i 13 12zin pa/ slob grwa chen mo'i ched las tshan khag gi slob ma 5633yod pa des brgya cha'i 15 98zin pa/ de min gzhan rnams 'bring rim ched las 221

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/kyi slob sbyong gi lo rgyun man chad yin/zhu ces pa las bod 'dir nub rgyud thon 'byed chen po'i dgos mkho dang 'tshams pa'i rig gnas slob gso'i rim pa cung mtho ba'i shes ldan pa mkho ba de lung rigs kyis bstan/ de'ang nub rgyud thon 'byed bya bar thog mar rig gnas slob gso 'phel rgyas gtang rgyu de ches gal che'i gnas su 'jog dgos la/ rang ljongs kyi sa khul yongs su slob gso dang tshan rig lag rtsal 'phel rgyas gtang rgyur snang chen bya ba'i rnam pa zhig chags pa byas te/ slob lo'i thad rig tshan khag gi sne mo ba dang /ljongs rim pa'i slob khrid mkhan po/ rim pa ches mtho'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen/ dbyin ji'i skad yig gi ched las mi sna/ glog spyad slob khrid mkhan po/ glog rdul rtsis rgyag 'khor lo'i slob khrid mkhas can bcas mkho gal che/de ltar smra don ni ma 'ongs pa'i slob gnyer lam lugs la gsar brje chen po zhig 'ongs srid de dper na/slob grwa'i tha snyad gsar pa da wasgo dbye'i slob gso/slob gso'i thabs lam gsar pa da wathag ring gi slob gso/slob gso'i brjod bya gsar pa da wacha 'phrin bed spyod kyi nus rtsal/slob gso'i las 'gan gsar pa da wartsad 'dri mkho 'don gyi zhabs zhu/slob gnyer pa'i gdam nga gsar pa da watshe gang slob gso myong rgyu lta bu'i 'gyur ba 'ongs bas/ de la de 'tshams kyi rig gnas slob gso'i shes ldan mi sna ni nub rgyud thon 'byed chen po'i rig gnas slob gso'i bya gzhag nang du ches rgyugs shos kyi mi snar grub/3 srid 'dzin do dam gyi shes ldan mi sna/222

nub rgyud thon 'byed khrod rang ljongs su shes ldan mi sna gsar spel ji ltar bya ba'i skor/1999lo'i lo mjug tu rags rtsis byas pa ltar na bod ljongs yongs su tang srid las byed pa 30738yod pa'i nang zhib 'jug slob ma'i slob lo yod pa'i mi 31las med pa des brgya cha'i 1las zin med pa dang / slob grwa chen mo'i dngos gzhi'i tshan khag gi slob lo yod pa'i mi 1782yod pa des brgya cha'i 5 8zin pa/ slob grwa chen mo'i ched las tshan khag gi slob lo yod pa'i mi 6009yod pa des brgya cha'i 19 55zin pa de min gzhan rnams 'bring rim ched las kyi slob sbyong gi lo rgyun man chad yin pa ma zad de dag nang dma' 'bring man gyi slob sbyong gi lo rgyun las med pa'i mi 103898yod pa des brgya cha'i 33 79zin yod duces pa las/ bod la srid 'dzin do dam bya mkhan gyi shes ldan mi sna shin tu nyung ba mtshon/ de'ang tang srid las khungs kyi 'go khrid kyis sa gnas de ga'i gsar spel bya bar 'go khrid bya rgyu dang / srid jus gtan la 'bebs rgyu/ sgrig 'dzugs dang / mnyam rogs/ do dam bya rgyu la bskyur thabs bral ba'i 'gan dkri yod pas/ byang tshad ches mtho ba'i srid 'dzin mi sna yod na gzhi nas las 'gan lci po de lta bu theg thub/ des na rang re'i bod 'dir srol rgyun 'du shes kyi 'ching rgya las grol thub pa dang / bsam blor bcings bgrol gtang thub pa/ rig pa gsar pa'i snying bcud dang len bya bar mkhas pa/ sne gcig mkhas la sne mang 'jon pa/ bsam pa'i 'char sgo gsar du 'byed thub pa/ lag rtsal dang / sgrig 'dzugs do dam bcas la gsar gtod kyi nus pa ldan pa/ tang dang rgyal khab kyi spyi'i jus gzhi dag don dam pa'i 'char bkod kyi ri mor bkod de lag bstar bya bar mkhas pa/ slob rgyun dang / rig gnas kyi 223

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/mtshan gnas mtho ba'i tang srid las byed pa ni bod ljongs kyi srid 'dzin do dam la ches mkho'i mi snar rigs pas grub/4 khe las gnyer skyong gi thes ldan mi sna/bod rang skyong ljongs ni mes rgyal gyi lho nub mtha' khul du gnas yod pa dang / lo rgyus 'phel rim la sogs pa'i dbang gis dpal 'byor dang /rig gnas cung rjes lus su gnang shing / rmang gzhi'i slob gso nyams dmas yin gshis/ dpal 'byor rig pa'i ched las mkhas can dang / tshan rig lag rtsal mkhas can gyi shes ldan mi sna gso skyong bya yul gyi grags can slob grwa chen mo ches nyung ba dang / rang ljongs kyi slob gnyer pa ching hwa slob grwa chen mo dang / pe cin slob grwa chen mo sogs la slob tshud kyi go skabs ni dal 'byor mi lus len pa las kyang lhag par dka' ba dang / rtsis rig dang /dngos khams rig pa/ khor yugardzas 'gyur rig pa'i rig tshan la slob gnyer byas te rigs lung khungs 'pher mkhan nyung ba dang / bod 'dir rig tshan de'i thad kyi ched las gnyer skyong nyams zhan pa'i slob gso'i sgrig gzhi 'dis bod ljongs kyi dpal 'byor rig pa dang tshan rig lag rtsal gyi shes ldan mi sna'i 'byung khungs nyag phra bar gyur pas bod kyi dpal 'byor gra rgyas gtang rgyur 'ching rgya bzos/ nga tshos shes gsal ltar khe las gnyer skyong mkhas can ni rang re bod kyi yul gru 'dir ches mkho ba'i mi sna yin la/ nub rgyud thon 'byed chen po'i khrod du thog mar nang 'dren bya dgos pa'i mi sna'ang yin/5 thon las gsum pa gnyer skyong byed pa'i mkhas can mi sna/rang re kha ba can gyi yul klung 'dir mes po rnams kyis btod pa'i thun 224

nub rgyud thon 'byed khrod rang ljongs su shes ldan mi sna gsar spel ji ltar bya ba'i skor/mong min pa'i yul srol goms gshis/ lta na sdug pa'i ri klung / khams gtsang gi khor yug drin can gyi mes pos bzhag pa'i gna' shul grags can sogs yul bskor spro 'cham bya ba'i gnas mchog mang dag yod pas/ bod ljongs su yul bskor spro 'cham gyi bya gzhag 'phel rgyas gtang rgyu des bod kyi nor srid dpal 'byor dar rgyas gtang rgyur 'gangs che'i go 'phangs zin yod/des na de la de 'a tshams kyi thon las gsum pa gnyer skyong bya mkhan gyi shes ldan mi sna ni deng gi char bod du mkho ba'i mi snar ngang gis grub/mdor na/ rig tshan mi 'dra ba'i shes ldan mi sna'i khrod du/ da lta'i bod kyi dngos yod gnas tshul la dmigs nas tshan rig lag rtsal dang /slob gso/ dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas gtang bar ches mkho'i shes ldan mi sna ni/ched las lag rtsal mtho rim sku gzhon gyi mtshan gnas yod pa'i shes ldan mi sna dang / las sna gcig byang cha yod pa'i mkhas can/ khyad par du las gnyer gsar pa'i lag rtsal la byang tshad mtho ba dang / gal che'i las grwa gnyer skyong mkhan po/ rig pa gsar pa'i brgyud spel/ tshong gnyer do dam gyi 'jon thang can/ slob gso slob khrid kyi sne mo ba/ tshan rtsal gyi rkang 'dzin pa 'di dag ni bod 'dir nye ba'i char ches mkho'i shes ldan mi snar bdag blo khab mig lta bur snang ngo /gnyis/ ri ches mkho'i shes ldan mi sna bskyed babrings kyi lam bu'i skor/rgyang ring nas bltas na nub rgyud kyi dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas gtang rgyu'i 'gog rkyen che shos ni shes ldan pa mi 'dang ba yin pa las ma dngul dang byed 225

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/las rnam grangs mi 'dang ba min/ rang re kha ba can gyi zhing khams 'dir mtshon na shes ldan pa gso skyong bya rgyu ni de bas gal cher mngon te/ rgyal khab cig la mtshon na dpal 'byor dar rgud dang / dmag shugs btsan gnyom/ca lag bzang ngan sogs tshong gi 'phel 'grib kyi rtsa ba ni skye bo'i blo'i byang tshad dang / shes rab bzang ngan gyi rjes su 'gro ldog byed cing / bod 'di spun zla'i mi rigs gzhan dang dpung pa mnyam gshibs su 'gro dgos na/nges par du bod kyi don dngos la dmigs nas gsham gsal mi sna bskyed bsrings bya dgos pa ste/ khrims don mkhas can dang gcig phyi rgyal gyi skad yig mkhas can dang gnyis/ yul bskor spro 'cham bya gzhag gnyer skyong mkhas can dang gsum/ rig pa'i gnas la rnam dpyod kyi rtsal ldan pa'i zhib 'jug mkhan po dang bzhi/ slob gso gnyer skyong mkhas can dang lnga/ glog rdul rtsis rgyag 'khor lo'i lag rtsal mkhas can dang drug skye khams srung skyong dang thon khungs rtogs zhib la mkhas pa dang bdun/ tshong don gnyer 'grims mkhas can dang brgyad/ glog rdul tshong don gyi shes ldan pa dang dgu/bod lugs gso rig gi sman pa 'bum rams pa dang bcu'o//gong smros ches mkho'i shes ldan pa dag gso skyong bya ba'i lam bu ni lo brgya'i jus chen slob gsor thug ces pa ltar slob gso slob khrid kyi bya gzhag la mthong chen byas te rmang gzhi'i slob gso legs par gnyer te/ slob gso'i dbul skyor kyi 'char gzhi bzos nas bod phrug rnams slob shor gyi grangs tshad nyung du gtang rgyu dang / da yod kyi mi sna'i khrod nas lo na phra la/ rig pa rno ba/ rmang gzhi brtan pa/ don gnyer che ba/ las ka'i 'jon thang che ba/226

nub rgyud thon 'byed khrod rang ljongs su shes ldan mi sna gsar spel ji ltar bya ba'i skor/blo'i byang tshad mtho ba/ rig pa'i gnas la shing rta'i srol 'byed kyi blo bskyed ldan pa'i phul byung mi sna bdams thon gyis nang sa'i ching hwa dang / pe cin slob grwa chen mo sogs rgyal khab gyi gtso gnad slob grwa chen mo khag dang phan tshun gan rgya bzhag nas bod phrug ched sbyong bya bar mngags rgyu/ rang sbyong legs par byas nas rgyugs gtong ba dang / yig springs slob khrid kyi thabs lam la brten nas ched las kyi chu tshad dang slob sbyong gi lo rgyun mtho ru gtong rgyu/ rgan pas gzhon 'khrid dang las gnas sbyong brdar bya ba'i thabs lam la brten nas rang gi ched las kyi chu tshad mtho ru gtong rgyu/ 'char gzhi yod pa'i sgo nas lo re bzhin rang ljongs kyi mtho rim slob 'bring nas thon pa'i phul byung slob ma bdams thon gyis nang sa'i grags can slob grwa chen mor slob gnyer la mngags te slob grwa nas thon rjes pha yul du log nas pha yul gyi 'dzugs skrun bya gzhag la zhugs rgyu/ srid 'dzin do dam gyi las byed sbyong brdar 'dzin grwa dang / zhing 'brog khul du tshan rig khyab gdal dang / nyer mkho'i lag rtsal mi sna'i sbyong brdar 'dzin grwa gnyer skyong bya rgyu/ shes ldan mi sna nang 'dren bya ba dang / de'i lus ngag yid gsum bod du gnas thub par byas nas chu tshad mtho ru gtang rgyu'i dmigs tshad mngon 'gyur bya rgyu/ rig stobs gzhan las skyen pa'i zhing 'brog khul gyi phul byung slob ma la srid gzhung gis slob gron btang nas nub rgyud thon 'byed chen por mkho ba'i rim pa ches mtho ba'i mkhas dbang bskyed bsrings bya rgyu/ bsdoms rtsis byas pa ltar na/mig sngar rang ljongs su lo re bzhin zhing 'brog khul gyi slob ma 15000—17000rang yul du log 'gro dgos kyi yod pa des slob thon slob ma spyi'i 227

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/brgya cha'i 50yan zin gyi yod pa de tshos phyugs 'tsho mi shes la/ zhing yang 'debs mi shes pa'i don dngos la dmigs te srid gzhung gis dngul rtsa 'bor chen btang nas bod kyi zhing 'brog sa khul dang / nub rgyud thon 'byed chen mo'i dgos mkho dang 'tshams pa'i las rigs lag rtsal slob grwa btsugs te shes ldan mi sna gso skyong gi lo rgyun thung du gtang rgyu bcas yin/gsum/ ji ltar byas nas shes ldan mi sna'i lus ngag yid gsum bod du 'gugs par bya ba'i skor/da lta'i gnas tshul ni/ dper na 'dab chags lta bu dbyug pa gzhus nas 'phur na bsam pa rnams 'phur nas mi 'gro ba dang / ma 'phur na bsam pa rnams khu byug mon la byon pa ltar nam 'phang bcad nas 'gro ba ni don dngos kyi gnas tshul zhig tu grub/ deng gi char shes ldan mi sna phar 'gro tshur 'ong gi rgyal sgo phye nas shes ldan par rang dbang thob pa ni spyi tshogs kyi yar rgyas chen po zhig yin pa'o/ /'on kyang ji ltar byas nas 'jon thang can gyi mi sna'i blo yid 'gug par bya rgyu ni spyi tshogs yongs kyis brtsi mthong bya yul gyi gleng gzhi zhig tu gyur/ de'i 'gag rtsa'i gnas tshul ni thob thang mtho ru gtang rgyu dang / lam lugs rnying pa bsgyur bcos/ khor yug legs skrun/dmigs bsal gyi srid jus gtan phab kyis shes ldan mi sna'i blo yid bkug ste dpung khag brtan lhing bya rgyu de yin to//1 thob thang legs pos shes ldan mi sna'i blo yid 'gugs dgos pa/gla phogs sogs kyi thob thang ni shes ldan pa'i blo 'gug pa'i rtsa rkang yin 228

nub rgyud thon 'byed khrod rang ljongs su shes ldan mi sna gsar spel ji ltar bya ba'i skor/te/ pe cin slob grwa chen mo'i grags can dge rgan che mo ba zhig gis18rlu(bzo tshong do dam)dus thung 'dzin grwa'i sbyin bdag rnams la slob khrid gnang skabs/ khong gis nga'i da lta'i yong 'bab kyang mi dma' te/ gal srid bshad na khyod tsho skrag nas bla chad par nye zhes gsungs/ phyis su khong gi lo re'i yong 'bab grangs gnas drug zin gyi yod pa rtogs 'phral dngos 'brel sbyin bdag rnams kyang mthong rgya 'byed ces pa dang / ching hwa slob grwa chen mo'i zla re'i las gnas phogs snon rim pa dgur dbye ba las dma' shos la sgor 300dang / mtho shos la sgor 5000yod pa red/dhi de lta bu'i thob thang legs po la dri ldan me tog rgyang ring yang / bung ba sprin gyi tshogs bzhin 'khor zhes pa ltar shes ldan pa mi 'du ci la srid/ 'on kyang rang re'i bod ljongs 'dir shes ldan mi sna rnams gnas mi thub pa'i rgyu mtshan gtso bo ni dpal 'byor dar rgyas med pa dang / thob thang bltos bcas kyis dma' ba/'grim 'grul stabs bde med pa/ cha 'phrin mi skyen pa/ slob sbyong dang las ka'i khor yug zhan pa/ tshan zhib bya thabs rjes lus yin pa/ rigs gzhung spel res kyi byed sgo 'khrug po med pa/ rgyal khab phyi nang du zab sbyong gi go skabs nyung ba bcas la brten nas rang rgyud du shes rab 'phel ba dang /'bras bu g.yur du za ba thon pa'i go skabs shin tu dkon pa'i dbang gis so/ /rgyu mtshan de'i phyir nga tshos gang thub ci thub kyis shes ldan pa'i gla phogs dang /sdod khang / sman bcos 'phrod bsten/ 'grim 'grul/ glog 'phrin sogs la dmigs bsal gyi lta rtogs dang thob thang sprad pa dang sbrags gzhung shag khang gi sgrig chas dang / tshod lta khang gi sgrig chas/ cha 'phrin gyi dpyad 229

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/gzhi'i yig cha/ tshan rig zhib 'jug gi las gnyer bya yul sogs las ka'i cha rkyen legs par bskrun dgos/ de ltar brjod don ni snga dus su u ru sus shi po li ya zhes pa gsar spel bya skabs thog mar sa gnas de ga'i shes ldan mi sna'i gla phogs ni sa khul gzhan gyi brgya cha 140yin pa dang / phyis su sa gnas gzhan las ldab 2 2su gyur pas khor yug shin tu skyo po yin pa'i shi po li ya la shes ldan mi sna 'bor chen gzhi sa bkug thub ste shi po li ya'i gsar spel legs sgrub la rmang gzhi brtan po btsugs/dhi lo rgyus kyi dpe gzhi gson po de las thob thang gis shes ldan mi sna 'gug rgyu ni 'gag rtsa yin par ra sprod thub pa'o//2 lam lugs bsgyur bcos kyis shes ldan mi sna'i blo yid 'gugs dgos pa/mi don lam lugs la legs bcos bya rgyu ni shes ldan pa'i brtson sems 'gugs pa dang / 'gran rtsod bya bar zhugs pa'i 'gag rtsa'i gnas tshul zhig kyang yin pas/ bod du mi don sgrig 'dzugs khag gis shes ldan mi snar dmigs bsal gyi khe dbang yod pa'i lam lugs lag bstar bya dgos pa ste/dper na/ las khungs mi 'dra ba gnyis la gdam nga byas chog pa'i lam lugs dang / las gnas la 'gran rtsod kyis zhugs chog pa'i lam lugs/las gnas dang gla phogs gcig lcogs byas chog pa'i lam lugs/ grub 'bras dang byas rjes la bltos nas gla phogs sprod pa'i lam lugs/ mkhas shing mdzangs pa rnams blo khog chen pos 'go khrid go gnas su bsko gzhag bya ba'i lam lugs/ legs par bya dga' dang / zhan par chad gcod kyi lam 230

nub rgyud thon 'byed khrod rang ljongs su shes ldan mi sna gsar spel ji ltar bya ba'i skor/lugs/ 'jon thang can rnams sa khul dang grong khyer bar phar 'gro tshur 'ong gis las gnas brje res byed rgyur rang dbang yod pa'i lam lugs/ mkhyen rab dang mdzad rjes dngos 'brel yod pa rnams la lugs srol las 'das pa'i rig gnas kyi mtshan gnas gsol ba'i lam lugs/ rgyal khab phyi nang gi rigs gzhung spel res dang tshan zhib rnam grangs brtson len gyis bya dga' thob mkhan la rgyab skyor dang gnang sbyin gsol ba'i lam lugs bcas kyis shes ldan mi sna'i lus ngag yid gsum bod kyi bya gzhag thog bde bar gnas gzhis chags pa bya dgos/3 khor yug skyid snang dod pos shes ldan mi sna'i blo yid 'gugs dgos pa/'dir smra ba khor yug ni phyi snod kyi yid dbang 'phrog pa'i bkod pa dang lta na sdug pa'i ri klung gi khor yug kho na min par/ spyi tshogs yongs kyis shes ldan mi snar brtsi bkur dang shes bya yon tan la mthong chen bya ba'i spyi tshogs kyi khor yug mkhas dbang rnams la dpa' bor dpa' rtsal 'don yul lta bu'i yangs pa'i khor yug khrims lugs kyi 'gan srung 'og mi dang mi bar mdza' mthun mnyam 'grogs kyi khor yug tang srid 'go khrid kyis yon tan can gong du bkur ba'i khor yug rgyu nor gyi nang nas 'phags nor ni shes rab yin pa rtogs mkhan gyi khor yug brtan snying mthun sgril yin pa'i chab srid kyi khor yug gong gsal dag legs par bskrun na/ gzhi nas shes ldan mi sna bod du blo bde ba'i ngang nas bag phebs su gnas shing / shes ldan pa'i mi mngon pa'i nus pa dngos 'brel 'don spel gang legs bya thub/4 dmigs bsal srid jus kyis shes ldan mi sna'i blo yid 'gugs dgos 231

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/pa/ma'o tse tung gis srid jus dang thabs jus ni tang gi srog rtsa yin zhes gsungs pa ltar/ nub rgyud thon 'byed chen po'i nang dmigs bsal srid jus la brten nas shes ldan mi sna'i blo yid 'gugs thub par bya dgos pa ste/mgyogs myur du 〈bod rang skyong ljongs kyi shes ldan mi sna'i do dam gyi srol yig〉 ces pa dang (bod rang skyong ljongs kyi shes ldan mi sna gso skyong bya ba'i srol yig〉 〈nub rgyud thon 'byed chen po'i dgos mkho dang 'tshams pa'i rang ljongs kyi rim mtho'i shes ldan pa gso skyong bya rgyu'i bsam 'char 〉 lta bu 'don gnang mdzad de/ nang sa sogs sa khul gzhan nas them tho ma bsgyur bar dus tshigs rang bzhin gyi las kar gdan zhu'i srid jus/ las gnas gcig lcogs gdan zhu'i srid jus/ shes ldan pa'i las gnas brje res byed par rang dbang yod pa'i srid jus/ tshan zhib kyi 'gro gron dmigs bsal gyi srid jus/ bca' khral thad dmigs bsal lta skyong gi srid jus bcas la brten nas da lta bod kyi las rigs khag gi nang du yod pa'i shes ldan mi sna bed spyod legs par byas te kho tsho'i chab srid dang / 'tsho ba/ la rgya'i brtsi mthong la thugs 'khur zab bzhes kyis mig 'bras bzhin gces skyong bya rgyu dang / yul gru gzhan nas lag rtsal dang / shes rab ches mtho'i mkhas dbang re 'ga' gdan 'dren bya rgyu gnyis zung sbrel byas na nub rgyud thon 'byed chen po'i khrod shes ldan mi sna'i hur brtson rang bzhin bskong 'then dang shes bya'i rin thang gzhi nas mngon thub pa dang / rang re bod 'di'ang nub rgyud kyi spun zla'i zhing chen dang 'gran rtsod bya ba'i 'thab sa mdun mar mi 232

nub rgyud thon 'byed khrod rang ljongs su shes ldan mi sna gsar spel ji ltar bya ba'i skor/pham pa'i go 'phang zhig zin nus par snyam/dpyad yig① (krung go'i bod kyi shes rig〉 spyi lo 2000lo'i bod yig dus deb gnyis pa'i shog grangs 3la gsal/② 〈shes bya ni stobs shugs yin 〉 zhes pa spyi lo 2000lo'i dus deb bzhi pa la gsal/① (bod ljongs slob gso 〉 spyi lo 2000lo'i bod yig dus deb gsum pa'i shog grangs 13la gsal/me gong mtshungs/du (slob gso'i mi don 〉 zhes pa'i spyi lo 2000lo'i rgya yig dus deb gnyis pa'i shog grangs 43la gsal/dhi〈krung go'i nub rgyud thon 'byed chen mo 〉 zhes pa'i rgya yig deb gnyis pa'i shog grangs 291la gsal/ 233

rang ljongs su las rigs slob gso gnyer phyogs kyi bsam gzhigs 'ga'/rang ljongs su las rigs slob gso dar mgo tshugs nas bgrang bya nyi shu tsam song ring / lha sa dang / gzhis rtse/ lho kha/ chab mdo/ nag chu/nying khri bcas sa khul du 'bring rim las rigs ched las slob grwa rim gyis dar 'phel song ba dang / de ni byang tshad slob gso'i nang don dngos dang slob gso bsgyur bcos kyi gsar brje chen po zhig dang / ma 'ongs pa'i bod kyi slob gso'i 'phel kha chen po zhig dang ngal rtsol pa'i byang tshad mtho ru btang ste dmangs yongs kyi rig gnas dang dpal 'byor gyi 'tsho lam gsar du gtong rgyu sogs la don snying gting zab ldan/ 'on kyang las rigs slob gso de gsar du skyes ma thag pa'i myu gu lta bu zhig yin pas de skyon bral ngang 'tshar longs 'ongs thabs thad rang gi bsam gzhigs cung zad brjod pa la/dang po/ las rigs slob gso'i dgos pa bstan pa/rgyal khab stobs 'byor gyi dar rgud ni ngal rtsol pa'i byang tshad dang /shes ldan pa'i spus tshad dang grangs tshad la rags las gshis/ dus rabs nyetwe 3/cig pa'i dus 'dir mkhyen rgya yangs pa'i rab 'byams pa dang / las

rang ljongs su las rigs slob gso gnyer phyogs kyi bsam gzhigs 'ga'/rigs lag rtsal la byang chub pa'i lag rtsal mkhas dbang dang bya gzhag gsar gtod kyi snying stobs ldan pa'i gsar gtod mkhan po mang dag cig dgos la/las rigs slob gso dar rgyas btang nas byang tshad slob gso don 'khyol gyis ngal rtsol pa'i byang tshad mtho ru gtong rgyu ni shin tu gal chen snang zhing / bod kyi zhing 'brog mi dmangs dbul po'i gnas las thar ba dang / lto gos sogs rang gi blo gros dang lag rtsal/ shes rab la brten nas 'tsho ba la las rigs slob gso'i dgos phan che bas/ 'bring rim las rigs slob gso de sngar las lhag pa'i sgo nas dpal 'byor 'dzugs skrun dang spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas/ ngal rtsol pa'i las zhugs dang bcas khrom ra'i dpal 'byor gyi dgos mkho dang 'tsham pa bya rgyu la don snying zab mo ldan yod/gnyis pa/ las rigs slob gso 'phel rgyas gtong bar mi mthun pa'i phyogs kyi dka' ba bstan pa/rang ljongs su slob bsdu'i mdzad jus thad spyir btang gi mtho rim slob 'bring gi slob bsdu dang 'bring rim ched las slob grwa gnyis 'dra mnyam min pa'i cha dang gcig 'bring rim ched las slob grwa'i slob yon cung mtho ba dang gnyis/ spyi tshogs yongs kyis las rigs slob gsor 'dzin pa'i lta ba dang 'du shes rjes lus yin pa dang gsum/ las rigs slob grwa nas thon pa'i slob ma rnams las zhugs kyi 'gro khungs lam bu bshangs ma thub pa dang bzhi/235

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/slob grwar sbyangs pa'i ched las lag rtsal spyod sgo shin tu dog pa dang lnga/ srid gzhung gis las rigs slob grwa nas thon pa'i slob mar de la de 'tshams kyi srid jus shig gtan 'bebs byas med pa dang drug las rigs lag rtsal slob khrid la byang pa'i ched las dge rgan shin tu nyung ba dang bdun/ rang re bod kyi sa rgyud chu rgyud dang 'tshams pa'i las rigs slob grwa'i bslab gzhi tshad dang ldan pa brtsams bsgrigs byas med pa dang brgyad/ slob gnyer pa rnams dpe cha'i steng gi shes yon tsam las lag len dngos nang bkol bskyod dmar sbyong bya yul nyung ba dang dgu/ rang re bod spyi dang bye brag tu zhing 'brog khul du byis pa slob grwar btang nas rgyal khab kyi las byed pa bya rgyur dmigs pa kho na las rang gi slob yon btang nas shes rig dang lag rtsal sbyangs te bya gzhag gsar gtod kyi 'du shes med pa dang bcu/ las rigs slob grwa khag gi sgrig gzhi de srol rgyun gyi slob gnyer sgrig gzhi'i rgya las ma thar ba dang bcu gcig las rigs slob grwa khag tu sbyang bya'i ched las dang slob khrid kyi rtsa 'dzin sogs gtan la phab pa'i lam lugs 'thus tshang zhig chags med pa dang bcu gnyis/las rigs slob grwa khag tu ched las shes bya gang dang gang sbyang chog pa gtan la phab pa'i yig cha med gshis tshang mas rtsis rgyag 'khor lo'i 'dzin grwa dang drung yig ched las zlos che bas slob gnyer pa rnams las ka rag dka' ba dang bcu gsum bcas kyi skyon cha rnams rim gyis ma bsal na las rigs lag rtsal slob gso legs po zhig gnyer skyong byed dka' snyam mo//236

rang ljongs su las rigs slob gso gnyer phyogs kyi bsam gzhigs 'ga'/gsum pa/ nus shugs yod rgu rtsal sprugs kyis las rigs slob gso'i mthun phyogs lam bu bshang dgos/gcig srid gzhung gis mthong chen bya dgos pa/ slob gso gnyer ba'i sgrig gzhi dang / lam lugs 'gyur ldog chen po byung ste bod kyi las rigs slob gso de srid gzhung gi skyabs rogs 'og rim gyis dar mgo tshugs/ srid gzhung gi ngos nas brjod na/ mu mthud du bod kyi sa khul khag gi sa khyon dang / mi 'bor/ sa khams khor yug dmigs bsal khyad yon sogs yul dus la legs par dpyad de slob grwa'i gzhi khyon gtan 'khel dang /slob grwa gnyer ba'i cha rkyen legs skrun bya dgos pa ste slob khang dang / nyal khang / dpe mdzod khang / tshod lta khang / dngos sbyong do ra/ las rigs lag rtsal slob khrid la mkho ba'i yo chas sna tshogs mkho nyo bya ba'i gron dngul btang nas 'byor shugs kyi 'gan len bya dgos pa dang khyad par du srid gzhung gis sne khrid de spyi tshogs yongs su slob gso las rigs gnyer ba'i dgos pa dang de'i phan yon/ mdun lam/ 'du shes gsar brje sogs ji ltar bya dgos lugs kyi dril bsgrags bya shugs che ru gtong ba dang / yang sgos su slob thon slob ma rnams las zhugs kyi srid jus sogs gang sa ci thad nas las rigs slob gso gnyer rgyur rgyab skyor rogs ram bya shugs che ru gtong dgos/237

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/ gnyis/ las rigs slob grwa'i yig cha khag gtan la 'bebs dgos pa/ 'jig rten thog bya ba ci rigs byas rung tshad 'dzin sa zhig yod na gzhi nas legs nyes dang / che chung / yang lci 'jal byed kyi gzhi ltar bod kyi las rigs slob gso 'di la'ang slob bsdu ji ltar bya ba dang / slob gnyer skyed sring bya ba'i dmigs tshad/ slob yun gyi lam lugs/ slob gnyer pa'i bsrung bya/ slob khrid kyi 'char bkod/ ched las rig tshan khag gi rnam grangs/ slob khrid kyi rtsa 'dzin sogs rgyal khab slob gso pus gtan la phab pa gzhi rkang byas te bod rang gi don dngos dang 'tshams pa'i slob gso slob khrid kyi rtsa don dang / khrid ston/ tshad 'jal bcas kyi nang don 'khod pa'i yig cha gtan la phab na rmongs tshod dang / tshad gzhi ma lon pa'i skyon cha sel thub snyam/gsum/ las rigs slob gso'i ched las lag rtsal slob tshan 'bur thon bya dgos/ bod kyi don dngos dang 'tshams la tshan rig dang mthun pa'i ched las lag rtsal gyi slob tshan bkod sgrig bya rgyu ni las rigs slob gso'i dmigs bsal khyad chos 'bur thon bya ba'i rmang gzhi'i las don zhig tu grub/ des na sa gnas de ga'i khrom ra'i dpal 'byor dang / spyi tshogs kyi dgos mkho la brtag nas ched las gnyer dgos pa dang / gnyer ba de yang nges par du rgya yig dang bod yig rtsis rig sogs rmang gzhi'i rigs gzhung gi khrid rgyun ma chad pa dang / ched las lag rtsal slob rgyu de don gyi snying por bzhag nas khrid dgos la slob tshan de'ang las yul dngos nang du bed spyod rgya cher ldan pa dang / 'tsho lam gsar gtod bya bar sman pa/ spyi 238

rang ljongs su las rigs slob gso gnyer phyogs kyi bsam gzhigs 'ga'/tshogs thog mkho che ba gtso gnad du 'jog dgos/ der brten ched las lag rtsal la byang ba'i mi sna gso skyong bya rgyu de las rigs slob gso'i srog shing yin dgos/ bzhi/ slob gzhi gsar sgrig bya dgos pa/ slob gzhi ni dge rgan gyi slob tshan khrid bya'i gzhi 'dzin sa dang / slob gnyer pa rnams kyi shes rig sbyong ba'i tshad 'dzin sa yin pas nges par du dus rabs dang shes bya/ yul babs/ bed spyod/ dpal 'byor 'dzugs skrun/ spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas/slob gnyer pa'i shes rig yar 'phel sogs kyi dgos mkho dang 'tshams pa zhig rtsom dgos/ da lta rang ljongs kyi 'bring rim las rigs slob grwa khag tu bod kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i bslab gzhi gsar rtsom byas pa ha lam med par nang sa'i las rigs slob grwa'i bslab gzhi nyos te bed spyod byed bzhin yod/dper na nang sa'i skye dngos dang / srog chags gso lugs kyi shes bya de bod kyi yul du ji ma ji bzhin du 'chad na sa chu dang / drod gsher/ gnam gshis dang gtan nas mi mthun pas ra mgo lug sbyar gyi dpe ru song nas bed spyod thub pa zhig yong dka' bas/ thun mong gi slob gzhi phud thun mong ma yin pa'i ched las kyi slob gzhi rnams nges par du rang yul gyi don dngos la bstun nas gsar sgrig byed dgos/lnga/ byade tshad mtho ba'i dge rgan gyi dpyang khag cig skyed sring bya dgos pa/ las rigs slob gso ni bod du da lta gsar skyes kyi myu gu lta bu zhig yin pas de'i thad kyi dge rgan shin tu dkon par gyur/ bod kyi sa khul khag tu gnyer ba'i las rigs slob grwa'i rig gnas slob tshan khrid mkhan gyi 239

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/dge rgan phud/ lag rtsal ched las slob tshan khrid mkhan mang che ba ni dge rgan rang nyid kyis ched las slob tshan sbyang bzhin du slob ma la khrid kyin yod mkhan ni phal mo che yin/ ched las der rang las thon pa'i dge rgan spus dag shin tu nyung ba dang / slob grwa 'gar ched las ga ge mo'i slob bsdu'i brda tho bkram nas gal te slob ma bsdu thub par byung na dge rgan skabs 'phral gdan zhu bya rgyu'i mtshams su lhung yod pa'i don dngos la bltas na sngar yod kyi rig gnas ched las kyi na gzhon dge rgan la dus thung sbyong brdar byas nas las rigs slob khrid kyi rig tshan sbyang du bcug ste/ ched las dge rgan du bsko bzhag byed pa tshad ldan zhig mi yong bas/ bod dang ga sbyar gyi nang sa'i zhing chen gyi las rigs slob grwa zhig dang 'brel lam btsugs te las rigs dge rgan mngags gtong gi thabs lam bshang rgyu dang / slob grwa che khag gi las rigs lag rtsal ched las nas thon pa'i dge rgan sgrig 'dzugs kyis slob grwar las bgos bya rgyu/ khe las khag gi lag rtsal mkhas can dang dmangs khrod kyi sgyu rtsal mkhan can gdan zhu bya rgyu sogs kyi thabs la brten nas ched las dge rgan dkon pa'i dka' ngal sel dgos snyam/drug kun spyod slob gsor gtsigs chen bya dgos pa/ spyod pa bzang yang shes bya yon tan med na dpa' bo lag rdum dang shes bya yon tan che yang spyod pa ngan na rang gzhan tshang mar phan thogs pa zhig dka' bas nges par du spyod yon gnyis ldan gyi slob ma skyong dgos/ las rigs slob tshan khag gi nang du las rigs kyi kun spyod dang / gtan tshigs rig pa'i rmang gzhi'i shes bya/ dpal 'byor dang chab srid kyi rmang gzhi'i shes bya/ khrims 240

rang ljongs su las rigs slob gso gnyer phyogs kyi bsam gzhigs 'ga'/lugs kyi rmang gzhi'i shes bya bcas kun spyod slob gso dang 'brel ba'i slob tshan khrid rgyur mthong chen byed dgos/ rtsod sgrub dngos gtso ring lugs dang lo rgyus dngos gtso ring lugs kyi slob gsor shugs snon brgyab ste slob mar yang dag pa'i 'jig rten lta ba dang mi tshe'i lta ba btsugs nas rmongs zhen dang blun rmongs/ rul sungs kyi bsam ngan 'gog pa dang / mes rgyal dang pha yul la brtse zhen/ dka' spyad las gnyer/ sems khams bde thang gi slob gsor shugs snon brgyab ste slob gnyer pa'i dpe deb steng gi bsam pa de spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi khrom ra'i dpal 'byor gyi dgos mkho dang / las zhugs ngal rtsol gyi 'tsho ba dngos dang 'tshams par byed pa'i bsam brtul slob gso rgyag dgos pa las spyi tshogs kyi don dngos 'tsho ba las ring du 'das pa'i lung 'dzin dang spyi mtshan gyi slob gso rnams spangs dgos/bdun/ lag rtsal bed spyod thub pa'i 'jon thang skyed sring bya dgos pa/ las rigs slob gso'i dmigs bsal khyad chos ni/ lag rtsal bed spyod kyi 'jon thang ldan pa'i mi sna skyed sring bya rgyu don gyi dam pa yin/rgyu mtshan ni slob gnyer pa de dag 'bring rim las rigs slob grwa nas thon rjes phul byung gi slob ma khag cig slob grwa che mor bskyod pa phud mang che ba las kar zhugs rgyu yin gshis/ kho tshor rig gnas kyi rmang gzhi'i shes bya brtan po zhig dgos pa ma zad spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba dngos nang spyod go chod pa'i lag rtsal bed spyod kyi 'jon thang nges can zhig kyang dgos/ kho bos yul skor sne shan ched las slob gnyer pa 'ga' zhig khe las las khungs su dngos sbyong la mtshams sbyor byed skabs/ khe las tshan pas slob ma'i dbyin ji'i skad dang /241

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/rgya skad/ bod skad bcas kyi ngag rtsal/ 'phral don thag gcod bya rtsal/zhe tshig gi gus zhabs bya lugs/ mdzes chos kyi rtsal sogs rgyugs len byas te 'jon thang la mthong chen byed kyi 'dug des na las rigs slob mar bshad khrid dang / dmar khrid/ myong khrid bcas khrid stangs gsum las phyi ma gnyis po gtso gnad du 'jog dgos/ sngar bod kyi khrid rgyun las skar rtsis thon rjes lo gcig gi lo tho rgyas bsdus gang rung zhig rtsom 'bri byed du 'jug pa dang / snyan ngag thon rjes gzhung cha tshang gi dper brjod gsar rtsom byed du 'jug pa/ rgyud bzhi thon rjes ri thang du sman 'thu ru 'jug pa dang /nad bcos su 'jug pa/ sgra rig pa thon rjes sgra gzhung gi cha tshang ba'i ri mo blo thog nas 'bri ru 'jug pa/ de snga lha sa grong khyer du grags che ba'i na rong shar zhes pa'i sger btsugs slob grwa zhig yod pa des kyang slob grwa nas thon rjes gzugs legs pos srid gzhung gi bka' rgya dang / snyan zhu/ chod yigadapyad 'tshams khra ma/ gan rgya sogs 'bri ru 'jug gi yod pas/ deng gi las rigs slob mas kyang ched las gang spyad rung de bed spyod byed pa la byang chub po zhig nges par dgos so//brgyad/ las zhugs kyi lam yangs por bshang dgos pa/ bod kyi las rigs slob gso mu mthud du dar rgyas gong 'phel gtong thub min gyi 'gag rtsa ni slob ma rnams slob grwa nas thon rjes las kar zhugs thub min la thug yod/ las rigs slob grwa zhig gi dar rgud ni slob ma bsdu thub min dang slob mar 'jon thang bslab thub min/ slob ma rnams las kar zhugs tshad mtho dma' bcas lhu tshigs gsum po 'di la thug de'i rtsa ba'ang las kar 242

rang ljongs su las rigs slob gso gnyer phyogs kyi bsam gzhigs 'ga'/zhugs tshad la thug yod/ kho bos nang sa'i grong khyer khag gnyis tsam la bskyod nas nyams zhib byed skabs/ nang sa'i las rigs slob gso de bod las dar rgyas shin tu che ste/ dper na khrung ching grong khyer gyi bu mo'i las rigs slob grwa zhig la slob gnyer pa 2800yod pa dang / lo ltar slob thon slob ma brgya cha'i 100las kar zhugs thub kyi yod pa red/ gnad 'gag ni nang sa'i khul du bzo grwa sogs las kar zhugs yul shin tu yangs po yod pa de yin/ rang re bod du dpal 'byor dar rgyas zhan pa dang las zhugs 'du shes yang dag med pa/ bzo grwa nyung ba/ grags can khe las nyung bas slob ma rnams slob grwa nas thon rjes las kar 'gro khungs shin tu dog po yin/ don de thag gcod byed pa la/ gcig nas srid gzhung gis kho tshor gang la gang 'tshams kyi khe bzang srid jus sprad dgos pa dang / gnyis nas las khungs khag nang las ka byed du 'jug pa'am tha ma za khang / tshong khang la sogs pa 'dzugs dgos na'ang las rigs slob grwar sbyong brdar byas te sbyangs 'bras tshad lon pa'i lag khyer med na tshong gnyer byed mi chog pa'i srol lugs 'dzugs dgos pa dang / gsum nas slob grwas kyang ma skul dang blangs kyis khe las tshan pa dang bya gzhag tshan pa sogs la 'brel lam btsugs te/ lag rtsal mi sna gso skyong bya rgyu dang / las kar bsdu mkhan sde khag kyis slob mar las 'jug gi go skabs sprod pa'i bya gzhag mnyam gnyer gyi gan rgya 'jog pa/bzhi nas slob grwar las rigs slob ma sdud skabs zhing 'brog khul du mkho gal che ba dper na/ shang krang dang / tshon krang / shang grong gi em chi/ zhing las lag rtsal mi sna/ shang grong gi drung yig 'char ldan bu btsa'i do dam mi 243

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/sna sogs gso skyong byas te slob grwa nas thon rjes yul de rang la mngags na da lta'i las zhugs kyi ngal ba de sel thub pa dang bcas gang ltar las rigs slob ma las zhugs kyi tshad de bod kyi las rigs slob grwa khag gi mdun lam dang snyan grags/ shi gson dang 'brel ba dam thag chod yod do/ /dgu/ slob yon dma' ru gtong dgos pa/ rang re bod kyi las rigs slob grwa mang che ba ni srid gzhung gis gnyer ba yin pas/ dge rgan gyi gla phogs dang spyi spyod gron dngul/ sgrig chas mang che ba srid gzhung gis 'gan gtsang bzhes byas yod/ bod kyi mi 'bor mang che ba zhing 'brog khul du yod pa dang / slob ma'i 'byung khungs kyang phal che ba zhing 'brog khul du yin/'on kyang zhing 'brog mang tshogs kyi 'byor pa shin tu zhan pa'i khar rang gi bu phrug la slob yon btang nas slob grwar gtong ba'i 'du shes yang dag kyang med/da lta bod kyi mtha' khul du lo drug gi 'gan babs slob gso mtha' 'khyol la ma 'khrol tsam dang / slob lo lon pa'i slob ma phyir 'then bya shugs che ba/nyes chad bcad kyang bu phrug slob grwar mi gtong ba bcas kyi gnad don 'dis bod kyi slob gsor bsam gzhigs kyi dri ba nan po zhig 'don gyi yod pa bcas 'brel yod slob grwa dang / slob gso'i las khungs kyis dbyings dpyad mdzad de las rigs slob grwa'i slob yon bsdu tshad dma' shos su btang nas slob zhugs kyi hur sems skul slong byed dgos/bcu/ las rigs slob gso'i sgrig gzhi bsgyur bcos bya dgos pa/ da lta bod du gnyer ba'i las rigs slob grwa'i do dam dang sgrig gzhi khag de sngon gyi 'ching rgya las 'grol med/ thog mar slob spyis 'gan len gyi lam 244

rang ljongs su las rigs slob gso gnyer phyogs kyi bsam gzhigs 'ga'/lugs 'og dang / bar du kun spyod slob gso khang / ched las khang /rig gnas khang / slob don khang / slob bsdu las 'jug khang / las gnyer khang / mi don khang dang / tha mar slob dpyod khang bcas rim pa gsum gyi sgrig gzhi zhig 'dzugs dgos/ de ltar btsugs te slob spyis khyon yongs nas do dam byas thog khru'u rim par thad kar jus bkod byed pa dang /kun spyod slob gso khang gis slob ma'i sgrig khrims dang bsam spyod gcun pa/ched las khang gis ched las mi 'dra ba'i slob dpyod khang do dam dang tsu'u krang la jus bkod byed pa/ rig gnas slob dpyod khang gis rig tshan mi 'dra ba'i slob dpyod khang gi do dam dang tsu'u krang la jus bkod byed pa/ slob dpyod khang gis slob khrid la lta skul dang rgyugs len par tshad 'jal byed pa/slob bsdu las 'jug khang gis slob ma gsar pa bsdu ba dang dngos sbyong gi bkod sgrig slob ma las zhugs kyi 'gro khungs 'tshol ba/ las gnyer khang gis dngos sbyong gi zhabs zhu dang yong 'bab gsog 'jog byed pa/ mi don khang gis dge rgan las bzo 'gyur len dang / gla phogs/ dge rgan zab sbyong gi las ka byed pa/ slob dpyod khang gis slob khrid zhib 'jug sogs kyi las don sgrub pa bcas byung na slob grwa'i sgrig gzhi tshags tshud yong bar sems so//bcu gcig tshan zhib la brten nas las rigs slob gsor gson shugs 'byin dgos/ las rigs slob gso gnyer ba la thog mar slob gso slob khrid kyi zhib 'jug sde khag cig nges par du 'dzugs dgos/des slob khrid zhib 'jug dang / slob grwa do dam/ dge rgan gso skyong /245

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/slob khrid bsgyur bcos/ tshod lta khang gsar skrun sogs la zhib 'jug bya dgos/ slob grwa'i las 'gan ni khrom ra'i dpal 'byor gyi dgos mkho dang 'tshams pa'i mi sna gso skyong bya rgyu de yin pas/ khrom rar mi sna gang 'dra zhig dgos min dang / nga tshos de dang 'tshams pa'i mi sna gso skyong byed pa las 'ol tshod kyis slob gso gnyer na 'gran rtsod che ba'i khrom ra'i nang rang nyid pham rgyu nyag cig yin/ dper na/ bod kyi khrom rar drung yig mi grangs brgyad cu las mi dgos par/ khyod kyis drung yig mi grangs brgya dang lnga bcu gso skyong byas na gtan nas mi 'tshams pa lta bu'o/ /de bzhin bod kyi las rigs slob gso ji ltar 'phel rgyas gtong phyogs dang / slob khrid bsgyur bcos ji ltar bya dgos pa/ slob thon slob ma las kar zhugs yul ji ltar bshang dgos pa/ las rigs slob gso'i ma 'ongs pa'i mdun lam sogs la zhib 'jug bya rgyu ni ha cang gal chen yin/bcu gnyis/ dmigs bsal khyad chos ldan pa'i ched las gnyer dgos/ skye bo zhig la thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos mchis na de la tshang mas mthong chen byed pa bzhin/ rang re bod la mtshon na thun mong min pa'i khyad yon rig gnas dang / ri klung chu bo/ yul srol goms gshis yod par brten 'dzam gling yongs kyis shin tu ngo mtshar dang lkog 'gyur zhig tu mngon nas gcigs mthong byed kyi yod/ las rigs slob grwa zhig la thun mong gi ched las tsam las dmigs bsal gyi ched las shig med na yun ring 'tsho gnas thub dka' bas/ las rigs slob grwa khag gis rang gi slob gnyer gyi cha rkyen dper na/ dge rgan dang / sgrig chas/ sa khongs/ yul babs/246

rang ljongs su las rigs slob gso gnyer phyogs kyi bsam gzhigs 'ga'/khrom ra'i dpal 'byor sogs la dpyad de gzhan las khyad du 'phags pa'i dmigs bsal gyi ched las gnyer skyong byas nas ming grags yod pa zhig bzo thub na dri ldan me tog rgyang ring yang bung ba sprin gyi tshogs bzhin 'khor zhes pa ltar yong ngo //bcu gsum/ slob spyi la dmigs bsal gyi mkhyen yon ldan dgos pa/slob grwa zhig legs sgrub byed min gyi 'gag rtsa ni slob spyi'i shes rab che chung dang / 'jon thang che chung la thug gi yod la khyad par du las rigs slob grwa'i slob spyi zhig gi ngos nas brjod na de bas kyang dmigs bsal gyi mkhyen yon gsum ldan dgos pa ste/ slob gso slob khrid la byang chub pa'i slob gso mkhas can dang gcig rnyog 'dzing che ba'i spyi tshogs thog mi dang mi'i bar gyi 'brel lam yang dag 'dzugs par mkhas pa dang gnyis/ khrom ra'i dpal 'byor 'gro lugs ltar dpal 'byor gnyer skyong la 'jon thang che ba'i khe las mkhas can dang gsum gyi cha rkyen yin no//247

nges par du 'bring rim dge 'os slob grwa'i bod yig slob gzhi tshad ldan can du legs bcos bya dgos/tang srid nam mkha'i nor bu yis/ /dus ngan mun stug mthar skrad de/ /mkhas btsun bzang gsum do ra ru/ /'chad rtsod rtsom gsum sgo 'phar gye/ /bod rang skyong ljongs su da bar 'bring rim dge 'os slob grwa'i gcig gyur gyi bslab gzhi zhig med gshis/ slob grwa so so'i mkho bab dang bstun nas 'ga' res mtho rim slob 'bring gi gcig gyur slob deb dang / 'ga' res dma' rim slob 'bring gi slob deb/ 'ga' zhig gis rang gi bsdu rtsom byas pa'i slob deb bcas sna tshogs shig slob gzhir byas nas khrid bzhin yod pas slob gnyer la dmigs pa gcig mthun ma byung bar brten/ chu tshad kyang mtho dman sna tshogs shig thon te rang mi rigs kyi khyon yongs kyi slob gso'i 'phrin las rgyun 'dzin dang / gong 'phel gtong rgyur mi sman pa'i shugs rkyen chen po phog pa rmongs brtul kho bo'i blo ngor 'char bas 'dir rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i skal bzang dang bstun nas nga tsho'i slob grwa'i bod skad yig slob gzhi legs bcos kyi nyams myong dngos dang sbyar nas don rtsa 'ga' zhu bar spro/248

'bring rim dge 'os slob grwa'i slob gzhi tshad ldan can du legs bcos byed pa/dang po/ slob gzhi gcig gyur byed dgos pa/'bring rim dge 'os slob grwa ni slob chung gi dge rgan gso skyong bya yul gyi lte gnas shig yin pas/ dge 'os slob grwa'i slob gso'i ma lag gi legs nyes ni rang ljongs kyi rmang gzhi'i slob gso 'phel sgrib ci 'ong bar thag gcod rang bzhin gyi go gnas zin yod pa dang gcig 'bring rim dge 'os slob grwa ni dgon gzhol gang la'ang ma the ba'i grong pa gcig dang 'dra bar slob grwa che 'bring chung gesum gyi srub tu kha ya byed mkhan med par lus nas/ da bar du go 'pher ba'i gcig gyur slob gzhi med par bya zin nya zin yin pa'i gnas bab med pa bzo ched dang gnyis/ rang ljongs slob gso tshan rtsal khang gis ljongs yongs kyi 'bring rim dge 'os slob grwa'i dge rgan yongs la dmigs pa gcig mthun gyis rgyugs len bya ba gzhir bzung ba'i yul zhig 'byung ba'i khar dge rgan gyi dpung khag spus dag tu gtong rgyu dang / slob thon slob gnyer pa tshad ldan can du 'gyur rgyur phan 'bras 'bur du thon pa 'ongs nges dang bcas dgos pa gsum gtsor mngon/gnyis pa/ slob deb kyi ma lag skor/'bring rim dge 'os slob grwa'i slob ma ni dma' rim slob 'bring nas thon yong ba sha stag yin gshis/ dma' rim slob 'bring nang sbyangs pa'i rmang gzhi'i shes bya legs bshad ljon dbang lta bu dma' rim slob 'bring skabs 249
snye bye rdo/ṭaṃ ngh+rubye /ṭ+wāṃ/ / ༷byebye ༷ṭ+wāṃ da
khro byerde / k+ṣiṃ stegs (stod/)
