mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/'dir lung ston pa rtsa ba sum rtags gnyis sngon du 'khrid dgos pa'i blo 'don dgos don ni/ dge 'os slob grwa'i slob yul la dmigs nas brjod pa yin pa ma gtogs dma' rim slob 'bring la'ang de ltar bya dgos pa'i blang bya bton pa min/ spyir na ba las be'u byung ba dang / rna rwa gnyis las sna cog sngon du skyes pa ltar bod yig gi 'khrid rgyun ngo ma 'di ltar yin rung / bar dgag dbang gis legs bshad ljon dbang sngon du 'khrid rgyun chags/de'ang dngul chus/ thon mi'i legs bshad sum cu pa'i/ /lhang po mdor bsdus bshad par bya/ /zhes slob dpon thon mi'i brda sprod gzhung gi snying bcud rnams btus te snyigs dus skye bo'i blo dang 'tshams par go sla zhing mdor bsdus sgo nas bshad par dam bcas pa zhig yin/ de'i dus mkhas mchog dam pa khong gi thugs la thon mi'i brda sprod gzhung de deng gi skye bo'i blor mi shong par dogs pa dang dbang po brtul ba rnams go bde la zin sla ba zhig bzos na/ kha ba can gyi skye 'gro kun la phan 'bras cher dgongs pa mdzad pa lags snyam/ des na slad mar dge rgan byed mkhan zhig gi ngos nas bshad na/ thog mar rtsa ba sbyangs nas phrad rnams kyi grub tshul dngos gsal rtogs khar de nas 'phros te legs bshad ljon dbang dang sbyar nas 'khrid na dge mtshan de bas che/ rtsa ba las/ de phyir dang po 'di nyid bslab/ de nas rgyas pa'ang mnyan byas te/ zhes pa brda sprod gzhung gi bslab tshul gyi go rim la 'doms pa gnang ba 'dis kyang de ltar lags so//'o na sla ba nas dka' ba'i 'khrid thabs dang 'gal bar mi 'gro'am zhe na/ mi 'gro ste sla ba dma' rim slob 'bring skabs 'khrid zin pas na 'dir 252

'bring rim dge 'ose5slob dz+wa'i slob gzhi tshad ldan can du legs bcos byed pa/de dang legs par sbyar te rgyas 'khrid bya ba'i las skal tsa ma las 'gangs che ba gang ma gnas pa'i tshig brda 'dis kyang dogs rgya las lhug gis grol snyam/gsum pa/ slob thun/lo 'ga'i slob khrid kyi nyams myong dngos brgyud nas gong gsal 'khrid bya khag legs sgrub byed dgos na gza' 'khor rer bod yig slob tshan ma mtha' yang thun brgyad nas dgu bar 'gan len byed dgos/ de 'dra byas na gzhi nas phra zhib spus dag gis las 'gan legs sgrub yong bar snyam/bzhi pa/ dmigs tshad/gong gsal bod yig gi bslab gzhi khag gi ma gzhi zhing chen dang ljongs lnga'i mnyam sgrig slob gzhi mtho rim slob 'bring gi bklag deb dang 'dra rung /rnam pa dang sgrig gzhi/ shes bya'i ma lag bcas kyi thog nas brjod na slob grwa thon skabs slob gnyer pa mang che ba mtho rim slob 'bring las thon pa'i slob ma'i yon tshad las cung mtho bar slebs par the mi tshom snyam/lnga pa/ khyad chos/gong gsal bslab gzhi de dag gi sgrig stangs thad rgya'i skad yig khrid srol gyi shan ma zhugs par bod skad yig ngo ma'i khrid rgyun dang mthun gang thub byas pa ste/ dper na yi ger yig mgo med pa bla mas bslab ma myong / gos la 253

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/gong ba med pa a mas g.yog ma myong / zer ba bzhin de dag la thog mar dge ba mchod brjod dang / rtsom par dam bca' ba/ bar du dge ba gzhung don dngos/ mtha' mar dge ba mjug bsdu zhing dge bsngo ba bcas bod yig gi rtsom ring thung gang la'ang khyab pa'i khyad chos de dag rgyun 'dzin byas yod snyam pa dang gcig de'i phyir mi rigs slob gso'i khyab khongs nang du mi rigs rang gi skad yig ring du bskyur nas mi rigs gzhan zhig gi skad yig bed spyad de slob khrid byas na/ grangs nyung mi rigs kyi rig gnas chu tshad mthor 'degs dang skye khungs grangs nyung mi rigs yin pa'i shes ldan mi sna skye bsring bya rgyu ni ha cang dka' ba'o/ /gzhan zhig nas dge 'os slob grwa'i dngos yod dang slob gso'i 'phel rim sogs slob chung dge rgan la 'tshams pa dge slob gnyis kar gnon shugs tog tsam yod pa'i khyad chos ldan pa ste/ dper na/ sum rtags dang dag gzugs/ sngags klog lta bu dge 'os slob grwa'i slob gnyer pas shes dgos nges khar/ snyan ngag dang bsdus grwa/ rtsom rig lta bu ni rgya'i ngag rgyun du slob gnyer par shes tshad bum pa gang ldan dgos na/ dge rgan rang nyid la chu zom gang dgos zer ba ltar dge rgan gyi shes tshad de slob phrug las ldab bcu yan gyis mtho ba dgos pa'i khyad chos ldan pa dang gnyis/slob gso'i gzhung lugs ltar spyir na sla ba nas dka' ba dang / rags pa nas zhib pa/ dma' ba nas mtho bar khrid dgos pa'i khyad chos la dmigs te sgrig dgos pa dang bcas khyad chos gtso bo gsum dang ldan yod pa snyam/254

'bring rim dge 'os slob grwa'i slob gzhi tshad ldan can du legs bcos byed pa/drug pa/ gzhi khungs/rje gung thang dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes/'khrul bral gzhung re nges bzung gzhir byas nas/ /gzhan rnams de dang sbyar nas daphyod pa las/ /gang byung dpe la blta zhing thams cad kyi/ /rjes su 'brangs pa shes rab 'chal 'gyur bas/ /rang lugs gtad so yod par gyis gig ang // zhes gdams pa ltar gzhung gang zhig 'chad par gyur kyang thog mar rang lugs kyi gzhi khungs gtad so yod par byas nas gzhan lugs la dpyad pa 'gog par bya dgos pa ni rigs pas sgrub lugs shig yin gshis/ gong smros slob gzhi khag gzhi khungs gtan nas med par rang bzos bab col du smra ba min par dpyad gsum dag pa'i gzhung bzang gis rkang dang srog shing byas nas 'gar zur brgyan pa tsam las ma 'das so//bdun pa/ dge rgan gyi las bgos bcos byed pa/lo bzhi'i nang khrid bya'i rnam grangs mang po de dag dge rgan gcig gis sdeb zin byas nas khrid na slob tshan gra sgrig 'thus tshang zhig mi yong ba dang gcig slob gzhi gcig gyur yin rung 'grel tshul thad dad pa'i phyir tshad gzhi gcig gyur gyis rgyugs len dka' ba dang gnyis/ da yod dge rgan 255

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/dpung khag la bltas na shes bya sne brgya 'dzoms pa'i dge rgan gcig gis 'khrid bya khag la thogs med yin pa'i 'jon thang can nyung ba'i don dngos dang gsum/ 'khrid yul slob mar slob khrid spus dag la gnad 'phrod pa zhig mi 'ong ba dang / dge rgan so so'i khyad yon 'don spel byed mi thub pa dang bzhi bcas skyon cha de dag la dmigs nas dge rgan bkod sgrig byed skabs nges par du so so'i sprod snang dang / dad blo/ khyad yon la dmigs nas shes bya nang tshan phyes te sne gcig rkang 'dzin gyi dge rgan ched bskos byed dgos/ dper na/ snyan ngag dge rgan gyis 'dzin grwa yongs kyi snyan ngag slob tshan gyi 'gan bzhes nas khrid na de'i legs cha brjod kyis mi langs ba da phan lo 'ga'i slob khrid kyi nyams myong dngos nas ra 'phrod nus/ 'ga' shas kyis de la dge rgan mang po dgos pa'am/ yang na dge rgan de'i las 'gan lci po 'ong bar dogs 'char skyes srid/ 'on tang kho bos bltas na bsam mno gtong shes pa dang skabs bstun ci bder byed mkhas pa zhig gi ngos nas brjod na slob grwa de'i 'phral yun gnyis ka'i dmigs yul sgrub pa dang /bod yig dge rgan khag gi spro ba bsrings thub par the mi tshom snyam/brgyad pa/ mi rigs slob gso dar gud kyi 'gag rtsa'i gnad don thag gcod byed pa/spyir shes rig la yang dag min gyi gnas tshul las go sa mtho dman dang /256

'bring rim dge 'os slob grwa'i slob gzhi tshad ldan can du legs bcos byed pa/gral rim/ rgyal khab sogs kyi rnam dbye med/ des na 'phrin brda dar rgyas che ba'i dus skabs 'dir/ rmongs brtul kho bo'i blor rang ljongs khul du mi rigs slob gso'am bod yig gi slob gso kha tsam min par don ngo mar bed spyod dang 'phel rgyas 'ong min ni mtho rim 'go khrid kyis bsam blo'i gtad phyogs dang / rang gi dad blo/ rgyus mnga' sne khrid byas nas bed spyod bya rgyu ni mdud brgya bkrol ba'i gnad dam pa yin/ dper na/ mtho rim sne mo bas bod kyi rig gnas bslabs kyang ma bslabs rung gang ltar dpal 'byor la dngos gang yang med par snyam pa'i blo dang / nga rang bod kyi rig gnas la rgyus mnga' de tsam rang med pas de 'phel kha che drags na nga'i gser krig 'phrog pa'i chag sgo langs mi 'ong ngam snyam pa'i blo dang / 'go khrid bsko bzhag byed skabs slob gsor rgyus mnga' gtan nas med pa'i 'go khrid rgan gras slob grwar mngags nas slob grwa de las bsgyur khang zhig tu brtsi ba'i bsam blo dang / bod yig ni sangs rgyas chos lugs kyis sbags pa'i rig pa zhig yin pas des mi rigs nyams dmas su gtong ba dang / zing slong gi rgyu byed kyin med dang snyam pa'i bsam blo sogs ni mi rigs slob gsor mi sman pa'i bsam pa'i bkag rgya mang po dum bur bcad nas/ rtag tu chu sna gar khrid ma byas par rang mi rigs kyi slob gsor gcigs 'dzin/ mi rigs kyi la rgya srung ste las rigs khag gi thog mtha' bar gsum gyi 'dzin shog dang /gsung bshad sogs la rgyun spyod dang / phog spar ba/ gnas spar ba sogs 'tsho ba dngos dang thad kar 'brel ba yod par mi rigs kyi skad yig shes min de thog ma'i cha rkyen dang rgyugs len gzhir 'jog pa'i re 'bod mgrin pa'i rdza 257

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor ba phyogs bsgrigs/༄rnga drag po brdungs ba 'di mkhas mang dgyes pa'i skyes tshul dang / blo nongs can rnams blang dor gnas la 'dzol ba'i re 'bod srong gtam gyi tshul du thal/'dir ma 'thad par 'ong nges la spyan dkyus yangs pa'i gzur gnas mkhas pa'i spyan sngar 'chags par bya'o// 258

rang ljongs kyi 'bring rim dge 'os slob grwa'i bslab gzhi gsar bsgrigs byas pa'i rtsa ba'i bsam blo'i gtang phyogs/rang ljongs su 'bring rim ched las dge 'os slob grwa lnga yod pa las/bod zhi bas bcings bkrol btang tshun nas da bar du 'bring rim dge 'os slob grwa'i gcig gyur gyi bslab gzhi zhig gsar skrun byas myong med gshis/rang ljongs slob gso tshan rtsal u yon lhan khang gis 'bring rim dge 'os slob grwa'i slob gso'i gal che'i rang bzhin dang go 'phangs la gzigs te spyi lo 1986lo'i zla 8par lha sar bslab gzhi rtsom sgrig bya rgyu'i tshogs 'du thengs dang po 'tshogs shing / tshogs 'du des gzhis rtse dge 'os slob grwas sngar rtsom sgrig byas pa'i bklag deb de gzhi rkang byas nas ljongs yongs kyi dge 'os slob grwa'i bslab gzhi rtsom sgrig byed rgyur gtan 'bebs byas/ gzhis rtse dge 'os slob grwa'i bod yig slob dpyod khang gi dge rgan tshe ring rdo rje lags dang /mig dmar tshe ring gnyis kyis kyang las 'gan legs bsgrubs kyis ljongs bslab gzhi rtsom bsgyur cud la zhib bsher bya rgyur phul rung / dus rabs kyi rnam pa'i dgos dbang dang / slob grwa 'bring chung gi khyon yongs kyi bslab gzhi'i ma lag dang 'tshams min sogs gzhan dbang gis bslab gzhi de rtsom sgrig byed ma thub/ de rjes lo 'ga' phyin pa'i spyi lo 1992lo'i zla 3par 259

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/ljongs slob gso tshan ud dang / ljongs bslab gzhi rtsom bsgyur cud kyis rang ljongs kyi slob gso gong mthor gtong rgyu ni sngon 'gro dam pa yin pa'i tshad mtho'i gzigs rgyang dang gcig da lta spyod bzhin pa'i slob deb la mkhregs 'dzin mkhregs skyor gyi nang don ches mang ba dang gnyis/ dge 'os slob grwa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos mtshon med pa dang gsum/ rgyal khab kyi gnas bab dang rang ljongs kyi gnas bab mtshon pa'i nang don nyung ba dang bzhi/ bslab bya'i gros 'debs kyi nang don mang ba dang dngos spyod kyi rang bzhin ldan pa'i nang don nyung ba dang lnga/ srol rgyun gyi bslab gzhi dang dus rabs gsar pa'i bslab gzhi'i 'brel ba thag gcod yang dag med pa dang drug slob ma rnams kyis lag pa 'gul te rtsom 'bri ba'i rtsom 'bri'i shes bya nyung ba dang bdun bcas la dmigs te bslab gzhi gsar du rtsom sgrig bya rgyu'i bya las chen po de mgo brtsams/bslab gzhi rtsom sgrig bya ba'i brgyud rim nang slob gzhi rtsom bsgyur cud kyi rtsom sgrig 'gan 'khur dang kho bo gnyis mnyam du dus yun ring po bed spyad de gzhis rtse dang / lha sa/ lho kha/ nag chu sa khul gyi dge 'os slob grwa la dngos su gsham skyod byas te phyogs gcis nas slob khrid kyi rtsa 'dzin dang /rtsom 'bri'i dkar chag sogs la bsam 'char bsdu len byas pa dang / phyogs gcig nas slob grwa de dag gi slob ma'i 'byung khungs dang / dge rgan gyi grub cha sogs la rtogs zhib gting zab byas te yang bskyar bzo bcos thengs mang byas mthar/ bod rang skyong ljongs bslab gzhi zhib bsher u yon lhan khang gis snga rjes su zhib bsher thengs spusum byas te (bod rang skyong ljongs 'bring 260

'bring rim dge 'os slob grwa'i bslab gzhi gsar bsgrigs byas pa'i rtsa ba'i bsam phyogs/rim dge 'os slob grwa'i bod yig gi slob khrid rtsa 'dzin 〉 zhes pa'i bslab gzhi rtsom 'bri'i dkar chag la mos mthun byung ste/ spyi lo 1993lo'i ston dus kyi slob dus dang po nas bzung snga rjes su dge slob rnams kyis bkol spyod byed thub par byung /da lta 'dir kho bos dge 'os slob grwa'i bslab gzhi gsar pa de'i nang don gyi sgrig stangs dang / der ldan pa'i khyad chos/ rtsom sgrig gi rtsa don sogs zur bltas lebs mthong 'ongs slad 'dir rags tsam gleng pyor spro ba bsrings/dang po/ rtsom sgrig rtsa don gyi skor/gcig chab srid bsam blo'i nang don mtshon dgos pa'i rtsa don/bod skad yig gi bslab gzhi rtsom sgyur bya rgyu de'ang rtsa ba'i rtsa don bzhi rgyun 'khyongs dang / rang gi pha yul la dga' zhen byed mkhan gyi dmar zhing mkhas pa'i mi rabs gsar pa skyed bsring bya rgyur gcigs su 'dzin thub par dgos so/ /gnyis/ dge 'os slob grwa'i khyad chos 'bur thon bya dgos pa'i rtsa don/ de'ang 'bring rim dge 'os slob grwa'i slob gnyer pa rnams ni slob grwa nas thon rjes slob chung dge rgan bya rgyu sha stag yin gshis/ slob tshan nang khungs dag po dang rmang gzhi'i shes bya ste gzugs dag 'don gsum 'gro rgyugs 'pher ba 'ongs pa bya rgyu gtso gnad dang / dngos su slob khrid bya ba'i brgyud rim nang rmang gzhi'i shes bya khag thogs med khrid thub pa'i nus pa skyed 261

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/bsring bya slad du 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum las 'chad par 'jug thabs dang /slob chung bslab gzhi'i khrid thabs tshad 'dzin yig gzugs bcas kyi nang don 'bur thon byas yod pa'o//gsum/ tshan rig gi rang bzhin ldan dgos pa'i rtsa don/bslab gzhi'i nang bod kyi dus rabs rim byung gi phul byung rtsom yig dang rtsom 'bri'i shes bya/ sum rtags dag gsum/ snyan ngag mngon brjod/ tshad ma sogs kyi nang don khag gi grangs 'bor dang / gting zab tshad sogs slob ma'i lo na dang / tsheg 'grel dang / bsam gzhigs dri gzhi/ bskyar sbyong dri gzhi/ nor 'phyugs med par gnad la 'phigs pa dang / bslab gzhi'i nang don gong 'og 'brel mthud kyis spyir sla ba nas dka' ba dang /rags pa nas zhib par 'gro dgos pa'i rig pa'i 'gro lugs kyi chos nyid dang mi 'gal bar byas pa'o//bzhi/ rtsa ba'i nus rtsal gso skyong bya dgos pa'i rtsa don/ bod yig gi shes bya khag sbyangs nas bed spyod ma shes na don byed nus stong du 'gro bar nges pas na bslab gzhi rtsom sgrig bya skabs slob chung gi slob khrid la nye bar mkho ba'i shes bya sgyu gu'i kha ma bzo stangs/ thig rgyag stangs/ 'bri stangs/ 'bri lugs/ rgyun par spyod sgo che ba'i rtsom 'bri stangs la shugs snon brgyab ste/ phyogs spyod skar ma mtho la/ rtsa ba'i nus rtsal zhan pa'i slob gnyer pa mi thon pa'i slad/ bslab gzhi'i thog mtha' bar gsum du khrid bya'i shes bya de lag len dngos kyi nus rtsal ngo mar 'gyur ba bya rgyu'i nang don mtshon thabs byas pa'o/ /262

'bring rim dge 'os slob grwa'i bslab gzhi gsar bsgrigs byas pa'i rtsa ba'i bsam phyogs/gnyis pa/ bslab gzhi'i nang don bkod sgrig gi skor/gcig nang don sgrig gzhi/ bslab gzhi'i nang don che rigs lnga la dbye nas sgrig gzhi chags pa ste/ sum rtags dag gsum gtso byas pa'i brda sprod rig pa'i skor dang gcig snyan ngag gtsor byas pa'i tshig rgyan rig pa'i skor dang gnyis/ rtsom dpe dang rtsom 'bri'i shes bya gtso byas pa'i rtsom rig gi skor dang gsum/ gtan tshigs rig pa'i shes bya gtsor byas pa'i lam chung ba'i skor dang bzhi/ slob chung bslab gzhi'i khrid thabs kyi sgyu rtsal gtsor byas pa'i slob gzhi khrid thabs dang lnga/ der ma tshud pa'ang slob tshan khag gi mchan 'grel dang / sbyong tshan rnams so/ /gnyis/ slob tshan khag gi nang don bdam sgrig gi tshad gzhi'i skor/ thog mar rtsom gyi brjod don gtsang ma dgos pa dang / des slob mar yar thon gyi bsam pa'i shugs rkyen thebs thub pa bya dgos pa dang gcigaming tshig brjod pa bcas kyi tshig sbyor kun tshad ldan yin dgos pa dang gnyis/gna' bzang deng spyod kyi rtsa don ltar dus rabs rim byung gi gces rtsom bdam rgyu dang gsum/ rtsom gyi lus dang / rtsom lugs kyi rnam pa 'dra min sna tshogs dang / brjod bya'i nang don cung rgya che la gting zab pa bdam rgyu dang bzhi/ sum rtags sogs bod spyi la khyab che zhing mkhas pa mang che bas khungs gtug sar tshad 'dzin byed pa bdam rgyu dang lnga/ slob ma'i lo na'i khyad chos dang / bed spyod rang bzhin la dmigs nas bdam rgyu dang drug deng rtsom gyi nang nas phul du byung ba'i rtsom 'ga' bdam rgyu dang bdun/ slob chung 263

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/dge rgan zhig gi ngos nas brjod na nges par du shes dgos pa'i rigs kyi shes bya'i khyab khongs rnams bdam rgyu dang brgyad/ rtsom 'bri'i shes bya khag bod rang la yod pa'i rnam gzhag 'ga' bdam rgyu dang bcas dgu'o/ /gsum/ bslab gzhi'i nang don gyi grangs 'bor gyi skor/ 'bring rim dge 'os slob grwa'i slob lo'i lam lugs dang dngos sbyong gi dus tshod ltar dngos khrid kyi slob deb bdun la gtan phab dang / gza' 'khor rer slob thun drug bed spyad de khrid tshar ba bya dgos pa'i slob gso'i srid 'dzin las khungs kyi gtan 'bebs la gzhigs te slob deb rer zur lta'i slob tshan gcig nas gsum bar dang / dngos su bshad khrid bya dgos pa'i slob tshan bcu gcig nas bco brgyad bar 'god rgyu bcas grangs tshad dang / 'bor tshad de tsam la 'os shing 'tsham par nges te/ de las 'gal mi chog pa byas yod pa'o//gsum pa/ bslab gzhi'i ma lag sgrig stangs/'bring rim dge 'os slob grwa'i bod yig bslab gzhi'i ma lag sgrig stangs ni cung thun mong ma yin pa'i sgrig thabs bed spyad pa ste/ dge 'os kyi khyad chos 'bur thon gyis rig tshan rnam dbye'i ngo bor dpyad de/ rig tshan 'dra ba rnams phyogs gcig tu mnyam sgrig byas pa ste/ slob deb dang por sum cu pa dang / gnyis par rtags kyi 'jug pa/ gsum par brda dag mngon brjod/ bzhi par snyan ngag lnga par rtsom 'bri'i rnam gzhag drug par gtan tshig rig pa/ bdun par slob chung bslab gzhi'i khrid thabs gtsor 264

'bring rim dge 'os slob grwa'i bslab gzhi gsar bsgrigs byas pa'i rtsa ba'i bsam phyogs/byas nas sdeb sgrig byas pa dang gcig bdams pa'i bstan bcos de'i gzhung ring po phud/ de byings la gang thub kyis bstan bcos de'i 'jug dngos mjug gsum tshang ba bya rgyu dang gnyis/ slob deb rer zur lta'i slob tshan gcig nas gsum bar bcug nas der blo sgo 'byed thabs kyi mchan nam dri gzhi bkol rgyu dang gsum/ rtsom yig khag slob deb bdun nang 'grems rgyu dang bzhi bcas rang ljongs kyi 'bring rim dge 'os slob grwa'i bslab gzhi dang /mtsho sngon zhing chen 'bring rim mi rigs dge 'os slob grwa'i bslab gzhi kan lho'i mi rigs dge 'os slob grwa'i bslab gzhi/ zhing chen dang rang skyong ljongs lngas mnyam sgrig byas pa'i mtho rim slob 'bring gi bslab gzhi'i legs cha'i snying bcud btus te/ rtsa ba'i ma lag ni ltos bcas kyis rig tshan sdeb sgrig gi ma lag dang rgyun mthud rang bzhin gyi ma lag bed spyod rang bzhin gyi ma lag bcas so//bzhi pa/ sbyang tshan bkol thabs/sbyang tshan gnad 'phigs bkod rgyu ni bslab gzhi'i rtsom sgrig bya ba'i gal che'i grub cha zhig yin pas/ nges par du slob tshan de'i nang gi shes dgos nges kyi nang don dang / tshig gi snying bcud rnams sbyang tshan nang 'god dgos pa dang gcig bkol thabs thad blo sgo 'byed thabs dang / rang gis bsam blo btang nas lan 'debs dgos pa las slob deb las bshus chog chog gi rigs gang thub kyis nyung tsam 'god dgos pa dang gnyis/ sbyang gzhi sum rtags sogs sbyangs zin pa'i rmang gzhi'i shes bya khag dang 'brel ba dam 265

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/zab byas te gzugs dag 'don gsum gyi rtsa ba'i nus rtsal sbyong brdar bya rgyur thog mtha' bar gsum du do snang bya dgos pa dang gsum/ sbyang tshan de'ang slob khang nang sgrub dgos nges kyi rigs dang / slob phyi'i nang sgrub dgos pa'i rigs gnyis su dbye dgos pa dang bzhi/ zur lta'i slob tshan la blo sgo 'byed mchan dang / lta klog myong bris/ snying don rags bsdu bya rgyu sogs 'os 'tshams shig 'god dgos pa bcas lnga'o//266

khyim tshang dang / slob grwa/ spyi tshogs bcas kyis slob mar kun spyod slob gso gtong ba gcig mthun yong thabs la dpyad pa/nye ba'i char rang rgyal la lo chung byis pa dung phyur gsum lhag tsam yod pa dag skyon bral ngang 'tshar longs 'ong rgyu ni rgyal khab kyi las dbang dang tang gi bya gzhag dar rgud dang thad kar 'brel ba che/ de'ang byis pa rnams 'tshar longs 'ong ba'i gnas gzhi chen po gsum ste khyim tshang gi khor yug dang /slob grwa'i khor yug spyi tshogs kyi khor yug bcas kyis byis pa'i gnyug ma'i dwangs gtsang gi sems rgyud la brtul zhugs nges gtan bya bar gdon mi za/deng gi shes bya'i rba klong 'phyur ba'i dus 'dir deng rabs can bzhi mngon par 'gyur ba'i rtsa ba ni shes ldan mi snar thug pa dang / shes ldan mi sna'i rtsa ba ni slob gsor thug pa dang / slob gso'i rtsa ba'ang khyim tshang gi slob gso la thug pa'i lta ba gsal 'don gnang nas khyim tshang gi slob gso'i gnas thang la gdeng 'jog byed pa dang / slob grwa'i slob gso ni slob chung nas dbu brtsams te rang gi bu phrug mkhas pa'i dbang po'i gser khrir 'phags pa'i 'dun pa cher bskyed kyis rig pa'i gnas la sbyang brtson bya bar skul ba'i gnas bab bzang po zhig thon dang 'thon bzhin pa'i rdzogs ldan skal bzang gi dus 'dir/ zur zhig nas shes rig slob pa mthong chen byas nas kun 267

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/spyod slob gsor mthong chen de tsam mi bya ba dang / de ma nyid du mkhas par 'gyur 'dod pa'i thal drags pa'i 'dun pa dang / slob grwa'i dwangs gtsang gi khor yug dang / spyi tshogs kyi zang zing 'du 'dzi'i gnas yul/ khyim tshang gi bkag rgya btsan pa'i gnas gzhi bcas phyogs 'di gsum 'gal 'du'i gnas shig tu mthong bas 'dir thog mar kun spyod slob gso'i go don/ rtsa don/bya thabs la dpyad pa dang / bar du phyogs gsum dag lung pa gsum nas rgyug 'ongs pa'i chu phran zhig dang 'dra bar so so'i mngar bsil la sogs khyad yon la dpyad de mthar rgya mtsho chen po'i nang 'du ba ltar phyogs gsum gyi kun spyod slob gso dag dmigs pa gtad yul gcig gi steng du 'bab par bya rgyu ni rtsom 'di'i gnad dam pa yin/dang po/ kun spyod slob gso'i go don/kun spyod kyi kun ni brjod bya'i dngos po ma tshang ba med pa yod do cog brjod pa'i mang tshig khyad par ba zhig yin pa dang / spyod ni bya ba gang zhig la dngos su sbyor ba'i las de la 'jug de'ang kun spyod ni lus kyi bza' lugs/ 'gro lugs/ 'dug lugs dang / ngag gi smra brjod/ yid kyi kun slong bcas kyi nang don tshud pa'i spyod tshul sna tshogs la zer/ kun spyod slob gso zhes pa ni rang gi yab yum dang / dge rgan/ rgan rabs/ skyes bu dam pa/ rang las bslab pa mtho ba dang / shes rab che ba/ yon tan khyad par du 'phags pa dag gis sdug bsngal skyed pa'i rgyu mi shes pa'i skye bo dag dper na/ lha rjes nad pa'i rma kha gso phyir sman bcos dang sbrags spyod 268

slob mar kun spyod slob gso gtong ba gcig mthun yong thabs la dpyad pa/lam bslabs nas bde bar gso ba ltar blo dman dag gi lus ngag yid gsum gyi spyod pa dag gsos te 'jug pa'i bslab 'doms byas pa la kun spyod slob gso zer/ 'di la'ang kun spyod slob gso byed pa po dang / bya yul/ bya bya'i chos bcas phyogs gsum nges par du tshang dgos pa dang / phan tshun ltos grub kyi rig pa zhig kyang ngang gis grub/gnyis pa/ kun spyod slob gso'i nang don/lo chung byis par kun spyod slob gso gtong rgyu'i nang don gtso bo rang gshis gso rgyu dang / bsam pa'i 'khyer so/ 'du shes 'dzin stangs/spyod tshul/ mi tshe'i lta ba bcas las grub/ de'ang rags par dbye na/1༄chung byis pa'i dus nas rang gi pha ma la bkur bste dang / spun mched dang grogs po la sems 'khur bya ba nas 'go brtsams te slob grwa dang /dge rgan/ pha yul la dga' zhen dang der gces 'dzin bya ba nas mthar tang la dga' zhen dang spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi mes rgyal la dga' zhen/ mi dmangs la dga' zhen gyi bsam pa rnam dag btsugs te tang dang / mes rgyal/mi dmangs bcas kyi khe dbang de bla med gtsug tu 'dzin dgos pa'i 'du shes 'dzugs thub pa bya dgos/2༄bsam spyod legs po'i goms gshis chags par gso skyong bya dgos/'di ni kun spyod slob gso'i gtso gnad kyi nang don zhig tu grub/ pha mas dmigs yul nges gtan yod pa'i sgo nas byis par rgan rabs dang dge rgan la brtsi bkur dang / ya rabs gus zhabs kyi spyod pas sne len zhu stangs/269

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/rig pa'i gnas la sbyang brtson bya lugs/ mnyam sdeb la do 'khur dang / mi gzhung drang bya lugs/ khengs pa skyungs lugs/ grung sha dod la spro snang ldan pa/ gang bsam thogs med smra ba/ dpa' mdzangs rtul phod/ khrims srung lugs skyong sogs phul du byung ba'i bsam blo kun spyod kyi goms gshis chags par gso skyong bya dgos/ de'ang lo chung byis pa ni lad mo byed par shin tu mkhas pa zhig yin gshis/ pha mas kyang rtag tu ya rabs dam pa'i bsam spyod kyi brtul zhugs 'dzin dgos pa las/ de las ldog na 'bras bu ngan pa 'thon rgyu gdon mi za'o/ /3ringal rtsol la dga' zhen gyi goms gshis gso skyong bya dgos/ ngal rtsol la dga' zhen bya ba'i slob gso gtong ba'i brgyud rim nang nges par du byis pa'i lo na dang / nus shugs la dpag pa'i khyim tshang nang gi las ka tsag cig bya rgyur the zhugs bya ru bcug ste kho tshor ngal rtsol gyi phan 'bras dang ngal rtsol par brtsi bkur/ ngal rtsol gyi 'bras bur gces spras/ yang dag pa'i ngal rtsol gyi lta ba 'dzin rgyu bcas kyi slob gso thebs pa byas nas ma 'ongs par ma mthar yang rang rkya 'pher ba'i ngang 'tsho ba bskyal thub pa'i ngal rtsol gyi goms gshis legs po zhig chags thub pa bya dgos/4yang dag pa'i lta bas byis par pho mo'i 'brel ba bya lugs kyi slob gso gtong dgos pa ste/ lo na'i khyad chos dang skye khams rig pa'i 'gro lugs ltar phru gur nges par du skye khams 'phrod bsten bya lugs dang / 'jig rten lugs dang mthun pa'i sgo nas bu bu mo'i bar gyi 'brel gtug ji ltar bya lugs thad kha gsal na go bde/ nam langs na 'gro bde zhes pa ltar gsang med 270

slob mar kun spyod slob gso gtong ba gcig mthun yong thabs la dpyad pa/rjen 'don gyis gzab nan dang gzhung drang pos pho mo'i bar 'brel gtug bya dgos pa'i slob gso bya rgyu de'ang kun spyod slob gso'i nang mthong chung gtan nas bya rgyu med pa'i 'tsho ba dngos dang 'brel ba thad kar yod pa'i nang don zhig tu grub pa'o/ /gsum pa/ kun smyod slob gso'i rtsa don/khyim tshang gi slob gso dang / slob grwa'i slob gso/ spyi tshogs kyi kun spyod slob gso'i thad yid gzab bya dgos pa'i rtsa don la/1༄nan la 'tshams pa dgos pa'i rtsa don/ de ni rgya'i gtam du dge rgan nan pa'i khrod nas dge gzhon mchog gyur thon zhes pa ltar phru gur re ba nan po bya dgos pa gzhir byas re ba de'ang 'os shing 'tshams pa zhig dgos pa las sgrub mi thub pa'i re ba be'u la glang lto sbyin pa lta bu bton na phru gu'i nang sems 'dul mi thub/ des na so so'i lcogs tshod la dmigs nas re ba nan la 'os shing 'tshams pa bton na dge rtsar gyur/2rirang dpe gzhan ston bya dgos pa'i rtsa don/ pha ma dang dge rgan gyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi bya lugs ni phru gur thad kar shugs rkyen thebs kyi yod pa ste/ bza' lugs/ 'gro lugs/ sdod lugs/ smra lugs/ kun spyod/gshis ka zhen yul/ lta ba sogs phru gu'i lad mo bya gzhi'am mig dpe lta yul gson por gyur gshis nges par du rang dpe gzhan ston dang rang gis rang gcun nas phru gu'i sems khams su ji srid bar brjed par dka' ba'i gzugs brnyan zhig 'jog thub pa bya dgos/ gal te pha ma gnyis kha rtsod 271

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/rgyag pa dang / tha na rgyag res rgyag pa/ sho sbag rgyan la rtsed zhen/ chang rag btung nas skyur 'gong shod pa/ khram dang g.yo sgyu'i bya bar dga' ba sogs byas na mi'i lad mo khyis byas/ khyi yi sbar mo mes 'tshigs zhes pa ltar phru gus pha ma'i bka' la mi nyan pa'i khar shugs rkyen ngan pa dug gi kha rlangs ltar phog ste mthar nyes gsog gi lam du 'gro nyen che bas der gzab dgos/3༄bslab 'doms gcig mthun dgos pa'i rtsa don/ kun spyod slob gso'i nang rgyu rkyen sna tshogs 'phrad srid pas na bslab 'doms byed skabs nges par du gcig mthun 'ongs pa bya dgos pa ste/ khyim tshang gi nang mi tshang ma'i bslab 'doms dang re 'dun gcig mthun 'ongs pa byed dgos pa dang /khyim tshang gi slob gso dang slob grwa'i dge rgan gyi slob gso gcig mthun 'ongs pa bya dgos/ gal te rtsa don de las ldog ste pha yis bu la bka' bkyon gnang dus ma bu yi phyogs su langs nas 'khang ra dang rgyab rtsa bya ba/ bya lugs ga ge mo zhig dge rgan nor ba red/ khyim bdag 'grig pa red ces brjod pa lta bu gcig mthun min pa'i lta ba byung tshe rnam dpyod kyi rig stobs zhan pa'i phru gus yin min rnam 'byed mi thub pa ma zad/ phru gu'i sems rgyud du rang snang gang shar bya ba'i sa bon btab ste mi nyan pa'i rang gshis ngan pa chags nyen che bas der gzab dgos/4drang phyogs nas blo sna khrid dgos pa'i rtsa don/ lo chung byis pa'i slob gso gtong rgyur thog mar drang phyogs nas gang ci thub kyis blo sna khrid dgos pa'i rtsa don rgyun 'khyongs bya dgos pa ste/ phru gus re ba gang zhig bton pa'am yang na nongs pa'i bya ba gang zhig byas rung gang zhig yang dag pa 272

slob mar kun spyod slob gso gtong ba gcig mthun yong thabs la dpyad pa/yin pa dang / gang zhig nyes pa yin pa gnas lugs rgyu mtshan dang bcas dpe drangs nas lhug par brjod na blor zugs pa dang mngon brtsi lkog 'gal du mi 'gro ba'i phan 'bras thon shugs che bar mngon/5༄gces dgos la gces lang du ma shor ba bya dgos pa'icortsa don/ pha mas rang gi sha rus las chad pa'i phru gur mi gces pa ni 'jig rten 'di na shin tu dkon/ 'on kyang byams po bya shes dgos/ byams po bya ma shes na dper na sman yin rung zos drags na grod par dug tu 'gyur ba gdon mi za ba ltar gces lang du shor drags na le lo dang sgyid lug rang shed che ba/chog mi shes pa sogs sems rgyud la 'gos te phru gur gnod pa'i rgyur 'gro rgyu las ma 'das/ rgyu mtshan de'i phyir phyogs gcig nas phru gus bton pa'i dngos po dang bsam pa'i re ba gang yang rung 'os 'tshams kyis skong ba ma zad/ji ltar bya lugs dang spyod lugs kyi slob ston bya dgos pa dang / phyogs gcig nas phru gu rnams skyon bral ngang 'tshar longs 'ong slad nges par du dka' sdug che ba'i khor yug tu sbyong brdar bya ru bcug ste kho tsho dka' tshegs dang bar chad las rnam par grol thub pa'i snying rus kyi bsam pa skyed bsring bya dgos/bzhi pa/ kun spyod slob gso bya thabs/1riblo sna 'khrid thabs/ thabs shes 'di ni pha mas kun spyod slob gso'i rtsa don dang bya lugs ltar lo na'i khyad chos la dmigs nas phru gu'i kun spyod gso ba'i thabs lam zhig yin/ 'dir gtso bo pha mas phru gu dang mnyam du dpe 273

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/deb lta klog bya ba/ sgrung shod pa bcas mthong thos myong gsum gyi thog nas phru gur kun spyod slob gso gtong ba dang gcig phru gu'i sems khams kyi khyad chos dang bsam pa'i 'khyer so'i don dngos la dmigs nas gnad la 'phigs pa'i bsam 'char brje res byed pa dang / don dngos drangs pa dang / bden pa bden thub/ dpe dang gnas lugs rgyu mtshan drangs nas go bskon gsed grol gyi slob gso gtong ba dang gnyis/ don snying ldan pa'i legs bshad dang gtam rgyud de bzhin grags can mi sna'i gsung rnams ngo sprod kyi thog nas phru gu'i kun spyod kyi rtogs pa mtho ru gtong ba dang sbrags blo sgo 'byed pa'i slob gso gtong ba dang gsum bcas mdor na pha ma dang dge rgan gyis ya rabs spyod pa'i lam sna drangs te phru gu ya rabs dam pa'i spyod bzang gi lam der 'jug pa'i thabs lam ston dgos/2rimig dpe ston thabs/ thabs lam 'di ni pha ma dang dge rgan gyis phru gur spyod lam kyi thog nas mig dpe ston dgos pa'i khar gna' deng gi skyes bu dam pa dang / mkhas dbang / de bzhin rang gi 'tsho ba'i khor yug tu yod pa'i sngon thon gyi mi sna de dag phru gu'i mig dpe lta yul du mtshams sbyor bya dgos/ de'ang gangs can yi ge'i byed po slob dpon thon mi dang / sa paṇa/dge 'dun chos 'phel/ paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa/ mdzangs blon bdun/de bzhin gzhon nu'i dus kyi ma'o tse tung / a khu le h+phung / li'u hu lan/krang had ti lta bu dpe mtshon gyi mi sna'i mdzad rjes ngo sprod kyis slob gso gtong ba dang gcig pha ma dang dge rgan gyis dus rgyun du rang dpe gzhan ston bya rgyur gcigs chen bya dgos pa dang gnyis/ de dag byas pa brgyud phru 274

slob mar kun spyod slob gso gtong ba gcig mthun yong thabs la dpyad pa/gus mig dpe bya yul gang de'i mtshan snyan la gces spras dang der slob sbyong bya ba'i bsam pa'i kun slong bzang po btsugs te bya spyod dngos kyi nang de dag rang gi mig dpe lta yul gyi snang brnyan gson po lta bu zhig tu 'gyur ba bya dgos/3skurang gis rang gcun thabs/ thabs shes 'di ni 'khrid ston byas pa'i 'og ya rabs spyod pa'i tshul lugs ltar rang gi kun spyod kyi mngon tshul la rang gis dpyad zhib dang legs spel nyes 'gog 'gyur bcos/ rang gis rang gcun te bzang po'i lam la 'jug pa'i chu tshad mtho ru gtong rgyu'i goms gshis chags thabs shig yin/ de'ang rang gi dad yul du gyur pa'i spyod bzang gi mi sna'i gzugs brnyan zhig rang gi blor bzhengs nas der lad mo byas te rang gcun spyod gso bya ba dang gcig phru gu rang nyid kyis rgyal po lugs kyi bstan bcos dang / sa skya legs bshad/ kha che pha lu'i bslab bya/skye bo gso thigs sogs lugs kyi bstan bcos la rang sbyong byas nas rang gcun spyod gso bya ba dang gnyis/ dmangs khrod ngag gtam du/ gzhan la lta ba'i mig yod kyang rang nyid lta na me long dgos zhes pa ltar kun spyod bzang po'i mi rnams rang nyid kyi mig dper 'dzin pa'i me long lta bur bzung nas rang gi nyes pa'i cha de ma nyid du spong ba ste me long bsten nas rang gcun spyod gso bya ba dang gsum/ rgyun par 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi don chung dper na dus thog mal nas langs rgyu dang / mal chas legs sgrig dang / gad bdar bya rgyu/ sku mgron la sne len byed rgyu sogs bya ba chung tsag gi thog la'ang rang gcun spyod gso bya dgos pa dang bzhi/ rang gi 'dagazin pa'i dus tshod 275

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/nang gi lta spyod la rjes dran gyis bsam gzhigs dang / dpyad zhib legs par byas te nongs pa'i cha de mur 'gyod bshags kyis skyon spang dgos pa bcas lugs kyi bstan bcos dpal 'du'i nor bu las kyang / lus zung thub pa seng ge 'dra/ /brnyas su mi gtub zil gnon che/ /ngag zung thub pa drang srong 'dra/ /skye bo thams cad yid ches dga'/ /yid kyi zung thub nor bu 'dra/ /bdag dang gzhan gyi 'dod pa 'jo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rang gis rang gcun thub na bzang po'i lam la 'jug pa'i mi chos kyi rtsa bar 'gyur/4gzengs bstod bya thabs/ bya thabs 'di ni phru gu'i bsam spyod bzang por dus thog tu tshad mtho'i gdeng 'jog byas te legs byas dar spel dang yar thon gyi bsam pa skul 'ded kyi nus pa rgya cher thon pa'i khyad yon ldan/ de'ang thabs lam mi 'dra ba mang du mchis pa las thog mar phru gu'i bsam spyod legs pa byung tshe de dag la ngag thog dang / mig gi lta stangs/lag brda/ dbu lcog mthe bong sogs lus ngag gi phra mo'i brda dang rnam 'gyur la brten nas shin tu mos pa'i rnam 'gyur ston pa dang gcig yang phru gus mi bzang las bzang byas pa la mi mang 'du tshogs kyi khrod du yig thog dang / ngag thog gang rung gis bsngags brjod kyi me tog gtor ba dang gnyis/ phru gu'i bya bzang dang spyod bzang / dmigs bsal can dang /'gyur ldog chen po byung ba la bsam pa dang dngos po'i thog nas bya dga' nges can sprod dgos pa dang gsum bya dgos pa ma zad/ bya thabs thad nges par du bsngags brjod byed rgyu'i nang don de bden pa bden thub yin pa las rdzun bzo'i sgro btags kyi rigs spang dgos pa dang gcig bsngags brjod bya rgyu 276

slob mar kun spyod slob gso gtong ba gcig mthun yong thabs la dpyad pa/de bsam blo'i gzengs bstod bya rgyu gtso bo dang / dngos po'i bya dga' sprod rgyu phal par 'jog dgos pa dang gnyis/ bsngags brjod dus thog tu bya dgos pa dang gsum/ rgyun par pha mas phru gur khyod kyis bya ba ga ge mo zhig bsgrubs tshe ngas dngos po'i bya dga' gang dang gang sprod do zhes mna' skyel dam bca' 'jog pa sogs mi byed pa dang bzhi/ mdor na snod bstun lung 'bogs kyi dpe ltar phru gu'i khyad chos la dmigs nas bstod bsngags 'os shing 'tshams par byas na da gzod phru gu yag po zhig chags pa'i dge rtsar 'gyur/5riskyon brjod bya thabs/ thabs shes 'di ni gtso bo phru gu'i bsam blo dang / spyod lam sogs kyi thad zhan cha dang / skyon cha/ nor ba'i cha mchis par dus thog tu rnag thog gtsag 'khel gyis skyon brjod dang tha na tha tshig sgrog pa bcas byas te yin min rnam 'byed legs par phye nas skyon spang dge sgrub kyis ngan lam la nam yang mi 'jug par bya ba'i thabs lam zhig yin/des na dge rgan dang pha mas skyon brjod byed skabs nyes rdung dang / gshe gshe/ tshig rtsub/ bsteng tshig khyad gsod sogs ngang thung gi bya thabs la brten nas byis pa rnams rlung ston yul lta bu zhig byas na phru gu'i blor mi zugs pa ma zad/ tha na pha bu dang dge slob gnyis 'gras nas 'gal zlar 'gro nyen che ste de ni dper na drag char dang bsil char gyi bsdur ba las rtogs thub pas slob gso gtong skabs nges par du ngang rgyud ring la yul dang dus la dpyad dgos pa ste/ dper na lto za bzhin pa'i skabs dang / gnyid ma nyal gong / mi mang 'du tshogs khrod skyon brjod bya rgyu med pa dang gcig277

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/pha mas phru gu'i nyes tshabs che chung la dmigs nas skyon brjod bya rgyu de nges par du gzhung drang zhing g.yo lhad med par gnad la 'phigs po dgos pa dang gnyis/ lang shor gyi bya ngan 'ga' de ma nyid du spong bar dka' gshis/nges par du don chen bsgrub par ngang bsrings dgos zhes pa'i dpe ltar ngang rgyud ring po dang dus yun ring tsam gyi brgyud rim brgyud de zhan cha spong rgyur skyon brjod bya dgos pa las/ gzugs langs grib mngon lta bu'i 'dun pa drags bskyed dag cis nas kyang khyad bsad bya dgos pa dang gsum/ phru gu'i nongs pa'i cha rtogs 'phral 'os med bstun thabs dang / nye dga' phyogs zhen/ rgya yan du btang ba'i rigs gtan nas bya rgyu med pa dang bzhi/ skyon brjod bya rgyu de'ang ngan pa'i cha rnams bcos nas bzang ba'i lam du skyob rgyu ni dmigs yul dngos yin gshis/ gzab brling dang rig pa dwangs gsal gyis skyon brjod bya rgyu las rlung langs thog la thal drags pa'i gtam dang bya spyod spel na rang gzhan gnyis ka phung ba'i rgyur 'gyur rgyu nyag cig yin pa rtogs dgos/6༄byang goms chags thabs/ slob grwa'i dge rgan dang pha mas phru gur dmigs yul nges can yod pa'i sgo nas kun spyod slob gso gtong ba dang chabs cig bya spyod ngo ma'i thog nas lag len bya rgyur mthong chen byas te goms gshis chags pa bya rgyu de'ang pha mas phru gur khyim las bya rgyu dang / dka' spyad bab chags kyi 'tsho ba bskyal thabs/ bza' lugs 'gro lugs/ sdod lugs/mi gzhan dang 'brel gtugs bya tshul sogs lag len bya rgyu'i go skabs mang tsam sprad de lag len bya rgyu'i go skabs mang tsam sprad de lag len dngos nang 278

slob mar kun spyod slob gso gtong ba gcig mthun yong thabs la dpyad pa/rang blor byang zhing nam zhag rgyun gtan gyi 'tsho ba'i khrod ya rabs spyod pa'i la rgya las mi 'da' ba'i goms gshis bzang po chags thabs bya dgos/7rigasang brda phra mo ston thabs/ thabs shes 'di ni dge rgan dang pha mas mngon chung gi thabs shes la brten nas phru gur shugs rkyen gtong thabs shig yin/ de'ang stabs bde'i gtam dang / lag brda/ rnam 'gyur tsam la brten nas bya ba gang zhig bya dgos pa'am gang zhig bya mi chog pa/ 'dod mthun med pa'am/ yang na mos mthun yod pa bcas mtshon thabs la zer/dper na nang du sku mgron zhig phebs tsa na gsol ja btegs zer 'dod na khyim bdag gi lag brda'am zur gyi phra mo'i rnam 'gyur gyi thog nas gsang brda byed pa dang / de bzhin slob sbyong gi sbyangs 'bras legs pa'am/ mi bzang las bzang gi bya ba spel tshe mthe bong bsgrengs nas bsngags brjod byed pa lta bu/8༄khams dang mos par bstun thabs/ de ni phru gur slob gso gtong rgyu'i nang don dang / bya lugs bya stangs de phru gu'i khams dang mos pa dang 'tshams pa byung na slob gso'i dmigs yul mngon du 'gyur thub ste/ phru gu'i blor 'bab zhing dad zhen dang 'tshams pa zhig dgos/ dper na/ rtsam pa za 'dod can la rtsam pa dang / mog mog za 'dod can la mog mog sbyin na de'i dad zhen dang 'tshams par 'byung ba ltar nges par du de'i zhen yul la dpyad de blo sna 'khrid dgos pa las lkugs pa u tshugs byas na mngon brtsi lkog 'gal byed pa'am/ yang na slob gso de chu dkrog nas mar mi thon pa'i dpe bzhin chags rgyu yin pas nges par du kun spyod gso yul gyi khams dang mos pa la dpyad de yul dang yul can gyi 'dun pa dang dmigs pa gcig mthun 'ong 279

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/bar 'bad dgos/lnga pa/ ji ltar byas nas phyogs gsum gcig mthun yong bar bya ba/dngos po'i gnas lugs kyi thog nas brjod na zung sbrel bya bar dka' ba'i gnas su lhung / 'on kyang spyi tshogs dang / khyim tshang / slob grwa bcas phyogs gsum gyi kun spyod slob gso gcig mthun yong ba bya rgyu ni gnad cher mthong nas kho bos 'dir ya rabs dam pa'i spyod pa la 'jug thabs kyi thog ma'i bsam 'char 'ga' srong po'i lam nas drangs pa 'di lta ste/gcig bsam pa'i kun slong gcig mthun yong dgos pa/'jig rten thog gi bya ba tshang ma rtsa ba kun slong bzang ngan la thug pas gal te phyogs gsum so so'i bsam pa'i kun slong tha dad pa yod tshe kun spyod slob gso'i thad la'ang spyod lam tha dad pa zhig yong srid de/ khyim bdag gis phru gu slob grwar rtsis sprad tshar bas phru gur slob gso rgyag rgyu ni dge rgan gyi las ka yin pas/ nga tshor las 'gan mi 'dug snyam pa'i blo dang / de bzhin phru gus rgyugs 'bras skar ma mtho tsam len thub na spyod pa zhan tsam byung rung gcig byas 'gro snyam pa'i blo/ phru gu 'tshar nas dngul mang tsam gsog srung bya thub na sbyang 'bras yag nyes dang spyod pa legs nyes ga re byas kyang byas bsam pa'i blo dang / spyi tshogs thog mi 'gas dwangs gtsang min pa'i chags sred kyi dpe deb dpar 'grems dang / ‘‘khang gsum thing gcig ’280

slob mar kun spyod slob gso gtong ba gcig mthun yong thabs la dpyad pa/btsugs pa/ chags sred brnyan phab spyin shog bkram pa/ dus yol bza' bya dang / chang rag tha ma kha btsongs pa la sogs rang nyid kyi mnog chung khe bzang kho na don du gnyer ba'i bsam pa'i kun slong / slob grwa 'ga' dang dge rgan nyung gras kyis byang tshad slob gsor mthong chen mi bya bar skar ma mthon po kho na brtson len gyi blos dngul gyi chad pa dang / lto'i chad pa/lus po'i chad pa gcod pa bcas kyis lo chung byis pa'i sems rgyud la dug rtswa'i sbrid sman bkram pa dang / log lam du 'dren pa'i sna thag lta bu byed kyi yod pa de dag gis spyod yon gnyis ldan gyi phru gu skyon bral ngang 'tshar longs yong bar gegs bar yong gi yod/ des na phyogs gsum kas dus rabs nyer gcig par mkho ba'i kun spyod dang / shes rig gzugs po bcas phyogs yongs nas 'tshar bskyed 'ong ba'i mi sna skyong ba'i bsam blo'i kun slong bzang po dang / nga tsho'i mi rabs dang mi rabs kyi shul 'dzin par nan tan gyis 'gan 'khur ba'i bsam pas phyogs gsum kas mi mthun phyogs kyi blo ngan yongs su spangs nas dwangs gtsang gi kun slong gis khams gtsang gi khor yug cig bskrun nas/ skyon bral gyi pha tsha bu rgyud skyong ba'i dar chen zhig bsgrongs dgos pa 'dug go /gnyis/ smyor ba'i spyod pa gcig mthun dgos/bsam pa'i kun slong bzang yang bya ba dngos la ma zhugs na stong pa nam mkha'i mtshan nyid dang mtshungs gshis nges par du gsham gyi phyogs 'gar shugs snon bya dgos/281

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/1༄spyi tshogs thog khor yug gtsang ma zhig bskrun dgos pa gal che ste/gna' dper gser gyi ri la gnas na/ de yi 'dab chags dag kyang gser la 'gyur zhes pa ltar khor yug gis spyod lam gso ba dang / khor yug gis mi skyong bas srid gzhung gis kyang btsan thabs la brten nas lo chung byis pa'i dwangs gtsang gi byis blo dag btsog dri can gyi bdud mo'i sder mos brku ba'i 'thung khang dang / rtsed khang / rol khang dag 'khyams po gnas sa gzhi med rtsa gtor bya dgos pa dang / byis pa la rgan po'i rnam thar 'dzin par byed cing / rig pa skyong ba'i gegs su 'gro ba'i chang 'thung khang dang / tha mag 'then pa/ mdza' bo sgrig pa/ rgyan 'dzugs pa bcas kyi gnas la bya thabs spyad nas chad gcod dang drungs 'byin bya dgos/ de lta ma byas na khyim tshang gi pha ma dang / slob grwa'i dge rgan rnams kyis tha mag ma 'then/ chang ma 'thung zhes nan bshad stong phrag byas rung tshong pas tha mag rkang la phral nas byis par sil tshong byed pa dang / chang mas g.yab mo byas nas slob phrug chang khang du bkug na gcig nas bkag rung gcig nas btang ba'i gnas lugs las ma 'das pas/ spyi tshogs kyi tshong gnyer ba'i spyod lam dang / khor yug gi gtsang sbra/ dril bsgrags/ dpar 'grems/ byang shing gi sbyar yigamadzes rtsal dang / rig gnas/ spyi spyod/ 'grim 'grul sgrig lam/ mi dang mi bar gyi 'brel lam/ spyi tshogs yongs kyi skye bo'i byang tshad/ yod tshad dang yod tshad tshang ma lo chung byis pa'i snang ngor bag chags bzang zhing spyi tshogs yar thon dang / mi rabs rjes ma la sman zhing ya rabs kyi spyod pa dang ldan pa zhig skong rgyu kho nar sems nas khams gtsang gi khor yug cig bskrun 282

slob mar kun spyod slob gso gtong ba gcig mthun yong thabs la dpyad pa/dgos/2rislob grwa dang khyim tshang gi kun spyod slob gso gcig gyur 'ong ba bya dgos/ khyim tshang gi slob gso ni slob grwa'i slob gso dang spyi tshogs kyi slob gso'i rmang gzhi yin la slob grwa'i slob gso'i kha gsab cig kyang red/ slob grwa'i slob gso ni ched mngags mi gso skyong dang / skye bo ma shes rmongs pa rnams bsam spyod legs shing blo rig dang ldan par bde bar gso ba'i gtso khrid kyi slob gso'i go 'phangs zin pa'i sde tshan zhig tu grub/ phyogs gnyis kas so so'i thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad yon dang 'gan nus zin yod mod/'on kyang dmigs pa'i gtad yul gcig mthun yin pas nges par du/ka khyim bdag dang dge rgan rang nyid kyis rang dpe gzhan ston bya bar mkhas dgos/ rang gi bus rang la bkur bsti bya bar 'dod na/ rang gis thog mar rang gi pha mar bskur bsti bya dgos pa dang / slob mas dge rgan rang nyid la gus zhabs bya bar 'dod na/ rang gis rang gi dge rgan la gus zhabs bya dgos/ de lta min na/ spyod ngan cig la gcig gis 'gos nas ya rabs dam pa'i spyod lam nyams 'gro ba dang bka' slob ci gnang rung snyan lam du 'gro dkon pa ste lo 'ga'i sngon du pir thogs pa khyim tshang zhig la don zhig sgrub par 'gro skabs/ pha bu gnyis kha mchu tshod med rgyag pa dang 'khel skabs der 'byung rkyen gnas lugs dris tshe pha rgan des mi mang tshogs sar phru gu der pha ma la brtsi bkur dang ya rabs gus zhabs med lugs brgya bshad stong bshad mang du byas pa dang / de rjes bu des pha la khyod kyis spo lags mig gnyis long bar phyin pa der zhabs zhu ji ltar zhus lugs dang / rmo 283

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/lags bskung rjes sman khang la gtan nas ma khrid pa'i lo rgyus dang bcas mang bar brjod pa ma zad/ bu des ngas khyod la bkur bste med pa'ang khyed kyis spo rmo la bya lugs de las shes pa ma yin nam zhes kha lan tshod med slog pa pha rgan de lan rgyag pa'i spobs pa bral te ci bya gtol med du gyur/ des na thog mar spyod pa gso ba po khyim bdag dang dge rgan rang nyid lus ngag yid gsum spyod gtsang dper 'os shig dgos pa'i rgyu 'bras bden pa yin par grub pa'i gnas lugs shig kyang bdag gis mthong /kha/ ma gros gcig mthun lta bu'i blang bya 'don par mkhas dgos/de ltar bya dgos na khyim bdag dang slob grwa'i bar gser gyi zam pa lta bu'i 'brel lam btsugs te slob ma'i bsam pa'i 'khyer so dang / gshis spyod/sbyang brtson/ blo'i gtad yul/ zhen phyogs la de ma thag nyams rtogs kyis kun spyod kyi slob gso 'ben yod mda' 'phen bya dgos pa dang gciga'adzin grwa'i nang gi spyod tshul phud slob phyi'i spyod tshul dag slob khrid dge rgan dang / 'dzin grwa'i 'gan 'khur dge rgan slob grogs dang bcas par nyams rtogs zhib par byas nas dus thog tu legs spel nyes 'gog dang chu ma shor gong la chu rags lta bu brgyag rgyu dang gnyis/ phyogs gnyis kas ma bskul dang blangs kyis slob ma skyong ba'i bya bar the zhugs bya dgos pa ste/ dper na slob ma'i rgyugs 'bras kyi gnas tshul dus thog tu shes rtogs dang / grogs po ngan pa dang mnyam du 'grogs pa dang / byis pa 'gro sa'i gnas min par 'gro ba/ slob byol bya ba/ slob tshan tshugs skabs kha g.yeng mig g.yeng gis blo rtse gcig tu mi gnas pa sogs thon tshe khyim bdag dang de mur 'brel ba 284

slob mar kun spyod slob gso gtong ba gcig mthun yong thabs la dpyad pa/byas na rta kha g.yang kha nas gcus thub pa dang bslab 'doms nad thog 'khel ba'i sman mchog lta bur 'gyur ba dang gsum/ dge rgan gyis bkod sgrig byas pa'i sbyang gzhi dang slob phyi'i blta klog dang / khyim sbyong gi las 'gan gnyis 'os shing 'tshams pa dang / phan tshun gnyis ka gcig gis gcig la ram 'degs dang kha gsab kyi nus pa yod med la lta ba las slob ma'i 'khur po lci ru btang ba dang tshad las brgal ba'i gnon shugs sprad na mi 'thad/ khyad par du khyim tshang 'gas phru gu'i sbyangs 'bras phul du byung ba 'ong slad/ nyin mo slob grwar dge rgan gyis 'khrid pa dang / mtshan mo dang gza' spen pa dang /nyi ma'i ngal gso'i ring la'ang zur khrid dge rgan bsten nas 'khrid pa bcas la brten nas lo chung byis par rtsed mo dang / ngal gso ba'i go skabs gtan nas med pa bzos na nyin gang ra bzi nas ma dwangs pa'i mi zhig la chang sgron pa ltar dang ba mi 'dren par slob sbyong la sun snang gi blo zhig bskyed srid pas klad pa'i ngal gso bya ba'i bar gseng zhig yong phyir khyim bdag gis phyogs de la'ang gzab dgos pa dang bzhi/ de bzhin phyogs gnyis kas/1rispyi tshogs rig lugs kyi mes rgyal la dga' zhen/2rirang las mi gzhan gces par 'dzin pa/3ringal rtsol la dga' zhen/4ya rabs gus zhabs kyi goms gshis 'jags rgyu/5༄gshis bzang dang blo rtsa brtan po 'ong ba bcas kun spyod slob gso'i nang don gtso che ba yin par ngos 'dzin gcig mthun yong ba bya dgos pa dang lnga/ phyogs gnyis kas 'brel gtugs kyis phan tshun rgyus mnga' yod pa bya 285

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/dgos pa de'ang phru gu'i khams dang mos pa/ gshis ka 'jam rtsub/ lhag pa du bstod smad gang 'thad yul la dpyod dgos pa ste dper na/ phru gu spo lo rgyag par dga' ba'am/ rol cha gtong bar dga' ba/ ri mo 'bri bar dga' ba sogs rtogs par byas nas slob sbyong dang rang gshis kyi spro snang gcig mthun gyis bsring dgos pa dang drug gzhan yang slob grwar dge rgan gyis byis par zas rigs tsag cig za ru mi 'jug pa dang / a mas phru gu ltogs 'ong bsams nas zas rigs tsag cig khug mar brgyangs pa dang /dge rgan gyis nga tshos slob sbyong bya ba'i dmigs yul ni gsar brje'i shul 'dzin gyi ched du yin lugs rgyas par bshad pa dang / sger gnyer tshong pa dang khyim bdag 'gas kha gdangs tshad dngul kho na'i ched du yin lugs brjod pa/ dge rgan gyis shes bya yon tan gyi rin thang dang / thos pa'i rin thang gzhal dka' ba yin lugs rgyas par bshad pa dang / khyim bdag 'gas shes yon can la brtsi bkur dang gus zhabs mi byed par 'byor pa can la gus zhabs dang 'gram mchu ldang ba/ dge rgan gyis dus tshod skar char brtson len dang / brtson 'grus kyis rig pa sbyang dgos par bskul rung /khyim bdag 'gas ring nyid sho sbag dang / chang 'thung glu gar la rol nas phru gu'i bza' 'thung la'ang do snang mi bya ba'i khar byis pa chung chung yang sbag khri'i steng du bskyal nas dngul tshod med sbyin nas rgyan gyi gral du btsud pa/ slob grwas phan tshun rogs ram dang / 'cham mthun bya ba dang / kha mchu dang rgyag res mi brgyag pa/ gtsang sbrar do snang bya dgos pa'i slob gso btang ba dang khyim bdag 'gas do snang ma byas par pha ma gnyis kyis phru gu'i mdun du 286

slob mar kun spyod slob gso gtong ba gcig mthun yong thabs la dpyad pa/rgyag res dang kha rtsod rgyag pa dang / kha lud sna lud gad snyigs gang sar bsho ba/ ra bzi skyur 'gong shod pa/ slob grwas ngal rtsol la dga' zhen byed dgos pa'i kun spyod slob gso btang ba dang / khyim bdag 'gas phru gur gces drags nas phru gu'i tshab byas nas slob khang nang gad 'phyid bya bar yong ba bcas ni kun spyod slob gso gcig gyur 'ong ba'i mi mthun phyogs yin pas de dag spangs nas khyim tshang gi kun spyod slob gso dang / slob grwa'i slob gso gang thub ci thub kyis gcig mthun yong bar bya dgos pa dang bdun no/ /gsum/ phyogs gsum mthun smyor gyi lam bu bshang dgos/mi rnams kyi mi tshe hril po'i nang khyim tshang dang / slob grwa/ spyi tshogs bcas phyogs gsum gyi slob gso'i shugs rkyen thebs kyi yod pa dang / de gsum ni dper na phyogs bsdus rang bzhin gyi las snon bzo grwa zhig dang 'dra bar phyogs mi 'dra ba'i thog nas mi rnams kyi lus sems 'tshar longs yong bar shugs rkyen gtong ba dang phyogs gsum gyi slob gso de'ang dper na las snon gyi las rim gang rung zhig ma tshang na dngos po spus dag cig mi thon pa dang 'dra bar slob gso'i lhu tshigs gcig la skyon shor ba dang khyad par mchis/khyad par du slob grwa ni skyes bu ya rabs gso skyong bya sa'i gnas mchog dang /khyim tshang ni phru gu gces par skyong sa'i gnas gzhi yin pas phyogs gsum bsdur na 'di gnyis cung khams gtsang bas gnas tshul ni de bas rnyog dra che ba dang / shugs rkyen ni phyogs mang po nas yong gi yod pa red/1༄phyogs gsum kas ya rabs kyi spyod pa gso rgyu de bla shing lta bur 'dzin 287

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/dgos/ de'ang bod pa'i ngag rgyun du shes pa lha dang mnyam rung / spyod pa mi dang mthun dgos zhes pa dang / deng gi char yang spyod lam yag po med pa'i mi zhig yin phyin nyen kha che ba'i 'bar rdzas lta bur ngos 'dzin gyi yod pas nges par du kun spyod ang dang po yin pa'i lta ba gsal 'don gyis tshang mas gzhung thig de las ma g.yo bar snying po de yi phyogs su 'bad dgos/2༄khyim tshang dang / slob grwa/ spyi tshogs steng du/ bya ba legs nyes/bden rdzun/ drang bden/ g.yo sgyu/ khram pa/ dga' ba dang skyo shas/khong khro/ bde ba/ sdug bsngal bcas snang tshul sna tshogs dang 'phrad srid pas nges par du yin min rnam pa 'byed pa'i shes rab la brten nas 'jug ldog bya rgyur gcigs chen bya dgos/3chophyogs gsum kas kun spyod gso skabs rgyab nas ri 'gul ba ma shes par mdun nas spu 'gul ba mthong ba lta bu'i mig rgyang thung ngu'i blo dang / mi rabs du ma'i phugs bsam la blo mi gtod par rang gi khe phan kho na'i don thabs brgya jus stong gis phru gu'i phugs re me la bsreg par byed pa'i las gnyer dang / snang tshul/ bya spyod de rigs phyi nang gang du'ang rtsa 'gog bya dgos/4khyim tshang dang / slob grwa/ spyi tshogs bcas kyi kun spyod slob gso ni pha ma gcig las btsas pa'i bu spun gsum dang 'dra bar phan tshun phyar ba gru 'degs dang / dpung pa mnyam gshis kyis gzhogs 'degs dang kha gsab kyis dper na/ nyi ma dang zla ba/ skar ma/ glog gzhu/ sgron me sogs snang ba'i ris su gtogs pa dag gis mun pa bsal nas 'jig rten la 'od snang 'byin pa'i byed las byed pa bzhin tshang mas kun spyod ya rabs dam 288

slob mar kun spyod slob gso gtong ba gcig mthun yong thabs la dpyad pa/pa'i lam la 'jug par brtson dgos/5༄mi mthun pa'i phyogs spangs nas mthun pa'i phyogs sgrub dgos pa ste spyi tshogs thog lo chung byis pa'i sems khams la gnod pa'i chags sred kyi do ra dang / dpe deb/ 'khyams po/ dngul kho na don du gnyer ba/ mi gtsang ba'i kho ra khor yug dang / khyim tshang nang gi dza drag gi khor yug dang / yab mes kyi ya rabs dam pa'i spyod pa bzang po la brtsi mthong mi byed pa dang / ya rabs dam pa'i spyod pas rang gi sgo gsum gcun pa'i blo med pa dag ring du spangs nas/ khyim tshang dang slob grwa spyi tshogs bcas kyi kun spyod slob gso de gang thub ci thub kyis mi ya rabs phyag dang zhe sa mkhas pa dang / shes bya yon tan ldan pa/ gzugs gzhi khams bzang dang ldan pa'i phyogs su mthun sbyor bya dgos/6༄srid gzhung gis kyang bya spyod legs par spel te byis pas kun spyod gso bar nus pa 'don spel bya dgos pa ste/ spyi tshogs steng gi nying 'jags min la bslu brid mkhan gyi gte po gnyis te/ khyim tshang dang slob grwas kyang gcun ma thub pa'i ya med 'khyams po dag gis lo chung byis pa bslus nas 'khyams po'i gral du btsud par byed mkhan dag la bya thabs spyad de/ las zhugs kyi lam bu bshang pa'am yang na khrims ltar gcun thabs bya dgos/gnyis nas ar khang dang phrel ba'i smad 'tshong ma'i sle yon gyis byis pa'i blo la rgan po'i rnam thar bskyangs nas dngul med na brku thabs dang / rku ma thub na 'phrog bcom/ 'phrog bcom ma thub na gsod rtsis bcas kyis mi chos kyi mtha' 'bras ngan pa bzo kyi yod pa dug rgyun yin na mig mdun gyi khe bzang la ma bltos par drung nas 'byin dgos par sems/289

byang tshad/byang tshad zhes pa ni mi rigs de rang ngam skye bo de rang la gnyug ma nyid nas yod pa'i bsam pa'i 'khyer so dang / 'tsho thabs/ yul goms gshis lugs/ rig gnas sgyu rtsal sogs kyis ches rtsa bar byas pa'i rmang gzhi'i thog dus rabs rim byung gi phyi rkyen dang / nang rkyen sogs rten 'brel sna tshogs las grub pa'i blo'i byang goms kyi tshad la zer/ de la'ang chos gzhan dang mthun par mtho dman dang legs nyes kyi rnam dbye 'byed chog pa ste/ 'dir 'das par phyir blta dang da ltar dpyad nas ma 'ongs par 'doms pa'i tshul gyi bod rigs kyi byang tshad mtho ru gtong bar mi mkho 'gal rkyen 'ga' bzlog phyir gtam tsho 'di gleng bar spro ba brtas/dang po/ sngon byon bod mi'i byang tshad la yud tsam blta ba'i skor/'dir de lta'i blo dman rnams la 'dun pa drag bskyed dang / skul ma thebs slad gna' rabs bod mi rigs kyi mes po'i byang tshad la gzigs mo yud tsam gzigs na gnas dus da lta'i dus ltar mkha' la dngul mdog can gyi mkha' gru/ 4 sa la ldir ldir sgra sgrog mo ṭa la sogs sna brgya'i 'phrul 'khor 'dod rgu 'jo ba/ glog rdul la sogs 'phrul chas med kyang / ltos dang /290

byang tshad/blo yi byang tshad mtho ba'i bod kyi mes po rnams kyis gru 'dzin ri la brjid nyams che ba'i pho brang dang / se 'bras dge gsum sogs byin can chos sde kha ba ri yi gser tog bskrun/ de dag phyi gling pa yis mthong ma thag yid dbang 'phrog cing 'gram chu ldang / 'di dag mes po rnams kyi blo gros kyi rtsal las thon/ gzhan yang deng 'dir nyin mtshan dbyer med glog zhun dang /dkar 'jam thig ris bkra ba'i shog bu dang tshon mdangs rnam par bkra ba'i rdzas 'gyur snag tsha/ dkar cha dod pa'i slob khang / slob yon zho gang sprod dgos med pa'i slob grwa/ de dang de sogs phun tshogs dge legs kun gyi cha rkyen 'di lta rang rigs mes po'i dus su ma mchis kyang ltos/ mdzangs mi bdun gyi mdzangs las su/ zhing la chu 'dren thong gshol bzos/ chu la zam pa gtsugs nas 'grim 'grul dar/ zhing la dor kha brtsis/ phu chu mda' ru drangs te mda' zhing chu ma bzos/ 'bru mar 'jal byed bre srang bcos/las sdeb tshong zog brje res dang / yon tan kun gyi gzhi ma bod yig gsar gtod kyis/ bod yul mun pa'i gling la legs bshad sgron me spar/ rtswa sngon skam nas rta glang gso ba dang / bkas gcigs khrims yig bzos/ sku mkhar klung la btab pa sogs bsub bral phyag rjes dang / g.yu thog yon tan mgon pos rgya dkar nag yul gyi gso rig sman dpyad snying bcud blangs te bod lugs gso rig dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ lo tsā ba thon mis gtsos pe ro tsa na/ ska cog zhang gsum/ rin chen bzang po/ chos rje sa paṇa/a shang rnam gnyis sogs lo paṇa skar tshogs lta bus mi rigs gzhan gyi rigs gzhung gis rang rigs kyi rigs gzhung gtsug lag dar zhing rgyas pa byas/291

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/mkhas btsun bzang gsum de dag gi gzhal med drin las phyi rabs rnams la rgyal ba'i bka' dang bstan 'gyur dang / rig pa'i gnas sde snod gsum du 'dus pa'i bstan bcos 'byams klas longs su spyod rgyu'i 'phags nor 'di dag bzhag ar las dbu chen du grags pa grub thob thang stong rgyal pos chu la lcags zam bskun/ 'grim 'grul stabs bde'i 'phrin las sgrub/ a lce lha mo'i srol btod/ gangs ljongs lha mo'i zlos gar dar zhing rgyas par byas/de lta de lta'i cha rkyen dang dus rabs 'og rlabs chen gyi mdzad rjes de lta bu 'jog thub pa'i rgyu mtshan yang snying gang la thug ce na/ byang tshad ces pa'i yig 'bru rtsa tshig gnyis la thug par snyam/ des na bod mi rigs kyi kha sang dang / de ring / sang nyin la gcigs chen bya mkhan gyi mi zhig yin phyin brtag par bya rgyu ni bskyur med 'gan 'khri zhig yin pa'o//gnyis pa/ da lta bod mi'i byang tshad mtho ru gtang rgyur mi dman pa'i dug gsum bstan pa'i skor/da lta mngon sum gyur pa'i mthong chos la dpyad de bod mi'i byang tshad mtho ru gtang dgos zhes brjod rgyu yin/ de ltar brjod pa'i dgos pa ni krung hwa mi rigs hril po'i khyim tshang chen po'i nang du bod rigs kyis med du mi rung ba'i go 'phangs zin yod pa dang gcig deng gi char mkhas pa zhes pa mtho rengs skar chen ltar dang / gsung rtsom 'dra dpe 'dra bshus dang /292

byang tshad/thar thor bsdus rtsom/ lag shes bzo las 'phel med sor gnas/ don gnyer blo sbyong chog shes kho nas mi tshe 'phyid re'i blo las/ 'byung 'gyur la rgyang lta dang / rig stobs 'gran nas 'dzam gling gi gar stegs thog go 'phangs 'dzin pa'i blo skyed drag po med pa'i lta ba rtag 'dzin bsal phyir/'dir gleng rgyu shi yang bya 'ga' yin pas rab tu nyon cigagong gis bslad ce na dug gsum 'di'o/sngar kha rgyun la gtsang pa'i o lo la i dang i pags byung na las ka la skyug ma bro zer ba dang / deng sang bod rigs pho gzhon mo gzhon la sbi rag dang mā cang byung na rgyan btsugs pa la skyug ma bro zhes bshad na thal mi drags par snyam/ rgyu mtshan de'i phyir chang ni nyes pa kun gyi rtsa ba dang / bod mi rigs kyi byang tshad zhan du gtong ba'i dug chu rang yin/ ci'i phyir zhe na/spyir dbus gtsang khul du chang rag mtshams tshod med par 'thung mkhan mang bas/ chang de kha la reg tshe rang don dang gzhung don gang yang yid la mi dran par mi yul gyi bde skyid che shos la longs spyod bya rgyu byung bas/ 'di las bde skyid pa lha yul na'ang e yod/ 'di btung nas shi na'ang 'gyod pa med sems bzhin du/ ngag nas nga tsho 'di ru 'dzoms 'dzoms/ gtan du 'dzoms rgyu byung na/ zhes‘glu gar gyi rgya mtsho dang / chang gi rgya mtshor ’’rol bzhin mtshan gang bskyal/ de lta de lta'i mthar 'bras su/ rtsom pa po sgrog tse'i steng du gnyid la yur/ dge rgan gyi slob khrid la bzi dwangs la ma dwangs/ slob phrug yang bzi nas mgo bo yom yom/ kha lo ba yi 'khor lam 293

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/rab bi rib bi/ dbu khrid kyi dbu de bzi 'khyom 'khyom/ bza' tshang mig log gcigs gcigs/ na chung spyan mda' 'khyug 'khyug sang gi bya ba gnangs su skyel/ lhag par lo chung byis pas btung tshe dgos pa'i yon tan dang / ya rabs spyod pa mi shes/ mi dgos ma rabs tha shal gyi phyag rgya bya bar mkhas/ de dag las rig pa sbang ma'i nang du shi ba mang / phugs bsam chang rtsir 'byar ba mang / mi rigs kyi la rgya phab rtsi smyon pas brkus pa mang phyir/ rnam thar 'di ltar byung ba ste/ dam chos ma dran ma dran zer te lo gsum song / dam chos ma byung ma byung zer te lo gsum song / dam chos byed kyi byed kyi zer te lo gsum song / de ltar mi tshe rdzogs pa'i rnam thar yin ’’zhes pa lta bu 'ongs rgyu ni chang 'dis lan pas de lugs sems shig a ma'i pho gzhon mo gzhon tsho/ rgya'i gtam du/ chang thag gnyis bral med khyim tshang gcig yin ’’zhes pa ltar/ tha mag 'di'ang mi rigs kyi byang tshad zhan du gtong ba'i dug chen zhig yin te/ gung thang dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mas tha ma kha'i nyes dmigs gsung skabs su/pu ti lnga la mkhas pa'ang 'di yis bslad/ /pho rabs snying stobs can yang 'di yis bslad/ /mo btsun gtsang sbra can yang 'di yis bslad/ /zho sogs zhim dgu bsten kyang bro ba bslad/ /zo mdog mi bde gdon dang nad rims slong / /'o 'dod bas kyang lha srung 'khor mi nus/yo dong g.yang sa lta bu 'di spongs shig /ces gsungs pa 'dis tha mag 294

byang tshad/gi nyes pa phyogs 'ga' zhig bstan/ deng gi char bod rigs pho gsar 'ga' dang / lhag par slob chung dang slob 'bring slob ma'i nang tha mag 'then rgyur brtse zhen lhag par chen po yod pa dang / dge rgan gyis rtsa 'gog byas rung /gsang spyod sogs khag tu 'then mkhan mang / kho tshos tha mag 'then rgyu de thog mar rtsed mo dang / ster bzo dod pa'i tshul gyi mno bsam yang ma thongs bar dug mi btung / do gal ci yang med bzhin 'di la spyad/ rim bzhin sred zhen je cher phyin nas mthar gcod par 'dod rung gcod thabs bral ba'i rang gi gtan grogs su gyur nas mtshams tshod med par 'then pa'i mthar 'bras su/ tha rin med par rku jag las la 'jug sho dang khram la 'debs par byed/ so dang sems rgyud nag par byed gshis stobs shor nas rig pa nyams par byed/ lto gos dkon pa'i gnas su lhung bar byed/ glo mchin nad kyi rtsa bar gyur/ des na mi dag spong bar bya'o a ma'i bu/mā cang zhes pa'i rtsed mo 'di'ang bod mi'i byang tshad nyams dmas su gtong ba'i dug chen zhig dang / nyes brgya'i rtsa ba gsar pa zhig tu bdag gis mthong / 'di'i nyes dmigs dngos mtshon tshul ni/ de la dbyings shig zhugs tshe gdon zhugs pa bzhin mtshams tshod dang / ngo tsha/ snying rje sogs gzhan nas med par ma rabs spyod pa'i 'bag chen mthug po gyon te/gnyid ni mi sems mtshan gang gtong bar ngal dub med/ ltos dang / 'di la dbyings shig zhugs tshe gzhung don mi sems gzhung shag khang de rgyan po'i 'thab sar bsgyur/ thugs spro'i bzhugs gral skyid pa de gzhan pham nga rgyal bya ba'i dmag sar bsgyur/ dkar po'i grogs dang nye ba'i gnyen tshan de dag 295

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/nag po dgra ltar mthong / dmag 'thab na mi shi 'ongs nges bzhin rgyan po 'gyed mthar rgyal pham byung nges pas na/ phyug po'i bu yang sprang po'i rtsig khung du sgyugs pa mang / tshe gang gtan grogs mal nas bral ba mang lo chung byis pa brtson dong bcug pa mang / dug sman btung nas rang shi brgyab pa mang / slob ma'i rang sbyong mi tshar 'di yis lan/ dka' spyad sdug rus rig pa sbyang bar mi brtson/ ‘‘zhogs gang sangs rgyas go 'phang thob par 'dod/’’ sngon thon shes rig lag rtsal mi sbyong zhing / 'phral gyi bde ba 'di la brkam nas chags/ mi rig kyi la rgya/ yar thon/ shes rig mi sems spu gri'i ral grir chags/ de lta de lta'i spyan dkyus dang / blo gros/ byang tshad kyis shes bya'i rba klong 'phyur bzhin pa'i rdzogs ldan bskal bzang gi rjes su bsnyegs nas bod mi rigs kyi rigs gzhung rgyun 'dzin dar spel dang /dpal 'byor mnga' thang gra rgyas phun tshogs kyi gnas su 'phel rgyas gtong dka' bas na/ 'di lta 'di lta'i sems rgyu dang / spyod pa yod rigs kyis de mur rmongs gnyid las sad cig rta kha g.yang gzar las gcus shiga'aphral phugs bde sdug soms shig rig pa rems nas dug gsum spongs shig a ma'i pho gzhon mo gzhon tsho/296

dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyi blo sbyong skor mdo tsam gleng ba/rmad byung thugs dgongs skya rengs kyis/ /sgo ṭa'i yul sngongs lha lam du//bod yig nam mkha'i nor bu'i dpal/ /'dren mkhas thon mi'i zhabs la 'dud//lnga rig pad mo'i dga' tshal 'jir/ /skal ldan slob gnyer bung ba'i tshogs//legs bshad sbrang rtsi'i snying bcud kyis/ /skyong mdzad spob dpon byu bor bkur//'dir dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi blo sbyong skor rags tsam gleng bar 'dod de mkhas 'jug las gtsang mkhas gzhan la phan par 'dod/ ces pa ni slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid du gsungs/ gtsang zhes pa ni tshul khrims dag pas lu4 ngag gtsang ba zhig dgos te/ mi gtsang ba'am mi btsun na slob ma'i spyod pa chud 'dza' bar gyur to/ /mkhas zhes pa ni shes rab dag pas lung rigs la mkhas pa zhig dgos te mi mkhas na the tshom gyi dra ba gcod mi nus/ de'ang sa paṇa gyis/ mkhas gang shes bya'i de kho na/ /ji bzhin rtogs pa yin par 'dod/ /bye brag sbyangs pa'i don zhes pa/ /de yang de la mkhas zhes bya/ /zhes pa ltar sne gcig mkhas la sne mang 'jon pa zhig dgos/ gzhan la phan par 'dod ces pa ni lhag bsam rnam par dag pas gzhan la phan pa'o/ /gzhan phan gyi bsam pa med na ris med gdul bya kun la sman pa'i rig gzhung bdud rtsi'i char chen 'beb mi nus so/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi mtshan nyid re zhig de tsam du 'du bar bzhed do//297

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/da ni slob dpon la nges par du tshang dgos pa'i yon tan nam rtsa ba'i nus rtsal gyi skor cung zad gleng bar bya/dang po/ mang thos shes rab che ba/shes bya kun khyab las/ mang du thos pas ston ba rgya che dang / shes rab che bas gzhan gyi the tshom gartsad/ ces gsungs te/ slob dpon zhig la mtshon na thog mar thos pa'i sgron me spar dgos shing / ma spar na blang dor gyi tshul ji bzhin shes dka' bas nges par du thos pa rgya cher btsal nas blo mig sbyangs par bya dgos/ sngon byon mkhas dbang rnams kyis thos pa la ches mtho'i bsngags brjod gnang ba yin te/ thos pa gti mug mun sel sgron me yin/ /skun po la sogs mi 'khyer nor gyi mchog /kun du smongs pa'i dgra 'jom mtshon cha yin/ /thabs tshul man ngag ston pa'i grogs kyi mchog /phongs par gyur kyang mi 'gyur mdza' bo yin/ /gnod pa med pa mya ngan nad kyi sman/ /ya rabs rnams dang phrad na skyes kyi mchog /tshogs kyi nang na mkhas pa mgu bar byed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar slob grwa che 'bring chung gsum ci rigs kyi dge rgan yin phyin mang po las thos pa dang / mang po dang thos pa dang /mang por thos pa ci rung / gang ltar shes bya'i sgo 'byed rnam dag thos pa gsog dgos pa shin tu gal che ba yin/ thos pas shes rab 'phel bar byas te legs nyes mkhas blun 'byed pa'i blo gros rgyasasgrunus/ rgya'i ngag rgyun du slob gnyer par shes tshad bum pa gang ldan na/ dge rgan rang nyid la chu zom gang dgos zer/ 'di'i go don ṣ+ka dge rgan gyi shes tshad de slob phrug las 298

dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyi blo sbyong skor mdo tsam gleng ba/ldab bcu yan gyis mtho ba dgos pa'i gnad de bstan pa yin/ dge rgan zhig la mtshon na rang gi 'khrid bya'i rig gzhung de byang chub pa zhig dgos rgyu smos med thog slob gso rig pa dang / sems khams rig pas mtshon slob khrid dge rgan la ldan dgos nges kyi shes bya mtha' dag la thos pa byas te shes bya'i gnas rgya che tsam khong du chud pa dgos/ gal te rang nyid slob ma las yon tshad dma' na de la dge rgan gyi tha snyad sbyor mi rung bzhin du u tshugs kyis brdzus na rang gzhan gnyis phung gi rkyen kho nar 'gyur/ yang dge rgan gyi yon tshad slob ma dang mnyam na de la yang dge rgan gyi mtshan nyid ma tshang ba yin/ des na slob gnyer pa las shes tshad ches mtho ba rig pa'i gnas bcu phrag gis mang du thos pa'i blo gros kyis phyug pa/ gzhan phan gyi las la spro ba rgyas pa bcas kyi mthun rkyen 'dzoms pa la da gzod dge rgan gyi mtshan snyan thob pa yin/ de lta bu'i dge rgan yon tan ze'u 'bru'i bcud kyis phyug pa zhig byung na/ des dge phrug bung ba'i tshogs rnams legs par skyong bar gdon mi za'o/ /shākya'i dge slong kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis/ thos pa med pa'i sgom pa de/ /lag rdum brag la 'ardzegs pa 'dra/ /then tu rgas par gyur na yang / /thos pa mang du btsal bar bya/ /zhes mkhas pa rnams kyis thos pa 'tshol ba'i dgos gal nan cher gsungs pa de la skal mnyam rnams kyis cung zad dgos par mdzod/299

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/gnyis pa/ brtson 'grus dang ldan pa/yon tan 'byung ba'i rgyu gtso bo zhig ni brtson 'grus yin/ lhag don dge rgan rnams kyis zhum pa med pa dang / mi ldog pa/ chog par mi 'dzin pa bcas kyi brtson 'grus la brten nas slob khrid kyi spus tshad dang myur tshad legs par sgrub ched bslab gzhir brtson zhib kyis dpyad gzhi'i yig rigs gang mang klog pa dang / dogs gzhi mi chod sar 'brel yod kyi dpe deb khag dang nye 'khor kyi dge rgan tshor bka' 'dri zhus te slob tshan gyi nang don 'grel bshad gnad du 'khel ba dang kha gsal go bde ba/ ming tshig re re'i cha la yang 'grel bshad yang dag pa zhig mdzad rgyu ni bshes gnyen rnams kyi 'os 'gan nyag cig lags/ spyir dge rgan yongs dang / sgos su dgung lo gzhon pa'i dge rgan tshos brtson sems lhod pa med par rang gi yon tshad rgyun chad med par mthor 'degs gnang rgyu ni gal che/ mdor na rang gzhan kun la sman pa'i legs tshogs mtha' dag brtson 'grus kyi rjes su 'gro ba yin/slob gnyer bslab bya las/ kun byang 'jug ldog tshul la ma mongs shing / /tshogs kyi dbus su smra mkhas dpal 'dod na/ /da lta bza' btung gnyid kyi bde ba la/ /chags pa'i skyid chos 'di yis mi 'grub pas/ /dka' smyong sdug rus bzod par gyis shig ang / /zhes pa ltar/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la chags pa dang / rgod pa'i sems phyogs bcur g.yengs pa dang / gnyid rmugs la sogs pa'i dbang du song ba las ldog par byas te bod kyi rig gzhung 300

dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyi blo sbyong skor mdo tsam gleng ba/gtsug lag rgyun 'dzin pa gso skyong gi ched du dge rgan gyi mtshan thob mkhan tshang mas lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i dar chen bsgrengs nas/ brtson 'grus kyi gru bo cher brten te/ rig gzhung na kra'i grong khyer du yon tan yid bzhin gyi nor bu len par 'gro 'dod pa'i blo gsar rnams kyi re ba bskong thub pa byed na'ang brtson 'grus grogs la bsten dgos/ de bzhin rang gi blo gros 'phel ba la'ang brtson 'grus grogs su bsten dgos/ gang zhig brtson 'grus dang ma bsdebs na 'chad pa dang / rtsod pa/ rtsom pa'i bya bar 'jug brtsam na khrel ba'i rgyur 'gro nges te/ dper na/ bslab gzhir snying rus kyis brtson zhib dang grabs gshom spus dag ma byas shing / slob khrid kyi go rim la ma ltos par gang bsam gang dran smos pa/ blo dogs ma chod pa'i tshig don la 'ol tshod kyis 'grel ba/ slob khrid skabs stabs gang bde dang las gang sla byed pa sogs slob ma la brtse sems lhod pa'am rang gi yon tan gyis mi ldeng ba'i gnas tshul de rigs rgyun du mthong thos kyi yul du gyur pa de ni rang gzhan gnyis ka bslu ba la the tshom med do//gsum pa/ 'chad mkhas pa/'chad ces pa ni/ mkhas pa'i bgyi ba gsum gyi ya gyal zhig yin/lhag par du dge ba'i bshes gnyen zhig la mtshon na 'chad rtsal dang /'chad thabs kyis slob khrid byed pa'i bya rim nang ches 'gangs che'i gnas bzung yod/ de yang 'chad pa po slob dpon gyis 'chad yul slob ma la dmigs nas 'chad bya slob tshan gyi nang don gang la de 'tshams kyi rgyas bsdus 301

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/ran po'i sgo nas 'chad mkhas par byed dgos/'o na gang 'dra zhig la 'chad mkhas pa zhe na/ snod rab 'bring tha gsum gyi shes tshad la dmigs nas 'chad dgos pa shes bya kun khyab las/ blo chen zab rgyas blo chung gzung bde zhing / go sla phyis nas phra zhib 'gal 'brel gcod/ces slob ma dbang po rno zhing thos rgya dang shes rgya cung che ba rnams la tshig brling zhig 'grel legs la don zab cing rgya che tsam bcas kyi sgo nas slob khrid byed rgyur shugs snon brgyab ste re ba nan po bton nas kho tsho phul byung gi slob ma zhig tu gso skyong thub pa'i byed thabs spel dgos/ dbang po bltung zhing blo rgya chung ba tshor thog mar tshig gzung sla la go bde ba/ don zab pa min par rtogs sla ba'i khrid thabs spyad thog rim pa bzhin dka' gnad 'grol thabs la 'bad dgos/ dper na/ sngar dge bshes sha ra ba dang po to ba gnyis kyi yon tshad mnyam rung po to bas chos gsung skabs nyan mkhan shin tu mang la tha na rdzi bo rnams kyang rang bzhin gyis chos nyan du 'khor yong ba yin/'on kyang / cig shos de las ldog pa'i gnad de'ang 'chad pa'i thabs mkhas min par rag las pa gsal po ma yin nam/ mdor na/ thog mar brjod bya stabs bde go sla ba/ gzhung gi ngag don bsdus pa/ slob phrug gi blor 'dzin bde ba'i sgo nas rim bzhin zab gnas su 'jug pa'i khrid thabs la brten nas 'dzin grwa yongs kyi slob phrug la lta thub pa dgos/ mtha' gnyis kyi slob mar lta rtogs byed rgyu de 'dzin grwa 'tshog skabs tsam ma zad zur khrid la brten nas kho tsho yar rgyas yong ba byed rgyur do nan byed dgos/'chad pa'i brgyud rim nang slob mar spro ba bsrings ba dang / dpe don 302

dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyi blo sbyong skor mdo tsam gleng ba/sbyor ba/ brgal lan/ lus ngag gi brda sprod sogs kyi thabs lam la brten nas brjod bya kha gsal go brda 'phrod rgyur do snang byas te brjod bya dngos dang 'brel med dam yang na de tsam gyi 'brel ba med pa'i don gzhan mi gleng bar rtsa ba dam por 'dzin rgyu las yan lag rgyas nas sdong po bsgribs pa'i skyon du mi 'gro ba'i dgos pa ni shin tu gal che ba yin/ de bzhin slob khang nang gi 'chad stegs thog tu 'gying pa'i slob dpon gyi lus ngag gi nyams 'gyur la skyo snang dang / ngal dub/ le lo sogs kyi dri mas ma gos par grung sha dod la blo bag phebs pos slob khrid byed pa'i sgyu rtsal la brten nas slob ma rnams kyi yid dbang slob khrid thog la rtse gcig tu bkug ste 'chad mkhan la thogs pa med cing go rim ldan la kha gsal ba/ nyan mkhan rnams kyi go bde zhing spro ba 'phel ba zhig dgos rgyu ni gnad dam pa'o/ /de bzhin snyan sum sgra tshad sogs gang 'chad skabs kyang gzhi 'dzin khungs gtugs med pa'i rig pa 'chal rgyu med de slob gnyer bslab bya las/ 'khrul bral gzhung re nges bzung gzhir byas nas/ /gzhan rnams de dang sbyar nas dbyod pa las/ /gang byung dpo la blta zhing thams cad kyi/ /rjes su 'brangs pa shes rab 'chal 'byur bas/ /rang lugs gtad so yod par gyis shig yang / /zhes gdams pa ltar gzhung gang zhig 'chad par gyur kyang thog mar rang lugs phugs su 'pher ba gtad so yod par byas nas/ gzhan lugs la dpyad pas 'gog par bya dgos pa ni rig pas sgrub lugs shig yin yang slob grwa chung 'bring gnyis su rang lugs tshad ldan zhig bzhag rjes gzhan dgag pa'i rgya skyed dgos min la bsam zhib ma thub par mkhas pa so so'i bzhed pa mi mthun pa mang po sdeb 303

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/bshad bgyis tshe/ bum pa chung chung nang zom chen po'i chu gshong ba'i re ba bzhin 'grub par dka' bas las dang po pa rnams mgo 'thom pa'i rkyen du 'gyur ba nges so/ /'on kyang slob grwa chen mo dang blo rig bkra ba rnams la gang la de 'tshams kyi rgyas pa brjod rgyu yang shes dgos/ 'o na 'chad skabs spang dgos pa'i gnas ni mdo sde rgyan las/ le lo dang ni mi go dang / /skabs mi 'byed dang ma nges dang / /the tshom dag ni mi gcod dang / /de dang bral bar bstan mi byed/ /skyo ba dang ni ser sna nyid/ /'di dag gtam gyi nyes par 'dod ces 'chad skabs the tshom gyi dra ba ma bcad par bshad pa dang / dka' gnad la 'grel bshad zab mo ma byas par byil byil du 'gro ba/mi dgos pa'i gnas su brgya bshad stong bshad kyi spro ba 'phel ba/ gong 'og rim par don med rang dgar dkrugs nas gong du bshad rgyu 'og tu 'dor ba dang / 'og tu bshad rgyu gong du len pa/ skabs su ma bab pa shod pa dang bab pa mi bshad pa/ — 'chad skabs ha cang dal drags pa dang yang na mgyogs drags pa/ tshig brda gsal po mi 'phrod pa sogs 'chad pa'i nyes skyon yin pas de dag gang thub kyis spongs dgos/ gong gsal sngon byon mkhas pa'i gdams ngag de dag slob dpon rnams kyi thugs la bcangs nas phyag len thub pa mdzad rgyu gal che/304

dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyi blo sbyong skor mdo tsam gleng ba/bzhi pa/ gzhung bzang rgyud dag gi kun spyod/shes ldan mi sna gso skyong bya ba'i 'phrin las ni spyir btang tsam gyi las rigs la dga' zhen yod pa kho nas mi phan te/ der ches mtho'i 'gan 'khur gyi bsam pa dang / slob gso'i las don la lhag bsam rnam par dag pa byed pa'i gser btso ma lta bu'i bsam pa zhig dgos/ de'ang gung khran ring lugs kyi bsam pa dang / gzhan la phan 'dogs par 'dod pa'i bsam pa/ mi rigs kyi lar rgya zab pa'i bsam pa bcas ldan pa'i sgo nas rang gi lhad med rang bzhin gyi kun slong bzang pos slob gnyer pa rnams ya rabs tshul mthun gyi lam du 'khrid ston byas thog kho tsho rgyal khab la dga' zhen dang /mi dmangs la dga' zhen/ tang la dga' zhen byed dgos pa bcas kyi slob gso gtong dgos/ der brten dge rgan gyis dpe cha khrid pa tsam du ma zad/slob phrug gi kun spyod la yang do snang byed dgos/ rang cag su zhig yin yang shes yon ldan pa tsam gyis mi chog ste mi dmangs la zhabs 'degs zhu ba'i lhag bsam dkar po zhig kyang dgos pa gnyis kha bral thabs med/ lhag don dge rgan zhig la mtshon na rtsa ba'i cha rkyen 'di gnyis gang rung zhig ma tshang yang rang 'gan legs grub thub pa ches dka'o/ /dge rgan gyi sgo gsum spyod lam la thugs snang chen po gnang dgos te/ dper na/ slob khrid byed skabs lus nyal ba dang / bsnyes pa/ rkang pa 'phred la rkyong ba/ lus kyi gtsang sbrar do snang mi byed pa/ kun dang mi mthun pa'i gos ya ma gzugs gyon pa/305

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/slob tshan dang 'brel ba med cing / tshogs pa'i dbus su dbyung mi rung ba'i btsog gtam smra ba/ skad shugs chung ngur smras nas pha rol pos thos dka' ba/ skad sgra mi gsal ba'am rdab rdib tu smra ba/ yid dpe mkhyud gyis bcings pa/ phrag dogs dang nye ring sogs kyi dri mas gos pa'i dbang du ma song bar dus rtag tu slob phrug la gzhung bzang la rgyud 'jam pa/ bsun snang med la ngang rgyud ring po'i sgo nas slob khrid gnang ba'i hur sems 'chang dgos pa bcas yin/ lhag par du slob ma rnams la rang gi bu tsha lta bu'i brtse zhen bcangs te ngag 'jam 'dzum dmul tsam gyis dge slob mthun pa'i dpe tshad du mi 'jog par blang dor mi 'dzol ba'i lam gsal por bstan nas rgyun du slob phrug gi dge skyon skabs 'phral mthong thub pa dang dus thog yo bsrang byed pa ni slob ma rnams la drin che ba yin gyi/ slob ma'i skyon mthong yang ma mthong ba'i tshul dang / mi snyan pa thos kyang gang thub ci thub kyis skad cha nyung tsam dang rna ba bde tsam yong ba byed pa ni slob ma drin chung du btang ba sus kyang rtogs sla'o/ /kra'u tsung lis/ dge rgan la bkur bsti dang slob mar gces skyong byed dgos/ zhes pa'i bka' slob de dge slob tshang mas yid la bcangs te dus rgyun du lag len thog 'khyol ba'i 'bad brtson byed dgos/krung gorasta‘rig gnas gsar brje zhes pa'i rang gzhan thams cad phung la sbyar ba'i dus skabs de tsam du ma gtogs phyogs yongs nas dge rgan la brtsi bkur mi byed pa'i dus skabs kyang ma mchis/ de bzhin tshan rig lag rtsal 'phel rgyas zhan pa'i rjes lus can gyi rgyal khab nas tshan rig lag rtsal yang rtser son pa'i stobs 'byor rgyas pa'i rgyal khab ci 'dra zhig dang / spyi 306

dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyi blo sbyong skor mdo tsam gleng ba/tshogs gang dang gang zhig gi nang du'ang dge rgan gyi las rigs de dga' zhen byed pa yin/ der brten zas gos kyi bde ba 'ba' zhig don du gnyer ba'i blo chung 'ga' zhig ma gtogs gzhan thams cad kyis mi la shes yon slob pa'i las ka 'di lta bu ni rlabs che ba dang don snying ldan pa/ spyi tshogs dang rgyal khab mi sger bcas tshang mar phan thogs che ba zhig yin par ngos 'dzin byed cing / las rigs mi 'dra ba khri 'bum mang po'i khrod na dge rgan gyi las rigs des shin tu ngo mtshar ba'i gnas bab bzung yod pa'i dngos don der mchog dman kun gyis mi snyan pa'i kha rlangs thon par mi nus so/ /der brten dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyi mtshan snyan dang khong rnams kyi phyag las gong 'og tshang mas brtsi bkur dang rgyab skyor mtha' gcig tu zhus nas/rig gnas gsar brjes bzhag pa'i dge rgan la bskur 'debs dang shes yon la mthong chung byed pa'i bag chags mtha' dag gtsang sel byed rgyu ni cung zad bsam blo mthong ba'i skye bo kun gyi 'os 'gan yin/ gal te yon tan sbyong ba las tshong gnyer ba khe bzang che ba dang / dge rgan gyi las rigs de tha zhan du brtsi ba'i bsam sbyor de rigs ni mi rigs 'di nyid nyams rgud du gtong ba'i rkyen kho nar mthong bas/ dge rgan spyi bor bkur nas yon tan nor bu ltar brtsis te 'bad brtson chen pos len dgos pa ni rang cag tshang mas bsam zhib nan po byed dgos pa'i gnad dam pa yin no//307
