dge rgan gyi byang tshad skor gyi bsam gzhigs 'ga'i skor/tshad dang ldan pa'i phul byung dge rgan zhig bya rgyu ni dge rgan yongs kyi mi tshe hril por don gnyer byed pa'i 'dun pa'am phugs bsam zhig yin pas/dge rgan la slob gso'i las kar dga' ba'i las brtson gyi bsam pa rnam dag cig dgos pa ma zad/ da dung slob gso slob khrid kyi phyogs gang ci'i thad kyi ches rtsa bar gyur pa'i rmang gzhi'i yon tan nam byang tshad nges gtan zhig ṭ+wāṃṭ+wāṃ/sa/ pas 'dir kho bos de'i skor gyi bsam gzhigs 'ga' zhig gleng bar dang po/ byang tshad kyi mtshan nyid/byang tshad ces pa ni skye bo zhig gi ngos nas brjod na rang la dang thog gnyug ma nyid nas yod pa'i bsam pa'i 'khyer so dang / shes stobs/ 'tsho thabs/ goms gshis/ gshis ka rig gnas sgyu rtsal sogs myu gu skyed par bya ba'i sa bon lta bu des ches rtsa bar byas pa'i byang tshad kyi rmang gzhi'i thog phyis su gom pa rim bgrod kyis 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi khor yug gi phyi rkyen dang /nang rkyen sogs rten 'brel sna tshogs kyi shugs rkyen las grub pa'i mi rnams kyi sems khams dang / gzugs khams/ tshan rig rig gnas/ skye khams/chab srid bsam blo sogs kyi shes bya'i yon tan gyi blo'i rtogs pa'i byang goms 308

dge rgan gyi byang tshad skor gyi bsam gzhigs 'ga'i skor/kyi tshad de la byang tshad ces brjod pa de'ang sa bon mes 'tshig pa la myu gu sngon po ji ltar skye ba dang stos lud chu dang g.yog byed ma 'dzoms na/ rdo skam steng du ljang myug sngon po ji ltar skye ba'i dpe las rtogs par gyur/ byang tshad de la'ang tshong zog cig gi spus tshad dang chos mtshungs par mtho dman dang legs nyes kyi rnam dbye byas chog pas deng gi char rang ljongs kyi dge rgan dpung khag de sngon chad dang bsdur na yar rgyas chen po byung yod rung da dung grangs tshad dang spus tshad gnyis ka'i cha nas zhan cha mi nyung ba zhig gnas yod na/ de ni dus rabs nyer gcig pa'i mi sna gso skyong bya rgyu dang te bag nges can yod pa mthong chos su gyur gshis/ blo mthun cang tse min gyis/ tshan rig lag rtsal gyi yar rgyas dang / dpal 'byor dar rgyas/ spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi 'gag rtsa ni ngal rtsol pa'i byang tshad la rag las zhes gsungs pa ltar/mi rigs hril po'i ma 'ongs pa'i/ dar rgud kyi rtsa ba ni slob gsor thug pa dang slob gso 'phel rgyas gtong ba'i lam bu nyag cig ni byang tshad slob gso lag bstar bya rgyu dang / byang tshad slob gso lag bstar bya ba'i 'gag rtsa'am sngon 'gro'i thag gcod rang bzhin gyi rgyu rkyen ni dge rgan yin pa'o//gnyis pa/ dge rgan la 'dzoms dgos pa'i byang tshad/dge rgan zhes pa'ang sgo gsum rnam par dge ba'i las la sbyor mkhas par bya ba'i cha nas dge dang rgan pa ni bslab yul slob ma las bslab pa mtho ba'am shes rab mtho ba'i cha nas rgan pa ste rnam par dge ba'i 'phrin las spel ba la rang nyid las yon tan gyi chu tshad mtho ba'am rgan pa'i cha nas tha snyad de 309

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/ltar btags/ des na dge rgan la las rigs gzhan dang thun mong ma yin pa'i byang tshad 'dzoms dgos pa ni mkhyen rab pa rnams kyis dge rgan ni mi'i rigs kyi bla srog bzo skrun byed mkhan gyi dbu chen zhes snyan par 'bod de/gdul bya slob gnyer gyi bla srog dper na dkar gtsang gi shog bu lta bu la shes rig gi ri mo rnam par bkra ba 'bri mkhan zhig dang yang dag mtshungs/ des na ri mo lta bu ji ltar 'bri thub min ni dge rgan gyi byang tshad la thug pa smos med yin pas gsham du dge rgan la 'dzoms dgos pa'i byang tshad skor 'chad par bya'o//gastsag gzhan phan gyi byang tshad/ dge rgan la tang gi slob gso'i bya gzhag la lhag bsam rnam dag byed pa'i bla na med pa'i chab srid bsam blo'i byang tshad dgos pa ste/ bsam blo'i byang tshad thad slob ma thams cad mkhas pa chen po zhig chags na ci ma rung snyam pa'i snying rje dang gang 'chad bya'i don de slob mas shes na ci ma rung snyam pa'i kun slong / slob tshan gra sgrig dang sbyang gzhi bzo bcos/ 'chad pa'i dus la ngal dub dang dka' sdug la skyo ba med pa'i spro snang / dper na sems bzang gi lha rjes nad pa'i zug rngu yongs rdzogs bsal ba dang / long ba zhig la mig sbyin rgyu byung na ci ma rung snyam pa'i bsam pa ste rnyed bkur dang snyan grags zang zing sogs la ltos pa med par ris med slob mar shes bya'i bdud rtsi sbyin pa'i gzhan phan gyi bsam pa nam mkha'i nor bu nyi ma'i mdzad 'phrin lta bu dgos pa de mdo sde rgyan las/de ltar blo bzang skyo ba med ldan brtse ba can/ /snyan par rab grags cho ga bzang shes ldan pa yis/ /byang chub sems pa legs par smra ba yin pa ste/ /310

dge rgan gyi byang tshad skor gyi bsam gzhigs 'ga'i skor/bshad pa'i skye bo'i nang na nyi ma bzhin du ltam/ /zhes gsungs pa'ang da lta brjod pa'i rang don spu tsam med par gzhan don rkyang rkyang sgrub dgos zhes pa dang / mi dmangs la zhab 'degs zhu dgos zhes pa dang / rang las gzhan gces par 'dzin dgos zhes pa dang / tshan rig gi 'jig rten lta ba dang /yar thon gyi mi tshe'i lta ba dang / rin thang gi lta ba dgos zhes pa dag dang 'gal bar mi 'gro bas rab tu gces par 'dzin par bya/ gal te dge rgan zhig la skye bo blun rmongs mun pa'i dbyings su 'thom pa lta bu dag la shes rab kyi sgron me btegs te/ ma shes mun pa'i gnas las bsgral bar 'dod pa'i gzhan phan gyi bla shing de med na chos gzhan rnams sgrub par dka' bas dang por gzhan phan gyi byang tshad dgos pa de snying dbus su 'dzin dgos/gnyis/ shes rab kyi byang tshad/ gzhan phan gyi sems bzang yod pa kho nas mi chog par da dung yin min rnam 'byed kyi shes rab dgos pa ste/shes rab kyi byang tshad dman na lag rtsal byang goms chung ba'i lha rjes nad pa skyob 'dod dang / lag rdum gyi pha mas chur lhung phru gu skyob 'dod dang mtshungs pas sbyang bya'i shes byar mkhas dgos pa ste/ mkhas 'jug las/ mkhas zhes pa ni shes rab dag las lung rigs la mkhas pa zhig dgos ste mi mkhas na the tshom gyi dra ba gartsod mi nus/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dge rgan zhig gi ngos nas brjod ston gzhan phan gyi blo skyed dgos pa ma zad yin min rnam 'byed kyi shes rab kyang dgos pa ste/ rang gi ched las kyi shes byar mkhas shing /rig tshan gzhan la'ang byang goms cung zad byung na mkhas pa'i rgyan du gyur/'dir dmigs su bkar nas brjod rgyur ched las kyi shes bya de'i rigs pa'i 311

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/gzhung lugs dang lag len dngos spyod/ rig tshan de'i 'phel rim gyi lo rgyus/zhib 'jug gi 'phel kha/ srol rgyun rgyun 'dzin gyi khar gsar gtod kyi blo skyed/ snyigs dor bcud len dang / rig pa gsar spel gyis dus rabs kyi gom bgrod kyi rjes su bsnyegs te gcig byang kun grol dgos pa de'ang sa paṇa gyis/ mkhas gang shes bya'i de kho na/ /ji bzhin rtogs pa yin par 'dod/ /bye brag sbyangs pa'i don zhes pa/ /de yang de la mkhas zhes bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dper na rdzas 'gyur ched las dge rgan zhig la mtshon na/ rang gi khrid bya'i rig tshan de la byang zhing mkhas dgos pa ni bslab par bya ba'i yul de las yon tan khyad par du lhag pa zhig dgos/ gal te de lta min par slob ma las kyang yon tan dman na slob mar yon tan gang yang mi skye bar skyon mang bar bskyed pas nyams par gyur cing / yon tan rang dang mnyam na slob mar 'phel grib med par rang sor gnas par gyur/ des na shes rab ches mchog tu gyur pa yon tan slob ma las lhag pa dgos pa de'ang / gzhan phan gyi blo dang ldan zhing rig pa'i gnas la mkhas pa'i slob dpon la slob ma dang spyi tshogs yongs kyis bkur zhing bsngags par bya ste/ sdud pa las/slob ma bzang po bla mar gus ldan de dag gis/ /bla ma mkhas pa dag la rtag tu bsten par bya/ /ci phyir zhe na mkhas pa'i yon tan de las 'byung / /zhes gsungs pas/ mkhas par 'dod pa'i dge rgan rnams kyis ston pa rgya che'i mang thos dang the tshom rab gcod shes rab gnyis la byang goms byas te smra mchog go 'phang dbang ba la shes rab kyi mig lta bu der bsten par gces dgos so//312

dge rgan gyi byang tshad skor gyi bsam gzhigs 'ga'i skor/gsum/ gzugs khams kyi byang tshad/ dge rgan zhig la cha mtshon na gzhan phan gyi thugs skyed bzang zhing shes bya rig pa'i gnas la mkhas pa zhig yin rung / gal te gzugs gzhi bde thang med na shes bya rnams brgyud sprod bya thabs bral ba ni/ dper na gzugs khams nad kyis btums nas mal las ldang mi thub pa'i lha rje mkhas pa zhig gis 'gro ba'i nad rigs 'joms 'dod pa dang / ma rtsa med pa'i tshong pas lho tshong byang du 'dren 'dod pa dang mtshungs/ des na dge rgan gyis rgyun par 'tsho ba'i khrod zhogs pa'i lus rtsal dang / slob gseng gi lus rtsal/ de min mchongs rgyugs 'phen gsum dang / spo lo'i rigs kyi rtsed sbyong la rang 'gul gyis zhugs shing /blo rtsa brtan pos rgyun ldan can dang goms gshis can du 'gyur bar byed pa'i byang tshad dgos pa dang gcig dus thog tu nyal langs byed pa dang / lto thun gsum dus thog tu za ba/ gtsang sbrar do snang byed pa/ 'dug skabs lus 'phred du nyal ba'am bsnyes pa sogs mi byed pa/ mig shes dang blta bya'i bar thag nye bar byas na gzugs khams bde thang gi gegs su 'gro ba'i rigs yong ba sogs nges par du 'tsho ba'i chos nyid brtan la btsan pa'i byang tshad dgos pa dang gnyis/ rang gi gzugs khams bde thang la gnod pa'i chang rag dang / tha ma kha spang bar bya zhing / phyi rkyen las byung ba'i nad yams sngon 'gog bya thub pa'i byang tshad dgos pa dang gsum/ skye khams rig pa'i mkhas dbang rnams kyis zhib 'jug byas pa'i 'bras bur lus rtsal gyis mi rnams kyi klad pa je cher 'gro ba dang / grung sha je cher phyin te mi rnams kyi bde thang dang tshe bsrings la phan pa rgya cher ldan par ngos 'dzin gnang gi yod 313

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/pas/ nga tshos rig pa'i gnas la brtson 'grus ldan zhing klad pa mang tsam dkrugs na bde thang dang tshe bsrings la phan skyed yod pas/ dus tshod nges gtan bed spyad de slob sbyong byed pa'i goms gshis chags pa'i byang tshad dgos pa dang bzhi/ gzugs khams kyi don lnga snod drug la nad gzhi tshabs chen mi phog par sngon 'gog byed pa'i byang tshad dgos pa dang lnga/ don ga ge mo zhig la thug rung spro snang 'phel zhing dang bas 'jug pa dang / dad snang rgya cher ldan pa'i mi mang po dang 'grogs par mkhas pa/ khor yug dang bstun thub pa'i nus pa ldan pa sogs skye khams gso ba'i byang tshad dgos pa dang drug gzugs po ni dge rgan gyi ngos nas brjod na slob tshan khrid skabs med du mi rung ba'i gal che'i ma rtsa zhig yin par ngos 'dzin rnam dag gi byang tshad dgos pa dang bdun bcas mdor na/ gzhan phan gyi thugs skyed bzang zhing chos rab rnam 'byed kyi shes rab ldan rung / bde zhing thang ba'i gzugs gzhi med na/ sems bzang pos bar snang la rta rgyugs 'dod kyang / rgyu dngos pos sbar mthil la so thebs ma song zhes pa'i 'jig rten gyi gtam dpe las ma 'das par ltos grub kyi chos la yid ches mdzad dgos/bzhi/ chab srid bsam blo'i byang tshad/ deng gi char dge rgan gyis cung cha tshang ba'i sgo nas blo mthun teng zha'o phing gi krung go'i khyad chos ldan pa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs 'dzugs skrun byed pa'i rigs pa'i gzhung lugs kyi snying bcud rtogs dgos pa dang gcig yang dag pa'i 'jig rten lta ba dang / mi che'i lta ba/ mar khe si ring lugs kyi mi rigs kyi lta ba dang /chos lugs kyi lta ba/ tshan rig gi 'jig rten lta ba'i dgongs pa rtogs 314

dge rgan gyi byang tshad skor gyi bsam gzhigs 'ga'i skor/dgos pa dang gnyis/ mes rgyal dang spyi tshogs ring lugs la dga' zhen dang / rtsa ba'i rtsa don bzhi rgyun 'khyongs/ mes rgyal gong bu gcig gyur srung skyong dang / kha phral la ngo rgol/ mi rigs mthun sgril la shugs snon gyi byang tshad dgos pa dang gsum/ rang re'i krung hwa mi rigs hril po'i lo rgyus dang /rang mi rigs kyi 'od stong 'phro ba'i lo rgyus bcas la nyams zhib legs par byas te ma 'ongs pa'i dus la rang re'i rgyal khab kyi lo brgya'i jus chen ci dang gang yod pa rang blor ri mo bkod pa lta bu'i byang tshad dgos pa dang bzhi/krung go gung khran tang dang krung go na gzhon tshogs pa'i ngo bo dang de'i 'os 'gan/ 'bad 'thab kyi dmigs tshad ji yin sogs rgyun shes kyi byang tshad dgos pa dang lnga/ rgyal khab phyi nang gi gal che'i skabs don shes rtogs kyi byang tshad dgos pa dang drug mdor na chab srid bsam blo'i byang tshad mtho zhing langs phyogs brtan pa'i slob dpon zhig gis 'chad khrid kyi stegs bu zin nas gsar brje'i shul 'dzin pa gso skyong byed pa'i byang tshad dgos pa ni dge rgan gyi bla shing lta bu yin pa'o//lnga/ rnam dasbod kyi byang tshad/ blang bya dang dor bya/ yang dag pa dang nor 'khrul/ yin pa dang min pa/ ngo rgol dang bsngags brjod/ 'os dang mi 'os/ bden pa dang rdzun ma sogs ni mi rnams kyi rnam dpyod kyi rig par rten nas yin min dbye ba 'byed kyi yod pas dge rgan zhig gi ngos nas brjod na mkhas pa so so'i bzhed tshul tha dad pa dang / slob ma'i sbyang gzhi'i lan tha dad pa/ rgyugs gzhi'i lan tha dad pa/ slob ma'i rig stobs kyi ldob rkyen/ slob gzhi'i dgongs gzhi/ slob mas bton pa'i dri bar lan ji ltar 315

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/'debs pa sogs bya dngos ci dang ji la'ang rang gi blo gros rtsal gyis bsam gzhigs legs par byas nas yin min rnam 'byed kyi som nyi las grol ba'i lan gnad la 'phigs pa rgyag thub pa'i byang tshad ldan dgos/ byang tshad de lta med na/ mun pas btums pa'i mal nang du/ mdzes ma mdzes mar mi mthong bzhin slob ma'i the tshom gyi dra ba mi chod cing slob ma'i rgyud la nges shes gang yang mi brnyed par rang gzhan gnyis ka 'phungs pa'i rgyur gyur par nges pas na/ nges par du rigs lam rnam par 'byed pa'i rnam dpyod dang / /gzhung lugs gdams par shar ba'i nyams len dang / /tshig smyor tshul la mkhas pa'i ngag gi dpal/ /sa steng 'di na rin chen rnam gsum snang / /zhes rje tsong kha pas yin min rnam 'byed kyi rnam dpyod de rin po che rnam gsum gyi ya gyal du drangs nas gsungs yod pas/ nor la nor nyams chod nas nor bu lag nas ma 'chor gces par 'dzin dgos/drug dmigs bsal gyi byang tshad/ dge rgan ni mi'i rigs kyi bla srog bzo skrun gyi dbu chen zhig yin gshis/ zla ba'i go lar skor bskyod byed mkhan gyi mkha' gru dang kha lo ba la thun mong min pa'i rdzas shig dgos pa bzhin dge rgan gyi mtshan snyan thob par dmigs bsal gyi byang tshad 'ga' 'dzoms dgos pa 'di lta ste/ dang po/ dge rgan gyis slob khrid kyi rtsa 'dzin rtogs shing bslab gzhi rtsom pa po'i bsam blo'i gtad phyogs dang / bslab gzhi hril po'i shes bya'i grub cha khong du chud nas rkang bzung nas yan lag 'dzin thub pa'i byang tshad dgos/gnyis pa/ brjod bya'i don gang yang rung ba zhig dge rgan gyi ngag gi 316

dge rgan gyi byang tshad skor gyi bsam gzhigs 'ga'i skor/rtsal la brten nas brda sprod par byed pas na brjod don gting zab la rgya che ba rnams rjod byed tshig gi phreng bas snyan zhing 'jebs la/ chags thogs dang bral zhing sgra dag cing gsal ba gnad la 'phigs pa dang / chu rgyun lhung lhung du babs pa lta bu snga phyi 'brel chags pa/ gtan tshigs kyi rang bzhin ldan pa las ldab ldib dang zlos pa la sogs pa'i ngag gi skyon rnams spang nas brjod pa'i ngag rtsal gyi byang tshad ldan dgos/gsum pa/ slob tshan gra sgrig byed pa'am yang na dpyad rtsom 'bri ba sogs kyi skabs rang la dgos gzhi ci dang ji byung na dpyad gzhi'i yig rigs 'tshol dgos pa gdon mi za bas/ rgyun par dpe deb lta klog mang tsam byed pa dang dpe mdzod khang du yod pa'i dpe cha'i dkar chag sgrig stangs kyi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs la rgyus mnga' yong ba byas te dpe deb rgya mtsho'i 'jing nas rang la mkho ba'i dpyad gzhi'i yig rigs nor bu lta bu 'tshol bar mkhas pa'i byang tshad ldan dgos/bzhi pa/ dge rgan ni slob gnyer pa'i mig lta bya yul yin pas thog mar dge rgon gyis lus ngag spyod pas mig dpe bzang po ston dgos pa ma zad/slob khrid dngos la 'jug skabs snyan ngag gi rgyan gyi mtshan gzhi'i dper brjod dang 'phrin yig gtong ba'i dpe gzhi/ gan rgya 'bri ba'i dpe gzhi lta bu sogs rtsom 'bri'i dpe gzhi 'bri bar mkhas pa'i byang tshad dam yon tan khyad par ba ldan dgos/lnga pa/ shes bya kun khyab las/ blo tshen zab rgyas blo chung bzung bde zhing / /rgo sla phyis nas phra zhib 'gal 'brel gartsod/ /zhum la gzengs bstod 317

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/rgod dang skugs pa bablog /ces gsungs pa ltar snod rab 'bring tha gsum gyi shes tshad la dmigs nas 'chad khrid skabs gang nas bshad kyang 'brel ji tsam byas kyang ran/ ji ltar bshad kyang 'thad pa dngagazhan dga' bar nus pa'i dbyangs snyan pa dang bcas kyis snod bstun lung 'bogs bya bar mkhas pa'i byang tshad ldan dgos/drug pa/ gang khrid par bya ba'i rig tshan gyi ang ki'i gzugs dang yig gzugs tshad dang ldan pa dgos pa dang / khyad par du rgya yig dge rgan zhig gi ngos nas brjod na/ spu sgyug dang / sa smyug phu 'dren (lcags sgyug )gyi yig gzugs dang / bod yig dge rgan zhig gi ngos nas brjod na/ sa sgyug dang / lcags sgyug si sgyug bcas sgyug rigs mi 'dra ba la brten nas yig gzugs ka kha zlos hral nas 'go brtsams pa'i yig gzugs khag mi 'dra ba rnams yi ge'i gzugs kyi 'bri lugs ltar lag pa'i 'du byed kyi sgyug rtsal la mkhas pa'i byang tshad dgos/bdun pa/ dge rgan la skye bo rnams kyis yang lā dang / sa sgyugadar 'bu la dpe bzhag nas bsngags brjod dang gdeng 'jog byed kyi yod pa ni dngos 'brel 'os shing 'tshams pa'i dpe zhig yin pas/ legs skyes kyi bsam pa che zhing zang zing gi rnyed pa don du mi gnyer ba'i byang tshad dgos/de'ang nam mkha'i bstan bcos las/ rig pa can dang 'byor pa can/ /'tsho ba'i tshul la khrad med kyang / blo ni gling dang gling bar gyi/ /nam mkha' lta bu'i khyad par yod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ dge rgan ni rig pa can gyi gral du tshud pas/ zang zing rnyed bkur la mi blta ba'i bag yod tshul ldan zhig tu 318

dge rgan gyi byang tshad skor gyi bsam gzhigs 'ga'i skor/'bad dgos/brgyad pa/ slob gnyer pa dbang po bltung ba dang / dran shes mi brtan pa/ rnam g.yengs che ba bcas la yang nas yang du bslabs kyang da dung rtogs pa mi 'phel ba dang / sbyang gzhi ri bo'i gtos dang mtshungs par sgrog tse'i steng du spungs pa'i skabs dang / gdul bya shin tu 'dul dka' bas khong khro'i me lce dgung du 'bar ba'i skabs khyod la zam pa dang phyags dar lta bu'i bzod sran gyi sems shig gis slob ma'i yid la dwangs ba 'dren pa'i 'dzum dmul gyi mdangs shig phyung ba'i byang tshad dgos/ de'ang yang yang 'chad pa'i ngal ba skyo ba dang / bdag nyid sgrog cing gzhan skyon gleng ba/shes byar dpe mkhyud byed pa/ zas gos la sogs zang zing la lta ba'i ma dag sems rgyud dag ring du spong thub pa'i byang tshad dgos pa'o//dgu pa/ rang gi nyes pa bcas pa'i g.yo dang / gzhan bslu ba'i sgyu med pa'i gzhung drang ba'i byaja tshad dgos/ rdzi'aju mi pham rnam rgyal rgya mtshoso kyang / drang pos drang por bskyangs pa la/ /skye bo'i 'grogs yun chu bas ring / /g.yo can 'dod pas bkug pa'i grogs/ /ji ltar byams kyang nam phugs dgra/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /bcu pa/ slob dpon gyis rang nyid slob dpon yin pa'i bsam pa'i 'khyer so tshangs pa'i thig shing bzhin bsrangs te slob ma rgan pa rnams rang gi gcen po gcen mo dang / gzhon pa rnams rang gi gcung po gcung mo yin snyam pa'i blo bskyed de dge slob bar gyi dam tshig ma nyams par gtsang bar bya ba'i byang tshad dgos/ dam gtsang min pa la ljon shing skam pa'i grib bsil bzhin 319

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/du phugs nas phugs su skye bo rnams gzhan dang gzhan du byol ba la the tshom tsam yang srid par min no/ /bcu gcig bslab gzhi dang slob ma'i rig stobs la dpyad de rgyugs gzhi tshad dang mthun par 'don par mkhas la/ rgyugs gzhi'i dka' sla 'tshams la slob ma'i shes stobs nyams tshod len par gnad la 'phigs pa'i byang tshad ldan dgos/bcu gnyis/ slob tshan khrid skabs dang / 'dzin grwa'i do dam bcas la slob ma rnams sgrig gis rang gi dbang du 'du zhing kha lo bsgyur nus pa'i byang tshad ldan dgos/bdun/ ya rabs smyod gtsang gi byang tshad/ dge rgan zhes pa ni slob ma'i mig dpe lta yul yin pas lus ngag gi bya spyod ngan pa spang nas ya rabs spyod gtsang gi byang tshad cig dgos pa ste/ spyi tshogs kyi spyi spyod la brtsi srung dang / spyi rdzas la bdag gces/ khor yug gi mdzes ljongs la gtsang sbra dang gces 'dzin/ bsrung bya'i sgrig srol lam lugs legs par srung ba dang /mi gzhan la las rogs byed rgyu de rang gi bde bar 'dzin pa/ rgan bkur gzhon skyong gi bsam pa dang / ya rabs gus zhabs kyi spyi spyod ldan pa gzhir byas nas slob ma'i khrod du ngag nas 'chal gtam dang / tshogs pa'i khrod du dbyung mi rung ba'i gtam/ shes rab 'phel ba'i rgyur mi 'gro ba'i gtam/lus kyi mi tshangs spyod pa dang cha lugs ya ma zung / slob tshan tshugs skabs phyi 'byor snga logs dang nyi ma gang 'khyol/ rgyugs gzhi'i nang don phyi gyar ram slob mar bshad pa/ sbyang gzhi dus thog tu mi bcos pa/ tshod med chang rag 320

dge rgan gyi byang tshad skor gyi bsam gzhigs 'ga'i skor/'thung nas skyur 'gong bshad pa/ las grogs sogs dang kha mchu rgyag pa/yon tan slob pa'i gegs gyur 'dod yon lnga la chags drags shing rgod pa'i sems phyogs bcur g.yengs pa/ sho 'bag mā cang la sogs rgyan po 'gyed la tshod med kyis nyin mtshan 'da' ba sogs spangs te/ dge rgan la thog mtha' bar gsum du ya rabs spyod bzang dang tshul khrims gtsang ma'i srab bzang gis rang gi spyod pa'i rta rgod gcun thub pa'i byang tshad dgos/ ltergyu mtshan ni ya rasbas spyod pa las 'jig rten gyi dpal yongs su rdzogs pa yong ba dang / cig shos ni slob mas brnyas dang brtsi mthong med pa'i rgyur 'gro bas so/ /brgyad/ rig tshan gzhan la dad snang gi thos rgya che ba'i byang tshad/ dge rgan gyis khrid par bya ba ni mi'i rigs kyi shes rig gi snying bcud yin gshis/ de la shes bya'i rnam grangs mtha' yas pa yod par nges pas na/gang thub ci thub kyis rang gi mkhyen rgya dang / thos rgya che ru btang ste nyin re bzhin rang gi klad pa'i nang la shes bya'i rnam grangs mang du gtong dgos la/dad snang gi rig tshan kyang phun sum tshogs su gtong dgos pa ste/ mtshar sdug ldan pa'i me tog gcig la me tog gi ldum ra'i tha snyad mi 'dogs par me tog sna brgya 'dzoms pa la me tog ldum ra zhes thogs pa ltar thos rgya che zhing shes bya'i rnam grangs mang bar khong du chud na da gzod skye bo'i gral du tshud/de'ang thos pa gal che chung ni skyes rabs so bzhi las/ thos pa gti mug mun sel sgron me yin/ /skun po la sogs mi khyer nor gyi mchog /kun ngu mongs pa'i dgra bcom mtshon cha yin/ /thabs tshul man ngag ston pa'i grogs kyi mchog /321

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/gang zhig thos pas yid ni dad gyur na/ /legs par dga' la brtan pa nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes rab skye zhing gti mug med par 'aglur/ /rang gi shas kyang de ni nyo bar rigs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rgyun par 'tsho ba'i khrod du glog brnyan dang / glu gzhas/ ri mo/ yig gzugs/ par rgyag grags can gyi bzo skrun/ mdzes chos kyi sgyu rtsal dang / rkang rtsed dang lag rtsed la sogs pa'i spo lo rigs kyi 'gran bsdur sogs la dga' ba dang / gung seng dus dang bstun nas rol rtsed kyi rtsed chas kyi rigs la rol ba dang / sprag 'dzin dang /gna' lor dang / gna' rdzas nyar tshags bya bar dga' ba dang / nad rigs 'joms pa'i sman dpyad rig pa'i rgyun shes dang / gza' skar 'phrod sbyor la sogs pa'i skar rtsis kyi rgyun shes/ slob gso rig pa dang / sems khams rig pa/ rdzas 'ogyur rig pa/ dngos khamarmi rig pa la sogs kyi gzheng lugs mthar phyin shes pa'i mi zhig 'jig rten 'di na ches dkon rung de dag la rang gi blo'i dad snang skye zhing / gang la gang 'tshams kyi thos pa bsags te spyi 'gros dang 'gro lugs la rgyus mnga' lam lhong tsam zhig gi byang tshad dgos/de'ang 'ju mi pham gyis/ yon tan kun tshang dka' na yang / yon tan nyid la dga' byas nas/ /blang bya'i yon tan goms byas na/ /nam zhig yon tan chen por 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa la go ba lhag po che lon rgyu mi 'dug gam/dgu/ rig pa gsar spel gyi byang tshad/ mi rigs su zhig la'ang lo rgyus ring la 'od stong 'phro ba'i rig gnas ldan yod rung / dus rabs 322

dge rgan gyi byang tshad skor gyi bsam gzhigs 'ga'i skor/'phel rgyas kyi goms bgrod dang ma bstun na nam zhig rjes lus thebs rgyu nyag cig yin/ snga dus su slob mar chu bum pa gang sbyin dgos na dge rgan la chu zom gang dgos gsungs pa de'ang rgyun chad med par rig pa gsar len gyi snyigs dor bcud len gyi gson shugs ldan pa zhig dgos pa las/ nam yang 'gyur med kyi chu rul zom gang gis gtan nas mi 'grig pa'i don yin pas/dge rgan gyis srol rgyun rig gnas kyi legs cha yongs su rdzogs pa rgyun 'dzin gyi khar/ rig tshan gsar pa dang mi rigs gzhan gyi legs cha'i snying bcud blangs te mi rigs rang gi srol rgyun rig gnas la gson shugs dang / deng rabs kyi srog rtsa gsar pa 'byin te sngar bas phun sum je tshogs su gtong dgos/ rang re'i bod la mtshon na chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum gyis bod mi rigs rang nyid kyi rig gnas 'di 'phags nor lta bur brtsis pa'i rmang gzhi'i thog rgya dkar nag dang / bal yul sogs nas rig gnas kyi snying bcud blangs te bod rang gi lugs dang bstun nas bsreg bcad brdar gsum byas te bod pa'i rig gnas thun mong min pa zhig chags par byas yod/des na glog rdul gyi dus rabs su slebs tsa na/ dge rgan gyis ma mthar yang glog rdul rtsis rgyag 'khor lo'i rmang gzhi'i shes bya dang bed spyod byed stangs khong du chud pa dang / deng rabs can gyi slob chas la brten nas slob khrid bya thub pa bya dgos la/ dge rgan gyi blo de'ang rig pa gsar spel gyi gom bgrod kyi rjes su bsnyegs thub pa'i byang tshad dgos/ de'ang don grub rgyal gyis/dhed par dka' ba'i lo rgyus kyi bam po'i lus la/ /dus dang mthun pa'i srog gi dbang po ma zhugs na/ /yar rgyas kyi 'phar rtsatsāng mi srid/ /sngon thon gyi snying 323

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/khrag rgyu mi thub cing / /mdun skyod kyi gom pa ni de bas kyang zhes dang / tshan rig gzhon nu mag par len na bsu ba ji ltar bgyid/ lag rtsal gyi bu mo bag mar bsu na khro bo su yis bya zhes gsungs pa la go rgyu lhag po che ga 'dra mi 'dug gam/bcu/ zhib 'jug gi byang tshad/ rig pa gsar pa dang / grub 'bras gsar pa/ nyams myong gsar pa ni mkhas dbang rnams kyis zhib 'jug thengs mang byas pa'i 'bras rtags shig yin pas/ nye ba'i char rgyal khab kyis tshan rig dang slob gsor brten nas rgyal khab mnga' thang dar rgyas su gtong ba dang / tshan rig zhib 'jug la brten nas slob grwa dar rgyas su gtong dgos pa'i mdzad phyogs bton gnang yod phyir/ dge rgan gyis slob tshan khrid thabs bslab gzhi bsgyur bcos dang / bod rigs slob mar ji ltar byas nas rgya yig slob khrid bya thabs/ rgyugs ji ltar len thabs/ byang tshad slob gso ji ltar lag len bya thabs/ slob ma'i rtsa ba'i nus rtsal lam yon tan la tshad ji ltar 'jal ba/ ji ltar byas nas slob thun gcig gi phan 'bras thon thabs/ rgya bod skad yig gnyis kyi slob khrid kyi khyad 'phags kyi bsdur ba/ slob srol ji ltar byas nas legs bcos bya ba la sogs pa'i skor dang /de min bod rig pa'i skor gyi zhib 'jug dang dmangs srol dang mjes rtsal sogs la rang blo'i rtsal bton te lung rig la brten nas rang gi lta ba gsal ston gyi dpyad rtsom 'bri ba'i byang tshad ldan dgos/ de'ang slob gso mkhas can pas slob gsor dam 'dzin bya dgos na dge rgan gyi byang tshad mtho ru gtong rgyur mthong chen bya dgos pa dang / slob khrid la dam 'dzin bya dgos 324

dge rgan gyi byang tshad skor gyi bsam gzhigs 'ga'i skor/na nges par du tshan rig zhib 'jug bya rgyur dam 'dzin dang mthong chen bya dgos zhes pa de ni rten 'brel gyi gnas lugs ldan pa zhig yin 'dug pas dge rgan tshad ldan zhig bya dgos na tshan rig zhib 'jug byed pa'i byang tshad dgos/gsum pa/ dge rgan gyi byang tshad mtho ru gtong ba'i lam bu/dge rgan gyi byang tshad mtho ru gtong rgyu ni phyi rkyen dang / nang rkyen /srid gzhung dang / mi sger/ slob gnyer gyi sgrig gozhi sogs gcig la gtsog bltas kyi rten cing 'brel ba las grub pas/ dus yun cung ring ba'i lam bu brgyud de 'ongs rgyur thug pa'i gnad don zhig yin pas/ 'dir kho bos rmongs 'char 'ga' zhu rgyu ni/gcig dge 'os slob gsor bskur bcos kyis dge 'os slob chen gnyer dgos/ da lta bod du 'bring rim dge 'os slob grwa bzhi dang /phyogs bsdus rang bzhin gyi bod ljongs slob grwa chen mo yod pa des/ lo rabs brgyad cu dang dgu bcu'i dus kyi dge rgan gyi dgos mkho dang / byang tshad kyi dmigs tshad bcas kha skong thub pa las/ da lta dpyad nas ma 'ongs par rgyang blta byas na/ da ltas dus rabs 'phel rgyas kyi re ba dang bar thag rgyang ring chod yod pas 'bring rim dge 'os slob grwa nas thon pa rnams nges par du dge 'os slob chen du ched sbyong lo gnyis tsasda byas nas da gzod slob chung dge rgan du bsko bzhag byed pa dang / slob grwa chen mo nas thon pa rnams dge 'os slob chen du ched sbyong lo gnyis tsam byas nas da gzod 'bring rim 325

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/slob grwa'i dge rgan byed chog pa'i 'phel kha la bstun te/ mi rigs kyi rang bzhin dang / dus rabs kyi rang bzhin/ rig tshad 'thus tshang gi rang bzhin ldan pa'i dge 'os slob grwa chen mo ched du 'dzugs dgos pa dang gcig slob grwa chen mo'i dngos gzhi'i tshan khag thob pa'i dge rgan gyis/dngos gzhi'i tshan khag gi slob gnyer par slob tshan khrid pa lta bu'i rnam par 'gyur ba btang ste slob gnas kyi rim pa'i re ba rim pas gong mthor gtong dgos pa dang gnyis/ ljongs slob ud kyi dge rgan do dam khrus 'char gzhi yod pa'i sgo nas 'gro gron btang ste gso skyong bya re yod pa'i dge rgan rnams dus tshod nges gtan bed spyad de dge 'os slob chen du zab sbyong bya rgyu'i skal bzang skrun dgos pa dang gsum/ rang ljongs kyi gzhis rtse dge 'os slob grwa dang / lha sa grong khyer dge 'os slob grwar lo ltar phul byung slob thon slob ma gdams gses kyis slob chung dge rgan gyi slob chen ched sbyong 'dzin grwa re gnyer te rmang gzhi'i slob gsor sman pa'i lam bu gsar du gtod dgos pa dang bzhi bcas so//gnyis/ las gnas smyong brdar gyi lam lugs 'dzugs dgos/dge rgan tshang ma dge 'os slob chen du zab sbyong la 'gro rgyu'i go skabs dkon pas/ phyogs gcig nas slob grwas sgrig 'dzugs yod pa'i sgo nas dge rgan la slob khrid byed pa'i lam lugs btsugs te kho tsho'i rigs gzhung gi byang tshad mtho ru gtong dgos pa dang / phyogs gzhan zhig nas mkhas dbang gdan zhus kyis slob gseng dus dang slob phyi'i dus tshod bed spyad de slob khrid kyi byed sgo spel te dge rgan gyi byang tshad mtho ru gtong dgos/ de min nang rkyen la 326

dge rgan gyi byang tshad skor gyi bsam gzhigs 'ga'i skor/brten te rang sbyong byas te tshad dang ldan pa'i dge rgan gyi dmigs tshad du 'byor thabs byed pa bcas thabs shes gsum gang rung la brten nas sbyong brdar byas te slob khrid do dam sde khag gis 'char gzhi yod la dus tshod yod pa dang / sgrig 'dzugs yod pa/ dmigs tshad yod pa/ do dam yod pa bcas kyi sgo nas dge rgan gyi chu tshad rgyun chad med par gong 'phel yong thabs bya dgos/gsum/ dge rgan gyi dpung khag brtan lhing 'ongs bar dam 'dzin bya dgos/byang tshad mtho la brtan snying yin pa'i dge rgan gyi dpung khag cig 'dzugs rgyu ni byang tshad slob gso lag bstar byed pa'i ches rtsa bar gyur pa'i 'gan srung yin/ 'jon thang shin tu che ba'i slob spyi zhig la byang tshad mtho la brtan snying yin pa'i dge rgan gyi dpung khag cig med na mi 'grig pas/slob gso'i srid 'dzin sde khag dang 'go khrid kyis nges par du dge rgan gyi skyid sdug la do 'khur byas te kho tsho'i 'tsho ba dang las ka'i cha rkyen/ thob thang /zab sbyong / chab srid bsam blo sogs kyi thad nas srid jus las mi 'da' ba'i sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen 'og kho tshor dmigs bsal gyis lta rtogs rogs ram byas te mi tshe hril por dge rgan byed pa'i sems rtsa brtan po zhig 'dzugs thub pa bya dgos/ bye brag tu dge rgan gyi ngal rtsol ni gzhan dang thun mong min pa'i khyad chos ldan par yid gzab byas te kho tsho'i ngal rtsol la brtsi mthong bya dgos/ de ltar byas na na gzhon dge rgan zhig la cha mtshon na'ang / gzhon dus slob khrid la ma byang pa nas lo mang gi slob khrid kyi myong ba dang / goms 327

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/'dris las byang par gyur te/ dmag dpon dmag jus la mkhas pa dang dmag mi dpa' rtsal dod pa'i mkha' 'og 'gran med kyi dmag dpung zhig dang 'dra ba 'byung bas de ltar na da gzod slob gso'i byang tshad gong du 'degs par the mi tshom/bzhi/ dge rgan gyi thob thang mtho ru gtong dgos/ rang rgyal gyi dge rgan gyi thob thang de sngar dang bsdur na da lta mtho ru phyin yod mod/ 'on kyang las rigs gzhan dang bsdur na da dung dma' sa bzung nas bsdad yod/de'i rkyen gyis byang tshad shin tu mtho ba'i mi sna'i yid dbang 'gugs ma thub pa ste/ mtho rim slob 'bring dang / dma' rim slob 'bring gi slob ma rnams dge 'os sde tshan la rgyugs gtong mkhan shin tu nyung ba dang / slob grwa chen mo nas thon mkhan rnams thabs shes yod rgu rtsal sprugs kyis slob gso'i sde tshan min pa'i las gnas shig tu 'tsho lam 'tshol ba dang / slob grwa'i nang byang tshad mtho ba'i dge rgan mang po zhig las rigs gzhan du gang thub ci thub kyis las bsgyur byed pa sogs kyi rkyen gtso bo ni 'tsho ba'i steng gi dngos yod gnas tshul yin/ de dag gi 'byung rtsa chu mgo gangs la thug pa lta bu ni dge rgan gyi thob thang de las rigs gzhan las don dngos thog dma' ba la brten nas byung bas/ des dge rgan dpung khag gi byang tshad mtho ru gtong rgyur bkag rdo'i nus pa thon yod phyir/ nges par du dge rgan gyi gla cha'i thob thang mtho ru gtong rgyu de don chen zhig tu bzung nas thag gcod byas na da gzod shes ldan mi sna'i rin thang mtho ru 'gro nges dang / gzhi nas dge rgan gyi byang tshad la gson shugs ldan la skul 'ded shugs chen thebs te shes ldan mi sna 'gran 328

dge rgan gyi byang tshad skor gyi bsam gzhigs 'ga'i skor/rtsod byed pa'i khrom ra yangs par bshang thub nges so/ /lnga/ grags can dge rgan gso skyong byed pa'i 'dzin grwa 'dzugs dgos/ shes yon la mthong chen dang / shes yon can la mthong chen byas te slob grwas rig tshan mi 'dra ba'i khyab khongs su grags can dge rgan skas rim bzhin gso skyong bya dgos/ de'ang rtsa ba'i byang tshad mtho ba bzhi dgos pa ste/deng rabs kyi chab srid bsam blo'i byang tshad mtho ba dang gcig kun spyod kyi byang tshad mtho ba dang gnyis/ rig gnas kyi byang tshad mtho ba dang gsum/gzugs khams kyi byang tshad mtho ba dang bzhi bcas la brten nas dge rgan yongs kyi kun spyod mig dpe dang / sngon thon slob gso sne khrid/ slob khrid mkhas can/ slob gso bsgyur bcos dang / tshan rig zhib 'jug gi 'go khrid mkhan de grags can dge rgan gso yul du gtan la 'bebs dgos/gso thabs ni las gnas su dge slob lta bu'i 'brel ba btsugs te rgan pas gzhon khrid dang / bslab pa mtho bas dman pa khrid rgyu'i gtan 'bebs srol yig bzo rgyu dang / gzhan yang las gnas las bral te ched du grags can slob chen du zab sbyong byed par mngags gtong bya thabs la brten nas/gcig nas srol rgyun rig gnas kyi legs cha brgyud spel dang / gnyis nas rig pa gsar spel gyi thabs la brten nas glog rdul rtsis rgyag 'khor lo dang /glog 'phrul slob khrid/ tshod lta bcas deng rabs can gyi slob khrid kyi ma lag 'dzugs thub mkhan gso skyong bya dgos/ grags can dge rgan la skul 'ded kyi gzengs bstod lam lugs 'dzugs dgos pa ste dper na/ phul byung gi na gzhon dge rgan zhes pa'i gzengs bstod dang / shes ldan mi sna bskyed 329

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/bsrings byas pa'i gzengs bstod/ dge rgan gyi las ka'i dpyad sdom lo gsum bstud mar phul byung gi gzengs bstod/ slob gso slob khrid zhib 'jug gi brtsams 'bras kyi gzengs bstod/ lus rtsal dang / mdzes rtsal/glu gzhas sogs la khyad yon ldan pa'i mi sna bskyangs pa'i gzengs bstod/slob grwa dang / sa khul/ ljongs rim pa'i slob khrid mkhan po'i gzengs bstod bcas la brten nas mig dpe lta yul gyi grags can dge rgan gyi gzugs brnyan bzhengs nas khyon yongs kyis slob gsor lhag bsam rnam par dag cing slob mar brtse ba gzhan phan gyi bsam pa 'dzugs rgyur skul 'ded gtong dgos/gzhan yang ji skad du/ 'ju mi pham gyis/ legs par mthar phyin sbyangs gyur na/ /gzhung cig shes kyang nyi ma bzhin/ /the tshom dang bcas gzhung mang po/ /'dzin blom byas kyang rgyu skar 'dra/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/dge rgan gyi khrod du slob gso slob khrid kyi rnam 'dren mi sna lta bu rigs gcig mkhas can gso ba'i lam bu bshangs te dge rgan gyi byang tshad mtho ru gtong dgos pa'o/ /mdor na/ byang tshad slob gso lag bstar bya thub min ni/ mi rigs hril po'i byang tshad mtho ru gtong thub min gyi 'gag rtsa dang / dge rgan gyi byang tshad mtho dma' ni byang tshad slob gso lag bstar thub min gyi 'gag rtsa yin pa lung dang rigs pa brgya phrag gis grub pas/ 'dir kho bos nges par du dge rgan gyi byang tshad mtho ru gtong dgos zhes skad gsang mthon pos 'bod sgra sgrog rgyu yin/330

'du shes gsar pa las byung ba'i g.yur za'i 'bras bu/bcings 'grol btang tsam la gzhis rtse grong khyer 'dir 'tsho sdod byed mkhan mi grangs khri gcig tsam las med pa dang grong mi'i sdod khang dang /khrom srang / gzhung lam bcas btsog la gtsang sbra zhan pa'i gnas shig yin mod/ 'on kyang dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur btang rjes dang / lhag par du bsgyur bcos sgo dbye byas pa nas bzung / gom pa rim bgrod kyis phyogs gang cir gnam sa bla 'og gi bsgyur ba lta bu'i 'gyur ldog byung ste/ phyi snod kyi bkod pa maldas shing lta na sdug pa dang / nang sems can rnams ya rabs spyod pa'i dpal yon 'dzin zhing / rang rang gi blo gros dang / spyang grung /shes rab la brten nas nyam thag dbul po'i gnas las rnam par grol te phyug 'gyur gyi lam bu bshangs/ blun rmongs dang rjes lus/ rnying zhen dang rmongs dad kyi gnyid las sad de shes rab kyi sgron me btegs/ 'das pa'i dus kyi rnying pa thams cad lha ru mthong / gsar pa thams cad 'dre ru mthong zhes pa'i dus las ring du 'das te shes rig dpal 'byor smra ba dang / cha 'phrin gyi dus rabs/ nub rgyud thon 'byed/ shes bya'i rba klong 'phyur ba'i dus rab gsar pa'i bgros dang bstun pa'i 'du shes gsar ba'i rjes su bsnyegs te 'gran rtsod kyi lam du rgyu/ yul 'di na sna mang gnyer skyong dang /rig pa gsar spel/ cha 'phrin bya gzhag yul skor 'grim 'grul/ 33༵tsho

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/thabs/ bsam pa'i dpal yon bcas kyi thad lo rgyus thog byung myong med pa'i rnam pa gsar rkyang zhig byung yod pa 'di lta ste/dang po/ sna mang gnyer skyong gis 'tsho lam gsar gtod mdzad pa/gzhis rtse grong khyer mi dmangs srid gzhung gis rgyal gnyer khe las dang mnyam sdeb khe las bsgyur bcos dang / do dam bya gzhag la shugs snon/shang grong khe las kyi sna mang gnyer skyong bcas dam 'dzin shugs chen byas pa ste/mi rigs rang nyid kyi khyad yon 'don slad/ mi rigs rang nyid kyi srol rgyun lag shes bzo las gnyer skyong bya rgyu de ang dang por bzhag nas bkra shis skyed tshal dngul chas bzo grwa dang / grong khyer kha gdan bzo grwa/ lcags bzo hre/gyon chas bzo grwa/ khyad par du gzhis rtse'i lcags thab dang / lcags sgam/zon pa lha mo thon skyed bya rgyur mthong chen byas te spyi lo 1999lor yong 'bab sgor khri 1244 56byung ste khe las dpal 'byor gyi phan 'bras dngos su thon/nye ba'i lo shas nange du krung dbyang gi byams brtse'i gzigs skyong dang /rgyal yongs kyi shugs che'i bod skyor/ ching ta'o grong khyer gyis rang don ring du spangs shing gzhan don lhur len gyis dngul rtsa sgor khri 100rgyab skyor gnang ba dang gnad 'phigs kyis bed spyad de rgya khyon la smi gru bzhi ma 138yod pa'i shang grong khe las phyogs bsdus zhabs zhu'i lte gnas khang zhig gtsang gi 'dzin ma'i lte bar 'gying nger gsare du bzhengs/ des khe las 332

'du shes gsar pa las byung ba'i g.yur za'i 'bras bu/dpal 'byor gnyer skyong bya rgyur 'go khrid dang blo 'don byas te/ khe las kyi dpal 'byor gong 'phel dang / 'gran rtsod kyi nus pa che ru gtong rgyur phan 'bras dngos thon/ grong khyer srid gzhung gis spyi lo 1995nas 'go brtsams te ma rtsa sgor khri 600btang nas snga rjes su g.yang ṭi'i bzo grwa dang /bza' chas bzo grwa/ sha rigs mkho 'don bzo grwa/ so phag bzo grwa/ snum snon sa tshigs gsum bcas khe las gtso bo che ba brgyad gnyer skyong byas pa'i khar/ tshwa dang rdo chas gtsor byas pa'i rngog 'don las rigs dang / 'bru snum dang shing chas gtsor byas pa'i las snon las rigs/ tshong khang dang 'grul khang bza' chas gtsor byas pa'i zhabs zhu'i las rigs/ las grwa 'gan gtsang gtsor byas pa'i 'dzugs skrun las rigs/ 'grul skyel dang tshong zog dbor 'dren gtsor byas pa'i skyel 'dren las rigs/ phag pa dang bya de gtsor byas pa'i gso spel las rigs/ sha mar thud gsum dang tshal rigs gtsor byas pa'i nyer mkho'i bza' chas khe tshong las rigs/ gsol ja dang chang rigs gtsor byas pa'i btung bya'i las rigs/ gshag lcam gtsor byas pa'i shing chas khe tshong las rigs/ tshags par dang dus deb gtsor byas pa'i dpe tshong las rigs bcas sna mang gnyer skyong gi lam bu yangs pa gsar du bshangs te spyi lo 1999lor yong 'bab sdom rtsis byas pa 'di lta ste/333
skreṭī trīḍiṭī/

'du shes gsar pa las byung ba'i g.yur za'i 'bras bu/khri 16161 48byung ba de spyi lo 1992lo dang bsdur na yong 'bab ldab gcig 'phar yod pa red/ des na 'das pa'i dus su zhing pas zhing las kho na dang / 'brog pas 'brog las kho na/ grong mis tshong las kho na byas te rang mkho rang 'don dang / khoms chung nus med/ sgo brgya dam par bsdams nas 'tsho thabs bya ba shin tu gu dog cing ya nga ba'i thon skyed bya lugs dang / khe gnyer bya lugs/ 'tsho sdod bya lugs kyi lus po rnying pa de la dus rabs yar rgyas kyi 'phar rtsa lding zhing sngon thon gyi snying khrag rgyu ba/bsgyur bcos kyi srog gi dbang po bcas zhugs te yul 'di'i dpal 'byor mnga' thang rgyas shing / spyi tshogs mdun skyod dang mi rigs dar rgyas 'ongs phyir ma 'ongs pa'i lam bu gsar pa zhig 'byed do//gnyis pa/ rig gnas slob gso dar spel gyis skye bo'i byang tshad mtho ru btegs/bsgyur bcos sgo dbye byas pa las grong khyer 'di'i skye bo rnams kyi bsam pa'i 'du shes 'dzin stangs kyi khyab khongs la 'gyur ldog chen po 'byung rgyu ni phyogs gang ci'i thad 'gyur ba 'ongs pa'i 'byung rtsa dper na myu gu skyes par byed pa'i sa bon lta bu zhig yin te/1 rig gnas kyi byang tshad mtho ru gtong rgyur mthong chen byas pa ste/thog mar grong khyer u yon lhan khang dang / grong khyer srid gzhung gis bskal brgya'i jus chen gyi rtsa ba slob gsor thug par ngos 'dzin rnam dag gnang ste/335

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/dge rgan dpung khag 'dzugs skrun bya rgyu'i thad dmigs bsal gyi thugs 'khur zab bzhes kyis grong khyer nor srid yong 'bab kyi brgya cha 15slob gsor btang ba dang / spyi lo 1993lo nas bzung slob gsor ma dngul sgor khri 212btang ba dang sbrags gzhis rtse grong khyer slob gso yar spel gyi thebs rtsa lhan tshogs btsugs te da lta dngul sgor khri 150tsam yod pa red/ nye ba'i lo shas nang nang sa'i spun zla zhing chen gyi shugs che'i rgyab skyor dang / rang nus yod rgu rtsal sprugs bton par brten nas da lta gzhis rtse grong khyer khul du grong khyer slob chung brgya dang so gsum/ shang lte ba'i slob chung bcu/ phugs re'i slob chung gnyis/ spyi'i ma rtsa sgor khri 1408btang nas slob 'bring gcig gsar du bzhengs pa dang / grong tsho'i slob chung brgya dang nyer bzhi rgya bskyed du btang bar brten nas lo chung byis pa rnams slob grwar 'gro ba'i cha rkyen gsar du bskrun/ deng gi char pha mas mi rabs rjes mar mthong chen gyis rang gi phru gu shes yon can zhig chags phyir slob grwar gang thub ci thub kyis gtong ba'i rnam pa gsar pa zhig thon pa dang gcig sbyang bya'i rig tshan gyi rnam grangs rang mi rigs kyi skad yig gtsor byas thog rgya yig dang /dbyin yig rtsis dang / sa khams/ dngos khams/ rdzas 'gyur rig pa/glu gzhas/ mdzes rtsal/ lo rgyus sogs kun la don gnyer byed pa dang gnyis/ glog rdul rtsis rgyag 'phrul 'khor sogs rig pa gsar pa sbyong sa'i slob zhor dang las zhor sbyong brdar 'dzin grwa je mang du phyin pa dang gsum/pha mas phru gus rig pa sbyong ched 'gro song gtong phod pa dang bzhi/ khyim tshang nang du dge rgan gdan 'dren gyis khyim tshang slob gso'i srol bzang dar ba 336

'du shes gsar pa las byung ba'i g.yur za'i 'bras bu/dang lnga/ deng khul 'dir lo na lon pa'i byis pa slob zhugs kyi tshad de brgya cha'i 97 3la slebs pa dang / slob zhugs sra brtan gyi tshad de brgya cha'i 99zin pa/ slob grwa thon tshad brgya cha'i 98 2la slebs pa dang drug bcas g.yur za'i 'bras bzang la brten nas gzhis rtse grong khyer 'di ljongs yongs kyi 'os 'gan slob gso dang / rmang gzhi'i slob gso'i sngon thon grong khyer du bdams thon byung /2 bza' zla 'tshol ba dang bu btsas pa'i rnam par 'gyur ldog chen po byung ba ste/ dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas dang / mi'i byang tshad mtho dman gyi dbang gis bza' zla 'tshol ba'i dmigs tshad dang srol lugs la'ang 'gyur ba 'ong bar gdon mi za ba ste/ 'das pa'i dus na bu mos dmag mi dang / kha lo ba/ las byed pa zhig rang gi blo gtad bcol yul dam par brtsis te de'i rjes su 'jug par byed/ da lta'i dus 'dir cing li dang / sbyin bdag pa/khe las mkhas can/ rigs gcig mkhas can sogs la blo kha 'gyur ba dang gcig spyir tshan rig dang rig gnas dar rgyas che ba'i rgyal khab dang sa khul du phru gu btsa' mkhan de bas nyung ba thon gyi yod pa ltar yul 'di la'ang skye bo'i byang tshad de gom pa rim bgrod kyis mtho ru phyin par brten khyo shug gsar pa'i khrod du rang 'gul gyis bu phrug nyung tsam skye ba dang / bu phrug spus dag skye ba/ bu gcig las mi skye ba'i phyogs su 'gyur ba dang gnyis so/ /3 tshong gnyer bya ba'i rnam par 'gyur ldog byung ba ste/ 'das pa'i dus tshong zog gi bdag pos dngos pos dngos por brje res byed pa/ dper na 'brog pas phar bal sprad na zhing pas tshur 'bru rigs sprod pa lta bu'i dngos 337

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/zog brje res kho na'i dus las ring du 'das te dngul lor la brten nas tshong gnyer byed pa dang gcig 'bru rigs la sogs lo 'khor mor 'bru mdzod nang du nyar tshags bya ba'i srol las 'das te/ dngos zog dngul sgor la bsgyur nas sna mang khe tshong bya ba'i srol kha 'byed pa dang gnyis/ khang gla gtong ba dang / 'grul khang gnyer ba/ 'grim 'grul rlangs 'khor brten pa/tshong khang che chung 'dzugs pa/ lho tshong byang du bskyal ba dang / byang tshong lho ru 'dren pa las/ khrom ra'i dpal 'byor 'khrug cha dod du btang ba dang gsum bcas las nga che nga rlom dang / phyi bkag nang sdom gyi bsam pa'i 'du shes las grol ba mngon no/ /4 tshan rig la yid ches byed shugs che ba'i phyogs su 'gyur ldog byung ba ste/ zhing pa rnams kyis zhing 'phrul la brten nas dpyid rmod dang / ston bsdu/ son bzang brje res/ rdzas lud dang zhing sman bed spyod bcas byas pa'i thog nas tshan rig ni thon skyed nus shugs ang dang po yin zhes par yid ches dngos byung ba dang gcig zas sna 'dzoms shing / 'grim 'grul stabs bde ba/ rig rtsal 'tsho ba phun tshogs su phyin pa dang gnyis/ 'byung lus nad kyi 'khrug pa byung tsa na phyi lugs bod lugs la sogs pa'i sman par bsten pa las rtsis pa dang mo pa la bsten mkhan nyung du phyin pa dang gsum/ tang gi chos dad rang mos kyi srid jus yang dag yod par brten/ chos la dad cing sku 'gyed gnang mkhan yod rung 'das pa'i dus dang bsdur na chos la dad zhen dang / zhabs brtan byed mkhan/ zhabs skor la 'gro mkhan/ zhal 'debs gnang mkhan nyung du phyin te dpal 'byor 'dzugs skrun dang tshan rig 338

'du shes gsar pa las byung ba'i g.yur za'i 'bras bu/dang / rig gnas dar rgyas gtong rgyu de lte bar 'jog pa'i phyogs su blo kha gtad pa dang bzhi/ zhing pas gnam gshis sngon brda dang / le tā la yid ches byed pa las ser srung bla ma la yid ches mi byed pa dang lnga bcas so /5 dwangs gtsang khor yug gi rnam pa baspun byur 'gyur sdog byung ba ste/de'ang 'das pa'i dus kyi skyag gcin gang sar gtong ba dang / gad snyigs gang sar dbyugs pa/ srang lam btsog snyigs kyis khengs pa'i rnam par 'gyur ba byung ste deng rabs can gyi gsang spyod mang du skrun pa dang / gad snyigs blugs sgam mang po bsham pa las gna' bo'i grong khyer gnyis pa'i rnam par zu—ra rgyan spras pa dang gcig yul mi rnams kyis gang sar btsog gcin mi gtong bar grong khyer srang lam gad bdar bzo pas rtag tu phyags pa las grong khyer gtsang sbra dod du phyin pa dang gnyis/ dpal 'byor gra rgyas phyin rung skye bo'i glo mchin la gnod pa'i tha mag 'then mkhan nyung du phyin pa dang /khyad par du grong khyer khul gyi slob grwa dang / las khungs mang dag cig la du med slob grwa dang / du med las khungs zhes sgo byang bkal ba dang gsum/ lo ltar shing 'dzugs nags bzo'i dus su grong khyer nang gi srang lam g.yas g.yon dang / grong khyer nye 'dabs su shing 'dzugs nags bzo'i byed sgo spel te skye khams khor yug legs bcos dang thal rlung che ba'i rnam par 'gyur ldog byung ba dang bzhi/ grong khyer gyi 'grim 'grul/ bde 'jags/ gtsang sbra/'char bkod/ khrom ra bcas kyi rnam par rtog zhib byed mkhan gyi las khungs gsar du btsugs pa dang lnga/ da lta ya rabs kyi dpal dang ldan zhing /khams gtsang gi khor yug ldan pa'i grong khyer gyi srol lam gsar pa zhig rgyal 339

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/khab phyi nang gi skye bo rnams kyi gzugs 'dzin dbang po'i mdun du 'char dang 'char mus lags/ gsum pa/ srid jus dril bsgrags/phyi phyogs dang rgyal nang du srid jus dril bsgrags bya rgyu ni rang re'i tang gi bsam blo'i chab srid las don gyi grub cha gal chen zhig yin gshis/thog mar grong ud dang grong khyer mi dmangs srid gzhung gis tang dang srid gzhung gi mgrin tshab lta bu'i dril bsgrags lag cha dang dril bsgrags las khungs gnyer rgyur mthong chen byas te lo shas nang grong khyer rgyang bsgrags las khungs dang / glog brnyan las khungs/ skor bskyod glog brnyan ston mkhan bcas kyis tsho pa bdun dang / shang bcu la sa ngos rlung 'phrin brgyud gtong sa tshugs dang / brnyan 'phrin las khungs/ tshags par las khungs/ rig rtsal 'khrab ston ru khag btsugs nas rang rang gi khyad nus 'don spel gyis tang gi mdzad phyogs srid jus dus thog tu dril bsgrags gang legs byas pa dang gcig gzhis rtse grong khyer ni mes rgyal gong bu gcig gyur srung skyong dang / kha phral la ngo rgol bya bar g.yul sa'i mkhar rdzong lta bur gnas yod gshis/ dril bsgrags kyi lag cha de dag gis mang tshogs la tang krung dbyang dang / ljongs tang ud kyis tā la'i ru tshogs la 'dzin pa'i byed phyogs dang srid jus/ de bzhin nga tsho dang tā la'i ru tshogs bar gyi 'thab rtsod kyi ngo bo gang yin gtso gnad du gsal bsgrags byas pa dang gnyis/ khyad par du paṇa 340

'du shes gsar pa las byung ba'i g.yur za'i 'bras bu/chen sku phreng bcu pa'i yang srid ngos 'dzin byed skabs gser bum dkrug pa'i lo rgyus kyi byung ba ngo sprod dang dril bsgrags legs par byas pa dang gsum/grong khyer tang ud dang srid gzhung / srid gros kyis dgon sder slob gso'i las don tshogs chung sgrig 'dzugs byas te dgon sde khag gi grwa btsun la tang gi mdzad phyogs dang / srid jus/ khrims lugs/ mi rigs mthun sgril/rgyal gces chos gces bcas kyi dril bsgrags slob gso rgya cher byas pa dang bzhi/ (gzhis rtse grong khyer gyi spyi lo 1996ge2000lo'i spyi tshogs bde 'jags khyon yongs nas bcos skyong bya rgyu'i las don 'char bkod〉 gtan la phab pa dang lnga/ shugs chen gyis gtsang khul gyi spyi tshogs brtan lhing dang /mi rigs mthun sgril/ bsgyur bcos sgo dbye/ dpal 'byor 'dzugs skrun/mi rigs rang skyong sogs bya rgyu dang mi dmangs rang nyid la dmangs gtso'i khe dbang yod pa'i skor gyi tang gi mdzad phyogs srid jus phyi nang kun tu dril bsgrags byas pa dang drug lhag par du tang krung dbyang gi nub rgyud thon 'byed chen po'i dgongs gzhi dang / don snying dril bsgrags bya rgyu dang bdun/gna' grong gtsang gi ser skya mang tshogs kyis blo dkar tang la phyogs te spyi lo 1989lo'i zla 5tshes26nyin paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa'i sku gdung gdan 'dren dang rab gnas kyi mdzad sgo/ 'dzam gling yongs kyis brtsi mthong byed pa'i paṇa chen sku phreng bcu gcig pa gtsang bkra shis lhun por zhabs sor pad mo 'khod pa'i dga' bsu dang / khyad par du spyi lo 1991lor tang dang rgyal khab kyi dbu 'dzin spyi khyab hru'u ci cang tse min mchog gtsang bkra shis lhun por zhabs sor 'khod pa'i dus dang khong gis phyag bstar gnang ba'i rgyal 341

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/skyong 'gro phan zhes pa'i gser yig gi pan de 1996lo'i zla5tshes 28nyin bkal ba'i mdzad sgo sogs tang dang rgyal khab kyi mdzad sgo gal chen khag bde blag ngang bsgrubs/ des 'dzam gling kun gyis brtsi mthong byed pa'i grong khyer 'di'i spyi tshogs dang chab srid kyi gnas bab brtan snying yin pa ngang gis rtogs par gyur/bzhi pa/ bsgyur bcos sgo dbye byas pas 'tsho ba'i rnam par 'gyur ldog byung ba/blo mthun teng zha'o phing gis btod pa'i bsgyur bcos sgo dbye kyi lam bu ni mnga' 'bangs bde skyid dang / rgyal khab stobs 'byor/ mnga' thang dar rgyas 'gro ba'i bgrod lam nyag cig yin pa don dngos las ra sprod byung ba ste/ nye ba'i lo shas nang gtsang gi grong khyer 'dir gzhis chags 'tsho sdod byed pa'i skye bo rnams kyi bsam pa'i 'du shes kyi 'gyur ba las byung ba'i bza' chas dang / 'thung chas/ gyon chas/ sdod khang sogs phyogs gang ci'i thad lo rgyus rang bzhin gyi 'gyur ba chen po byung yod pa ste/1 rol rtsed rig gnas/ 'das pa'i dus na mi rnams mnyam du 'du tshogs byas te chang 'thung bzhin bod gzhas rgyag pa'am chang glu gtong ba/yang na 'gas sho rtse ba dang / sbag chen rgyag pa tsam du zad/ bsgyur bcos sgo dbye kyi dri bsung gtsang gi sa gzhi chen po 'dir 'thul ba nas bzung rig gnas rol rtsed kyi rnam grangs je mang du phyin yod pa ste spyan zung 'phrul ba'i 342

'du shes gsar pa las byung ba'i g.yur za'i 'bras bu/glog 'phrul rol rtsed dang / brnyan phab khang gi ltad mo/ sgra bsdu sgra phab 'khor lo'i snyan dbyangs/ lta bas mi ngoms pa'i gzugs mthong brnyan 'phrin/ ril ril stegs sgrom spo lo dang rkang rtsed lag rtsed spo lo/ gzhon nu'i sgeg nyams dod pa'i sbrang si/ 'gyur khug stong dang ldan pa'i kha la o khe(ṣ+kakhri05) rtsed nas chog mi shes pa'i mā cang / ja khang nang gi tag ze/dga' bde'i glu gar gyer khang nang ma zhes pa/ rig stobs 'gran pa'i shang chi mig mangs/ khyad par du gtsang gi mang tshogs sgyu rtsal khang gis las 'khyur rgan khog sgrig 'dzugs byas te spen skyid zlos gar tshogs pa zhes pa gsar du btsugs pa las bgres song gi lus la gzhon nu'i lang tsho mngon zhing /pho gzhon mo gzhon gyi bzhin las spro snang gi mdangs shig 'char bzhin mchis/2 dar srol che ba'i gyon chas/ 'das pa'i dus tsa na/ gtsang gi khul 'dir gyon chas gtso bo snam chas dar che zhing da lta gyon chas kyi rgyu cha dang bzo lta/ rtags can tshon mdog sogs la dang dod chen po byed pa'i phyogs su 'gyur ldog chen po byung ste mi rnams kyis ngal rtsol byed bde ba dang gyon bde ba'i phyir rgya chas rgyun gyon byed mkhan mang bar mchis pa dang / gyon chas kyi bzo lta'ang bod chas kyi bzo lta dang phyi lugs kyi bzo lta/ krung go'i lugs kyi bzo lta/ dpe gsar gyi bzo lta/ de dag gi rgyu cha'i rnam grangs mang ba dang tshon mdog rnam par bkra ba yod pa dang / de dang chabs cig bod bzo'i gyon chas kyi bzo lta la'ang bsgyur bcos shugs chen byas te bu mo'i phyu pa dang /'og 'jug sogs kyi gyon chas mig gi snang ngor rmerdzas shing lta na sdug pa dang /bzo lta dod pa'i dpe gsar gyi phyogs su legs bcos byas te grong khyer nang du 343

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/bod chas mgo nas rting bar gyon mkhan ni lo na shin tu bgres pa'i rgan rgon rnams las med pa dang da lta'i dus 'dir bod chas ngo ma ni rgan rgon rnams kyi gyon chas lta bu dang / bod rigs rnams kyis tshes bzang dus bzang dang rten 'brel mdzad sgo'i dus chen gyi skabs su gyon pa'i gzab mchor gyi gyon chas shig tu gyur/ des na rnying pas gsar pa'i tshab byed mi thub pa dang /'das pa'i dus kyis da lta'i dus kyi tshab byed mi thub par lo rgyus 'phel rgyas kyi 'khor lo'i rjes su bsnyegs na 'di dang 'di'i dpal dang / de dang de'i dpal 'thob par nges pa ngang gis bstan/3 ro brgya'i bza' bangung phun sum tshogs/ 'das pa'i dus tsa na bza' chas gtso bo rtsam pa dang / gro zhib/ thug pa/ tshag sha lug shal phug zhog khog pad tshal tsam du zad pa dang / da lta bza' bya'i rnam grangs dang / snga dgong dang nyin gung dus kyi bza' bya'i rigs la'ang 'gyur ldog chen po byung yod de/ tshal rigs la mtshon na mes rgyal nang sa nas dbor 'dren byas pa'i sa dma' sa'i tshal rigs sogs dang / bod yul du skyes pa'i so lo dmar rtsi la sogs pa'i tshal rigs rnam grangs mi 'dra ba sna brgya tsam rang 'dod ltar sngo tshod kyi khrom rar nyo rgyu yod pa dang / sha rigs la mtshon na/ tshag sha lug sha bya sha nya sha ri bong gi sha dang / rgya mtsho'i gting gi rus sbal sdig srin la sogs dang / sgong rigs la mtshon na/ngang dkar gyi sgo nga dang / rgya bya'i sgo nga / bod bya'i sgo nga / gong mo dang bya sreg pa'i sgo nga sogs dang / shing 'bras dang / 'o ma bcas sngo tshod kyi ra ba de sngar med 'khrug cha dod du phyin pa dang / de bzhin 'bru rigs la mtshon 344

'du shes gsar pa las byung ba'i g.yur za'i 'bras bu/na yang / sngar 'char ldan dpal 'byor gyi dus las rbad de 'das te khrom rar gang mkho gang nyo'i dus shig shar te rtsam pa dang / dkar mo nas/'bras dkar po dang / 'bras nag po/ gro zhib la mtshon na/ rgya zhib/bod zhib/ bal po'i gro zhib sogs khrom ra dar rgyas che bas da lta grong mi'i khyim du snga dro ja bsrubs ma dang mnyam du go re rlangs btsos (7ṭ+wā)dang /yang na bag leb/ yang na glog sreg go re(khrothu)nyin gung 'bras dang / ro brgya ldan pa'i tshal rigs sna tshogs/ yang na sha 'bras/ dgong mo rgya thugabod thug sog thug 'bras thug sha mog dpal zhib/ tsa'o tse bcas rang gi khams dang mos ltar bza' btung bya rgyu yod pa'i 'tsho ba'i goms gshis gsar pa zhig chags te rgyun srol bza' bya'i rigs kyi gong tshad chag 'gro ba dang / grong khyer nang du rtsam pa za mkhan nyung du 'gro ba bcas las bza' bya'i rnam grangs phun tshogs su phyin pa 'di dag ni yul 'di'i 'tsho ba dang spyi tshogs yar rgyas phyin pa'i rtags so/ /'tsho ba'i yo chas dang bud shing la mtshon na de snga'i bud shing lci ba gtsor byas pa'i me thab la brten nas 'tsho ba bskyal ba'i dus las 'das te da lta khyim tshang so so'i mkho bab la bstun pa'i nyi thab/ snum thab/ glog thab/ sol rlung thab bcas dar ba dang /glog 'phrul las byung ba'i rgya thug che phra chung gsum dang / sog thug stabs bde'i rgya thug dang / bkol chas thad rdza las grub pa'i ja nyir me glang dang thug khru dag bed spyod byed mkhan rim pas nyung du phyin te/ ja dam che chung sna tshogs dang / mtho gnon sla nga sogs dar khyab che bas 'tsho bar stabs bde bskrun/ btung bya'i thad 'das pa'i dus kyi bod chang dang bod ja/ ja 345

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/mngar mo yod pa phud/ yul klung mi 'dra ba las thon pa'i sbi rag gi rigs dang a rag rigs btung bya sna brgya yod pa bcas las khyim tshang gi sbag lcog gru bzhi'i steng du bza' btung gi rnam grangs dang ro bcud spus tshad legs su phyin te 'tsho ba yar zla'i dpal dang mtshungs/ 'das pa'i dus tsa na yul 'di'i gshis lugs su skye bo pho mo rgan gzhon dang lhag par du bu mo za khang dang / ja khang / chang khang nang 'dzul na shin tu tha shal dang / ngo tsha dgos pa'i ma rabs pa'i spyod tshul zhig tu mngon nas mi rnams kyis 'phya mod bya yul du 'gyur gyi yod/ 'on tang deng gi char 'tsho ba'i goms gshis dang bsam pa'i 'du shes 'dzin stangs la gsar brje chen po byung ste za khang dang / ja khang / chang khang / nang ma/ glu gar khang nang rang gi 'dod blo ltar 'gro ba la rang nyid 'tsher snang med pa dang / gzhan gyis 'phya smod dang / dma' 'bebs gtong mkhan med par gyur pa 'di ni/ kho bos bltas na 'di ni nang gi sems rgyud la 'gyur ba byung ba de phyi'i spyod tshul las mngon pa e re skan/4 sdod khang gsar rgyag bcings 'grol btang tsam la gzhis rtse grong khyer 'dir rgya phibs gser 'od chem chem 'tsher ba'i dpal bkra shis lhun po dgon dang / brjid chags yid dga'i bsam grub rtse rdzong phud bkod pa legs pa'i khang bzang ches nyung bar mngon pa dang / lhag par du grong mi'i sdod khang thabs chag tsam du zad/ 'on tang nye ba'i lo shas ring gtsang gi yangs shing gshin pa'i sa gzhi chen po 'di'i steng hran tung thog brtsegs khang bzang gis gtsos shel brag gnam la zug pa lta bu'i bkod legs khang bzang 346

'du shes gsar pa las byung ba'i g.yur za'i 'bras bu/tshom bu dang tshom bu bskrun pa'i khar las la brtson pa'i yul mi rnams kyis rang gi lag gnyis la brten nas pha yul 'dzugs skrun bya ba'i mtho rlabs shig dgung du 'phyur te/ spyi lo 1996lor ar rgyag gi rgya khyon smi gru bzhi ma5000lhag tsam dang / spyi lo 1997lor ar rgyag gi rgya khyon smi gru bzhi ma9579 22zin te sngar gzhung khang du 'tsho sdod byed mkhan rnams rang gis gsar du bzhengs pa'i sger khang yid 'ong rab gsal gyi nang du spos/khyim bdag tsho'i bzhin ras nang rang khyim rang bdag byung ba'i mdangs shig phyung ba dang / deng gi ar rgyag rgyu cha'i ngos nas brjod na/ 'byor pa rgyas pa rnams kyis sngar sa phag las bzhengs pa'i khang pa rnams bshig nas/ ar 'dam las grub pa'i khang bzang 'gyings nger bzhengs/ khang pa'i bzo dbyibs kyang sngar rdo ring bstan 'dzin dpal 'byor rgya nag du byon pa'i skabs kyi rgya nag rgyal po'i pho brang gi bkod pa dang 'dra bar phal mo che rkyang thog yin rung 'gyings cha mtho ba'i dbang gis rgyang nas bltas na nyis thog cig dang yang dag mtshungs pa zhig mngon/ de min rang yul las thon pa'i shing cha dang / sa rdo bed spyod gang legs byas khar/ ar 'dam dang /lcags rtsibs/ ha yang lcags bsres ma/ tshon khra can gyi shel/ tshon ris rnam par bkra ba'i gyang shog lcags dang ar 'dam bsres ma'i ka gdung /so phag sogs rgyu cha sna mang gi phyogs su 'gyur ba dang / khang pa'i mdzes ris bkod 'bri'i thad/ brkos dkrol can gyi ka gdung dang chu ris kyi dra ma rnam bkra'i tshon ris/ khang pa'i bzo dbyibs dang bkod pa de gcig nas bod mi rigs kyi khyad chos dmigs bsal ldan pa dang / gnyis nas mi rigs gzhan 347

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/gyi ar rgyag lag rtsal gyi legs cha'i snying bcud bsdus te bskrun pa las gna' nyams dang / da lta'i sgyu rtsal gyi mdzes nyams ldan pa'i khang bzang gtsang gi grong khyer chen po 'dir ha cang mang /5 blog 'phrul sna brgya/ deng rabs can gyi lag rtsal dang / tshan rig dar rgyas ches cher phyin pa las gtsang gi grong khyer 'dir rgyun par mkho gal che ba'i 'tsho ba'i yo chas gzugs mthong brnyan 'phrin dang / 'khyags sgam/sgra bsdu sgra phab 'khor lo/ brnyan phab 'khor lo/ ud si sti/(myozhu0) gos 'khrud 'phrul chas/ de bzhin gzhung lam pa ṭa'i steng rkang 'khor/ sbag sbaga'akhor lo gsum can gyi rkang 'khor/ gla byed sogs nyi rdul bzhin phar 'gro tshur 'ongs byed pa dang mnga' 'bangs kyi 'tsho ba de rdzogs ldan bskal bzang gi dus la slebs pa dang mtshungs so//348

slob grwa'i sgyu rtsal slob gsor brtag pa'i gtam 'dod pa'i kha rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so//slob gsor bsgyur bcos gting zab gtang rgyu dang / byang tshad slob gsor shugs snon brgyab ste ji ltar byas nas slob ma rnams khyon yongs nas 'phel rgyas gtang rgyu ni da lta'i slob gso'i mdun du lhag bsdad pa'i gal che'i tshan zhib rnam grangs cig tu nges/ sgyu rtsal slob gso ni khyon yongs nas byang tshad slob gso lag bstar bya ba'i thabs lam dam pa yin te/ 'dis slob gnyer pa rnams lus khams bde thang ngang 'tshar longs 'ongs ba dang / khyon yongs nas byang tshad mtho ru gtang rgyu la slob gso gzhan las mi 'dra ba'i dmigs bsal gyi nus pa ldan yod/ 'on kyang da lta'i slob grwa'i slob khrid dngos la bltas tsa na/ sgyu rtsal slob gso ni phal pa'i slob tshan du brtsis nas brtsi mthong mi bya ba'i gnas su gyur/ da lta slob gnyer pa mang dag gi dran shes nang rig tshan khag gi man ngag dang tha snyad skam po dang / ched rtags gzhung lugs skam po tsam las sgyu rtsal las byung ba'i rnam dkar dge ba'i sems/ mdzes chos kyi bsam pa/ gzugs khams bde thang / ngoms pa med pa'i bde ba'i tshor ba/ chags sdang 'dod yon lnga yi longs spyod sogs kyi brtul zhugs 'byin gyi yod pa ma rtogs pa 'dis slob gnyer pa rnams khyon yongs nas 'phel rgyas 'gro bar bkag ro'i nus pa thon gyi yod/ des na 'dir sgyu rtsal slob gso nges par du khyab gdal bya dgos pa'i skor gyi 'a~X sgo

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/'ga' zhig gleng bar spro ba bsrings/dang po/ sgyu rtsal slob gso'i gal che'i rang bzhin/gcig sgyu rtsal slob gso'i ngo bo/ rgyal khab slob gso u yon lhan khang gis 'grems spel byas pa'i 〈slob grwa'i sgyu rtsal slob gsor shugs snon rgyag rgyu'i skor gyi bsam 'char 〉 zhes pa'i nang slob grwa'i sgyu rtsal slob gso ni ched las min pa'i rgyal dmangs kyi byang tshad slob gso zhig yin te/ de'i dmigs yul dngos ni khyon yongs nas 'phel rgyas btang nas sgyu rtsal ched las pa min pa'ipha‘bzhi ldan ’’gyi shes ldan mi sna gso skyong bya rgyu yin zhes ngo bo gtan la phab pa des slob grwa'i sgyu rtsal slob gso de nges par du slob gnyer pa yongs su rdzogs par kha phyogs te/ khyon yongs nas slob ma'i byang tshad mtho ru gtang rgyu de khyab che'i las 'gan yin zhes gsal bshad byas/ des slob grwa khag gi nang sgyu rtsal slob gso spel dgos pa'i ngo bo dang / las 'gan/dmigs yul gtan la phab/ deng skabs rang ljongs kyi slob grwa khag gis sgyu rtsal slob gsor shugs snon rgyag rgyu'i gal che'i rang bzhin dang dgos nges kyi rang bzhin/ dka' tshegs kyi rang bzhin/ kha tsha dgos gtug gi rang bzhin/ phan yon gyi rang bzhin rtogs par byas te slob grwa khag gi nang du nges par du sgyu rtsal slob gso'i slob tshan bkod sgrig bya dgos pa'o//gnyis/ phal pa ni nam yang phal pa min/ 'das pa'i bgrang bya 'ga'i nang slob gso'i srid 'dzin sde khag gis slob gnyer pa rnams lo rim 'phar chag dang / slob thog rgyugs tshad/ slob grwa che 'bring la tshud pa'i 350

slob grwa'i sgyu rtsal slob gsor brtag pa'i gtam 'dod pa'i kha rgyan/mnyam rgyugs nang rig gnas kho na slob gnyer byas pa'i byang tshad kyi tshad 'jal byed kyi srang lta bu byas te sgyu rtsal slob gso de phal pa'i phal pa zhig shes na'ang 'dra ma shes na'ang 'dra gang ltar don byed nus stong lta bur brtsis nas brtsi mthong gtan nas bya kyi med/ des don dam par slob gnyer pa rnams khyon yongs nas byang tshad mtho ru gtong rgyur bkag rgya nges can zhig bzos/de dag ni sgyu rtsal slob gso las byung ba'i phan yon ma rtogs pa las byung ba'i 'bras bu ngan pa zhig red/ der brten mi rigs hril po'i byang tshad mtho ru gtong dgos na nges par du sgyu rtsal slob gso de phal pa'i slob tshan du ma bzhag par slob grwa'i slob gso'i nang gi gal che'i nang don zhig tu brtsis nas slob khrid bya dgos/ gnyis pa/ slob grwa'i sgyu rtsal slob gso'i nang don/sgyu rtsal zhes pa ni go rgya shin tu che ba'i rig tshan zhig yin pas 'dir gtso bo sgyu rtsal ched sbyong min pa'i slob gnyer pa yongs la dmigs nas/ thos pa bsag rgyu dang shes rtogs lon rgyu/ lta zhib kyi nus pa gso skyong bya ba'i skor gyi rig tshan rnam grangs rnams rags bstan bya rgyur spro bas dpyad par 'tshal/gcig 'dzugs skrun gyi sgyu rtsal/ 'dzugs skrun gyi sgyu rtsal ni mi'i rigs kyi ches snga ba'i sgyu rtsal gyi gras shig yin te/ gdod ma'i spyi tshogs kyi mjug tsam nas bzung mi rnams kyis khang pa'i bed spyod rang bzhin dang /mdzes nyams kyi rang bzhin/ sra brtan gyi rang bzhin bcas gsum la dang dod bya mgo brtsams shing / dus rabs rim byung nang 'dzugs skrun byas pa'i 351

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/khang pa de dag kyang bed spyod kyi nus pa mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis dmangs spyod khang pa dang / bzo las khang pa/ dgon sde/ pho brang / spyi spyod khang pa/mchod rten/ dran rten rang bzhin gyi khang pa sogs su dbye ba dang / rgyu cha tha dad pa'i dbang gis shing rgyu'i khang pa/ rdo rgyu'i khang pa/ sa phag gi khang pa/ ar 'dam gyi khang pa sogs su dbye ba/ bzo dbyibs mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis rgya'i bzo lta dang / bod kyi bzo lta/ phyi gling pa'i bzo lta sogs su dbye ba la dus rabs kyi rang bzhin dang / mi rigs kyi rang bzhin zhes rtsa bar byas pa'i bzo dbyibs dang / bkod pa tha dad pa yod pa la mdzes chos kyi rin thang rgya cher ldan la mtshon byed kyi rang bzhin yang rgya cher ldan yod de/dper na 'dzam gling thog skad grags yod pa'i dmar po ri'i steng du 'gying nger bzhengs pa'i pho brang po ta la lta bur mtshon na gcig nas rgyu skar dkyis na zla dkar bzhin 'dzam gling rgyan gcig ces gzengs su thon/ gnyis nas skya ser tshon bkras ser skya'i gtsug gi rgyan/ gsum nas grong dang grong khyer dbus nas gzengs su thon/ bzhi nas cha dang cha can zung sbrel bkod nyams dod/ lnga nas rtsig rmang brtan la rdo shing rgyu cha bzang / drug nas nang gi bzo bkod mdzes ris rnam par bkra/ bdun nas chos srid rnam pa'i bro ba gting du zab/ brgyad nas dus rabs kyi mtshon rtags yin pa bcas bod mi rigs blo gros kyi snying bcud mtshon la skye bo rnams kyis bsngags pa'i yul du gyur pa'i 'dzugs skrun sgyu rtsal gyi nor mdzod lta bur gyur/ de dag slob ma tshor 'chad na kho tsho'i la rgya dang spobs pa/ sgyu rtsal gyi shes rgya che ru 'gro rgyur gdon mi za'o//352

slob grwa'i sgyu rtsal slob gsor brtag pa'i gtam 'dod pa'i kha rgyan/gnyis ri mo'i sgyu rtsal/ ri mo'i sgyu rtsal ni 'bri byed spu sgyug sogs kyis rnam bcad dang / tshon mdangs/ dbyibs ris/ rgyan gyis sba ba'i thabs kyis gzugs dbyibs dang / kha dog gtsor byas pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi nyams 'gyur las 'dren byed lam du mthong snang sna tshogs snang ba dang / des skye bo rnams la dga' sdug 'dod sdang / brtse dung / blang dor gyi rnam rtog kyang 'byin par byed pa'i nus pa ldan to/ /de'ang bzo rig pa'i nang tshan ri mo'i sgyu rtsal 'dir rgyal khab mi 'dra ba dang / mi rigs mi 'dra ba/ lta ba mi 'dra ba so sor rang rang gi gzhung lugs dang / khyad chos ldan pa'i ri mo'i sgyu rtsal gyi grub mtha' tha dad pa yod pa ste rgyal srol ri mo dang / phyi lugs kyi srol gsar ri mo/ bod kyi srol rgyun ri mo thang ga lta bu bcas dang / de bzhin de dag la'ang snum tshon ri mo/skya ris chu tshon ri mo/ ldebs ris/ brkos ris/ dar bris ri mo/ glog klad ri mo sogs su dbye/ de dag gis mi sna'i gzugs brnyan/ srog chags sems can gyi gzugs/ bem gzugs/ mdzes ljongs bcas snod bcud kyi bkod pa mtshon/ de'i mdzes dpyad kyi khyad rtags gnyis yod de/ ngos snyom kyi dbyibs kyi mig lam du tshor snang sna tshogs 'byin te spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba dngos mtshon par byed pa dang gcig ri mo'i sgyu rtsal gyis 'tsho ba dngos mtshon phyir yul dus kyi bkag rgya med par tshon mdangs dang / 'od mdangs/dbyibs gzugs/ skya ris/ bar mthong bcas dbyibs bzo'i sgyu rtsal gyis gson shugs dang / mtshon shugs/ 'char sgo sna tshogs ldan pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi gzugs brnyan bkod 'bri byas pa dang gnyis/ des na gcig nas slob 353

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/gnyer pas ri mo'i sgyu rtsal gyi 'phel rim dang mtshon bya brtsam bya'i khyad rtags rtogs dgos pa dang / gnyis nas ri mo sgyu rtsal gyi phyi rnam pa'i mdzes nyams kho na la yid dbang 'phrog pa tsam ma yin par dbyibs dang kha dog las byung ba'i blta bas mi ngoms pa'i tshor ba'i myong ba byung bar bya rgyu gal che ba dang /gsum nas ri mo mkhan gyi rnam dpyod kyi rtsal yod do cog pa bton te bris pa'i ri mo la rten nas brten pa dang / cha nas cha can/ rags pa nas zhib pa'i rim pas lta zhib byas te de'i nang gi bla na med pa'i sems khams dang /snying stobs/ mdzes rtsal la go rgyu zab mo yod pa rtogs yod pa ste/ dper na/ bod kyi srol rgyun ri mo mthun pa spun bzhi lta bur mtshon na gzugs dbyibs dang / tshon mdangs kyis srog chags bzhi'i gzugs brnyan mtshon pa ma zad/ de bas go rgyu lhag po che ni rgan bkur gzhon skyong gi brjod bya bstan pa rtogs par bya rgyu gnad dam pa'o//gsum/ 'jim brkos sgyu rtsal/ 'jim brkos ni 'bur thon gyi gzugs dbyibs gtso bor byas pa las grub pa'i mi'i rigs kyi lo rgyus thog ches snga shos kyi sgyu rtsal gras su nges/ lo rgyus 'phel rgyas kyi gom bgros dang sbrags 'jim brkos sgyu rtsal de'ang gom gang mdun spos kyis 'phel rgyas byung ste nyams 'gyur sna brgya ldan pa'i 'jim brkos brtsam 'bras kyis 'tsho ba'i khor yug la rgyan spud dang spro ba bsrings pa'i bya ba'i khrod dpag par dka' ba'i nus pa rgya cher thon/ brkos dkrol langs gzugs dang / 'bur thon langs gzugs kyi sgyu rtsal la brten nas rdo brkos dang / shing brkos/ 'jim bskos/ zangs brkos/ rus brkos sogs byas pa de dag kyang 354

slob grwa'i sgyu rtsal slob gsor brtag pa'i gtam 'dod pa'i kha rgyan/dgon sde khag gi 'jim brkos dang / grong dang grong khyer nang gi 'jim brkos/ skyed mos tshal gyi 'jim brkos/ dran rten rdo ring gi 'jim brkos/khang pa'i 'jim brkos/ sgrig chas steng gi 'jim brkos sogs su dbye zhing /'jim brkos sgyu rtsal 'di la gcig nas gdos bcas kyi rang bzhin ldan yod pas skye bo rnams kyis mig dbang dang / lus dbang gi tshor ba la brten nas mdzes dpyad bya ba dang / gnyis nas mtshon rtags rang bzhin dang /shugs ldan gyi rang bzhin yod pas mtshon bya'i don dag rgya che la gting zab ldan yod pa'i cha nas mdzes dpyad bya ba dang / gsum nas ches mtho'i gcig bsdus kyi rang bzhin ldan yod pa ste/ 'jim brkos bya gzhir gyur pa'i chos de'i thog mtha' bar gsum gyi 'phel rim dang / mdzad rjes/ khor yug dang bcas pa yod do cog mtshon pa'i nus pa dang bral bas gtso bo mi sna'i phyi'i gzugs kyi rnam 'gyur las bsam pa'i bla med kyi snying stobs dang /dgongs pa mtshon par byed pa'i khyad chos ldan yod/ des na 'jim brkos sgyu rtsal gyi gzugs dbyibs kyi mdzes nyams dang / brjod bya'i snying po/'khor ra khor yug gi bkod 'bri bcas rten cing 'brel ba la rtogs zhib bya dgos/ de'ang 'dzam gling thog skad grags yod pa'i gtsang bkra shis lhun po dgon rje btsun byams pa mgon po'i sku brnyan dang / gnam bde sgo mo'i thang chen thog 'gyings nger bzhengs pa'i mi dmangs dpa' bo'i dran gso'i rdo ring lta bus mtshon rigs bsgres mkhyen par mdzod/bzhi/ bzo bkod mdzes rtsal/ bzo bkod mdzes rtsal zhes pa ni 'tsho chas dang khor yug mdzes byed kyi sgyu rtsal zhig ste/ bza' gos sdod 355

wumig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/gsum sogs 'tsho ba'i mkho chas dang khor yug gis skye bo rnams kyi bsam pa'i bde ba dang / mdzes chos/ dga' snang la sgyu rtsal gzhan gyis 'gran par dka' ba'i dngos spyod kyi rang bzhin dang / rgya che'i rang bzhin/ gting zab kyi rang bzhin ldan pa'i sgyu rtsal zhig yin/ gdod ma'i dus kyi rdo chas dang / rus chas/ shing chas thabs chags dar ba nas bzung rim bzhin dus rabs 'phel rgyas dang mnyam par rnam grangs dang / bzo bkod sgyu rtsal gang sar 'phel rgyas chen po byung / de'ang dngos spyod kyi bzo bkod sgyu rtsal dang / mdzes rgyan gyi bzo bkod sgyu rtsal gnyis su dbye ba dang / bzo bkod kyi rgyu cha tha dad pa la brten nas dbye na gser dngul zangs dang /shing cha/ g.yang ṭi/ shel/ ras/ 'jim/ dar gos/ ko rigs sogs sgyu rtsal rnam grangs mang du mchis pa de dag ni dngos spyod rang bzhin dang / mdzes rgyan rang bzhin/ spro snang gi rang bzhin gcig tu 'dus pa'i sgyu rtsal zhig tu grub pas/ gcig nas dbyibs gzugs snang ngor mdzes pa dang / gnyis nas rgyan ris mdzes pa/ gsum nas tshon ris bkra ba/bzhi nas rgyu cha spus dag pa/ lnga nas bzo rtsal chu tshad mtho ba'i khyad rtags ldan pas nga tshos de'i ro myang dus nges par du bzo bkod sgyu rtsal gyi phyi'i dbyibs bkod la bltas nas mtshon bya'i don rnams rtogs par bya rgyu dang gcig bzo bkod sgyu rtsal gyi thon rdzas kyi rgyu cha'i spus dag la dpyad de/ sgyu rtsal gyi rin thang rtogs pa bya rgyu dang gnyis/ bzo bkod sgyu rtsal gyi dbyibs gzugs mdzes pa'i sgrig chas dang / 'tsho ba dngos nang bed spyod kyi rang bzhin phyogs mthun la dpyad de mdzes snang bskyed par bya rgyu dang gsum/356

slob grwa'i sgyu rtsal slob gsor brtag pa'i gtam 'dod pa'i kha rgyan/dus rabs ring thung gi lo rgyus la dpyad de rin thang rtogs par bya rgyu dang bzhi/ sdod khang dang lus sogs yul mdzes par byed pa'i mdzes rgyan gyi yon tan la dpyad de de'i rin thang rtogs par bya rgyu dang lnga ste/ dper na/ rdza chas/ dkar yol/ bum pa/ dngul gyi zing phor/ gser gyi rgyan cha/chu zangs zom pa lha mo'i mdzes cha/ glo gri/ sbra gur/ zhwa mo tshe ring skyin khebs/ kha gdan/ mgul rgyan/ sku brnyan/ srog chags sems can gyi gzugs brnyan/ thon rdzas blug sgam gyi mdzes rgyan/ gos kyi rgyan bkod/khyim chas kyi bzo bkod sogs sgyu rtsal 'di'i khyab khongs su gtogs pa 'di dag la mdzes dpyod kyi rin thang shin tu che bar sems/lnga/ yig gzugs kyi sgyu rtsal/ yig gzugs ni skad gdangs mtshon byed kyi gzugs ris zhig ste/ mi'i rigs kyi rig gnas rgyun 'dzin dang / 'chad spel/ spyi tshogs yar rgyas gong 'phel gtong bar brda sprod pa'i lag cha gal chen zhig yin/ yi ge'i gzugs de'ang mtshon mdog dkar nag dmar ser sogs mdog gang rung gis ma bris na kha dog med pa'i yig gzugs shig gtan nas 'ongs mi srid/ de nas yig gzugs kyi sgyu rtsal de'ang gzugs dang kha dog ches mtho'i gcig bsdus kyi ltos bcas kyi 'brel ba'i sgyu rtsal gyi nyams 'gyur zhig byung ba'o/ /yig gzugs sgyu rtsal gyi mtshon rtags ni 'bri gzhi shog bu sogs gang rung gi steng du 'bri bya rgya bod dbyin yig sogs yi ge sna tshogs dang / 'bri byed spu sgyug sa smyug si sgyug lcags smyug sogs gang rung gis mi rigs gang yang rung ba'i skad brda brjod byar byas te (shes bya kun khyab 〉 las/ yi ge 357

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/'bri ba'i gzhi dang ni 'bri ba'i lag cha 'bri rdzas gsum/ snag shog smyu gu mi gzob par/ yi ge gzob 'dod yig mkhan 'khrul zhes pa ltar/ thog mar yi ge 'bri ba'i rgyu rdzas shig dgos pa rtsa che/ de'i rjes yig gzugs kyi rnam grangs so so'i 'bri lugs kyi gzhung dang / mthong ba brgyud pa'i man ngag ltar dkar cha nag cha'i cha tshad dang gzhi snyom gyi cha tshad/'dren byed kyi rgyan lugs/ bcad kyi cha tshad sogs yig mkhan so so'i sor mo'i 'du byed rtsal las byung ba'i yig gzugs kyi sgyu rtsal la mdzes dpyod kyi bya bar 'jug dgos pa de'ang mi'i rigs kyi yi ge byung ba nas bzung/ dus rabs rim byung gi lo rgyus nang yig gzugs kyi grub mtha' tha dad pa dang /yi ge'i gzugs ris kyang tha dad pa sna mang byung yod pas na gtsor rgyun par 'bri ba'i yig gzugs las 'das te gzugs ris shin tu mdzes shing mtshar ba'i sgyu rtsal gyi rin thang gi steng nas skye bo'i mig shes su mdzes pa'i tshor snang 'byin pa rtogs par bya dgos so/ /drug rol dbyangs kyi sgyu rtsal/ rol dbyangs kyi sgyu rtsal zhes pa ni rol cha dkrol gtong dang / glu gyer ba las byung ba'i sgra gdangs kyi sgyu rtsal zhig ste/ de ni 'gyur khug dang / dbyangs rta/ skad gdangs/ dbyangs shed bcas rgyu byas pa'i sgra gdangs mtho dman/ drag zhan/ dal lhod/ring thung las grub pa'i rna ba'i bcud du smin pa'i sgyu rtsal 'gran zla bral ba zhig yin/ 'di la dbye na glu dbyangs dang / rol dbyangs gnyis su mchis/dang po la'ang dmangs glu dang / mdun skyod kyi glu dbyangs/ brtse dung mtshon byed kyi glu dbyangs/ bstod glu/ gzhas glu sogs su dbye srol yod pa 358

slob grwa'i sgyu rtsal slob gsor brtag pa'i gtam 'dod pa'i kha rgyan/dang / gnyis pa la'ang mdun skyod rol dbyangs dang / 'jam snyan rol dbyangs/ dar khyab che ba'i rol dbyangs/ gna' bo'i zhabs bro'i rol dbyangs/ dmangs khrod zhabs bro'i rol dbyangs sogs su dbye/ glu dbyangs len mkhan gyi cha nas dbye na/ bu'i kher gzhas/ bu mo'i kher gzhas/ mnyam len gzhas bcas su dbye chog la/ rol dbyangs la'ang mi rigs kyi rol cha dkrol gtong dang / nub gling gi rol cha dkrol gtong gnyis su dbye ba de dag la rol cha dang / 'bangs sgrig rnam pa la so so'i thun mong min pa'i khyad chos yod pa red/ 'o na glu dbyangs kyi khyad rtags ji ltar yin zhe na/ sgra gdangs kyi sgyu rtsal ni ches mngon gsal dod shos dang gcig dus dang skar cha'i gom 'gros kyis mtshon par byed pa dang gnyis/skad gdangs kyis mtshon bya'i don mtshon par byed pa'i sgyu rtsal dang gsum yin pas/ nga tshos thog mar glu dbyangs kyi 'gyur khug dbyangs rta sogs tha snyad la ma rmongs pa bya rgyu/ gnyis nas rtsom pa po dang / brtsams chos lo rgyus kyi byung ba rtogs pa bya rgyu/ gsum nas nyan pa por glu dbyangs kyi ngoms med bro ba myangs thub pa'i rtsa ba'i shes bya dang / sems khams kyi byang tshad ldan dgos pa/ bzhi nas thengs brgya nyan yang bsun snang med pa'i snang bas nyan 'dod kyi blo dang / mdzes dpyod kyi nus pa mtho ru gtong dgos/glu dbyangs kyis lus kyi nad dang / sems kyi sdug bsngal gyi mya ngan sel bar byed pa'i byed las ldan pa dang / snyan pa'i glu dbyangs dang / 'jebs pa'i rol dbyangs kyis rna ba'i bcud du smin te lus sems la spro snang gi bde ba 'byin pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi gtsug rgyan te/ rol mo'i bstan bcos las kyang /359

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/blo ngan gzugs kyis phongs pa'ang rung / /rigs ngan nor dang bral yang sla/ /rol mo'i cha la mkhas gyur na/ /tshogs kyi nang na rgyan ltar mjos/ /zhes pa'ang chos dang / 'jig rten/ mkhas rmongs skye bo kun la mdzes pa dang /snyan pa ni glu dang rol mo yin pa bstan pa'o/ /bdun/ zhabs bro'i sgyu rtsal/ zhabs bro'i sgyu rtsal ni spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba dngos kyi dga' sdang skyo gsum dag rkang lag gi stangs stabs sogs lus kyi rnam 'gyur sna tshogs kyis mtshon par byed pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi rnam pa zhig ste/ de ni rgyal khab dang / mi rigs/ sa gnas bcas kyi yul srol goms gshis dang / srol rgyun rig gnas kyi mtshon rtags shig kyang red/ zhabs bro ni skye bo rnams kyis gna' snga mo nas ngal rtsol byed pa'i brgyud rim nang gsar du btod cing rim pas dar rgyas gong 'phel byung ba zhig red/ der dbye na gnyen sgrig dang / rten 'brel mdzad sgo/ chos lugs kyi mdzad sgo/ spyi tshogs thog gi 'brel gtugs bcas 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi zhabs bro dang / gna' rabs kyi zhabs bro/ dmangs khrod kyi zhabs bro/ deng rabs kyi zhabs bro gtsor byas pa'i sgyu rtsal rang bzhin gyi zhabs bro gnyis su dbye ba dag la lus kyi stangs stabs sgeg pa'i nyams kyi rang bzhin/ snying rje dang / mi sdugadapa' mi ro dag nang sems su myangs nas phyi rol du nyams kyis mtshon par byed pa'i rang bzhin/ dbyangs rta gsal la 'gyur khug snyan pa'i rang bzhin/dga' snang dang spro snang mdzes snang bcas 'byin pa'i 'dra brnyan gyi rang bzhin/ 'tsho ba dngos las ring du 'das pa'i rab rtog gi rang bzhin bcas kyi mdzes chos rang bzhin ldan yod gshis/ zhabs bro'i nyams dang 'gyur ba 360
