slob grwa'i sgyu rtsal slob gsor brtag pa'i gtam 'dod pa'i kha rgyan/las brjod bya'i snying po rtogs pa bya rgyu'i mdzes dpyod dang gcig gar stegs mdzes ljongs kyi bkod pa la mdzes dpyod bya rgyu dang gnyis/ 'khrab chas kyi mdzes rgyan la mdzed dpyod bya rgyu dang gsum/ mdor na/ lang tsho'i dpal dang ldan pa'i lus la brjod bya don gyi srog gi dbang po ldan zhing mdzes pa'i rgyan gyis bklubs pa dang / rkang lag gi stangs stabs dang / lus kyi nyams 'gyur dag ni zhabs bro'i sgyu rtsal gyi ches rtsa bar gyur pa'i mdzes dpyod kyi chos su grub pas mig gi snang ngor mjes snang 'byin pa kho nas ma chog par sems khams su chog tu mi shes pa'i bde ba 'byin pa'i ro brgya shes par bya dgos so/ /brgyad/ par len gyi sgyu rtsal/ par len ni par chas dang / 'od len spyin shog gis snod bcud kyi dbyibs gzugs dang / kha dog dngos ji ma ji bzhin 'god par byed pa'i rang bzhin gyi sgyu rtsal zhig ste/ de ni rig gnas dang / lag rtsal/ tshan rig khyab gdal gtang rgyu'i lag cha gal chen yin la/ rgyu skar gyi go la dang / sa yi go la/ mtsho yi gling sogs kyi dngos po che phra chung gsum par len la med du mi rung ba'i sgyu rtsal zhig tu grub/ skye bo rnams kyi 'dod pa'i yon tan gyi dgos mekho dang / rig gzhung gi khyad chos mtho ru phyin pa dang sbrags par len ni bsam pa'i rig gnas 'tsho ba'i dgos mkho dam par gyur pa ste/ skye bo'i yid dbang lcags dkyus bkug nus pa'i rtsal mchog 'dis blo gros 'phel ba ma zad/ mdzes dpyod kyi nus pa bskyed bsrings dang / spro ba 'phel ba/ blo kha rgyas pa/ 'tsho bar dga' snang dang gson shugs 'byin pa'i dmigs bsal yon tan ldan yod pa/361

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/'di la brjod bya don gyi cha nas dbye na gsar 'gyur gyi par len/ mdzes ljongs kyi par len/ skye bo'i gzugs brnyan gyi par len/ dngos gzugs kyi par len/ 'tsho ba'i par len/ lus rtsal gyi par len/ gyon gos kyi par len/ bzo skrun gyi par len/ brda khyab sgyu rtsal gyi par len/ zlos gar gyi par len sogs dang / 'od len rgyu cha'i cha nas dbye na/ tshon khra'i par len dang / tshon med par len/ de bzhin rnam pa'i thog nas dbye na/dngos spyod rang bzhin gyi par len dang / sgyu rtsal rang bzhin gyi par len sogs rnam grangs mang bar dbye ba 'di dag la brtan g.yo'i dngos po ci mchis ji ma ji bzhin 'god par byed pa'i rang bzhin dang gcig skad cig gi rang bzhin ldan pa dang gnyis/ 'dra gzugs kyi rang bzhin ldan pa dang gsum bcas mdzes dpyod kyi khyad rtags ldan yod pa 'di dag la gcig nas 'tsho ba dngos la snyigs dor bcud len dang / ches gcig bsdus rang bzhin gyis bstod smad 'gran pa'i yul la dpyad de par len sgyu rtsal gyi thabs la brten nas dngos gnas mdzes pa'i tshor snang 'byin pa'i rtsal ldan pa dang /gnyis nas nang don gyi mdzes pa dang / rnam pa'i mdzes pa/ cha yongs nas mdzes pa dag gtso yin pa'i brtsam chos de'i 'od dang / snang ba'i sgyu rtsal gyis mig gi dpang por ngoms pa med pa'i mdzes pa'i snang ba 'byin pa'i rtsal dang / gsum nas par gyi tshon gyi mdog dang / mdangs kyis snod bcud kyi rnam pa mtshon pa ma zad/ mtshon bya'i don yang mtshon par byed pa dang sbrags tshon gyi bkra mdangs dang / tshon mdog tha dad pa la brten mig gi snang ngor mdzes sdug gi tshor ba'ang tha dad pa 'byin gyi yod pa shes par bya'o/ /362

slob grwa'i sgyu rtsal slob gsor brtag pa'i gtam 'dod pa'i kha rgyan/dgu/ glog brnyan dang brnyan 'phrin gyi rgya rtsal/ glog brnyan ni spyi lo 1895lor mi'i rigs kyi lo rgyus thog dar mgo brtsams pa dang /gzugs mthong brnyan 'phrin ni spyi lo 1936lor dar mgo brtsams pa yongs su grags/ sgyu rtsal 'di gnyis ni gzigs mo ba ches mang ba dang / dar khyab ches che ba/ lo na ches phra ba/ ches gson nyams ldan pa'i sgyu rtsal zhig ste/ 'dir gzugs dang / sgra/ 'od gcig tu bsdus pa'i skye bo'i yid dbang 'gugs pa'i gson nyams ldan pa'i rmad du byung ba'i sgyu rtsal zhig tu grub/ der dbye na/ sgrung gtam/ mdzes rtsal/rmo tshan rtsal slob gso/zlos gar/ rgyun mthud zlos gar sogs rigs 'gar dbye/ gzugs mthong brnyan 'phrin dang glog brnyan gnyis mi 'dra ba'i cha ni sgyu rtsal de gnyis bzo byed kyi rgyu cha tha dad pa yin pa dang gcig gzigs mo ba 'du 'dzoms kyi gnas tha dad pa yin pa dang gnyis/ gzugs brnyan ston gzhi'i ras dang /shel gyi che chung dang / shong tshad tha dad pa dang gsum/ ltad mo ba'i grangs 'bor/ ltad mo'i dus yun ring thung tha dad pa dang bzhi bcas so/ /'das pa'i dus kyi glog brnyan khang du 'du 'dzoms kyis ltad mo ston pa'i glog brnyan gyi sgyu rtsal des deng gi khyim tshang dang / tshong khang sogs gang sar ltad mo lta rgyu yod pa'i gzugs mthong brnyan 'phrin gyi sgyu rtsal 'di la 'gran pa'i spobs pa bral ba ni tshan rig dar rgyas chen po byung pa'i rtags su nges/de'ang sgyu rtsal 'di gnyis kyi dmigs bsal khyad yon ni rtsom rig dang /zlos gar/ glu dbyangs/ ri mo/ brkos dkrol/ par len/ gna' 363

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/rabs kyi sgyu rtsal bcas sgyu rtsal yongs kyi snying bcud 'dus pa'i ches phyogs bsdus rang bzhin gyi khyad chos ldan pa dang gcig phyi rol yul gyi bya dngos dang / spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba dngos mtshon par byed pas ltad mo ba'i snang ngor gson ma'i sgyu rtsal gyi khyad yon mngon pa dang gnyis/ sgyu rtsal 'di ri mo dang /par len/ brkos dkrol sgyu rtsal dang mi 'dra bar sgra dang / gzugs zung du sbrel ba'i 'gul bskyod rang bzhin rgya cher ldan pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi khyad yon dang gsum bcas so/ /nga tshos thabs ji lta bu'i rtsal la brten nas 'di dag gi mdzes chos kyi cha la ro myang dgos she na/ gcig nas de dag gi tha snyad sogs rgyun shes la blor byang pa byas te/ de'i sgyu rtsal la dga' snang dang / dad snang / spro snang gi nus pa bskyed bsrings bya dgos pa dang / gnyis nas glog brnyan dang brnyan 'phrin sgyu rtsal gyi rtsa ba'i khyad rtags dang / gzugs brnyan ston gzhi'i steng gi 'khyug 'od las byung ba'i ngo mtshar ba'i sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos rtogs pa bya rgyu/gsum nas 'khrab 'khrid pa dang / zlos gar pa/ par len mkhan bcas kyi phul du byung ba'i bsam pa'i 'khyer so/ mdzes dpyod kyi lta ba/ sgyu rtsal gyi 'dun pa/ 'tsho ba'i nyams myong / bsam pa'i brtse dung / dad zhen/rig gnas bcas thun mong min pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi rang gshis dang / gsar gtod/ nyams 'gyur la bsam gzhigs legs por byas te gzugs kyi mdzes pa'i cha/ rna ba'i snyan pa'i cha/ mtshon bya'i don zab pa'i cha/ sgyu rtsal gyi rmad pa'i cha/ 'byung rim gyi rnyog pa'i cha bcas sgyu 'phrul las byung ba'i sgyu rtsal gyi brtsam chos la mdzes dpyod bya bar mkhas par bya'o/ /364

slob grwa'i sgyu rtsal slob gsor brtag pa'i gtam 'dod pa'i kha rgyan/bcu/ rtsom rig gi sgyu rtsal/ rtsom rig ni spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba dngos nas thon pa'i chos dag mi rnams kyi klad par tshur snang byung ba sogs skad yig gi sgyu rtsal la brten nas ri mo'i gzugs su bkod pa'i sgyu rtsal zhig yin/mi'i rigs kyi lo rgyus chu klung ring mo'i nang rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyis bzang po rnams la bstod pa dang / ngan pa rnams la smad de spyi tshogs yar thon dang /mi dge ba spangs shing dge ba sgrub pa'i bsam pa'i brtul zhugs la nus pa rgya cher thon yod/ de ni 'das pa'i lo rgyus kyi 'pho 'gyur la zhib 'jug dang /skabs de dang dus de'i yul srol goms gshis la dpyad zhib bya ba'i gal che'i rgyu char grub/ der dbye na snyan tshig dang / lhug rtsom/ brtsams sgrung /zlos gar bcas bzhi yod pa de dag gi khyad chos ni spyi tshogs steng gi mi sna dang /'tsho ba'i khor yug dag brjod bya byas nas mi sna'i gzugs brnyan bkod 'bri bya rgyu dang gcig spyi tshogs kyi 'tsho ba dngos nang thon pa'i mi sna dang / bya dngos mang dag 'ongs srid pa de'i nang nas ches dpe mtshon rang bzhin ldan pa mtshon par bya rgyu dang gnyis/ brda sprod pa'i gzhung dang mi 'gal zhing brjod bya'i don zab pa dag rjod byed tshig gi sgyu rtsal snyan zhing 'jebs pa dang gsum/ rtsom pa po'i blo gros kyi rtsal las 'bri bya'i yul du gyur pa'i chos dag 'bri byed smyu gu'i 'du byed kyis skye bo'i snang ngor rang nyid kyis yul de dngos su mthong ba'am der slebs pa lta bu'i dbyings zhugs thub pa'i blo khams su mdzes snang 'byin pa dang bzhi/ de dag la ji lta bus dga' sdang dang /dad zhen gyis rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi snying bcud kyi ro myang dgos she na/ thog mar rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyi rmang gzhi'i shes bya la sbyangs stobs rgyas shing / bar 365

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/du snyan rtsom gyi snyan 'jebs rang bzhin dang / lhug rtsom gyi 'bol rtsom rang bzhin/ sgrung rtsom gyi gzugs brnyan 'bur thon bkod 'bri'i rang bzhin/zlos gar rtsom gyi 'gal 'du'i 'phel rim rang bzhin la brtags par mkhas shing / de nas bslab gzhi'i nang 'khod pa'i rtsom rig dang / rtsom 'bri'i shes bya/ rtsom rig gi tha snyad sogs shes bya dag gcig tu bsdus nas go ba len par mkhas pa dang / lhag par rang rkya 'pher ba'i ngang rtsom de dang de'i bsam pa'i dmigs don dang / 'char yan/ sgyu rtsal gyi nyams bcas la bltos bcas kyis bsam gzhigs bya bar mkhas pa bcas rtsom rig sgyu rtsal ni 'tsho ba dngos las byung ba'i 'tsho ba dngos mtshon par byed pa'i rtsom rig cig yin rung / de sgyu rtsal yin gshis spyir btang gi 'tsho ba dngos las 'das te/de bas tshad mtho'i rang bzhin dang / gcig bsdus rang bzhin/ dpe mtshon rang bzhin/ phal tshig spangs te rna bar snyan pa'i rang bzhin/phugs bsam dang 'char yan rang bzhin/ brtse dung zab pa'i rang bzhin ldan yod pas tshad mtho'i sgyu rtsal gyis mdzes dpyod bya bar gces/gsum pa/ sgyu rtsal slob gso'i phan yon bstan pa/sgyu rtsal la dga' zhen byed pa ni mi rnams la gnyug ma nyid nas yod pa'i lhan skyes kyi nus pa zhig ste/ yul mdzes shing sdug pa dang / sgra snyan zhing 'jebs pa bcas kyis skye bo kun gyi blo'i mya ngan sel zhing / lus sems bde ba dang / snang ba skyid pa'i tshor ba 'byin pa ni chos pa ba dang 'jig rten pa/mkhas pa dang blun po/ skyes pa dang bud med/ sprang po dang phyug po bcas 366

slob grwa'i sgyu rtsal slob gsor brtag pa'i gtam 'dod pa'i kha rgyan/kun la mdzes chos snang ba ni sgyu rtsal slob gso'i khyad 'phags las byung ba'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig go/gcig lus khams bde thang la sman/ mdzes rtsal gyi brtsam bya gsar rtsom dang / mdzes chos nyams su myong ba'i khrod du sgyu rtsal gyis sems kyi 'du 'dzi dor rgyu dang / sems sdug sel ba/ sems nad sangs ba/lus skyid sems skyid dang / khong yangs dkyil che la thun mong min pa'i phan bskyed ldan pa dang / khyad par du glu dbyangs dang / rol dbyangs snyan pa'i 'gyur khug dang / zhabs bro'i mdzes pa'i nyams 'gyur/ yid dbang 'phrog pa'i dbyangs rta yis skye bo'i skye khams bde gso dang / spro sems brtas pa/lus po bde thang / nad gzhi bcos rgyu bcas la sman pa'i rgyur gyur/ ri mo'i sgyu rtsal las 'jig rten pa'i rnam rtog sna brgya las bral te dben pa'i bde ba dang / bsun snang ring du dor te sems rnal mar phab pa dang / dwangs gtsang gi zhing khams shig tu lhags pa'i tshor ba 'byin srid/ gzhan yang phul du byung ba'i rtsom rig sgyu rtsal dang / dpar ris/ gzugs mthong brnyan 'phrin gyis skye bo'i rnam shes la g.yo 'gul thebs pa'i nus pa ldan yod de mdzes sdug lta na sdug pa'i yul ljongs dang / mi sna'i gzugs brnyan bya ba'i 'phel rim/ ngo mtshar ba dang gson nyams ldan pa'i sgyu rtsal gyis dga' bde'i tshor ba 'byin pa'i mig chu rang dbang med par 'chor srid/ de'ang brtse dung gi rgyu las byung ba'i mig chu yis gzugs khams nang gi gnod rgyu rnams sangs shing dngangs 'tshub gyi blo dag zhi lhod du 'gyur pa/ skyo snang gi blo med par dus rtag tu spro snang kho na'i dbyings kyi gzugs khams bde thang 367

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/dang / tshe ring nad sel la sman pa'i rgyur gyur to/ /gnyis/ bsam pa'i brtul zhugs la sman/ rmad du byung ba'i sgyu rtsal gyi brtsam chos ni bden pa'i rtsa ba dang / dge ba'i rgyu/ mdzes pa'i chos yin pas des skye bo'i sems lhag bsam rnam dag dang / ya rabs/spyod bzang / byams dang snying rje ldan pa/ gzhan phan dang yar thon gyi bsam pa bskyed bsrings la phan pa nges can ldan yod de sgyu rtsal gyi slob gso yis nang sems brtul ba la dper na/ bsil rlung gis sbrang char sne khrid byas pa bzhin sems ngan rnams 'chos shing sems bzang gso ba'i gsos su smin te/ lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i sems rgyud dang / bla na med pa'i phugs 'dun/ mdzes dpyod kyi shes rabs/ blo yi byang tshad mtho ru 'dogs thub/ dper na/ rtsom rig gi brtsam chos nang dpa' bo'i gzugs brnyan gyis mdzad mtha' med pa'i snying stobs dang / dgra 'dul gnyen skyong 'thab sar 'jug pa de ngang pa pad mtshor 'jug pa lta bu'i spro ba yis skye bo rnams kyi yang dag pa'i 'jig rten lta ba dang / mi tshe'i lta ba/ phugs bsam don gnyer sogs la nus pa dpag med thon srid/ de'ang sgyu rtsal gyi brtsam chos rnam dag gis bong bu mi khyur btsud pa lta bu'i yon tan ldan pa dang / rgyun par 'tsho ba'i nang dbyangs rta snyan la 'jam lhod kyi glu dbyangs nyan che ba'i mi sems blo bde bag phebs su 'gro ba dang / zil shugs che la/ngar nyams ldan pa'i glu dbyangs kyis snying stobs cher bskyed byed pa/ sgrung gtam gyi glog brnyan zhig la bltas tshe de'i nang gi mi sna'i bya spyod las rang sems la yid 'gul thebs te rang gi bya ba'i 'jug ldog la lam ston dang /368

slob grwa'i sgyu rtsal slob gsor brtag pa'i gtam 'dod pa'i kha rgyan/nang sems brtul bar byed pa ni sgyu rtsal gyi thabs bzang las byung ba'i 'bras bu zhig yin pa ngang gis shes thub/gsum/ snang ba skyid pa'i spro ba bsrings/ mdzes sdug lta na sdug pa'i ri mo dang / brjid chags lhun gyis grub pa lta bu'i 'dzugs skrun tshom bu/'gyur khug stong dang ldan pa'i glu dbyangs/ nyams 'gyur sna brgya'i zhabs bro/mig rnams 'khrul bar byed pa'i glog brnyan dang brnyan 'phrin ltad mo/ bzo bkod rnam par legs pa'i bzo bkod sgyu rtsal/ brjod bya'i don rnams rjod byed tshig gi sbyor ba snyan pa las thon pa'i rtsom rig sor mo'i 'du byed rtsal las thon pa'i mdzes pa'i yig gzugs sogs thams cad dang thams cad kyi mdzes pa'i cha dang / snyan pa'i cha yis skye bo rnams la blo bde bag phebs dang / snang ba skyid pa/ 'tsho ba'i don snying / dal 'byor mi lus thob pa'i bde ba bcas chog tu mi shes pa'i snang ba skyid pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi bde ba zhig bster te/ der nyin mtshan dang / rgan gzhon/ bde sdug dbul phyug sogs skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal re zhig brjod de bde skyid kyi zhing khams su rol ba'i spro ba bsrings ba'i nus pa ldan to/ /bzhi/ 'dod yon bskang ba'i byed nus ldan pa/ skye bo pho mo rgan gzhon su 'dra zhig yin rung 'jig rten 'dir 'tsho zhing gnas pa las rna bar sgra snyan pa dang / lus la reg bya 'jam pa/ mig la gzugs mdzes pa/sna bar dri zhim pa/ lce la ro mngar ba 'dod pa ni gnyug ma nyid nas yod pa'i skye bo phal mo che'i rang gshis su grub/ sgyu rtsal gyi brtsam chos dbyibs legs mdangs mdzes kyi bzo bkod ri mo dang / par len/ brkos dgrol/369

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/ri mo/ yig gzugs/ zlos gar sogs kyis gzugs 'dzin dbang po ltad mos ngoms par byas shing / bya bye'u 'jol mo'i gasring skado dang gzhas ma'i gye gyur glu dbyangs/ dbyangs can lha mos dkrol 'dra'i pi wang sgra yis sgra 'dzin dbang po snyan zhing 'jebs par byas/ ma la ya yi tsan dan gyi dri dajo me rtog pad+ma'i dri bsung lta bu'i rtsom rig sgyu rtsal gyis dri 'dzin dbang por bsung zhim 'byin/ ri mo'i sgyu rtsal las 'khrungs pa sno tshogs shing 'bras bsam ma'i gzugs lta bus ro 'dzin dbang po rang dbang med par ro myang bar brel/ snyan ngag me long ma los/ lus 'jam gang la pad ma yi/ /mal stan dag kyang rtsub byed na/ lha mo de nyid ro khang dag /sreg za ldan par ji ltar nyal lta bu rtsom rig sgyu rtsal las 'khrungs/ reg bya'i snying rje'i nyams ston pa bzhin/ de ltar 'jig rten 'dod pa'i yon tan lpen gyi sdom sgyu rtsal dag gis bskangs nus pa shes par bya/370

'gyur ba stong gi bstod tshigabod zhi bas bcings 'gro btang nas bgrang bya lnga bcu'i ring gi lo rgyus ni bod kha ba can gyi zhing khams 'di mdun bskyod dang gsar gtod/ 'gyur ba chen po'i 'od stong 'phro ba'i lo rgyus shig ste/ gsar gtod ni mi rigs 'di'i rmad byung srol rgyun rig gnas rgyun 'dzin dar rgyas kyi bla srog dang /mdun skyod dang 'gyur ba ni dus rabs kyi bgrod dang mnyam pa'i bzlog med lo rgyus kyi chos nyid dam pa yin pas 'dir phal tshig srong po'i lam nas 'di don drangs pa 'di lta ste/mun nag spyi tshogs rnying pa de/ /spyi tshogs ring lugs gsar par 'gyur/ /spyi tshogs rnying pa'i bran g.yog dag /bod ljongs gsar pa'i bdag por 'gyur/ /rang lus rang dbang med pa rnams/ /rang lus rang dbang can du 'gyur/ /ka dang ga dang bod dmag de/ /bcings bgrol dmag mi zhes par 'gyur/ /khrag dang mig chu'i skyo glu de/ /dga' dang skyid pa'i spro glur 'gyur/ /gsar rnying spyi tshogs gnyis po de/ / 371

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/gnam sa bla 'og lta bur 'gyur/ / phyi bkag nang bsdoms 'tsho thabs de/ /bsgyur bcos sgo dbye'i phyogs su 'gyur/ /'char gzhi'i dpal 'byor sgrig gzhi de/ /khrom ra'i dpal 'byor 'khrug por 'gyur/ /slob gsor brtsi mthong chung ba de/ /bskal brgya'i jus chen slob gsor 'gyur/ /dge rgan ngo thang chung ba de/ /mi'i rigs bla srog bskrun por 'gyur/ /slob grwa'i grangs 'bor nyung ba de/ /da gzod khri ma 'bum du 'gyur/ /bod phrug slob gnyer nyung ba de/ /'gan babs slob gsos mang bar 'gyur/ /sbyang bya rgya bod rtsis gsum de/ /rig tshan bcu phrag tsam du 'gyur/ /slob yon gzhung brten kho na de/ /rang gis gang tsam btang bar 'gyur/ /ri khug rta bong bgrod dka' de/ /gzhung lam pa tra'i ris su 'gyur/ /gzhung lam thal bas khengs pa de/ /snum nag gtsang ma'i lam du 'gyur/ /372

'gyur ba stong gi bstod tshiga'agrul skyel las khungs gcig po de/ /'khor rigs mi 'dra'i gla byed 'gyur/ /rkang thang nyin bdun chod pa de/ /krung pā nyin gcig slebs par 'gyur/ /rta po'i nyin lam bco brgyad de/ /gnam grus skad cig slebs par 'gyur/ /skyel 'dren mgrin bzang bong bu de/ /zhing pa'i tho phrug bzang por 'gyur/ /bzhon rta gyi ling rta pho de/ /so nam zhing pa'i mo ṭar 'gyur/ /sne gcig gnyer skyong bya srol de/ /sne mang gnyer skyong las su 'gyur/ /so nam las chod chung ba de / /zhing 'phrul chen mo'i thabs su 'gyur/ /sa lud kho nar brten rgyu de/ /rdzas lud legs sbyor sman du 'gyur/ /thon 'bab chung ba'i son rtsa de/ /thon bzang son bzang brje por 'gyur/ /mi shugs brten nas ston bsdu de/ /'phrul 'khor thabs kyis bsdu bar 'gyur/ / ser srung bla mar bskyabs bcol de/ /373

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/yid ches le tā zhes par 'gyur/ /rkang brdung lag brdung snum 'tshag de/ /glog 'phrul las snon bzo grwar 'gyur/ /chu 'khor rtsam 'thag byed pa de/ /glog rtsam 'thag pa'i phyogs su 'gyur/ /rdza slang nang du yos rngos de/ /'phrul thab nang du brngo bar 'gyur/ /sgye rdo'i me thab skyo shas de/ /nyi 'od thab gsar can du 'gyur/ /'bru rigs lo bskor nyar rgyu de/ /dngul sgor tshong rgyag 'khrug por 'gyur/ /dngos pos dngos por brje res de/ /dngul lor chen mo'i tshong brjer 'gyur/ /dngos zog rang thon rang spyod de/ /lho tshong byang du 'dren par 'gyur/ /zhing pas zhing las rkyang byed de/ /tshong dang ar po rgyugs par 'gyur/ /bza' zla pha mas sbyor ba de/ /rang mos gnyen sgrig bya bar 'gyur/ /bu phrug tshod med btsas pa de/ /'char ldan bu btsa'i lam du 'gyur/ /374

'gyur ba stong gi bstod tshigadaga' rogs 'grig yul si ci de/ /cing li sbyin bdag phyogs su 'gyur/ /tshong las ngo tshar 'dzin pa de/ /phyug po'i gzi brjid can du 'gyur/ /lcags bzo rigs dman 'dzin pa de/ /lag rtsal mkhas pa'i rigs bzang 'gyur/ /rtsis pa mo par yid ches de/ /tshan rig dam par yid ches 'gyur/ /grwa btsun chos la zhen pa de/ /rgyal gces chos gces dpal du 'gyur/ /srol ngan ma rabs spyod pa de/ /ya rabs srol bzang can du 'gyur/ /gcin skyag gang sar gtong ba de/ /gsang spyod nang du gtong bar 'gyur/ /srang lam btsog snyigs khengs pa de/ /khams gtsang yid dga' can du 'gyur/ /mya ngam thang 'dra'i khor yug de/ /shing 'dzugs nags bzos skyed tshal 'gyur/ /smag rum mun pa'i mtshan ljongs de/ /dkar gsal glog bzhu'i mjos ljongs 'gyur/ /ya nga'i yang lā snum bzhu de/ /375

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/dkar gsal glog gi sgron mer 'gyur/ /'grul khang gtsang sbra med pa de/ /thog brtsegs khams gtsang can du 'gyur/ /g.yar khang cig tshang bstar bsgrigs de/ /sger khang gzhal yas khang du 'gyur/ /sa phag sob po'i rkyang thog de/ /ar 'dam sra po'i thog brtsegs 'gyur/ /gnas khang sbra gur nag po de/ /shel gling khang gsar gru bzhir 'gyur/ /sha mar thud gsum bza' rigs de/ /bza' chas sna mang phyogs su 'gyur/ /rtsam pa bod kyi gtso zas de/ /'bras dang gro phye mar par 'gyur/ /'tsho ba i dang i spags de/ /bza' btung ro brgya'i dpal du 'gyur/ /gsol ja mchod khang btung bya de/ /btung bya sna tshogs spu bkrar 'gyur/ /la phug zhog gog tshal bzang de/ /tshal sna 'dzoms pa'i 'tsho bar 'gyur/ /dgun kha sngo tshal mngon med de/ /dus bzhir sngo tshod 'dzad med 'gyur/ /376

'gyur ba stong gi bstod tshigatshag sha lug sha'i khrom ra de/ /sha rigs mang ba'i 'gran sar 'gyur/ /ston 'bras g.yur za'i shing tog de/ /dus bzhi'i shing tog sos mar 'gyur/ /bud shing lci bar brten pa de/ /glog dang sol rlung can du 'gyur/ /ja nyir me glang thug khru de/ /ja shel mtho gnon slang ngar 'gyur/ /ja zhim bsrubs byed mdong mo de/ /glog mdong 'ur sgra can du 'gyur/ /stod gzhas khams gzhas chang glu de/ /sna mang rig rtsal ldum rar 'gyur/ /glog brnyan khang gi ltad mo de/ / rang khyim yid dga'i gzigs mor 'gyur/ /thag ring gling lnga'i rgyal khab de/ /kha par drin gyis khyim mtshes 'gyur/ /rgyun srol bod chas mtshar sdug de/ /dpe gsar bzo lta'i phyogs su 'gyur/ /snam chas kho na'i rgyu cha de/ /sna mang rgyu cha'i gos su 'gyur/ /tshon mdog rkyang pa'i gyon chas de/ /377

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/tshon mdog rnam bkra'i gos su 'gyur/ /tshong khang ltag sgo brgyud dgos de/ /rang mkho rang sgrub tshong du 'gyur/ /kha lo ba la zhu 'then de/ /'grul par zhu 'then bya rgyur 'gyur/ /khram pa rang dgar rgyu ba de/ /khrims ltar rgyal srid skyong bar 'gyur/ /nub rgyud phyi bkag nang bsdoms de/ /nub rgyud thon 'byed chen mor 'gyur/ / 'gyur dang ma 'gyur 'gyur ba'i tshul/ /nang gi sems rgyud 'gyur ba las/ /phyi yi rnam pa 'gyur ba dag /'gyur 'gyur ri mo'i gzugs su bkod/ /378

myang chu sngon mo/dang po/gnod sbyin gang bzang rtse nas/ /lha yi bdud rtsi myang chu/ /myang gzhung ring mo brgyud de/ /gtsang ljongs gzhung la babs byung / /lhung lhung 'bab pa'i myang chu/ /lha yi yul gyi bdud rtsi/ /mi yi yul gyi gtsang chab/ /myang gzhung skye 'gro'i srog rtsa/ /bkra shis myang chu gtsang pos/ /'bru rigs sna lnga smin song / /rtsi shing g.yu lo rgyas pas/ /ri klung mdzes sdug ldan song / /bkra shis myang chu gtsang pos/ /phyugs rigs sha shed rgyas song / /sha mar thon khungs bzang bas/ /'dod yon longs spyod 'phel song / /379

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/bkra shis myang chu gtsang pos/ /o lo'i lang tsho rgyas song / /pho gzhon mo gzhon bzhin las/ /dga' spro'i 'dzum mdangs 'phyur song / /bkra shis myang chu gtsang pos/ /rgan po'i lus zungs brtan song / /rgad po rgan mo'i bzhin las/ /gzhon sha'i nyams shig thon song / /bkra shis myang chu gtsang pos/ /gser mig nya chung 'phel song / /chu nang nya mo 'khyug pas/ /nya pa gnas zos bde song / /bkra shis myang chu gtsang pos/ /ngang pa'i gshog zung rgyas song / / —'dab chags spu bkra legs pas/ /myang rgyud mkha' lam mdzes song / /bkra shis myang chu gtsang pos/ /skyid pa'i pha yul bskrun song / /pa snam bu mo mjes la/ /rgyal rtse snam bu legs song / /bkra shis myang chu gtsang pos/ /380

myang chu sngon mo/nas chang 'dzad med bskyil cing / /myang la bdud rtsi dar te/ /glu gar sna 'dren byas song / /bkra shis myang chu gtsang pos/ /chu 'khor 'khor lo bskor song / /sbrang dkar rtsam pa'i dri bzang / /lha lam dkrigs byed bgyis song / /bkra shis myang chu gtsang pos/ /chu glog 'phrul 'khor bskor song / /glog gi dra ba btsugs pas/ /mtshan mo'i smag rum bcil song / /bkra shis myang chu gtsang pos/ /skye khams bzang po bskrun song / /zhing khams khor yug legs pas/ /skye 'gro'i tshe srog bsrings song / /bkra shis myang chu gtsang pos/ /skye bor rgyal rtsal bslabs song / /gzhon nur rkyal stobs rgyas pas/ /chu klung bran du bkol song / /bkra shis myang chu gtsang pos/ /dkar gsum rdzas bzang bskyed byung / /381

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/mngar chur skad grags che la/ /dkrog kha bro ba zhim pa/ /bkra shis myang chu gtsang pos/ /dbyin 'gog dpa' bo bskyangs song / /dbyin ji mthar sgyugs btang bas/ /dpa' bo'i grong khyer grags song / /bkra shis myang chu gtsang pos/ /mkhas dbang stong phrag bsrings song /pa tshab sna snam byon pas/ /srid gsum grags pa 'bar song /bkra shis myang chu gtsang pos/ /lag shes mkhas mang bskyangs song / /rgyal rtse'i rum 'thag dar bas/ /yul mi'i 'byor pa rgyas song / /bkra shis myang chu gtsang pos/ /blo ldan bu phrug bskyangs song / /bkra shis lhun po'i byin gyis/ /gna' grong mdzes par brgyan song / /bkra shis myang chu gtsang pos/ /bsod nams zhing khams 'grub song / /paṇa chen rim byon bzhugs pas/ /382

myang chu sngon mo/sa rnams byin gyis brlabs song / /bkra shis myang chu gtsang pos/ /sa gshis sa bcud legs song / /gtsang la myang stod myang smad/ /o lo skyid pa'i pha yul/ /gnyis pa/khros pa'i myang chu gtsang po yis /shing rta lo(1950ru chu rud drangs/ /myang chu stod smad bar gsum gyi/ /skye 'gro'i lus srog nor rnams bcom/ /khros pa'i myang chu gtsang po yis /rba rlabs nam mkhar 'phyo 'dra yis/ /nying ru stag pa'i dud tshang yongs/ /shul med khyer pa ya re nga / /khros pa'i myang chu gtsang po yis/ /dmar smug khrag mdog lta bu'i chus/ /rgyal rtse lcang lho zam chen de/ /khyur mid btang ba kye ma hud/ /khros pa'i myang chu gtsang po'i nang / /brug chu'i brag rdo 'thab pa yis/ /383

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/hin rdu'i dpon dmag las byed sogs/ /gshin rje rgyal po'i khab la sgyugs/ /khros pa'i myang chu gtsang po ni/ /chu rud kyis ni brub gyur pas/ / mdza' gcugs bza' mi bu phrug rnams/ /thul pa'i sbubs shub nang du bgrongs/ /khros pa'i myang chu gtsang po ni/ /gshin rje las dmag bslebs 'dra des/ /mdzes pa'i myang gi zhing khams de/ /ro yi dri ngan dag gis khengs/ /khros pa'i myang chu gtsang po ni/ /gtum po'i gcan gzan mang po ltar/ /g.yu yi zhing thang yangs pa dag /phyugs rigs dag gi bam ros bkang / /khros pa'i myang chu gtsang po ni/ / brug pa'i 'jigs rung kha chen gyis/ /dud khyim brgyad brgya bdun cu yi/ /bkod legs sdod khang rmeg med byas/ /khros pa'i myang chu gtsang po yi /ngam nag brub chu'i phreng ba yis/ /son khal khri yi thang zhing rnams/ /384

myang chu sngon mo/gram gog chen po lta bur bsgyur/ /khros pa'i myang chu gtsang po yi/ /chu lha khros pa'i rba klong gis/ /dal 'byor rten can bdun brgya tsam/ /srog phrogs gshin rje'i zhing la bskrad/ /khros pa'i myang chu gtsang po ni/ /chu log smyon pa dang 'grogs pas/ /sran lgang chu mo'i gzhung la ni/ /ko ba btang ba bzhin du chas/ /khros pa'i myang chu gtsang po ni/ /khro ba'i chu chen du sprul pas/ /pad kha rka ru langs nas ni/ /mchi ma gtong bzhin 'dug pa 'dra/ /khros pa'i myang chu gtsang po yi/ /brub chu byung lugs krung dbyang gis/ /gsan 'phral rgud skyob za 'bras dang / /sdod gur bzo byed ras cha sbyin/ /khros pa'i myang chu gtsang po yis —sdug bsngal la gtad mang tshogs rnams/ /byams ldan krung dbyang srid gzhung gis/ /skyob dngul khri ma 'bum gyis bskyabs/ /385

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/khros pa'i myang chu gtsang po yis/ /bcom pa'i lam zam zhing mkhar sogs/ /skyob gso u yon lhan khang des/ /bskyar gso'i jus chen rgya cher bkod/ /khros pa'i myang chu gtsang po yi /chu skyon byung khul mang tshogs la/ /skyed med dngul bun gnang ba yis/ /ring por ma thogs rgud las thar/ /khros pa'i myang chu gtsang po yi /sa gshin gram thang bsgyur pa dag /bskyar gsos char chu legs pa yis/ /phyi lor lo legs byung bar grags/ /khros pa'i myang chu gtsang po yis /lcags 'brug lo (2000)ru chu log drangs/ /myang chu'i g.yas g.yon zhing khams la/ /mi bzod rgud pa gnyis pa bskyal/ /khros pa'i myang chu gtsang po ni/ /chu log dag gis brug gyur te/ /gser mdog zhing thang mu med dag /rgya mtsho brdol bzhin khyur mid btang / /khros pa'i myang chu gtsang po yi /386

myang chu sngon mo/drag tu rgyug pa'i rba klong ches/ /bkod legs khang bzang sgrig chas dag /mer mer chu yi gting du mnan / /khros pa'i myang chu gtsang po yis/ /tshangs thig lta bu'i gzhung lam dag /skad cig nyid la bsdubs pa yis/ /phyogs kun 'grim 'grul rgyun bzang chad/ /khros pa'i myang chu gtsang po yis/ /spyi 'bangs yongs kyi rgyu nor ni/ /sgor mo bye bar ri ba yi/ /rin thang brlags pa zin thor gsal/ /khros pa'i myang chu gtsang po yis/ /pa tshal la sogs dud tshang stong / /chu yi gnod 'tshe drag po yis/ /'obs gting mnan pa kye ma hud/ /khros pa'i myang chu gtsang po yis/ /zhing mu'u khri tsho bcu drug lhag /rlabs phreng 'phyo bzhin mnan pa dag / mthong tshe dbang med mig chu 'chor/ /khros pa'i myang chu gtsang po yi/ /chu skyon byung lugs gsan ma thag /387

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/dbu 'dzin kru'u zhi dngos 'byor thog /chu 'gog rgud skyob bka' bsgos mdzad/ /khros pa'i myang chu gtsang po yi /smyo chu ngan pa'i gnod 'tshe la/ /krung dbyang pu'u u drug gis ni/ /rgud skyob dngul nor gya nom sbyin/ /khros pa'i myang chu gtsang po yi /chu skyon nyen tshabs je che'i dus/ /gzhis rtse'i tang srid dpon dmag yongs/ /chu log 'gog pa'i 'thab sar zhugs/ /khros pa'i myang chu gtsang po yi/ /brub chu'i nyen khas zhum pa rnams/ /rgya mtshor byings pa'i rig byed bzhi/ /nya yi gzugs kyis bton ltar bskyabs/ /khros pa'i myang chu gtsang po yi/ /chu skyon drag po'i bskal ngan dus/ /bcings 'grol dmag gi 'thab 'dzing pas / /rang srog blos btang mdzad pa med/ /khros pa'i myang chu gtsang po yis/ /sdod khang mya ngam thang bsgyur dag /brtse ldan gung khran tang bzang gis/ /388

myang chu sngon mo/bstar sgrig khang bzang bskyar bskrun mtshar/ /khros pa'i myang chu gtsang po yis/ /myang rgyud bsnubs pa'i mjug 'bras dag /dpon 'bangs rdog rtsa gcig sgril gyis/ /bskyar bskrun mdzad brgya'i dpung la 'jug /gsum pa/g.yu 'brug sngon mo'i 'khyug bgrod lta'i/ /myang chu gtsang po'i byin rlabs kyis/ /myang stod myang smad skye 'gro rnams/ /'tshar bskyed byung 'di e ma mtshar/ /seng ge mkha' la 'phyo lta bu'i/ /myang chu gtsang po'i nga ro yi/ /myang gzhung ring mo'i skye 'gro la/ /'jigs pa bskul 'di kye ma hud/ /gtan du bde bar 'khod 'dod ni/ /sems can kun gyi rang gshis lags/ /myang chu'i rgyud kyi bde rtsa ni/ /myang chu bcos skyong legs par thug /rgyal rtse'i rdzong ud dbu khrid kyis/ /yul mi skul slong ngal brgya yis/ /389

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/sa rta lo (1978)la myang chu'i rgyud/ /chu rags las grwa spel par grags/ /tang gi byams brtse'i gziṭa skyong dang / /rdzoṭa ldan bskal bzang dus chen 'dir/ /yul mi'i blo gros rtsal stobs kyis/ /myang chur srab skon dus la babs/ /chu bed 'dzugs skrun rig byed la/ /mkhas pa'i rgya bod mkhas dbang dag /spyi bo'i gtsug tu bsten nas ni/ /lo brgya'i jus chen 'ding bar mdzod/ /rgya yi glegs bam me long las/ /tā yus chu chen btul mdzad gtam/ /rna ba'i bcud du blangs nas ni/ /bem chos myang chu gcun par bya/ /tang dang spun zla'i zhing chen gyis/ /phangs med sbyin pa'i rogs dngul gyis/ /srid pa'i mthar yang mi 'jig pa'i/ /chu rags brag ltar bslangs na mdzes/ /myang rgyud skye 'gro'i bla srog dang / /mnyam 'grogs myang chu gtsang po de/ /phan bde'i 'byung rtsar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ /390

myang chu sngon mo/myang chu bcos skyong bya bar brtson/ /bsod nams 'phrul las 'khrungs pa yi/ /myang chu gtsang por 'bod pa'i 'dis/ /dga' skyo'i zlos gar 'khrab pa ni/ /ma brjed ri mo'i gzugs su bkod/ /391

gtsang ljongs mdzes pa'i rgyan/nyi zla skar gsum mkha' yi rgyan/ /bkra shis rtags brgyad sa yi rgyan/ /bsgyur bcos sgo dbye phyug po'i rgyan/ /khrom ra'i dpal 'byor 'tsho ba'i rgyan/ /brtan lteng mthun sgril spyi tshogs rgyan/ /sna mang gnyer skyong phyug 'gyur rgyan/ /tshong zog sna brgya khrom ra'i rgyan/ /khrom ra dar rgyas tshong pa'i rgyan/ /jo ri'i rig gnas dus chen rgyan/ /ser skya bde skyid dbu khrid rgyan/ /ri klung mdzes pa lung pa'i rgyan/ /ya rabs spyod bzang yul mi'i rgyan/ /ri klung mdzes pa yul gru'i rgyan/ /shing 'dzugs nags skrun ri klung rgyan/ /lam chen pa tra rgya lam rgyan/ /'phrul 'khor sna brgya gzhung lam rgyan/ /glog sgron khra chil mtshan mo'i rgyan/ /392 bstar sgrig khang bzang grong khyer rgyan/ /

gtsang ljongs mdzes pa'i rgyan/bu mo mdzes pa pho gzhon rgyan/ /skyes pa mtshar ba mo gzhon rgyan/ /cing li sbyin bdag 'bangs kyi rgyan/ /glog 'phrul ltad mo mig gi rgyan/ /tshal rigs sna brgya tshal ra'i rgyan/ /khyim chas glog 'phrul stabs bde'i rgyan/ /kha par sna mang pho nya'i rgyan/ /rgyal gces chos gces grwa btsun rgyan/ /tshan rig dar rgyas rig gnas rgyan/ /slob grwa 'bring chung slob gso'i rgyan/ /dge rgan bzang po slob grwa'i rgyan/ /ta la'i lo ma dpe cha'i rgyan/ /chos dung dkar po dung gi rgyan/ /paṇa chen rim byon yid kyi rgyan/ /mi la ras pa sgom chen rgyan/ /mkhas dbang sa paṇa mkhas pa'i rgyan/ /'gro mgon 'phags pa rgyal gces rgyan/ /g.yu thog mgon po sman pa'i rgyan/ /mi dbang pho lha rgyal po'i rgyan/ /thang stong rgyal po lha mo'i rgyan/ /mgon po phan thogs ri 'dzegs rgyan/ / 393

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/tshe brtan sgrol ma gzhas ma'i rgyan/ /a shu rgun 'brum chang gi rgyan/ /phing phig zhim po gzhis grong rgyan/ /rgya lung phing legs khrom ra'i rgyan/ /se ma'i bro de bro yi rgyan/ /gzhis rtse'i lcags thab thab chas rgyan/ /stag lung rdza chas rdza yi rgyan/ /bkras skyed dngul bzo dngul chas rgyan/ /zon pa lha mo zon pa'i rgyan/ /mkhas pa'i dga' ston chos 'byung rgyan/ /snyan ngag me long snyan gzhung rgyan/ /mkhas pa'i rna rgyan mngon brjod rgyan/ /legs bshad ljon dbang brda sprod rgyan//sa skya legs bshad legs bshad rgyan/ /mi la'i rnam mgur mgur glu'i rgyan/ /jo mo glang ri ri tshogs rgyan/ /myang chu sngon mo myang gzhung rgyan/ /yar klung gtsang po chu bo'i rgyan/ /rtswa thang nor phyugs 'brog pa'i rgyan/ /lo legs snye ma zhing pa'i rgyan/ /hran tung khang chen thogs brtsegs rgyan/ /394

gtsang ljongs mdzes pa'i rgyan/kun khyab gling kha skyed tshal rgyan/ /bkras lhun dgon pa grong khyer rgyan/ /gtsang gi byams chen 'dzam gling rgyan/ /bde chen pho brang dbyar skyid rgyan/ /gos sku bkrams pa gtsang gi rgyan/ /lhan gyi dkar mo rtsam pa'i rgyan/ /rgyal rtse'i rdzong ri dpa' bo'i rgyan/ /rgyal rtse'i mngar phyur kha zas rgyan/ /rgyal rtse'i dkrog kha mar gsar rgyan/ /rgyal rtse'i rum 'thag kha gdan rgyan/ /rgyal rtse'i spu phrug snam bu'i rgyan/ /rgyal rtse'i mda' dmag dus chen rgyan/ /dpa' 'khor mchod rten chos sde'i rgyan/ /lha rtse'i gri chung glo gri'i rgyan/ /lha rtse'i sgra snyan rol cha'i rgyan/ /lha rtse'i bag bsregs bag leb rgyan/ /gam pa'i lug sha lug sha'i rgyan/ /gam pa'i gtsug phrug mal chas rgyan/ /mchod rten nyi chu gter chu'i rgyan/ /e ma'i zhog gog tshal gyi rgyan/ /'brong pa'i 'bri g.yag nor gyi rgyan/ /395

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/skyid grong slo ma smyug chas rgyan/ /kham bu'i chu tshan sman chu'i rgyan/ /gro mo'i nya de nya sha'i rgyan/ /dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu sman rtswa'i rgyan/ /rin spungs g.yang ṭi rdo yi rgyan/ /rin spungs g.yung mtsho mtsho lha'i rgyan/ /zangs zangs gsol mar mar gyi rgyan//pa snam bu mo mdzes pa'i rgyan/ /pa snam bya mo bya de'i rgyan/ /pa snam 'bru rigs bang mdzod rgyan/ /khang dmar star phyur phyur gong rgyan/ /gangs ri mtho po ding ri'i rgyan/ /gnya' lam bod sman sman gyi rgyan/ /gnya' lam mthongs la la mo'i rgyan/ /sa dga'i rgya gzhas rgya gzhas rgyan/ /'khrug pa'i stod gzhas gzhas kyi rgyan/ /rgyan rgyan rgyan gyis brgyan pa yi/ /gzhis rtse 'di dag bod ljongs rgyan/ /396

gsar 'khrungs me tog chun po/'dzam gling gtsug rgyan gtsang ljongs dag zhing 'dir/ /slob gso'i dus deb bdud rtsi bsil ma gang / /'bebs sems yun ring 'chang ba'i 'dod don de /de ring mngon gyur byung 'dis spro ba bsrings/ /bsgyur bcos sgo dbye'i rdzogs ldan skal bzang 'dir/ /rang rang mi rigs slob gso'i chos mthun pa'i/ /(gzhis rtse'i slob gso 〉zhes bya gsar 'khrungs 'dis/ /bdag 'dra'i skye bo'i yid kyi brtan pa 'phrog /mi rigs slob gso rgyu skar lam bzang las/ /bla med (gzhis rtse'i slob gso 〉 bsil zer can/ /kun bzod ma yi lto bar 'phro ba'i tshe/ /dge slob sa mos dga' ba'i 'dzum zhal ngoms/ /mkhas mang 'dus pa'i mdun sa rgya chen 'gran/ /legs bshad gtam gyi dga' ston 'gyed la 'gran/ /tshong zog dpa' 'byor dpyid dpal bzhad skabs 'dir/ /(gzhis rtse'i slob gso 〉 gsar skrun e ma mtshar/ /tshan rig slob gso gzhung brgya'i chu gter las/ /dgos 'dod (gzhis rtse'i slob gso 〉 sku bltams 'dis/ / 397

mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/sman ljongs dpyod ldan 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi/ /g.yul sa legs par bsham 'di dge rtsar gyur/ /mi rigs slob gso yid 'ongs skyed tshal du/ /dus deb me tog sna brgya bzhad pa'i dbus/ /〈gzhis rtse'i slob gso'i 〉'dab brgya grol ba'i tshe/ /gzhan rnams skyengs pa'i zol gyis phag tu yibs/ /gzhan 'dring mi 'jog mi rigs rang rang gi /ā li rgya mtsho kā li mkha' me las/ /'khrungs pa'i char dpal (gzhis rtse slob gso 〉yis/ /bod rigs skye dgu'i mgrin rgyan 'ongs bar shog /slob gso'i skyed tshal yangs pa'i do ra ru/ /sgyug 'dzin mkhan po bung ba'i khyu tshogs kyis/ /ldem ldem 'phur lding gar dang dbyangs 'gyur gyis/ /klog pa po yi sgra 'dzin 'jebs par shog /gsar 'khrungs dus deb dpag bsam ljon pa la/ /rigs gzhung me tog rnam par bkra ba'i khar/ /gzhan phan 'bras bu g.yur du za ba yis/ /skye 'gro'i longs spyod dpal bzang skrun par shog /khyad par kha ba ri pa'i skad yig dang / /bcu phrag rig gnas rgya mtsho'i gting byings pa'i/ /rig byed mche bas bton mdzad khyab 'jug bzhin/ /398

gsar 'khrungs me tog chun po/'dzin skyong spel ba'i rgyan du gyur par shog /bcad lhug spel ma'i lus bzang ci rigs la/ /slob gso slob khrid gtam gyis srog ldan zhing / /sgra don gab tshig nor bu'i rgyan spud de/ /'tsho ba'i nyams 'char smyug rtser bskyod par 'tshal/ /blang dor ston pa'i srid pa'i mig yod rung / /kun rmongs 'dzoms pa'i mi dmor mi tsha bas/ /tshe 'di'i bde skyid ring du bsringes ba'i phyir/ /'otsho ba kho bo'i sgyu gu'o'i'i rtse nas thothonan/ /399

dpe sgrig 'gan khur pa khros ma mthar/mdun shog jus 'god pa lis can zhung /༄sha /mig dmar tshe ring gi rtsom yig thor bu phyogs bsgrigs/(dang po/)krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang gis bskrun te bkram/'di ga'i dpe skrun khang gi glog rdul rtsis 'khor khang gis par gzhi bsgrigs/pe cin nyug hran hri shin par khang gis dpar btab/2005lo'i zla 12par dpar gzhi dang po bsgrigs/2005lo'i zla 12par par thengs dang po btab/1sdu2ma 7—80057—781da 3(snu 373rin gong sgor/ 15 00
